title: ‘We are fed up with old and low tricks’
summary: THE Chinese Embassy in Manila on Sunday dared lawmakers to act on their threat to declare China’s Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan persona non grata, saying it has grown tired of such repeated warnings. “Some anti-China politicians t
content:
THE Chinese Embassy in Manila on Sunday dared lawmakers to act on their threat to declare China’s Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan persona non grata, saying it has grown tired of such repeated warnings.

“Some anti-China politicians talked about declaring the Chinese ambassador persona non grata. Over the past 30 years, anti-China forces have been repeatedly doing the same thing to threaten our embassy. We are fed up with these old and low tricks,” the embassy said in a statement on Facebook.

“If they really want to do something, do it quickly and immediately please,” it added.

*   [Free trade deal with Canada pushed](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/news/free-trade-deal-with-canada-pushed/2448208)

The embassy said that it would not welcome lawmakers calling for the ouster of the ambassador to China.

“While diplomacy is based on reciprocity, we will not welcome them to China. Simple and fair enough,” it added.

Get the latest news
 delivered to your inbox

Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

More senators on Sunday called on the ambassador to leave the Philippines, saying China could easily defeat the country in a military conflict.

Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito and Sen. Francis Pangilinan were among the lawmakers who criticized Jing after the Chinese Embassy challenged Philippine officials to declare the envoy persona non grata.

In a video posted on his Facebook page, Ejercito addressed Jing in Mandarin, telling the ambassador the West Philippine Sea belongs to the Philippines and urging him to go home.

*   ![Image 1: OFW arrested at NAIA for estafa](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/18/1265067.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[OFW arrested at NAIA for estafa](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/news/ofw-arrested-at-naia-for-estafa/2448191)

In separate radio interviews, Ejercito described the envoy’s remarks as hostile, arrogant and undiplomatic, and could further inflame tensions between Manila and Beijing.

He said the Philippines should pursue diplomacy to improve bilateral relations, but Jing’s statements were undermining those efforts.

“He is adding fuel to the fire,” Ejercito said, adding that Manila did not want a war with China but expected Beijing to respect Philippine sovereignty.

“We do not want war. We do not want to fight China. They are super powerful, while we are only a Third World country,” he said.

*   ![Image 2: SC asked to stop courts from blocking wage orders](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/18/1265081.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[SC asked to stop courts from blocking wage orders](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/news/sc-asked-to-stop-courts-from-blocking-wage-orders/2448206)

Ejercito noted that the two countries have longstanding economic and cultural ties, including through the Filipino-Chinese community and bilateral trade.

Interviewed on DWIZ, the senator said President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was right to summon Jing but added the government must exhaust diplomatic means in addressing the dispute.

“Given his attitude, I think he should be declared persona non grata, and Beijing should replace him. If they want to improve our relationship, this ambassador will not help,” he said.

Ejercito said the Senate could consider a resolution condemning Jing’s remarks when sessions resume.

*   ![Image 3: More criminal cases seen vs VP Sara](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/19/1265093.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[More criminal cases seen vs VP Sara](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/news/more-criminal-cases-seen-vs-vp-sara/2448202)

He backed the continued modernization of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and the strengthening of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), saying the country needed a minimum credible defense capability to protect its territory.

Ejercito said his criticism was directed at China’s policies, not its people.

“I am not pro-America or pro-war. I am pro-Filipino,” he said.

Pangilinan criticized what he described as the envoy’s arrogant and condescending attitude.

“By way of diplomatic language, you can please easily leave Manila and go back to China,” Pangilinan said in a post on his Facebook page.

On Friday, Sen. Risa Hontiveros described Jing’s remarks as a form of “gray-zone” aggression intended to intimidate the Philippines without triggering outright conflict.

Hontiveros said summoning the ambassador was not enough, calling on the government to demand a formal retraction and an apology from Beijing.

If China refused, she said, the Philippines should declare Jing persona non grata and raise the issue before Asean and the United Nations General Assembly.

Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian called on Jing to apologize, describing his remarks as undiplomatic and uncalled for.

“It is not correct that a foreigner inside our country is threatening us. That’s undiplomatic and uncalled for,” Gatchalian said.

Sen. Erwin Tulfo, vice chairman of the Senate Committee on Foreign Relations, said the Philippines will not back down in the face of threats.

“Nobody in this world can bully the Philippines — whether through words or by force. Our sovereignty is not negotiable, our dignity is not for sale, and our resolve must never be mistaken for weakness,” Tulfo said.

Sen. Jinggoy Estrada urged caution on calls to declare Jing persona non grata, saying the Philippines should defend its sovereignty while keeping diplomatic channels open.

“While I share the concern and indignation his words have stirred, we must protest strongly and demand respect, without closing the doors of dialogue,” Estrada said.

“There is nothing to be gained from acting hastily in response to the Chinese envoy’s remarks,” he said.

title: Health minister decries bill subsidizing NHI premiums for most seniors - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 卫生部长谴责为大多数老年人提供国民健康保险保费补贴的法案 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月18日电 卫生部长石崇良警告说，新通过的立法全面补贴大多数老年人的国民健康保险(NHI)保费将增加年轻一代的经济负担。周五，来自反对党国民党和台湾人民党的立法机关以60票对39票通过了《老年人福利法》修正案。根据修正案，中央政府将被要求全额支付 65 岁及以上综合总收入需缴纳所得税的老年人的 NHI 保费
content:
中新社台北10月18日电 卫生部长石崇良警告说，新通过的立法全面补贴大多数老年人的国民健康保险(NHI)保费将增加年轻一代的经济负担。

周五，来自反对党国民党和台湾人民党的立法机关以60票对39票通过了《老年人福利法》修正案。

根据修正案，中央政府将被要求全额支付65岁及以上综合收入总额税率低于20%的老年人的国民健康保险费。

由于 20% 的税级仅适用于今年 133 万新台币（40,950 美元）以上的应税收入，据卫生部估计，多达 83% 的老年人符合资格。

施先生周六在接受记者采访时表示，台湾的医疗保健保费已经是世界上最低的。

施援引政府统计数据称，6岁及以下的儿童每年平均缴纳保费为新台币8,522元，但平均使用27,509点国民健康保险积分。每点的价值接近新台币 1 元，但不完全是新台币 1 元。

施说，65岁以上的人平均每年缴纳保费新台币9,912元，平均使用90,149个国民健康保险积分，是他们缴纳的保险费的九倍多。
施解释说，这些数据显示，幼儿和老年人在医疗保健服务上的使用量远多于他们支付的保费，而这一差异由工作年龄人口承担，他们生病的频率较低，平均支付的费用更高。

施说，在法案通过之前，政府已提议明年额外拨款600亿新台币，以支持国民健康保险体系。

卫生福利部在周日的一份声明中表示，按照目前的水平，每年的补贴费用约为新台币 400 亿元。该部表示，尽管保费收入因劳动力减少而下降，但随着人口老龄化，成本将会上升。

## NHI 积分解释

根据台湾国民健康保险“全球预算支付体系”，政府为每个医疗保健部门设定了固定的年度支出上限。

当医疗保健提供者提供服务时，他们会索要一定数量的 NHI“积分”，其货币价值会波动。

若医疗服务使用率较高，且所领取积分超过当期预算拨款，则积分价值低于新台币1元，医疗机构须吸收较低报销率。

近年来，每季度1点国民健康保险值在医院0.90元至1元之间波动，诊所在0.86元至1元之间波动，各地区存在差异。

（沈培尧、陈杰令、马修·马泽塔）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 18 (CNA) Health Minister Shih Chung-liang (石崇良) has warned that newly passed legislation fully subsidizing National Health Insurance (NHI) premiums for most seniors would increase the financial burden on younger generations.

The amendments to the Senior Citizens Welfare Act were passed 60-39 in the Legislature on Friday by lawmakers from the opposition Kuomintang (KMT) and Taiwan People's Party (TPP).

Under the amendments, the central government would be required to fully cover NHI premiums for people aged 65 and older whose total consolidated income is subject to an income tax rate below 20 percent.

Because the 20 percent tax bracket applies only to taxable income above NT$1.33 million (US$40,950) this year, as many as 83 percent of seniors would qualify, according to a health ministry estimate.

Speaking to reporters on Saturday, Shih said Taiwan already has some of the world's lowest health care premiums.

Citing government statistics, Shih said children aged 6 and younger pay an average of NT$8,522 a year in premiums but use an average of 27,509 NHI points. Each point is worth close to, but not exactly, NT$1.

People aged 65 and older pay an average of NT$9,912 a year in premiums and use an average of 90,149 NHI points, or over nine times what they pay in, Shih said.

The figures show that young children and seniors use far more in health care services than they pay in premiums, with the difference borne by the working-age population, who get sick less often and pay more on average, Shih explained.

Shih said that even before the bill was passed, the government had proposed allocating an additional NT$60 billion next year to shore up the NHI system.

In a statement on Sunday, the Ministry of Health and Welfare said the subsidies would cost about NT$40 billion a year at current levels. The cost would rise as the population ages, even as premium income falls because of a shrinking workforce, the ministry said.

## NHI points explained

Under Taiwan's NHI "global budget payment system," the government sets a fixed annual spending cap for each health care sector.

When health care providers deliver services, they claim a set number of NHI "points," whose monetary value fluctuates.

If use of medical services is high and the points claimed exceed the budget allocation for that period, the value of a point falls below NT$1, and medical institutions must absorb the lower reimbursement rate.

In recent years, the quarterly value of 1 NHI point has fluctuated between NT$0.90 and NT$1 for hospitals and NT$0.86 and NT$1 for clinics, with variations by region.

(By Shen Pei-yao, Chen Chieh-ling and Matthew Mazzetta)

Enditem/sfj

title: 贝森特：我今春曾要求欧洲盟友与我们一道，对中印实施次级关税但遭拒绝
summary: 美国总统特朗普周五（16日）签署了一份行政令，豁免多项涉俄制裁措施。更早时，特朗普9日在“真相社交”发文称，他与俄罗斯总统普京进行了一次“非常成功”的讨论：“双方同意，俄罗斯将立即向美国及全球市场供应超过30万吨柴油，并在11月再供应50万吨，随后立即再供应100万吨。此外，根据俄罗斯炼油厂的状况，俄方还将在短时间内供应300万吨柴油”。 发表时间： 18/10/2026 - 17:48 更改时间： 18/10/2026 - 17:51 14 分钟 浏览时间 在周日的访谈节目
content:
美国总统特朗普周五（16日）签署了一份行政令，豁免多项涉俄制裁措施。更早时，特朗普9日在“真相社交”发文称，他与俄罗斯总统普京进行了一次“非常成功”的讨论：“双方同意，俄罗斯将立即向美国及全球市场供应超过30万吨柴油，并在11月再供应50万吨，随后立即再供应100万吨。此外，根据俄罗斯炼油厂的状况，俄方还将在短时间内供应300万吨柴油”。

发表时间： 18/10/2026 - 17:48 更改时间： 18/10/2026 - 17:51

14 分钟 浏览时间

在周日的访谈节目中，当被美国全国广播公司（NBC）节目主持人韦尔克（Kristen Welker）问道，“特朗普总统签署了一项行政令，豁免了针对俄罗斯的制裁。我刚刚就此事与泽连斯基总统进行了交谈，他告诉我，此举是对普京的重大支持。为什么总统要奖赏一位入侵了乌克兰的独裁者？”

美国财政部长贝森特（Scott Bessent）回答说：“特朗普总统已明确表示，他希望杀戮能够停止。所谓的《格雷厄姆法》赋予了总统一定的灵活性，给予他60天的时间来评估局势。让我们看看实际情况究竟如何：欧洲人向俄罗斯和普京提供的资金，甚至超过了他们给予乌克兰的援助。他们仍在持续大量吞咽俄罗斯的能源”。

贝森特续称，“以（俄罗斯）亚马尔（液化天然气）设施为例，今年前6个月，该设施共发出了140批货物，其中136批运往了欧洲——具体包括前往比利时、西班牙、法国和荷兰，总价值超过80亿美元。因此，今年春天，我曾要求我们的欧洲盟友与我们一道，对中国和印度实施次级关税，但他们拒绝了。那么，为什么美国要独自承担这些负担呢？特朗普总统或许会与我们的欧洲伙伴进行沟通。美国为什么要独自行动呢？”

去年1月，贝森特在对其美国财长任命的提名听证会上曾对拜登政府的制裁政策提出过批评，并将乌克兰战争形容为自己一生中所见过的最大悲剧之一，贝森特当时说：“我认为，制裁力度不够。我认为，上一届政府是担心在大选期间导致美国国内能源价格上涨”。

就自己过去的发言，贝森特说：“首先，制裁力度实际上是翻了一倍。拜登政府在2025年1月即将卸任之际，采取了极其大胆的举措，将制裁力度增加了一倍。而我们并没有撤销这些制裁。特朗普总统对俄罗斯最大的两家能源公司——俄罗斯石油公司和卢克石油公司——实施了制裁，这对俄罗斯能源行业造成了灾难性一击。因此，在对俄制裁问题上，没有人比特朗普总统更强硬”。

贝森特续称：“周五并没有解除任何制裁。没有任何制裁被解除。（依照《格雷厄姆法》）我们设立了一个为期60天的观察期，以便审视局势发展。唯一被解除的是针对柴油的禁止贸易令。我想指出的是，英国早在5月份就豁免了其针对由俄罗斯原油提炼的柴油及航空燃油的禁运措施。那么，世界其他国家对此为何没有表现出愤慨呢？”

贝森特说：“要知道，泽连斯基总统并未批评他的欧洲伙伴。在那次采访中，他显得有些没有头绪。欧洲人正在为俄罗斯的战争机器提供资金。（2025年）美国从俄罗斯进口了价值40亿美元的产品，其中18亿美元是化肥。而欧洲人的进口额则是这一数字的十倍以上”。2025年，欧盟从俄罗斯的商品进口总额为279亿欧元，较2021年战前水平大幅下降了约90%，并非贝森特口中美国进口额的“十倍以上”。

当被主持人问道，“说到泽连斯基总统，他表示如果美国站在俄罗斯一边，乌克兰将无法获胜。一些共和党参议员认为，此举正是起到了这样的作用。那么，总统这是站在了俄罗斯一边吗？”

贝森特给予否认，并称：“再说一次，这是一种虚假的二元化。美国提供了什么？美国提供了情报。还有‘星链’；我们还允许北约成员国购买美国的武器装备，并将其转售给乌克兰。当泽连斯基总统请求提供‘爱国者’防空系统时——要知道，北约及其欧洲成员国手中拥有很多‘爱国者’系统，为什么他们迟迟不愿提供这些系统呢？德国又在哪里？为什么不给乌克兰提供‘爱国者’系统呢？”

此外，美国能源部长赖特（Chris Wright）周日在接受美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）节目采访中说：“首先，我们需要明确一点：针对俄罗斯的主要制裁措施依然全部有效。俄罗斯主要出口的产品是石油。我们不仅对俄罗斯石油实施了制裁，而且这些制裁的收紧力度前所未有——我们制裁了他们最大的石油企业。目前，俄罗斯几乎所有的石油都只能流向中国，而且是以折扣价出售，交付周期也拖得很长。因此，特朗普总统仅针对柴油出口放宽了制裁。过去一个多月里，俄罗斯唯一无法出口的产品是什么？就是柴油，因为他们自己也缺柴油”。

赖特续称：“全球范围内都面临柴油短缺，而特朗普总统正不遗余力地寻求各种途径，以减轻美国民众的成本负担。因此，如果俄罗斯能向市场额外供应并出口柴油，这将惠及美国消费者，乃至全世界。但要实现这一点，俄罗斯必须缓和与乌克兰的冲突，或者达成能源停火。他正在施加的压力，既会让美国消费者受益，也有助于推动俄乌战争走向和平”。

当稍后被主持人问道：“我想回到我最初提出的那个问题，即关于《格雷厄姆法》以及针对俄罗斯的经济制裁——这与您刚才提到的柴油协议是两码事。总统为什么要那样做（豁免制裁）？”

赖特说道：“《格雷厄姆法》并非关于对俄罗斯实施经济制裁，而是针对与俄罗斯有贸易往来的国家实施经济制裁。其中有两个具有实质意义的国家，即中国和印度。我们正在与中国就这一冲突（俄乌战争）以及我们（美中）之间的长期贸易关系进行探讨。他（特朗普）并没有终止《格雷厄姆法》规定的制裁，只是暂时暂停了这些制裁的执行”。

当被问及特朗普为何这样做时，赖特说：“这是因为当前这场冲突局势复杂多变；而这些权力依然掌握在他手中，以便在适当时机予以启用”。

title: World Food Day: Hundreds of protesters march to Parliament
summary: On Friday, 16 October 2026, hundreds of protesters marched to Parliament, calling for climate action and food sovereignty. The march took place in Cape Town on World Food Day and was organised by civil society organisations, such as the Cli
content:
On Friday, 16 October 2026, hundreds of protesters marched to Parliament, calling for climate action and food sovereignty. The march took place in Cape Town on World Food Day and was organised by civil society organisations, such as the Climate Justice Charter Movement (CJCM) and South African Food Sovereignty Campaign (SAFSC). However, the organisers were joined by multiple other civil society organisations, such as the Women on Farms Project, EcoMaties, the Cooperative and Policy Alternative Centre and Sovereign Agroecology and Food Empowerment. Protesters marched from Hanover Street in District Six to Parliament, where speeches were delivered by various civil society representatives. A memorandum was handed to parliamentary representatives, mainly calling on the government to place the country on a climate emergency footing, immediately ban harmful pesticides and adopt activists’ proposed legislation and policy documents on food sovereignty, according to SAFSC national coordinator Qhawekazi Mahlalela. “Today we bring our voices here to Parliament with a call for a fundamental transformation of our food system. We call on the government to put people before corporate profits, to support agroecology and to transition away from industrial agriculture and to recognise the role of communities in building those food systems that sustain life,” Mahlalela said during her speech outside Parliament. ### Food sovereignty and systems According to Mahlalela, the proposed food sovereignty legislation and policy are “twin documents” developed from 2015–2024 by SAFSC and CJCM activists in collaboration with allied civil society organisations and activists. These documents are intended to be guides for community organisers on the ground to solve food system and climate justice challenges, Mahlalela said. They equip organisers with knowledge of their rights but are also being used as a training tool for activists. Mahlalela added that the documents address multiple food-justice elements, such as growers’ rights regarding water, seeds, markets and finance. They imagine community-centred food systems, and food policy from a food-sovereignty perspective, she said. However, the government had failed to engage the CJCM and SAFSC when they brought the documents before Parliament in 2018 and again in 2024. This was one of the CJCM and SAFSC’s main grievances that led them to protest, Mahlalela said. ### Protesters’ grievances on World Food Day During her speech, CJCM co-chair Jessica Ngwenya highlighted the CJCM and SAFSC’s grievances about the government’s failure to engage with the activists on the proposed legislation and policy documents. The government had also failed to adopt the Climate Justice Charter, which the CJCM handed to Parliament in 2020 with the support of nearly 300 organisations, she said. According to Mahalela, the charter was developed in conjunction with communities and maps out food sovereignty, eco-mobility and rights of nature, as well as how these alternatives should help SA exit and survive the climate crisis. Ngwenya added that the government had failed to convene an emergency parliamentary sitting in 2018 to debate the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change’s Global Warming of 1.5°C report, missing an opportunity to prepare the country for worsening climate extremes and save lives. Activists march to Parliament on World Food Day on 16 October 2026. They are urging the government to declare a climate emergency ahead of the looming El Niño and to shift from reactive crisis management to a proactive, society-driven transition. (Photo: Misha Jordaan / Gallo Images) “We must ask ourselves: ‘What does it mean to mark this day in a country where so many people are going hungry? What does it mean to mark this day in a country where our food prices are constantly rising, but our salaries, our employment rates are not rising?’. “Hunger is not an inevitable crisis in this country. It is a result of a food system that puts profit before people and treats food as a commodity rather than a basic human right,” Mahalela said. She added that SA’s land, resources and power are concentrated in the hands of a few, while SA’s people should have the power to control their own food in a food-sovereignty system. In this system land, water, oceans, biodiversity and indigenous knowledge must be protected, she said. Small-scale farmers, farmworkers, fishers and community producers must be empowered and food production must be rooted in agroecology and dignity for all, she said. “It is high time. For too long our poor, small-scale farmers and impoverished communities have been entrapped in poverty. And we say enough is enough,” said Wendy Roebeck, a member of the CJCM. Seasonal farmworker Engela van Schalkwyk shared her experiences with the crowd. She detailed how her minimum wage pay is insufficient to support her until the end of the month. “Our people do the work on the farms, but the owners get big shares in the money from the grapes they export. They get the big pay, because of our people,” she said. According to Van Schalkwyk, the government should support farmworkers to build their own farms, noting that the workers have the skill, but not the resources. Activists and allied groups demanding food sovereignty march to Parliament on World Food Day. (Photo: Misha Jordaan / Gallo Images) CJCM co-chair Vishwas Satgar told the crowd that the country is facing a catastrophe, claiming that it is not prepared for the 1.5°C global warming overshoot nor the fact that the country is heating at twice the global average. “El Niño is coming. The last El Niño collapsed our food system; food prices went up. We are hungry. We are here to tell the government today, ‘Prepare the country for El Niño’,” he said. According to Satgar, the country’s lack of preparation for El Niño is a failure of leadership. “Wake up! The climate emergency is here!” Satgar chanted along with the crowd. ### Climate action and accelerating a just transition Near the end of the protest, Ngwenya read an open letter to the government. The organisations invited the government to place South Africa on a climate emergency footing and accelerate a just transition from below by supporting existing community activities, Ngwenya said. The CJCM and SAFSC had two broad demands; the first was for the government to end hunger by adopting food sovereignty. (Graphic: Iman Allie) The second was for the government to place the country on a climate emergency footing immediately. According to Ngwenya, these calls were endorsed by 220 other organisations.
](https://cdn.dailymaverick.co.za/i/3x9epS6xiQL4UyEgkkueUimK68c=/200x100/smart/filters:strip_exif()/file/attachments/orphans/Iman-WFDMarch1_660548.jpg) (Graphic: Iman Allie) ### Government representatives respond The memorandum was handed to the procedural adviser at Parliament, Perran Hahndiek. Addressing the crowd, Hahndiek said the memorandum would be lodged with National Assembly Speaker Thoko Didiza. Also present during the reading of the memorandum was the chief of staff in the Ministry of Finance, Mfuneko Toyana. Toyana said the SAFSC and CJCM’s message would be passed to the Minister of Finance and the National Treasury. Toyana added that the National Treasury has made funds available to address the effects of El Niño and that these developments would be announced on Wednesday, 21 October 2026, during the Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement. Western Cape Department of Water and Sanitation head Ntombizanele Bila-Mupariwa said she would deliver the protest’s message to the MEC and added that the MEC had already submitted a proposal with interventions to address the challenges of El Niño. Dissatisfied with the representatives’ responses, Satgar incited a chant once the final representative had finished speaking. “It’s not enough! It’s not enough! It’s not enough!” Satgar and the crowd chanted. **DM**

content:
据德国之声报道，中国企业正在走向领先地位。GoPro 曾经是运动相机的代名词。2015 年，该公司售出了约 660 万台相机，市场份额超过 70%。然而，如今这家昔日的行业先驱却在为生存而苦苦挣扎。原因在于来自中国的竞争。GoPro 最大的竞争对手是大疆（DJI）和影石创新（Insta360），它们分别于 2019 年和 2021 年进入运动相机市场。如今，全球智能手持相机的销售额中，超过 90% 来自这两家企业。

经常使用运动相机记录摩托车骑行过程的亚历山大·汉内曼（Alexander Hannemann）表示，大约两年前，他从 GoPro 转用了 Insta360。他说：“画质比 GoPro 好得多。即使我加速行驶，以每小时 80 公里的速度过弯，画面依然很好。”

GoPro 并非个例。自 2010 年前后以来，许多中国品牌已经在众多科技领域超越了西方行业领军企业，智能电视和扫地机器人就是其中的例子。

“中国产品仍然价格实惠，”加拿大企业家克里斯·佩雷拉（Chris Pereira）表示。他也是一位作家，在中国积累了超过 20 年的经验。“但与此同时，这些产品的质量也相当高。”佩雷拉补充说，这种价格与质量兼具的优势，使全球消费者购买的科技产品中，超过一半来自中国。

去年，全球售出的电动汽车中，近三分之二来自比亚迪（BYD）、小鹏汽车（Xpeng）及其他中国汽车制造商。这些企业已经将特斯拉等老牌厂商甩在身后。在扫地机器人领域，中国品牌也占据了全球市场的主导地位。美国昔日的行业先驱 iRobot，如今正面临激烈的竞争，难以与之抗衡。

佩雷拉通过自己的咨询公司 iMpact，帮助中国企业拓展海外市场。他认为，中国企业的成功主要归功于以下几个因素：深圳、杭州和上海等城市的国内市场竞争异常激烈；供应链高度整合；企业文化强调“凡事皆有可能”，能够迅速创新并作出反应。

中国的其他竞争优势还包括前所未有的工业自动化水平、人工智能（AI）在制造业中的战略性应用、监管机构较高的响应速度，以及相对低廉的劳动力成本。这些因素共同降低了生产成本，并使中国企业能够以比世界上最发达经济体更快的速度推出创新产品。

乔伊·程在 20 多年前移居美国攻读博士学位，因此同时熟悉美国消费者市场和中国制造业。他的创业公司总部设在美国，但几乎所有产品都在深圳生产。深圳是全球大量消费电子硬件产品的制造中心。

他说：“对于降低成本和加快产品开发而言，深圳的供应链几乎不可或缺。尤其是对初创企业来说，你必须迅速把产品推向消费者，否则就会被市场淘汰。”

尽管消费者越来越多地选择中国企业的产品，但对中国品牌的疑虑依然存在。一项近期公布的调查显示，超过 90% 的欧洲消费者表示，在数据安全问题上，他们不信任中国企业。与此同时，约 80% 的受访者也不信任美国企业。德国消费者的不信任程度尤其高。

德国旅游博主娜丁（Nadine）也使用大疆和影石创新的产品，但她表示，自己不会在家中使用亚洲品牌的产品。她说：“我的扫地机器人来自一家德国公司，原因就在于数据可以按照德国的相关法规进行处理。毕竟，制造商可以直接访问设备的摄像头。”她所指的是一些扫地机器人的摄像头和音频数据遭到黑客入侵的事件。

佩雷拉认为，希望进入海外市场的中国企业必须付出额外的努力来赢得消费者信任。他说：“由于缺乏信任，它们必须在产品和价格方面具备特别强的竞争力，才能让消费者选择自己。”他认为，中国企业可以通过在海外建立实体业务来缩小信任差距。例如，比亚迪计划在匈牙利开设其首家欧洲乘用车工厂，预计将在今年投入运营。

中国企业强调，它们遵守欧盟的数据保护规定。然而，美国和中国的国家安全法律在某些情况下可能要求企业向政府部门提供数据。

德国有关部门表示，对于欧洲服务器上的数据是否会被传输到国外，目前能够实施的监管仍然有限。除了数据安全问题，中国消费电子企业还因涉嫌间谍活动及其他安全风险而受到批评。近期，相关争议尤其集中在电动汽车等联网产品上。

出于安全担忧、贸易逆差以及中国企业影响力不断扩大的考虑，美国和其他一些西方国家已经对中国进口商品及企业实施关税和严格限制，并将部分企业列入黑名单。7 月底，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）政府禁止进口非美国生产的人形机器人。

中国机器人制造商 Primebot 的一名代表向德国之声（DW）表示，所有中国电子设备制造商都可能受到相关政策的影响。他说：“我们可能会尝试与一家美国本土企业合作。另一种解决办法是在美国建厂。”与此同时，欧洲各国及欧盟也正在考虑对中国企业进一步加征关税。

佩雷拉预计，关税将加速中国企业的两大发展趋势：将生产制造环节转移到海外；更加注重高端产品，与西方领先品牌展开直接竞争。

他强调：“中国政府和企业都明白，制造业必须在一定程度上转移到目标市场所在国。一方面，这是为了降低出口面临的障碍；另一方面，也是为了在当地建立信任。”他进一步解释说：“一旦关税抵消了低端市场的价格优势，企业就只能依靠高端市场的利润空间。因此，中国品牌将越来越多地与西方老牌企业直接竞争，而对于这些西方品牌来说，消费者信任是一个核心因素。”

随着中国的经济影响力不断增强，西方企业正努力维持自身的竞争优势。卡兹·默钱特（Kaz Merchant）在一家位于英国、从事 IT 硬件进出口业务的公司工作。他认为，尤其是规模较小的企业，必须找到适合自己的地理市场或细分市场。他说：“它们需要找到一个独特的产品优势，针对某个特定地区，而中国企业在这个地区可能还不具备相应的优势。或者，它们必须与中国企业建立合作伙伴关系。”

佩雷拉认为，欧洲需要解决的一个重要问题，是提高监管机构的响应速度。他说：“中国的监管机构会迅速、明确地告诉企业哪些事情可以做。正是这种高效率，让企业能够不断发展，并在海外市场取得成功。”他进一步指出：“如果企业必须等待数周才能得到答复，就会失去客户。”

# Chinese embassy to lawmakers on threat vs ambassador: Do it

[By The Manila Times](https://www.manilatimes.net/author/the-manila-times "The Manila Times")

 October 18, 2026

 1020

[Resize](https://manilatimes.net/2026/10/18/news/chinese-embassy-to-lawmakers-on-threat-vs-ambassador-do-it/2448124)

*   ![Image 16: font icon small](https://manilatimes.net/theme_manilatimes/images/font-small.svg)Small
*   ![Image 17: font icon medium](https://manilatimes.net/theme_manilatimes/images/font-medium.svg)Medium
*   ![Image 18: font icon large](https://manilatimes.net/theme_manilatimes/images/font-large.svg)Large

[![Image 19: Add The Manila Times as a preferred source on Google](https://manilatimes.net/theme_manilatimes/images/google-preferred-source.png)](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=manilatimes.net "Add The Manila Times as a preferred source on Google")

**MANILA, Philippines —**The Chinese Embassy in Manila on Sunday dared lawmakers to act on their threat to declare China's Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan persona non grata, saying it has grown tired of such repeated warnings.

"Some anti-China politicians talked about declaring the Chinese ambassador persona non grata. Over the past 30 years, anti-China forces have been repeatedly doing the same thing to threaten our embassy. We are fed up with these old and low tricks," the embassy said in a statement on Facebook.

"If they really want to do something, do it quickly and immediately please," it added.

*   [PH embassy in London concerned as Filipina's viral interview of life in UK draws criticisms](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/17/news/ph-embassy-in-london-concerned-as-filipinas-viral-interview-of-life-in-uk-draws-criticisms/2447915)

The embassy said that it would not welcome lawmakers calling for the ouster of the ambassador to China.

"While diplomacy is based on reciprocity, we will not welcome them to China. Simple and fair enough," it said.

title: Calls mount to expel Chinese ambassador
summary: **(UPDATE)**CALLS to expel Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan mounted over the weekend as anger grew over Chinese Embassy remarks daring lawmakers to declare the envoy persona non grata. Former Surigao del Norte representative and governor Robert
content:
**(UPDATE)**CALLS to expel Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan mounted over the weekend as anger grew over Chinese Embassy remarks daring lawmakers to declare the envoy persona non grata.

Former Surigao del Norte representative and governor Robert Ace Barbers on Saturday called on Jing to leave the Philippines immediately and criticized the Chinese Embassy remarks.

“He should go back to China immediately,” Barbers told The Manila Times.

*   [Chinese embassy to lawmakers on threat vs ambassador: Do it](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/18/news/chinese-embassy-to-lawmakers-on-threat-vs-ambassador-do-it/2448124)

Barbers also mocked Jing’s declaration that China “loves peace,” citing years of confrontations in the West Philippine Sea, including water cannon attacks on Filipino vessels, the use of machetes against Filipino soldiers, and the ramming of Philippine ships.

Barbers said he was “totally charmed and disarmed” by the ambassador’s “sweet remarks,” questioning whether Filipinos should feel reassured by China’s claims of peaceful intentions despite its actions at sea.

He accused the envoy of abusing Philippine hospitality and challenging the country’s sovereignty, warning Filipinos against accepting what he described as China’s provocative posture.

Barbers also took aim at lawmakers he accused of remaining silent over Jing’s remarks, referring to them as “DDS” (die-hard Duterte supporters) and “Tsina-tors.”

“I am also not surprised that the DDS and the Tsina-tors are firmly exercising their constitutionally guaranteed right to remain silent in the face of this most blatant and in-your-face challenge of sovereignty,” he said.

*   ![Image 1: Even Marcos wouldn’t want Chinese envoy expelled](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/18/1265078.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Even Marcos wouldn’t want Chinese envoy expelled](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/opinion/columns/even-marcos-wouldnt-want-chinese-envoy-expelled/2448203)

The controversy began after remarks by Jing were reported, where he asserted that China could “easily win" against the Philippines if it chose to “use force” in the West Philippine Sea but would not do so because “we love peace.”

President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Coast Guard officials, and lawmakers viewed the comment as a direct, undiplomatic threat against the country.

Sen. Risa Hontiveros said merely summoning the ambassador was insufficient and demanded a formal apology, raising the possibility of declaring him persona non grata.

In response to lawmakers considering his expulsion, the Chinese Embassy in Manila posted a sharp rebuttal on social media:

*   ![Image 2: OFW arrested at NAIA for estafa](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/18/1265067.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[OFW arrested at NAIA for estafa](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/news/ofw-arrested-at-naia-for-estafa/2448191)

“Some senators and House representatives are talking about declaring the Chinese ambassador persona non grata. Is this threat or coercion? But anyway, just do it. Otherwise, STOP BLUFFING.

The public-dare-stoked lawmakers' anger. Akbayan Rep. Perci Cendaña condemned the taunt as disrespectful and arrogant behavior from a foreign envoy, citing it as the breaking point to formally demand his immediate deportation.

“An arrogant, obnoxious visitor. How long are we going to tolerate this? This Chinese ambassador should be sent home,” Cendaña said in a social media post.

Sen. Francis Pangilinan said: “By way of diplomatic language, you can please easily leave Manila and go back to China.”

*   ![Image 3: SC asked to stop courts from blocking wage orders](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/18/1265081.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[SC asked to stop courts from blocking wage orders](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/19/news/sc-asked-to-stop-courts-from-blocking-wage-orders/2448206)

Hontiveros said the Chinese envoy’s statement was meant to intimidate.

“An ambassador who threatens his host country has crossed a line,” she said.

Following Marcos’ announcement that he intends to meet with Quan, the Chinese Embassy said Quan welcomes the opportunity to speak with the president.

“Ambassador Jing looks forward to exchanging views on certain important and sensitive issues with the president. Especially how to prevent some individuals from pushing bilateral relations into a dangerous situation,” the embassy said.

The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) previously warned that declaring a diplomat persona non grata is an "option of last resort" that carries heavy diplomatic and reciprocal consequences.

“It also carries tremendous implications moving forward, such as reciprocal action or other countermeasures in other areas,” the DFA said.

title: 非洲:索马里大选延至2027有争议

content:
1.   [回到首页](https://rfi.fr/cn/)
2.   /[中国](https://rfi.fr/cn/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD/)

RFI 法广中文 / 非洲时事

在东非国家索马里（la Somalie），在一项引入普选的选举改革框架内，原定2026年的大选现已延后。依照新的选举时间表，立法选举（les législatives）将于2027年4月展开，总统选举（la présidentielle）则定于2027年5月进行。这是本台法广非洲组（RFI Afrique）今天（2026年10月18号周日）刊出的最新法文消息之一。索马里独立国家选举委员会（la Commission électorale nationale indépendante）于本周四对外宣布的这一安排引发争议。索马里的中文国名也有译作索馬利亞（Federal Republic of Somalia）。

发表时间： 18/10/2026 - 22:58 更改时间： 18/10/2026 - 23:06

14 分钟 浏览时间

RFI carte d'archive / Afrique - Somalie et sa capitale Mogadiscio.](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/220de308-cb30-11f1-90a3-2d1c143cdef3/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-18-D-FMM-Image-Afrique-Somalie-carte-archive-RFI.jpg)

 法广(RFI)存档地图 / 非洲 - 索马里：首都是摩加迪沙（Mogadiscio） RFI carte d'archive / Afrique - Somalie et sa capitale Mogadiscio. © Studio FMM

[![Image 2: 法广(RFI)存档地图 / 非洲 - 索马里：首都是摩加迪沙（Mogadiscio） RFI carte d'archive / Afrique - Somalie et sa capitale Mogadiscio.](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/220de308-cb30-11f1-90a3-2d1c143cdef3/w:1024/2026-10-18-D-FMM-Image-Afrique-Somalie-carte-archive-RFI.jpg) 法广(RFI)存档地图 / 非洲 - 索马里：首都是摩加迪沙（Mogadiscio） RFI carte d'archive / Afrique - Somalie et sa capitale Mogadiscio. © Studio FMM](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9C%8B/20261018-rfi%E6%B3%95%E5%BB%A3-%E5%B0%BC%E5%8F%A4%E6%8B%89-%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2-%E7%B4%A2%E9%A6%AC%E9%87%8C%E5%A4%A7%E9%81%B8%E5%BB%B6%E8%87%B32027%E6%9C%89%E7%88%AD%E8%AD%B0)
位于非洲之角(la[Corne de l’Afrique](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/corne-de-l-afrique/))的[索马里](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E7%B4%A2%E9%A9%AC%E9%87%8C/)（la [Somalie](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/somalie/)）终于确定了新一届大选的时间表。本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）于2026年10月18号星期天刊出的法文消息说，立法选举定于2027年4月投票，随后将在5月份进行总统选举。索马里独立国家选举委员会于10月15日（周四）宣布了这一安排。上述选举原定是在今年（2026年）举行，但为了推进旨在建立“普选制度”（le suffrage universel,）的选举改革，而被推迟。

[![Image 3: Sheikh Mohamud Hassan, Rais wa Somalia](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/4f486602-1a08-11f0-ad08-005056bf30b7/w:1024/2025-03-28T194711Z_1852271011_RC21ZAANYA9P_RTRMADP_3_SOMALIA-USA-DIPLOMACY.JPG) 存档图片 / 非洲 ：索马里总统哈桑·谢赫·马哈茂德。 Image d'archive / Afrique - Somalie : Instaurer le suffrage universel, une volonté forte du président, Hassan Cheikh Mohamoud. Ici, le président somalien Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. (illustration) REUTERS - Annegret Hilse / archive RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/hassan-cheikh-mohamoud/)
同一法文报道说，任期即将届满的索马里现总统哈桑·谢赫·马哈茂德（le président somalien [Hassan Sheikh Mohamud](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/hassan-cheikh-mohamoud/)）有强烈的意愿要实现普选。那将是索马里民众自​​1969年以来首次能够按照“一人一票”（une personne, un vote）的原则进行投票。不过，这一改革和新的选举时间表已经遭受强烈反对。

**--****索马里推迟大选引起争议****--**

据本台法广（RFI）[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)通讯员卡艾乐（Gaëlle Laleix）于发自东非次区的法文报道，这一选举计划面临两方面的异议。首先是反对派（l’opposition）。曾于2017年至2022年担任过索马里总统职务的总统选举候选人之一：穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉希·穆罕默德（[Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed, dit Mohamed Farmaajo](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/mohamed-abdullahi-farmajo/)）表示：“这个单方面的选举进程对索马里国家构成一种威胁。”

[![Image 4: 存档图片 / 非洲：索马里：穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉希·穆罕默德（Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed, dit Mohamed Farmaajo） Image d'archive / Afrique : le président de la Somalie Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed, alias Farmajo, ici à New York, le 23 septembre 2019.](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8a3991a0-0faf-11ea-a4e9-005056a99247/w:1024/063_1176667261_0.jpg) 存档图片 / 非洲：索马里：穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉希·穆罕默德（Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed, dit Mohamed Farmaajo） Image d'archive / Afrique : le président de la Somalie Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed, alias Farmajo, ici à New York, le 23 septembre 2019. Riccardo Savi / GETTY IMAGES NORTH AMERICA / AFP](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/mohamed-abdullahi-farmajo/)
另一位前总统谢里夫·谢赫·艾哈迈德（[Sharif Sheikh Ahmed](https://www.rfi.fr/en/tag/sharif-sheikh-ahmed/)）补充说：“这一举措可能会导致出现‘平行选举’的风险和政治不稳定（une instabilité politique）。”

[![Image 5: Shugaban Somalia Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/74e42514-14b3-11ea-a946-005056bf7c53/w:1024/Sharif%20Sheikh%20Ahmed_0.JPG) Image d'archive / Afrique : Somalie - Sharif Sheikh Ahmed 非洲 - 索马里：前总统谢里夫·谢赫·艾哈迈德（Sharif Sheikh Ahmed) REUTERS/Murad Sezer](https://www.rfi.fr/en/tag/sharif-sheikh-ahmed/)
同一法文报道接着继续指出，另一方面的反对来自两个联邦成员州：邦特兰（[Puntland](https://www.rfi.fr/en/tag/puntland/)）和朱巴兰（Jubaland）。这两个加入联邦的州都认为，现任总统哈桑·谢赫·马哈茂德（Hassan Sheikh Mohamoud）所推行的选举改革，唯一目的就是延长其权力。

**--****索马里准备与普选制接轨****–**

本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）的报道介绍说，迄今为止，[索马里](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E7%B4%A2%E9%A6%AC%E9%87%8C/)的选举一直采取间接方式，并基于氏族制度(**Système clanique**)。由长老们（les anciens）指定议会成员，再由议会成员选出总统。若实行普选，将会大幅削弱氏族在政治游戏（le jeu politique）中的影响力，并增强执政当局的首脑（le chef de l’exécutif.）。

[![Image 6: 存档图片 / 非洲 - 索马里:坐落于首都摩加迪沙（Mogadiscio）的总统府。 Image d'archive / Afrique ：une vue du palais présidentiel à Mogadiscio, en Somalie, le 28 décembre 2021.](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/c8bdd970-6e95-11ed-a7db-005056bfb2b6/w:1024/2022-11-27T191203Z_866562579_RC2ONR9OLMUA_RTRMADP_3_SOMALIA-ATTACKS.JPG) 存档图片 / 非洲 - 索马里:坐落于首都摩加迪沙（Mogadiscio）的总统府。 Image d'archive / Afrique ：une vue du palais présidentiel à Mogadiscio, en Somalie, le 28 décembre 2021. © FEISAL OMAR / REUTERS](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261018-somalie-le-calendrier-pour-les-%C3%A9lections-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9rales-est-d%C3%A9j%C3%A0-contest%C3%A9)
本台法广（RFI）[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)通讯员在这篇法文报道的最后一个段落中引述[战略研究所]（Institut des études stratégiques）女研究员塞拉姆·塔德塞·德米西（Mme Selam Tadesse Demissie）的分析指出，在索马里的政治生活中，普选是一个“频繁提及但尚未实现”的计划。她建议要“循序渐进”（_une approche par étape_），从地方选举开始。她提醒说：“否则，索马里将停留于一种恶性循环，即每一次选举都会成为引发冲突的导火索。”

（ 翻译和编辑：法广[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/)电台记者 尼古拉）

【大紀元2026年10月18日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）10月18日，逾五千名來自台灣、韓國、日本、香港、澳門、馬來西亞、印尼、美國、丹麥與澳洲等地的部分法輪功學員齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會（台灣法會）。

今年台灣法會有18位法輪功學員上台發言。他們分享了在工作及日常生活中依循「真、善、忍」原則修煉的身心受益的體會，包括推廣神韻、發揚傳統文化以提升台灣各地社區文化素養及在中共迫害法輪功的27年中持續向世人講真相過程中的心得，也有學員分享了開天目後親歷的奇事。

## 自行車選手訓練途中遭嚴重車禍 修煉法輪功現奇跡

高雄學員莊博尹說，2024年7月他在訓練途中與一輛對向的貨車迎面相撞，造成臉部撕裂、氣胸、血胸及肝臟嚴重破裂。住院期間，父親拿了一本法輪功的主要著作《轉法輪》給他，讀完第一講，隔天他明顯感覺體力大幅恢復。

[![Image 5: 2026年10月18日，來自台灣、韓國、日本、香港、澳門、馬來西亞、印尼、美國、丹麥與澳洲等地的部分法輪功學員逾五千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會。（許基東／大紀元）](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872043-2610180440282378.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872043-2610180440282378.jpg)

2026年10月18日，來自台灣、韓國、日本、香港、澳門、馬來西亞、印尼、美國、丹麥與澳洲等地的部分法輪功學員逾五千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會。（許基東／大紀元）

莊博尹說，在普通病房他通讀了《轉法輪》三遍，並忍痛堅持煉功，身體恢復速度超出預期，醫生評估後為他拔除胸管，連原本需要進行的整形手術都不需要了。出院第一天他就重返訓練，回診時，醫生感到不可思議。他更在兩個半月後的自行車比賽中奪下第二名，所有車友都覺得這簡直是奇跡。

修煉前，他看著某些車友表現一般，比賽時卻能拿下冠軍，心裡便會妒忌；面對那些天才選手，也常懊惱自己能力不足。修煉後，他逐漸放下妒忌心與比較的心態，不再因焦慮失眠影響表現，能更加保持冷靜，靈活地改變戰術應賽。

面對隊友，他改變了態度，由嚴厲指責改以耐心分析、幽默善意的提醒，並尊重對方所有的努力和付出，使建議更容易被接受，也改善了團隊氣氛。

面對家人，他由過去的缺少耐心、語氣嚴苛且帶有掌控欲，轉為語氣溫和與善意溝通，給予家人理解與關心。

## 推廣神韻 提升台灣各地社區文化素養

桃園學員林紫榆分享了她在推廣神韻過程中的修煉體會。2025年10月中旬回到台灣後，她就想要如何用兩個多月時間有效率地推廣神韻。她靜心學法增長了智慧，決心「Cold Calling說明會」的方式，自己一人主動聯繫各地社區發展協會，舉辦神韻說明會。

[![Image 6: 2026年10月18日，來自台灣、美國、加拿大、日本、韓國、馬來西亞及香港的部分法輪功學員逾五千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會。（宋碧龍／大紀元）](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872084-261018070517100311.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872084-261018070517100311.jpg)

2026年10月18日，來自台灣、美國、加拿大、日本、韓國、馬來西亞及香港的部分法輪功學員逾五千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會。（宋碧龍／大紀元）

「每一個接通的電話，都是有緣人。」林紫榆逐漸學會以堅定、尊重對方的方式溝通。在一場神韻說明會中，當時假日的票快賣完了，有位太太說，聽說神韻很好看，她和先生都想看，如果沒有5,000元（台幣）的票，她就不看。這話給了她很大的觸動和啟發。後來只要有人嫌票價貴時，她就舉這位太太為例供對方參考，民眾都會接過資料研究一番。

她說，雖然單獨撥打陌生電話，但是自己並不孤獨，有很多團隊同修默默接力舉辦神韻說明會。她體會到，說明會能讓民眾了解神韻演出的內容並對傳統文化產生共鳴，進而訂票觀賞神韻，提升了各地社區的文化素養。2026年她開發了60餘場說明會，也體會到從Cold Calling、主講、公關、設備到後續接力過程中，同修們形成整體、齊心救人的堅定力量。

## 面對中共跨境迫害 助神韻順利演出

在國防科技研究單位工作的學員韋志龍說，他以「真、善、忍」對待同仁，並能很有效率地突破了關鍵技術研發，成功開發出許多新產品，完成了國防自主任務，深受長官和同仁的信任，得以在職場上從基層一路升遷到現在的主管職位。上司鼓勵他攻讀博士，未來他更有機會晉升到更高一級的管理職位。他對此抱持順其自然的態度，並帶著慈悲心持續在網絡上向更多可貴的中國人講真相。

[![Image 7: 2026年10月18日，來自台灣、韓國、日本、香港、澳門、馬來西亞、印尼、美國、丹麥與澳洲等地的部分法輪功學員逾五千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會。（許基東／大紀元）](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872042-2610180440162378.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872042-2610180440162378.jpg)

2026年10月18日，來自台灣、韓國、日本、香港、澳門、馬來西亞、印尼、美國、丹麥與澳洲等地的部分法輪功學員逾五千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會。（許基東／大紀元）

韋志龍提到，他今年1月承接了神韻在台灣巡迴演出某場的後勤安全組協調工作。在演出前的一個晚上的10點左右收到通知，館方稱收到兩封恐嚇信件，因此臨時要求主辦單位當天須完成維護安全計劃書。

他詢問全台保安協調人，他們均表示沒有案例可參考；他放下怕麻煩的想法，站在館方角度思考問題，撰寫維安疏散計劃書，最終他得以順利在晚上12點前完成計劃。

雖然館方這次在維安過程中要求很高，但他們積極配合。最後一場演出結束時，館長放下緊繃的臉，露出燦爛的笑容，祝賀演出圓滿成功，並感謝他們的配合。

## 生活中所遇到的事絕非偶然 應把握機會講真相

台北學員曹慧玲1998年開始修煉法輪功。她說，在未修煉前，就相信命運是天定的。父母過世時，她悲痛萬分；之後她放下對父母的依戀，才不難過了。她得法後體悟到，修煉大法，是對父母最好的回報。

曹慧玲的先生是在社會上有相當影響力的張教授，她回顧了三年前的一段心路歷程。當時她在社團課程中獲知她的先生已送醫搶救，她努力保持平靜，搭計程車趕赴醫院；她才在急救室待了不久，先生便被轉到往生室。

[![Image 8: 2026年10月18日，來自台灣、美國、加拿大、日本、韓國、馬來西亞及香港的部分法輪功學員逾五千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會。（宋碧龍／大紀元）](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872086-261018071144100311.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872086-261018071144100311.jpg)

2026年10月18日，來自台灣、美國、加拿大、日本、韓國、馬來西亞及香港的部分法輪功學員逾五千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會。（宋碧龍／大紀元）

在先生搶救和處理喪葬期間，她和醫師、禮儀社人員及前來張教授追思會的親友、同儕、長官講了法輪功真相。她分享親歷大法修煉的神奇。台灣1999年9.21地震時，他們在震央山頂的茶園絲毫未損；她的公公煉功，近90高齡安詳離世，身體冷凍兩週後依舊柔軟。

在這期間有親共的教授及幾位親共、罵台的留美同學都肯定張教授的奉獻。有些社會精英對「真、善、忍」產生興趣，甚至到她家了解法輪功。

她提到，今年國際扶輪年會期間活動頻繁，加上推廣《超限戰》特映會，雖然感到很累，但仍然出席了有許多國際友人參加的扶輪社晚宴，順利完成了自己想做的事。她認為，生活中所遇到的事絕非偶然，務必要把握機會救人。

## 新竹學員分享天目看到的神奇景象

新竹學員何遠談到，他修煉沒多久，就開了天目（位於兩眉之間，即俗稱的開天眼），可以看到另外空間的奇特景象，比如他跟家人到歐洲旅行時，看到很多宏偉的大教堂上方有小小的、跟東方的龍不一樣的飛龍在高處接近屋頂的地方飛；在亞洲，他也發現很多寺院外面的天空上有連綿不絕的寺院建築無限延伸，很宏偉、壯觀。

[![Image 9: 2026年10月18日，來自台灣、美國、加拿大、日本、韓國、馬來西亞及香港的部分法輪功學員逾5千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會（台灣法會）。（宋碧龍／大紀元）](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872212-261018070510100311.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14872212-261018070510100311.jpg)

2026年10月18日，來自台灣、美國、加拿大、日本、韓國、馬來西亞及香港的部分法輪功學員逾5千人齊聚台北和平籃球館，參加2026台灣法輪大法修煉心得交流會（台灣法會）。（宋碧龍／大紀元）

台灣法會10月18日召開前夕，法輪功學員於17日在台北中正紀念堂前舉行大型排字活動。何遠分享，歷年參加排字時，他都能看到另外空間的景象，有一次看到金色的大光柱從排字學員組成的圖案裡往上伸，高到看不到頂；另一次看到從排字圖案裡衝出一條身體巨大的金龍；還有一年，他看到兩邊的黃瓦屋頂上面坐著許多神在看排字；另一年，他看到有一排大神圍著排字場地站成一圈觀看排字。

修煉26年的何遠說，他堅持每天學法，為解決學法時走神的問題，他開始每天背大法書中的若干段落，之後逐步增加進度，至今將大法書背完約9輪。背法能促使他過好心性關。他提到，修煉要向內找，但起初就是找不到自己的問題；後來他體會到，要找出是哪一顆心在起作用，一定是內心有執著才導致行為的產生。他找到自己存在堅持己見、爭鬥心、妒忌心、面子心等執著，並發現它們、去掉它們；他還體會到，要放下認為自己對的心、增加包容。

責任編輯：張憲義#

title: 一文读懂：中国有权要求美国军舰“无害通过”前事先通知吗？国际法怎么说？

content:
中国星期二(10月20日)派遣海军力量监视美国海军查尔斯顿号(USS Charleston)在南中国海萨比纳浅滩(Sabina Shoal)附近的航行。美国则表示，中国试图执行其非法海洋主张，破坏地区稳定；美国将继续在国际法允许的范围内开展海空行动。

美国国务院美国东部时间星期二晚间在回应美国之音时表示，维护海洋自由、遵守国际海洋法对整个国际社会都至关重要。美国将继续在国际法允许的任何地方飞行、航行和行动，包括南中国海。

那么，中国是否有权要求美国军舰在“无害通过”相关海域前事先通知，甚至获得批准？美国为什么认为自己有权继续行动？萨比纳浅滩的自然属性又与这场争议有什么关系？

**萨比纳浅滩的特殊之处**

萨比纳浅滩位于菲律宾巴拉望岛以西约75海里。菲律宾称其为埃斯科达浅滩(Escoda Shoal)，并认为它位于菲律宾的200海里专属经济区内。中国称其为仙宾礁。

其中的一个争议，是萨比纳浅滩究竟属于什么类型的自然地物，以及它在国际海洋法下能够产生哪些海洋权利。

耶鲁法学院高级研究学者， 法学教授彼得·达顿(Peter Dutton)说，萨比纳浅滩是一处低潮高地(low-tide elevation)，并非能够独立产生领海等海洋权利的岛屿。

“萨比纳浅滩是一处低潮高地，这意味着该浅滩没有任何部分能够永久露出水面。根据国际法，低潮高地被视为最近沿海国家大陆架的一部分。在这种情况下，最近的沿海国家是菲律宾。”他告诉美国之音。

这一问题涉及《[联合国海洋法公约](https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part2.htm)》(United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea，简称UNCLOS)第13条。该条规定，低潮高地是指在低潮时露出水面、高潮时被淹没的自然形成陆地区域。如果低潮高地位于大陆或岛屿领海外界以内、距离不超过领海宽度，其低潮线可以用于测算领海宽度；如果它完全位于大陆或岛屿领海外，且距离超过领海宽度，则不拥有自己的领海。

通俗地说，一片浅滩不会因为退潮时露出水面，就自动成为一座可以产生领海和专属经济区的岛屿。

达顿还说：“作为一处低潮高地，萨比纳浅滩本身不拥有领海或其他海洋权利。除非附近其他地物的领海覆盖该浅滩，否则浅滩周边海域属于享有航行等自由的海域。不过，即使在这种情况下，像‘查尔斯顿’号这样的军舰，在法律上仍有权在浅滩周边行使无害通过权。”

**中国有没有权要求美国军舰事先通知？**

中国称其对南中国海包括萨比纳浅滩的广泛海域拥有领海主权，并反对美国军舰在其所称的相关海域开展行动。

中国解放军南部战区海军新闻发言人尹刚海军大校星期二通报，美军查尔斯顿号当天凌晨“冲闯南沙群岛仙宾礁（菲称萨比纳礁）附近海域。”

澳大利亚西悉尼大学法学院副教授洛厄尔·包蒂斯塔(Lowell Bautista)告诉美国之音，中国不能仅凭自己的主权主张，就要求外国军舰在周边海域航行前获得许可或提前通知。

萨比纳浅滩的自然属性已经决定了这一点，但即使是一国领海和专属经济区，外国船舶均享有国际法保护的“无害通过权”。根据《联合国海洋法公约》，“无害通过”即“继续不停和迅速”通过。“无害通过”的军舰不会展开任何军事演练和直升机升空等行动。

包蒂斯塔解释，根据《联合国海洋法公约》第58条和第87条，各国船舶，包括军舰，在专属经济区内享有航行自由，通常不需要事先获得沿海国许可。专属经济区则可延伸至基线以外200海里。沿海国在这里主要享有渔业、海底资源开发等方面的权利。

“中国主张，外国在专属经济区内进行军事活动须征得中国同意，但这一观点并未得到《联合国海洋法公约》的支持，也遭到大多数海洋国家的反对。无论如何，过境属于行使航行自由的行为，而航行自由是《公约》所保护的最基本自由。”他告诉美国之音。

但1992年中国出台的《中华人民共和国领海及毗连区法》要求外国军用船舶进入中国领海，须经中国政府批准，即便是“无害通过”。

“即使在领海内，沿海国拥有的管辖权要强得多，《联合国海洋法公约》第17条仍承认所有国家的船舶，包括军舰，均享有无害通过权，但须遵守《公约》规定的相关要求。”包蒂斯塔说。领海通常延伸至海岸基线以外12海里，沿海国在这里享有主权。

他补充说，虽然美国不是《联合国海洋法公约》的缔约国，但美国接受并依据习惯接受公约中的许多航行自由规则。中国则是公约缔约国，受其相关规定约束。

**美国的立场：航行自由不需要中国批准**

美国国务院就此事回应美国之音时表示，维护海洋自由、遵守国际海洋法对整个国际社会都至关重要。美国将继续在国际法允许的范围内开展行动，包括在南中国海飞行和航行。

国务院指责中国试图执行其所称的非法海洋主张，损害了地区稳定，也侵害了美国及其他国家的合法权利和自由。

美国的立场是：不能因为中国声称对某片海域拥有权利，就认定美国军舰必须先得到中国批准才能航行。

**核心总结：**

根据《联合国海洋法公约》第13条，萨比纳浅滩的自然属性决定其附近地区不能被称为领海，所以中国对美国军舰的指控并没有法律依据。

根据《联合国海洋法公约》第58条和第87条，各国船舶，包括军舰，在专属经济区内享有航行自由，通常不需要事先获得沿海国许可。

根据《联合国海洋法公约》第17条，即使是在领海内，外国军舰原则上也享有无害通过权；中国要求外国军舰进入其领海前事先获得批准的立场，本身就不符合国际法的规定。

title: Title deeds key to unlocking SA agriculture’s full potential
summary: South Africa’s agriculture is entering a period of change, which may bring shared prosperity. For some time, we have talked about the country having “two agricultures”: one commercially oriented and white, and one resource-poor, smallholder
content:
South Africa’s agriculture is entering a period of change, which may bring shared prosperity. For some time, we have talked about the country having “two agricultures”: one commercially oriented and white, and one resource-poor, smallholder and black.

South Africa’s land history largely explains these disparities, but inefficiencies in land reform have also compounded them.

The South African government has acquired land in the open market over the years but hasn’t successfully transferred it to deserving black farmers with title deeds.

Farmers have typically received short-term leases, which hindered their agricultural possibilities. But this is changing. The government is now releasing the state land with title deeds.

Speaking in Stutterheim in Eastern Cape on 8 October 2026, President Cyril Ramaphosa underscored the point that the state-owned land would be transferred to beneficiaries with title deeds.

This was a build-up to the message the President has already underscored on 2 June 2026, when he delivered the Presidency’s Budget Vote speech, which carried vital messages for the long-term growth of South Africa’s agriculture.

### **Productive land**

Among other things, the President stated that “access to productive land is essential to grow our agricultural output further, create jobs and lift people out of poverty. Over time, the government has acquired around 2.5 million hectares of land under the Proactive Land Acquisition Strategy programme”.

He further stated that “this land has generally been leased to beneficiaries on a short-term basis, which limits their ability to borrow money, invest in the land, grow agricultural production and contribute to the rural economy”.

We concur and believe the lack of title deeds has been the major constraint to inclusive growth in South Africa’s agriculture. With the President now signalling the start of the title-deeds release process, we may start to see some positive action to grow the sector.

The President further stated that “as part of our efforts to revitalise rural economies, to strengthen land rights and support the inclusion of black farmers in commercial agriculture, we have embarked on a concerted programme to release this land with title deeds to deserving beneficiaries. The Minister of Land Reform and Rural Development will outline the details of the programme to convert agricultural leases to title deeds.”

Essentially, this step is fundamental to achieving the goals outlined in Chapter 6 of the National Development Plan (NDP) and, thereafter, in the Agriculture and Agro-processing Master Plan (AAMP). Both documents highlighted the sector’s potential to grow and create new jobs. In fact, the NDP indicates that the sector and its value chain could create close to a million new jobs.

### Title deeds open up job opportunities

Matumeleng Jali removes covers that keep soil cool and deter pests before harvesting spinach at the Costa farm in Klippoortje, Boksburg. (Photo: Felix Dlangamandla)

Part of the prerequisites for those jobs was through strengthening land rights and allocating the land in the government’s books to the deserving beneficiaries. Over time, South Africa’s primary agriculture sector has delivered jobs, from 718,000 at the end of 2012, when the NDP was published, to 960,000 in the first quarter of 2026. The sector’s value chain also created employment during this period.

Still, these job gains were far below the nearly million jobs the NDP envisaged in the sector and its value chain.

One constraint on job gains was the slow progress in releasing land with title deeds. Now that the President has directed the release of this land with title deeds, we see greater opportunities for growth and job creation in the sector.

The Department of Land Reform and Rural Development has heeded this call and is now releasing this land.

Essentially, releasing the land will be a powerful step towards boosting inclusive growth in agriculture. This land is also key to ensuring we finally make progress in implementing the AAMP.

Importantly, organised agriculture, labour and agribusinesses, among other key stakeholders, will continue to play a role in boosting inclusive growth in the sector, having helped draft the AAMP.

In essence, agriculture remains one of the sectors of our economy with potential for growth and job creation. The President’s important step to strengthen land rights is key to realising this vision and supporting the rural economies.

Importantly, this also signals that property rights are intact in South Africa and that investment in farming is protected. **DM**

_Wandile Sihlobo is the Presidential Envoy on Agriculture and Land. He is also the chief economist of the Agricultural Business Chamber of South Africa and a senior research fellow in the Department of Agricultural Economics at Stellenbosch University._

title: U.S. Curb on Chinese Drones Hurts American Users
summary: Foreign tourists select handheld photography equipment at a DJI flagship store in Shenzhen. (PHOTO: XINHUA) U.S. restrictions on Chinese-made drones are hurting cash-strapped American police departments, forcing some to scramble for ways to
content:
Foreign tourists select handheld photography equipment at a DJI flagship store in Shenzhen. (PHOTO: XINHUA)
U.S. restrictions on Chinese-made drones are hurting cash-strapped American police departments, forcing some to scramble for ways to afford the more expensive American-made alternatives, according to an October 12 report by NPR.

The report quoted Jon Beal, head of the Law Enforcement Drone Association (LEDA), as saying Chinese-made drones are "light years ahead of what our American drones are able to do."

Beal said Chinese company DJI offers a drone with an impressive high-resolution thermal camera that costs less than 10,000 USD. In comparison, American-made drones have lower flight-time capabilities, thermal imaging and zoom. They usually cost between 20,000 USD and 50,000 USD, depending on the type and the model.

In recent years, the U.S. has steadily erected barriers to the import and sale of Chinese drones. In December 2025, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) added foreign-produced unmanned aircraft systems and critical components to its "Covered List," restricting the authorization of new models for import and sale. In July 2026, the FCC sought to label civilian drones as "military-grade," expanding the scope of restrictions. In addition, several other U.S. government agencies have repeatedly used their regulatory powers to target Chinese drones.

The difficulties facing U.S. police departments are just one example of the wider consequences of these restrictions. Similar problems are emerging across multiple industries.

According to Construction Executive, a U.S. construction industry news outlet, 36 percent of American contractors are using drones, and nearly all of them rely on Chinese products. The U.S. government's prohibition on the use of Chinese drones by contractors working on government projects has put these businesses under pressure.

Sales of new agricultural spray drones in the U.S. fell by 60 percent in 2025, largely because of U.S. Customs and Border Protection interventions in DJI shipments, U.S. agricultural news website AgFunderNews reported.

Eric Ringer, president of the American Spray Drone Coalition, described the industry as "very much in flux," with some U.S. spray drone operators buying up any existing DJI models that are not enmeshed in the ban.

The performance advantage of Chinese drones is a major reason many American users would rather continue using older Chinese models than switch to domestic alternatives.

Last year, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security's National Urban Security Technology Laboratory evaluated drones in Manhattan, New York City. As the surrounding highrises interfered with control signals, three drones were unable to fly reliably: one could not determine its position, another failed to take off, and a third temporarily lost contact.

By contrast, the two DJI drones tested at the same time operated normally, according to a report by U.S. drone industry news outlet DroneXL.

However, the U.S. government's test report mentioned only the scores of the American drones while deliberately concealing the test results of the Chinese drones. The U.S. government appears unwilling to let the public fully understand the performance advantages of Chinese drones, nor does it want to face the reality of its own products lagging behind.

However, if police officers and firefighters in New York are forced to use substandard American drones to carry out missions in the densely built and heavily populated Manhattan, it has the potential of creating enormous public safety risks.

At present, drone technology is still undergoing iterative development. Restrictions on Chinese drones will prevent the American public and various institutions from using the latest Chinese drone products, effectively creating an artificial technological divide — and this time, it is the U.S. that will be losing.

Reports indicate that DJI is about to launch a new generation of drones and drone stations that can quickly swap batteries without waiting for recharging. DroneXL lamented in its report that this clearly demonstrates the losses caused to the U.S. by the "Covered List," as law enforcement agencies in other countries no longer have to endure a 27-minute charging time.

As for the so-called security issues of Chinese drones that the U.S. has repeatedly hyped, facts have proven them to be a fabricated pretext for trying to suppress China's related industries and engaging in trade protectionism. From October last year to March this year, American cybersecurity firm OnDefend conducted an independent security review of multiple DJI drone models. The results found no backdoors, no data flowing out of the U.S., and no viable network hijacking pathways.

Drones are becoming increasingly integrated into economic development, public safety, urban governance, agricultural production and everyday life. Restricting Chinese drones will not serve as a "protective shield" for the development of the U.S. drone industry. Instead, it will create a range of unnecessary problems across different applications.

The U.S. government should listen to drone users across industries. Persisting with its current course could ultimately result in even greater losses.

zh_title: 印尼当局调查疑似中国火箭碎片坠毁事件
summary: 中国 印度尼西亚当局正在调查一块汽车大小的碎片，可能来自中国朱雀二号火箭，坠入加里曼丹中部的一个棕榈油种植园。没有人员伤亡或损坏的报告，后来在附近发现了第二块碎片。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 20 日香港时间 19:13 · 2 分钟阅读印度尼西亚当局周二对一块汽车大小的碎片（可能来自中国岩石）进行调查
content:
中国
一块汽车大小的碎片可能来自中国朱雀-2E火箭，坠毁在中加里曼丹的一个棕榈油种植园，印度尼西亚当局正在对此进行调查。没有人员伤亡或损坏的报告，后来在附近发现了第二块碎片。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 20 日 19:13 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

周二，一块汽车大小的碎片坠入印度尼西亚婆罗洲住宅和工作地点附近的一个棕榈油种植园，据政府机构称，这块碎片可能来自中国火箭，印度尼西亚当局正在进行调查。

周一早上，中加里曼丹省的一名种植园工人发现了这些碎片，此前居民报告称前一天晚上在偏远地区听到一声巨响。 PT Agro Bukit 棕榈油公司 51 岁的工人 Wardi Tamroni 告诉法新社，他最初认为这可能是飞机残骸。该物体坠毁在距他工作的住宅区约三公里处。

“幸运的是，所有工人都已经回家了，所以种植园里没有留下任何人，”瓦尔迪说。当地警察局长 I Kadek Dwi Yoga Sidhimantra 将这个物体描述为“一块相当大的铝板，长达九米，形状不规则，有明显的烧痕”。
民航发言人扎赫鲁迪恩表示，此次事件没有造成人员伤亡或财产损失，他还表示，碎片没有造成辐射或毒性风险。印度尼西亚国家研究与创新局（BRIN）表示，碎片似乎来自中国朱雀二号E火箭。中国政府上周表示，朱雀二号E号已从中国西北部的一个商业发射场将10颗卫星送入太空。记者未能立即联系到中国国家航天局置评。

BRIN 研究员托马斯·贾马鲁丁 (Thomas Djamaluddin) 表示，航天器的所有部件在重返地球大气层时不一定都会燃烧，更多耐热部件可能会到达表面。他说：“这种现象是在桑皮特棕榈油种植园发现大型金属碎片的一种可能解释。”碎片通常会坠入海洋，海洋覆盖了地球表面约 70% 的面积。

扎克鲁迪恩说，周二早上，在距第一块碎片约一公里处发现了第二块碎片，据信来自同一枚火箭。他告诉法新社：“我们计划检查它。从照片来看，该物体似乎是圆形的，与第一个物体有关。”这些碎片正在附近的一个军事空军基地接受检查。
据欧洲航天局（ESA）称，由于不受控制的重返大气层而导致地球上人员伤亡的风险低于雷击或鲨鱼袭击等罕见事故，尽管这一风险正在上升。欧空局太空碎片办公室在去年的一份报告中表示：“尽管重返大气层的风险仍然相对较小，但从 2019 年到 2024 年，这种风险已大幅增加，这主要是由于太空活动的增加。”

沃迪谈到这一怪异事件时说：“如果我们每天都必须预见到这样的事情发生，我们将无法完成我们的工作。” “只能听天由命了，还能做什么呢？”

Indonesian authorities are investigating after a car-sized piece of debris, possibly from a Chinese Zhuque-2E rocket, crashed into a palm oil plantation in Central Kalimantan. No injuries or damage were reported, and a second fragment was later found nearby.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

20 Oct 2026 at 19:13 HKT · 2 min read

Indonesian authorities were investigating on Tuesday after a car-sized piece of debris, possibly from a Chinese rocket according to a government agency, crashed into a palm oil plantation near homes and work sites in Indonesian Borneo.

The debris was found on Monday morning by a plantation worker in Central Kalimantan province, after residents reported hearing a loud bang the previous evening over a remote area. Wardi Tamroni, a 51-year-old worker at the PT Agro Bukit palm oil company, told AFP he initially thought it might be aircraft debris. The object crashed about three kilometres from the housing complex where he works.

"Fortunately, all the workers had already gone home, so no one was left in the plantation," Wardi said. Local police chief I Kadek Dwi Yoga Sidhimantra described the object as "a fairly large aluminium plate measuring up to nine metres with an irregular shape and visible burn marks".

The incident caused no loss of life or property damage, according to civil aviation spokesman Zachrudien, who also said the debris posed no radiation or toxicity risks. Indonesia's National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN) said the debris appeared to come from a Chinese Zhuque-2E rocket. The Chinese government said last week that a Zhuque-2E had launched 10 satellites into space from a commercial launch site in the country's northwest. The China National Space Administration could not be immediately reached for comment.

BRIN researcher Thomas Djamaluddin said not all parts of a spacecraft necessarily burn up on re-entry into Earth's atmosphere, and more heat-resistant parts may reach the surface. "This phenomenon is one possible explanation for the discovery of a large metal fragment in a palm oil plantation in Sampit," he said. Debris usually crashes into the oceans, which cover about 70 per cent of Earth's surface.

On Tuesday morning, a second piece of debris thought to be from the same rocket was found about one kilometre from the first, according to Zachrudien. "We plan to inspect it. From the photographs, the object appears to be round and related to the first object," he told AFP. The pieces were being examined at a nearby military airbase.

According to the European Space Agency (ESA), the casualty risk to individuals on Earth due to uncontrolled re-entry was lower than that for rare accidents such as lightning strikes or shark attacks, though it is rising. "Although the re-entry risks are still relatively small, they have grown considerably from 2019 to 2024, mainly due to increased space activities," the ESA Space Debris Office said in a report last year.

"If we had to anticipate something like this happening every day, we wouldn't be able to do our jobs," Wardi said of the freak event. "We have to leave it to fate. What else can we do?"

佳士得「傳奇40」名表晚間拍賣，百達翡麗《Celestial 型號 6104/12G-010》，18K白金鑲長方形紅寶石自動上鍊天文腕表，配星空圖表、月相及月亮軌跡顯示、天狼星及月亮中天及日曆顯示，約2017年製，估價1,200萬港元起。圖／佳士得提供

為慶祝進駐亞洲四十週年，[**佳士得**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E4%BD%B3%E5%A3%AB%E5%BE%97)[**香港**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF)名表部將於今年11月雅逸精品周期間於香港佳士得[**亞太**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E4%BA%9E%E5%A4%AA)區總部呈獻兩場現場拍賣——11月25日登場的「傳奇40」名表晚間拍賣，以及11月26日舉槌的「精緻名表拍賣」。兩場拍賣共匯聚逾300件時計臻品，總低估價突破3.3億港元，刷新亞洲名表拍賣歷來最高估價總額紀錄。

本次拍賣由佳士得歷來最重要單一藏家私人珍藏之一的「克羅諾思：時間之巔」隆重領銜。全場最引人注目的焦點莫過於百達翡麗（Patek Philippe）Sky Moon Tourbillon型號6002G與其傳奇前作型號5002R首度同時亮相拍場，無疑是現代鐘表史上的重要里程碑。其中型號6002G-010配備大教堂鐘聲三問、陀飛輪、萬年曆、星空圖及月相軌跡等高達十二項複雜功能，並以巧奪天工的手工雕刻與掐絲琺瑯表盤備受推崇。而超稀有的紅金版本型號5002R全球僅發行二十五枚，至今仍是百達翡麗極具代表性的超級複雜功能傳奇之作。

融合高級製表與珠寶工藝的高階複雜功能珠寶表亦為本次拍賣一大焦點。精選拍品包含極珍罕的百達翡麗Celestial型號6104/12G-010白金自動上鍊天文腕表，表鑲嵌長方形紅寶石，因此前世上從未見過相同的配置，應為獨一無二之孤品。同場亦呈獻鑲嵌八十顆長方形切割祖母綠的型號5271/13P-001鉑金萬年曆計時腕表，僅為品牌最尊貴顧客限量製造；歷來第二次現身拍場的型號5130P/13P-010世界時間腕表，無疑也是珍罕難求的收藏機會。

像賴備受資深藏家喜愛的獨立製表典範F.P. Journe，於四十周年紀念拍賣上特別呈獻向獨立製表大師F.P. Journe致敬的一系列時計傑作。領銜之作為超稀有的Tourbillon Souverain紅寶石表盤鉑金陀飛輪腕表，此鉑金版本發行量極少，配有瑰麗紅寶石表盤的版本更是絕無僅有，並巧妙結合一分鐘陀飛輪和恆定動力擺輪，彰顯登峰造極的製表造詣。同場亦呈現早期技術突破的Chronomètre à Résonance「Pre-Souscription」雙獨立擒縱腕表，以及可精確計時至百分之一秒的專門店限定版Centigraphe Souverain "Black Label"計時腕表，全方位展現品牌的前衛創新精神。

而以獨到造型表殼美學在製表史上站穩重要地位的卡地亞（Cartier），拍品陣容同樣令人驚豔，由一座華麗的十八K白金鑲祖母綠、藍寶石與鑽石神祕座鐘領銜，配備八天動力儲存，盡顯頂級工藝。另有造型前衛的Crash "NSO"不對稱腕表以及多款稀有Tank系列腕表，完美詮釋卡地亞兼具創意、精湛工藝的雋永設計美學。

佳士得「傳奇40」名表晚間拍賣，克羅諾思：時間之巔系列，百達翡麗《Sky Moon Tourbillon 型號 5002R》，18k紅金雙表盤腕錶，配十二項功能包括大教堂鐘聲三問功能、陀飛輪、萬年曆、逆返日曆、月行軌跡、恆星時間、星空圖，估價800萬港元起。圖／佳士得提供

佳士得「傳奇40」名表晚間拍賣，F.P. Journe《Tourbillon Souverain》，鉑金陀飛輪腕表，配恒定力裝置、跳秒功能、動力儲存及紅寶石錶盤，錶殼編號758-TN，估價1,600萬港元起。圖／佳士得提供

佳士得精緻名表拍賣，卡地亞《型號 HPH00031》神秘座鐘，18K白金鑲祖母綠、藍寶石、藍玉髓、水晶、赤鐵礦、灰鑽石及鑲圓形鑽石，配8天動力儲存，約2007年製，估價600萬港元起。圖／佳士得提供

佳士得「傳奇40」名表晚間拍賣，克羅諾思：時間之巔系列，百達翡麗《Sky Moon Tourbillon 型號 6002G-010》，18k白金雙錶盤腕表，配十二項功能包括大教堂鐘聲三問功能、陀飛輪、萬年曆、逆返日曆、閏年顯示、恆星時間、星空圖、月相及月球軌跡及掐絲琺瑯表盤，估價2,650萬港元起。圖／佳士得提供

title: 台湾驱离16艘中国船只，谴责北京发动“多点齐发”与混合战海上骚扰
summary: 华盛顿 — 中国对台湾的海上施压行动骤然升级。台湾政府说，星期天(10月18日)发现16艘中国海警、科考及渔船编队同时出现在台湾东部、南部、西南方外海及普拉塔斯群岛(Pratas Islands，台湾称东沙群岛)，对台湾实施“多点齐发”及混合战等海上侵扰，“数量异常增加”。台湾海巡署派出舰艇采取有效反制措施，予以强势驱离。 海巡署星期天发出新闻稿，说明对中国以各式船舶在台湾周边海域进行骚扰已在第一时间采取强势作为，有效化解威胁，中国船只在各水域的出现与海巡舰艇的应对作为包括：
content:
华盛顿 —

中国对台湾的海上施压行动骤然升级。台湾政府说，星期天(10月18日)发现16艘中国海警、科考及渔船编队同时出现在台湾东部、南部、西南方外海及普拉塔斯群岛(Pratas Islands，台湾称东沙群岛)，对台湾实施“多点齐发”及混合战等海上侵扰，“数量异常增加”。台湾海巡署派出舰艇采取有效反制措施，予以强势驱离。

海巡署星期天发出新闻稿，说明对中国以各式船舶在台湾周边海域进行骚扰已在第一时间采取强势作为，有效化解威胁，中国船只在各水域的出现与海巡舰艇的应对作为包括：

*   在花莲东方水域，中国科考船“探索三号”航入台湾限制水域，台东海巡队巡防艇前往实施广播驱离；
*   在屏东鹅銮鼻西南方水域，中国“北调996”科考船凌晨进入台湾限制水域，恒春海巡队巡防艇“连续广播警告12次，强势迫使其转向”航出限制水域；
*   在高雄西南方水域，台湾渔船“万发诚11”被中国“海洋地质8”科考船及中国铁壳渔船干扰作业，海巡“屏东舰”立即赶抵现场采取护卫行动；
*   在东沙周边海域，中国“3301”及“3303”两艘海警船“绕岛对开，挑衅意味十足”，海巡“旗津舰”及“台中舰”采取“近迫并航”监控，并以广播强势驱离，当天中午成功将中国海警船全数驱离到限制水域外并持续往外航离。

海巡署的声明说，中国此次以12艘海警、科考船和四艘渔船编队，在台湾东部、南部、西南方及东沙周边海域“发动多点齐发及混合战”等海上侵扰行动，是企图以“假执法、真扩权”手段片面改变台海现状、制造管辖权假象，如此只会造成台湾人民反感，海巡署对此予以最严厉谴责。

面对中国不断升级对台湾的海上施压行动，台湾海巡署是否有能量来持续应对，美国哈德逊研究所资深研究员许毓仁在接受美国之音采访时说，中国对台湾的海上骚扰一直存在，要更有效的应对，美国在此水域的持续存在非常重要，台湾也必须寻求和美国、日本等盟友协同，采取包括联合巡逻在内的行动。

许毓仁说：“我觉得中国的海上灰色地带行动其实一直都在都在进行，透过各种方式，还有透过无论是军船伪装成渔船或民船，有时候会介于可执法跟不可执法之间，很难有一条清楚的线。很重要的事情是让美国知道，在台湾海峡这边美国要有一个presence(存在)，就是要有他的出现，这是很重要的。然后第二就是呼吁日本跟美国跟台湾配合，来进行共同巡逻，甚至在周边海域可以有定期的join patrol(联合巡逻)这样的做法。”

不只是美国和日本，许毓仁说，菲律宾也是遏制中国海上侵扰的重要一环。

“这非常重要，尤其是菲律宾这边会形成一个破口，透过菲律宾的一些破坏让美国跟日本分心，进而对台湾采取一些行动。我觉得这是大家都必须去关注的，尤其是我们的海巡署或是海委会，我觉得他们可能要有更强硬的一些措施，”他说。

菲律宾海警队10月初说，中国科考船“嘉海科7号”9月底、10月初在该国北部巴丹群岛水域活动多日遭菲国海警舰艇驱离。海警队一名发言人在声明中提到，不只是该国在关注这艘中国科考船的行踪，还有3艘台湾海巡船也在该海域监控中方船只。

许毓仁认为，中国对台湾的灰色地带骚扰，也就是低于战争门槛的施压、胁迫，涉及法律、外交和军事等层面，需要台湾不同部门来共同应对，研究重点包括海洋电缆安全的他目前也是美国国土安全部(DHS)海洋电缆工作组的成员，他建议台湾政府设立一个跨部门的工作组来研拟反制中国海洋施压行动的作为。

“现在海军、海巡署跟海委会，甚至是国防部和外交部可能都需要整合一下，尤其是有关涉外关系，还有法律上的灰色地带行动也会产生一些冲突，我觉得这可能需要一个整体跨部会的工作小组，比如说我现在就在国土安全部的海洋电缆工作小组，这里面其实有很多私部门跟公部门的一些专家，我觉得这是非常重要的，”他说。

台湾海巡署说，面对中国的威权扩张和持续进逼的侵扰，该署全天候维持高强度的监侦作业与勤务部署，捍卫台湾的主权与自由民主制度。

星期一，中国外交部发言人毛宁在例行记者会上，针对台湾从本岛及东沙附近海域驱离了16艘中国船只的提问只说了一句，“这不是外交问题”。

不过她上星期一在回应美国国务院有关中国在台湾东部海域的活动是“深度破坏稳定”、“只会加剧紧张局势”的表态时曾表示，中国在台湾以东海域拥有专属经济区和大陆架，中方在该海域开展活动“完全是中国主权权利和管辖权范围内的事，正当合法，无可非议。”

title: Joburg mayoral candidate Tlaleng Mofokeng on grief and a vision
summary: When [Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-08-16-fresh-face-bold-policies-eff-s-dr-tlaleng-mofokeng-outlines-her-vision-for-joburg/) was approached about becoming the Economic Freedom Fighters’ mayoral candidate
content:
When [Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-08-16-fresh-face-bold-policies-eff-s-dr-tlaleng-mofokeng-outlines-her-vision-for-joburg/) was approached about becoming the Economic Freedom Fighters’ mayoral candidate for Johannesburg, her husband was the first person she told. He encouraged her to make herself available, telling her that after years of fighting for other people’s rights around the world, she should bring that fight to the city they called home.

That was one of their last conversations before her husband died on 10 July, leaving the 44-year-old medical doctor and human rights activist to navigate the demands of an election campaign while grieving his death and adjusting to life as a single parent.

For a brief period, Mofokeng questioned whether she could or should continue, but ultimately decided the reasons she agreed to stand had not changed. “I would feel like I’m letting myself down if I didn’t do this because the reasons why I said ‘yes’ are still the same and still existed even after he had passed away,” she said.

Mofokeng enters Johannesburg’s mayoral contest with an extensive career in medicine, international health policy and human rights advocacy, including serving as the United Nations Special Rapporteur on the right to health. Although this is her first attempt at elected office, she has helped develop the EFF’s election manifestos since the party’s early years.

She hopes to bring a different approach to the Johannesburg Metro, a municipality beset by political instability, failing infrastructure and deteriorating services, and argues that the City’s leadership has lost sight of the people it is supposed to serve.

Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng at Milk Bar in Parkmore, Johannesburg, on 6 October 2026. (Photo: Our City News / Alaister Russell)

At the centre of her candidacy is the belief that dignity, care and empathy should shape how Johannesburg is governed, especially when decisions affect residents who already struggle to access essential services or have little influence over the institutions that deliver them.

“Why I always talk about dignity in my candidacy is precisely because dignity has been eroded from all of us, for so long,” Mofokeng said.

Mofokeng says her activism began during her childhood in QwaQwa and has remained central to her work as a doctor and international human rights advocate, describing herself as an activist first and a doctor second.

### It’s personal

Her commitment to Johannesburg is also personal. Sitting at Milk Bar at George Lea Park in Sandton, while rushing between meetings recently, she described having moved to Johannesburg as a young doctor and remembers travelling through popular and familiar taxi routes and public space, feeling safer in the city that many residents now fear entering.

She recalls a city where people worked hard, embraced its cultural life and found opportunities despite their circumstances, and she believes much of that determination remains even as the infrastructure supporting it has deteriorated.

“I think that’s where our disappointment comes from... Our passion and our drive is not matched by processes and resources and infrastructure that works to meet us somewhere,” she said.

Mofokeng’s proposals combine the EFF’s commitments to insourcing municipal services and expanding access to basic infrastructure with a greater emphasis on how residents participate in decisions affecting their communities.

She wants ward-based people’s assemblies, technical oversight teams to scrutinise infrastructure spending and a one-stop municipal service centre where entrepreneurs and informal traders can get help with permits, registration and compliance.

Rather than relying primarily on punitive enforcement, she argues that municipal officials should help residents understand and comply with regulations, while giving communities greater insight into how budgets are allocated.

### Migration

Mofokeng is also critical of politicians who exploit frustration over migration, arguing that failures in government planning, immigration administration and service delivery have contributed to tensions between communities. The exploitation of these tensions for political gain was on display again recently in Soweto and in Durban, which led to public violence following misinformation about a [Constitutional Court ruling](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-10-13-what-the-constitutional-court-judgment-on-asylum-actually-said/) on asylum laws.

Joburg mayoral candidate Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng speaks to Our City News. (Photo: Our City News / Alaister Russell)

“It can’t be that 5% of the population is the one that’s causing all of the queues in the clinics or causing all of the queues in the schools,” she said, rejecting the suggestion that migrants are responsible for Johannesburg’s wider problems.

Her approach raises questions about financing and implementation, as the City continues to battle collapsing infrastructure and reduced revenue collection, while the EFF proposes employing more municipal workers, reducing outsourcing and expanding services – all of which would require significant administrative changes and investment.

Mofokeng believes the municipality can recover resources through better management, reduced waste and stronger negotiations with the national government. But coalition politics could further complicate those ambitions, particularly where the EFF’s opposition to privatisation conflicts with the priorities of potential governing partners. Mofokeng, however, refuses to exclude parties from pre-election negotiations, arguing that a mayor must represent residents regardless of how they voted.

### Wider concerns

Her concerns extend beyond municipal finances and infrastructure to the conditions in which people live, including the fear of violence that restricts women’s freedom and the disappearance of public spaces where children can play. She also advocates for renewed investment in Johannesburg’s theatres, cultural institutions and recreational facilities.

“We work hard in Johannesburg, but we also come here to play and to dream, and to be creative. And I think it’s very important to not neglect that,” she said.

For Mofokeng, the mayoralty is a chance to change how the municipality functions rather than build another political career. “I don’t want to be a mayor for too long. I want to be a mayor, achieve things, change systems. But this is not a new career move for me,” she said.

EFF mayoral candidate for Johannesburg Dr Tlaleng Mofokeng believes the mayoralty is a chance to change how the municipality functions. (Photo: OUR CITY NEWS / Alaister Russell)

Her decision to continue campaigning despite her husband’s death has also brought the importance of community support into sharper focus. She spoke about the friends and family who have helped her manage the responsibilities of parenthood while allowing her the space to grieve.

“Grief is also its own thing. It comes in its own time and it comes in waves,” she said.

Despite the financial and political challenges ahead, Mofokeng remains committed to her vision for Johannesburg, drawing encouragement from her final conversation with her husband and the words that helped convince her to stand. **DM**

# Seven candidates nominated for Labour Advisory Board employee representative election

Hong Kong's Labour Department announced on 23 October 2026 that seven candidates have been nominated for the Labour Advisory Board employee representative election. Voting will take place on 28 November at Mei Foo Community Hall.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 23 Oct 2026 at 15:00 HKT · 1 min read

Hong Kong's Labour Department on 23 October 2026 announced the list of seven candidates nominated for the employee representative election of the Labour Advisory Board (LAB). The candidates, listed in order of nomination receipt, are: Sze Sze-kit, chairman of the Hong Kong Construction Industry General Workers Union; Tang Tze-on, chairman of the Hong Kong Government Lifeguards General Union; Yeung Hoi-kuen, vice-chairman of the Hong Kong Seamen's Union; Lik Na, president of the Hong Kong Social Welfare Services Employees Association; Tam Kam-lin, vice-chairman of the Hong Kong and Kowloon Federation of Labour; Lo Wai-kit, vice-chairman of the Hong Kong Nurses Association; and Lam Kwan-ho, chairman of the Marine Inspectors and Senior Assistant Shipping Officers Association.

A total of 804 registered trade unions serving as electoral units have appointed authorised representatives to vote in this election. The Labour Department will notify these units in writing of the candidate list and detailed voting arrangements. Authorised representatives can cast their ballots on election day, 28 November, from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm at the polling station in Mei Foo Community Hall.

Candidates may monitor the vote count on election day. The returning officer is the Assistant Commissioner for Labour (Development). The candidate list, the register of electoral units that have appointed authorised representatives, and the election rules and procedures are available on the Labour Department's website (www.labour.gov.hk/tc/news/LAB_Election2026.htm). Enquiries can be directed to 2852 4022.

The LAB is a tripartite advisory body that provides advice to the Commissioner for Labour on labour matters. Its members include representatives of both employees and employers.

# Tibet earthquake kills 16, emergency response raised to level 3

A magnitude 7.0 earthquake in Baqing County, Tibet, has killed 16 people and injured 54. China's emergency response has been upgraded to level 3, with a working group led by Wang Kun, head of the China Earthquake Administration, dispatched to the area.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 23 Oct 2026 at 08:54 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2&text=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203 "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2&text=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203 "X")[](mailto:?subject=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203&body=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2 "Email")

A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Tibet on the evening of 22 October, killing 16 people and injuring 54, according to state broadcaster RTHK.

The Ministry of Emergency Management has raised the disaster emergency response from level 4 to level 3. A working group led by Wang Kun, deputy commander of the State Council's earthquake relief headquarters and head of the China Earthquake Administration, has been sent to the affected area to provide guidance and assistance. The ministry has also deployed a Wing Loong drone to the disaster zone for reconnaissance missions.

The Western Theatre Command has activated its emergency response mechanism for rescue and disaster relief operations. It has verified the extent of the damage and assessed the geographical and climatic conditions of the affected region, and has directed troops stationed near the disaster area to deploy to affected villages and towns.

National Highway 317 in Tibet, where a section near Nyingchi was blocked by falling rocks, was cleared in the early hours of 23 October after emergency repairs.

The earthquake struck at 10:33 pm local time on 22 October, with the epicentre located in Maryu Township, Baqing County, at a depth of 10 kilometres.

# Customs seizes HK$1.7m cannabis at airport, two mainland men arrested

Hong Kong Customs arrested two mainland men at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday, seizing about 8kg of suspected cannabis buds worth HK$1.7 million. The suspects, aged 30 and 36, arrived separately from Bangkok with cannabis in their carry-on luggage. Investigations continue.

Hong Kong Customs arrested two incoming mainland Chinese male passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday in separate drug trafficking cases. Officers seized about 8 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds with a total estimated market value of about HK$1.7 million.

In the first case, a 30-year-old man arriving from Bangkok was found with about 5 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds in his carry-on suitcase. In the second case, a 36-year-old man also arriving from Bangkok was found with about 3 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds in his carry-on suitcase.

Both investigations are ongoing. Customs reminded the public that drug trafficking carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

# Hong Kong para-swimmers win bronze in mixed S14 relay at Asian Para Games

Hong Kong's mixed S14 4x100m freestyle relay team won bronze at the Asian Para Games, finishing in 3 minutes 53.77 seconds behind gold medalists Japan and silver medalists Thailand. The quartet of Chan Yui-lam, Lau Chiu-yee, Cheung Tsun-lok and Wong Hon-yin will receive HK$125,000 under the Jockey C

Hong Kong para-swimmers captured a bronze medal in the mixed S14 4x100-metre freestyle relay at the Asian Para Games, adding to the city's podium tally in the pool following a closely contested four-way final.

The quartet of Chan Yui-lam, Lau Chiu-yee, Cheung Tsun-lok, and Wong Hon-yin clocked a combined time of 3 minutes and 53.77 seconds to finish third overall. Hong Kong entered the final facing competition from three other regional sides, including Thailand, host nation Japan, and South Korea.

Setting an assertive tempo over the opening legs, the Hong Kong squad established themselves near the front of the pack, holding second place behind early pacesetter Thailand through the initial stages of the race. Japan launched a powerful surge over the closing legs of the relay, overtaking both Hong Kong and Thailand to touch the wall first and claim the gold medal.

Despite the late change in the running order, the Hong Kong swimmers maintained their rhythm over the remaining distance to stop the clock at 3 minutes and 53.77 seconds, securing the bronze medal ahead of fourth-placed South Korea.

The relay squad will be rewarded for their third-place finish through local athlete support initiatives. Under the Jockey Club Athlete Incentive Awards Scheme, Hong Kong, China athletes who claim bronze medals in team events at the Asian Para Games are eligible to receive HK$125,000, providing financial recognition for the four swimmers' collective accomplishment on the regional stage.
