Rather than stepping back, Wheatley’s investment vehicle, WGW Capital, went to war with the remaining board. Using Section 61(3) of the Companies Act, WGW demanded an urgent shareholder meeting to install its own slate of directors.

When the independent board pushed back on governance grounds, WGW filed a supplementary demand to have the sitting directors removed immediately.

On 9 October 2026, the governance machine stuttered to a halt. Chairperson Norma Sephuma, interim CEO Stafford Masie and independent directors Snowy Masakale and GG Alcock resigned en masse, stating plainly that they had irresolvable differences with the majority shareholder.

ABC wrapped a loan book balance sheet in the language of a bitcoin treasury revolution, and tried listing itself from Cape Town to Frankfurt, but it can’t outrun the consequences of accumulative actions. **DM**

title: 要闻分析 - 在俄导弹袭乌的轰炸中 俄中美“联盟”显形了?
summary: 周一19日凌晨俄罗斯发射多波导弹袭击基辅，至少造成1人死亡、8人受伤。乌克兰总统泽连斯基就此表示：虽然俄罗斯以弹道导弹攻击基辅及周边地区的能源设施，但乌方事前并未收到盟国的预警。所谓的盟国指的当然是美国 泽连斯基指出，俄罗斯19日向基辅及周边地区发射16枚弹道导弹，并向乌克兰各地出动了200架以上的无人机。法新社记者报道说：在首都基辅可以听到空袭警报与爆炸声。 乌克兰总统19日在社群媒体发文表示：俄罗斯再次发动弹道飞弹攻击，一整夜分多次袭击，而我们的伙伴又一次没有事先发出预警
content:
周一19日凌晨俄罗斯发射多波导弹袭击基辅，至少造成1人死亡、8人受伤。乌克兰总统泽连斯基就此表示：虽然俄罗斯以弹道导弹攻击基辅及周边地区的能源设施，但乌方事前并未收到盟国的预警。所谓的盟国指的当然是美国

泽连斯基指出，俄罗斯19日向基辅及周边地区发射16枚弹道导弹，并向乌克兰各地出动了200架以上的无人机。法新社记者报道说：在首都基辅可以听到空袭警报与爆炸声。

乌克兰总统19日在社群媒体发文表示：俄罗斯再次发动弹道飞弹攻击，一整夜分多次袭击，而我们的伙伴又一次没有事先发出预警。基辅方面上周就曾经指出，美国先前也未针对类似攻击发出预警，使居民几乎没有时间躲进避难设施。

但美国国务卿卢比奥19日稍早否认美国曾暂停与乌克兰分享情报。

美国总统特朗普近日数次就俄乌战争批评泽连斯基。他曾表示，美国已与俄罗斯达成协议，以放宽制裁换取俄国出口燃料。

特朗普18日在自家社群平台“真实社群”（Truth Social）发文称，他在推动俄乌和平谈判方面正取得“重大进展”，但泽连斯基既“不在乎”也“不希望结束这场战争”。

于是泽连斯基19日在贴文中反驳特朗普以上说法，他强调：“乌克兰从来就不想打这场战争，也一直欢迎合作伙伴为使战争有尊严地落幕所付出的一切努力。”

他还说：俄罗斯的回应，就是一次又一次的弹道导弹、见证者（Shahed）无人机与杀戮。

他补充道：“当对乌克兰的防空导弹供应受阻，俄罗斯却获得了制裁放宽或延后实施的待遇，很遗憾，这显示我们有些伙伴不愿正视现实。”

美国特朗普政府用断供防空导弹和星链不灵等方式逼迫乌克兰放弃袭击俄罗斯能源目标，就在双方矛盾公开化的节点上，普京在加大打击乌克兰的同时，又抛出外交武器，提议要在中国深圳亚太经合会峰会期间，与习近平和特朗普共商：如何在对俄罗斯有利的情形下结束俄乌战争？

一名前俄国情报官员向华尔街日报透露，普京是在10月9日与特朗普通话时提出的这个构想，当天的通话还促成了美俄柴油协议，让美国得以购买俄罗斯柴油，并协助俄方将柴油销往全球市场。

克里姆林宫发言人则证实这一消息属实，并且相关各方的确在讨论举行这类会晤的可能。虽然目前对于会晤本身及可能讨论的议程，尚无明确共识，“但3方都承认，举行这类会晤在理论上可行”。

报导还引述一名美方高层表示，特朗普虽尚未同意举行这场峰会，但特朗普希望兑现竞选承诺、结束俄乌战争，因此推测特朗普很可能对这项提议抱持开放态度。

据报俄方已透过外交管道向北京提出这项构想，中方则表明只要特朗普同意，中方不反对举行会晤。

报导还引述前俄国情报官员表示，普京过去就曾分别向特朗普和习近平提议举行3方峰会，不过这次提出时机正逢美俄关系回温，目前态势的天秤正朝有利俄国倾斜。

莫斯科盼促成美俄中3方对话，将欧洲排除在外；克里姆林宫认为，欧洲是阻碍俄乌战争结束的背后力量。

这名前俄国情报官员甚至表示，普京有意将可能的美俄中3国领袖会形塑成第二次雅尔塔会议，接此重新划分彼此的全球势力范围。华尔街日报认为如果这场峰会在排除欧洲与乌克兰参与下登场，等于开创罕见先例，势必引发欧洲各国高度警戒。

**同一天10月19日的另一条消息也令人生疑：**

自己发动对乌克兰战争快5年，需要习近平特朗普加持的普京现在试图扮演调解伊朗战事的角色，他派俄国外交部长拉夫罗夫19日抵达伊朗进行访问，这是中东战争爆发以来俄外长首度到访伊朗。

法新社报导，本月初，俄罗斯总统普京曾告诉伊朗总统裴泽斯基安（Masoud Pezeshkian），俄国准备为中东地区的战争调解工作贡献心力。

拉夫罗夫预计将与伊朗外交部长阿拉奇（Abbas Araghchi）会面，他表示，俄国的努力“旨在防止重返大规模战争”。目前伊朗与美国的谈判处于僵局状态。

最近特朗普公开展示对普京的友好和对乌克兰的背叛，已经引发舆论对特朗普动机的怀疑。特朗普逼迫泽连斯基单方面停止轰炸俄罗斯能源设施，说是为了降低油价，人们无法相信但找不到真实原因。

**部分答案现在显现了：其实是特朗普在与普京做交易，他对普京高抬贵手，普京则可以发挥对伊朗政权的影响力，最终让特朗普更体面地从海湾战争泥潭中脱身。**

**被牺牲的当然就是乌克兰，而能阻止这一切的最重要力量也只能来自美国内部。即将到来的中期选举重要性毋庸置疑。**

title: 一文看懂：美中俄或举行乌克兰问题会谈 大国外交能否推动战争终结？
summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)星期一(10月19日)针对美中俄三方可能就乌克兰战争举行高层会谈表示，“只要我能做任何事来结束战争，我都会去做。”特朗普总统也在回答美国之音中文部记者提问时表示，他会与中国国家主席习近平商谈乌克兰问题。 与此同时，国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)星期一表示，目前尚未最终确定会谈细节，有关会谈可能在11月举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会期间进行。 这场潜在会谈的背后，是三个大国不同的战略考量，以及乌克兰在持续战争
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)星期一(10月19日)针对美中俄三方可能就乌克兰战争举行高层会谈表示，“只要我能做任何事来结束战争，我都会去做。”特朗普总统也在回答美国之音中文部记者提问时表示，他会与中国国家主席习近平商谈乌克兰问题。

与此同时，国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)星期一表示，目前尚未最终确定会谈细节，有关会谈可能在11月举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会期间进行。

这场潜在会谈的背后，是三个大国不同的战略考量，以及乌克兰在持续战争压力下面临的艰难抉择。若会谈成行，能否推动俄乌战争走向结束？当乌克兰的未来成为大国谈判议题时，基辅又将面临怎样的处境？

**美国：推动停火，同时控制战争风险**

特朗普总统星期一在白宫玫瑰园签署了一项聚焦女性健康的行政命令，在签署仪式结束后面对记者询问时，他表示，愿意做任何事帮助结束乌克兰战争。

“我对俄罗斯和乌克兰的唯一希望就是他们停止这场愚蠢的战争。无论有人在场与否，只要我能做任何事情来结束战争，我都会去做。”特朗普说。

当美国之音中文部记者黄耀毅询问特朗普总统，是否会与中国领导人习近平谈乌克兰问题时，特朗普给予一个肯定的答案。

“我会的。不过，到目前为止，我认为他(习近平)在乌克兰问题上一直非常公平。他并没有过多介入，对俄罗斯方面也是如此。他们的介入程度远没有达到本来可以达到的程度，我对此表示赞赏。他们知道我对此表示赞赏。”

星期一稍早，国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)在访问乌兹别克斯坦期间说，美国将尽一切努力达成解决方案。“在过去近两年时间里，我们多次进行接触，试图促成或推动这场战争的结束；我认为，如果有可能，总统愿意采取任何他能做的事情来帮助结束这场战争。我们将继续寻找这样做的机会。”他说。

特朗普政府可能试图利用其对乌克兰的长期支持，以及与俄罗斯直接沟通的渠道，推动双方达成停火或政治协议。与中国展开沟通，也有助于美国探索更广泛的外交解决路径。

然而，如何平衡尽快结束战争与维护乌克兰安全，是美国面临的核心难题。

如果美国过于强调迅速达成协议，乌克兰可能被迫接受不利的领土安排，或者在缺乏可靠安全保障的情况下停火。近期美国取消部分对俄罗斯能源的制裁，也引发基辅对华盛顿是否会继续对莫斯科施压的担忧。

**俄罗斯：将战场成果转化为政治利益**

对俄罗斯而言，与美国直接讨论乌克兰问题，有助于莫斯科争取将战场上的既得利益转化为外交成果。

自2022年全面入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯一直试图巩固对乌克兰部分领土的控制，并要求西方重视其安全诉求。莫斯科希望未来的安排能够涉及领土问题、乌克兰的军事与外交方向，北约扩大，以及涉俄制裁。

与美国和中国领导人举行会谈，也能提升俄罗斯的国际地位，表明莫斯科仍是国际安全事务无法绕开的参与者。

但俄罗斯面临的难题是，如何在不作出重大让步的情况下结束战争。若停火无法满足其核心诉求，莫斯科可能缺乏妥协动力；而战争持续带来的军事和经济消耗，也使其必须权衡继续作战的成本。

**中国：主张政治解决，争取外交主动权**

中国一直主张通过对话谈判解决乌克兰危机，强调尊重各国主权和领土完整，同时重视各方合理安全关切。

中国与俄罗斯保持密切的政治和经济关系，也与欧洲及乌克兰维持外交联系。

对中国而言，参与三方会谈既可能为政治解决提供新的沟通平台，也有助于提升中国在欧洲安全事务和全球外交中的影响力。乌克兰战争持续影响能源、粮食、贸易及大国关系，北京也有动力推动局势降温。

不过，中国的角色面临争议。美国及部分西方国家批评中国与俄罗斯的经济和工业联系有助于俄罗斯维持战争能力，北京则否认支持俄罗斯的军事行动，并强调政治解决。

中国外交部发言人毛宁星期一被记者问到可能的三方会谈时回答说：“这个问题目前我没有可以提供的信息。”

**乌克兰：战争当事方，却面临话语权受限**

对乌克兰而言，最大的担忧是，三个大国讨论乌克兰的未来，却未必充分考虑乌克兰自身的诉求。

经过多年战争，乌克兰面临人员伤亡、基础设施受损和经济压力。随着冬季临近，能源设施及供电、供暖保障也成为现实挑战。与此同时，乌克兰的防御能力仍高度依赖美国等西方国家的军事、情报和经济支持。

基辅面临两难：接受以现有战线为基础的停火，可能意味着俄罗斯继续控制部分乌克兰领土；拒绝不利条件，则可能让战争继续消耗国家资源。

更重要的是，即使达成停火，乌克兰仍需要可靠的长期安全保障，以防俄罗斯未来再次发动进攻。

因此，乌克兰希望确保自己能够直接参与谈判，并坚持任何和平协议都必须考虑国家主权、领土完整和未来安全。欧洲国家的参与同样重要，因为欧洲既是乌克兰的重要支持者，也是战争长期影响的直接承担者。

title: China protests after Japanese premier sends monetary offering to war-linked Yasukuni shrine
summary: Aamir Latif and Riyaz ul Khaliq 19 October 2026•Update: 19 October 2026 Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi sent a monetary offering Monday to the war-linked Yasukuni shrine in Tokyo, prompting “strong protests” from China, according to
content:
Aamir Latif and Riyaz ul Khaliq

19 October 2026•Update: 19 October 2026

Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi sent a monetary offering Monday to the war-linked Yasukuni shrine in Tokyo, prompting “strong protests” from China, according to local media.

The shrine has long been a source of diplomatic friction between Japan and its neighbors, including China.

Takaichi sent the offering out of her own pocket for the shrine’s autumn festival, Kyodo News reported.

Takaichi, as the leader of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party, also sent a "masakaki" ritual offering of evergreen twigs on Saturday.

Land Minister Tatsunori Ibayashi and the ruling Liberal Democratic Party's Election Strategy Committee Chairperson Nishimura Yasutoshi separately visited the shrine, which honors "convicted war criminals" along with millions of war dead.

Previous visits to the shrine by Japanese leaders have prompted strong criticism from China and South Korea. Japan occupied a wide area of China by the end of World War II, and South Korea was under Japanese colonial rule between 1910 and 1945.

China’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said Beijing “firmly opposes and strongly condemns” the “negative moves” by Japan.

Beijing has “lodged serious and strong protests with the Japanese side,” Mao told reporters in Beijing.

“The war shrine is a spiritual tool and symbol of Japanese militarist war of aggression,” Mao said, recalling that it “honors 14 convicted Class A war criminals responsible for Japan's aggression.”

“Japanese leaders and politicians, despite knowing this quite well, still pay respect to the war shrine. This reveals their deep-seated wrong view on historical issues and malicious intention to erase the criminal record of those war criminals, reverse the verdict on aggression and clear the path for remilitarization,” Mao alleged.

Noting that this year marks the 80th anniversary of the opening of the Tokyo Trials, Mao said Beijing calls on Japan to “recognize history, repent for historical crimes, stop the retrogressive moves on historical issues and earn the trust of its Asian neighbors and the wider world with concrete actions.”

Ties between Tokyo and Beijing have been strained since last November following Takaichi's comments suggesting that an attack on Taiwan could prompt a response by Japan's Self-Defense Forces in support of the US.

China considers Taiwan its breakaway province to be unified with the country, while Taiwan insists on its independence.

# Typhoon Champi to turn away from Taiwan, will still bring heavy rain

10/19/2026 07:53 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

CNA graphic

Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) Typhoon Champi will turn northward earlier than previously forecast, sparing Taiwan a direct hit but still bringing heavy rain to the north of the country on Friday and Saturday, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

CWA forecaster Cheng Chieh-jen (鄭傑仁) told CNA Typhoon Champi had strengthened and increased in size over the past 12 hours, and as of Monday afternoon was packing sustained winds of 198 kilometers per hour near its center.

Due to the weakening of a Pacific high-pressure system, however, the storm is now expected to turn northward earlier than initially forecast, likely around Japan's Ishigaki Island, Cheng said.

As Champi brushes past northeastern Taiwan, it will likely be a strong "moderate" typhoon or weak "intense" typhoon per the CWA's classification system, which defines the latter as having sustained winds above 184 kph, Cheng said.

Based on current forecasts, the CWA could issue a sea warning on Wednesday night or Thursday at the earliest, and a land warning on Thursday evening or Friday, Cheng said.

The warning will likely apply to northern and eastern Taiwan, with the north and Yilan, in particular, facing possible heavy or extremely heavy rain on Friday and Saturday, he added.

As for this week's weather, Cheng said the CWA forecast mostly cloudy to clear skies on Tuesday, with high temperatures of 30-32 degrees Celsius in the eastern half of the country and 31-34 degrees in the west.

On Wednesday, a northeasterly wind system will bring slightly cooler temperatures to the north, with daytime highs reaching 27-30 degrees and a chance of scattered showers in Yilan and areas north of Hsinchu, Cheng said.

As the typhoon approaches on Thursday, there will continue to be scattered rain showers in Yilan and northern Taiwan. Those areas could see heavy or extremely heavy rain on Friday and Saturday, while scattered showers are forecast for other regions, Cheng said.

As Typhoon Champi weakens and moves away from Taiwan on Sunday, cloudy to clear weather conditions will prevail in most regions, with the exception of lingering rain showers in the east and on the Hengchun Peninsula in the south, Cheng said.

(By Chang Hsiung-feng and Matthew Mazzetta)

title: 花旗預測 陸AI企業赴港上市維持穩健
summary: [udn](https://udn.com/)[兩岸](https://udn.com/news/cate/2/6640)[陸港經貿](https://udn.com/news/story/7333/9822648) 聽新聞 0:00 / 0:00 2026-10-19 03:21 聯合報／ 記者[謝守真](https://udn.com/news/reporter/MDY5OTg=)／綜合報導 香港 [**中國大陸**](https://udn.com/search/tag
content:
[udn](https://udn.com/)[兩岸](https://udn.com/news/cate/2/6640)[陸港經貿](https://udn.com/news/story/7333/9822648)

聽新聞

0:00 / 0:00

2026-10-19 03:21 聯合報／ 記者[謝守真](https://udn.com/news/reporter/MDY5OTg=)／綜合報導  香港

[**中國大陸**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9C%8B%E5%A4%A7%E9%99%B8)ＡＩ產業今年掀起上市潮，[**香港**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF)成為相關企業重要的融資市場。據路透，[**花旗**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E8%8A%B1%E6%97%97)銀行高層預期，儘管市場對企業估值的疑慮升高，大陸ＡＩ供應鏈企業赴港上市趨勢仍將維持穩健，明年香港股權資本市場的焦點，有望從硬體供應商轉向ＡＩ模型及應用開發商。

路透報導，花旗中國投資銀行及亞太區金融機構業務主管袁崢怡在曼谷出席國際貨幣基金（ＩＭＦ）會議期間受訪，談及大陸ＡＩ供應鏈企業赴港上市前景。她提到，儘管市場對估值的疑慮升高、審查日益嚴格，ＡＩ供應鏈企業仍將持續赴港上市。

袁崢怡指出，近期資料中心企業的估值回落主要源自美國市場，但ＡＩ供應鏈企業仍將繼續赴港上市。

她表示，計畫在香港上市的大陸企業，投資需求大致一半來自大陸境內、一半來自國際市場，有助於緩衝市場波動的影響。香港市場也有本地資金支持，持續增加的大陸南向資金正成為重要買盤。

不過，袁崢怡警告，如果美國整個ＡＩ產業周期出現反轉，全球市場都將受到影響，香港也不例外。他並指出，過去幾周市場已出現一些波動。

在供應鏈布局方面，袁崢怡表示，許多大陸硬體業者已主動在大陸以外建立生產據點，有助於服務全球客戶，並降低地緣政治摩擦帶來的影響。

他指出，大陸硬體供應商受惠於全球ＡＩ基礎設施建設熱潮，銷售量成長，產品單價也有所提高。

展望明年，袁崢怡預期，香港股權資本市場的焦點將從純硬體企業，轉向大陸ＡＩ模型及應用開發商。

不過，他強調，這些企業必須證明商業模式可行，並展現強勁的成長及獲利能力。

路透指出，在大陸科技企業融資需求帶動下，今年前九個月共有一一八家企業在香港上市，募資總額達三八八○億港元，年增百分之一○六。

# ‘Hybrid warfare’: Taiwan drives away 16 Chinese ships

_China is ramping up its presence around Taiwan, in a pattern that Taipei said is designed to ‘alter the status quo’._

[![Image 2](https://www.aljazeera.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/2017-06-08T131939Z_1189275883_RC11B0FE7F20_RTRMADP_3_GULF-QATAR-JAZEERA-1714943623.jpg?resize=96%2C96&quality=80)](https://www.aljazeera.com/author/al_jazeera_staff_150119130629458)

By [Al Jazeera Staff](https://www.aljazeera.com/author/al_jazeera_staff_150119130629458) and AFP

Published On 18 Oct 2026 18 Oct 2026

Taiwan has confronted and driven away 16 Chinese coastguard, research and fishing vessels that it said were involved in simultaneous “maritime harassment” operations.

An “unusually large” number of Chinese vessels took part in coordinated operations around Taiwan’s main island and Pratas (also known as Dongsha), a disputed island to the southwest, the Taiwanese coastguard said in a statement on Sunday.

## Recommended Stories

list of 3 items
*   list 1 of 3[Taiwan Coast Guard confronts Chinese fishing boats in Dongsha waters](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/10/2/aje-onl-nf_taiwan-coast-guard-fires-water-cannon-on-chinese-021026)
*   list 2 of 3[Taiwan president says defence spending boost aims to ‘deter war’](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/10/taiwan-president-says-defence-spending-boost-aims-to-deter-war)
*   list 3 of 3[China sanctions Paraguay, Belize ministers over Taiwan ties](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/12/china-sanctions-paraguay-belize-ministers-over-taiwan-ties)

end of list
The Chinese vessels included four fishing boats, which engaged in “simultaneous operations’ that the coastguard described as “hybrid warfare”.

Taiwan’s coastguard said its vessels took “forceful action immediately to effectively neutralise the threats” and accused Beijing of “attempting to unilaterally alter the status quo” in the Taiwan Strait and give the “false impression of jurisdiction”.

Some of the vessels reportedly entered Taiwan’s restricted waters.

## Intensified maritime pressure

Beijing claims Taiwan and Pratas as part of its territory and asserts jurisdiction over the surrounding waters, which Taipei rejects. China has long threatened to use force to regain control of Taiwan.

In an incident on October 1 , Taiwan’s coastguard fired water cannon at a Chinese recreational fishing vessel near Pratas island between Taiwan and mainland China that Beijing claims.

China has intensified its maritime pressure on Taiwan in recent months. Beijing deployed a record 244 coastguard, scientific research and other ships around Taiwan’s main island in July, Taiwanese official data show, compared with just 58 in the same month last year.

 Advertisement

In the first 21 days of August, 152 vessels were detected; most were from the Chinese Coastguard, but fishing boats and research vessels were also involved.

China also deploys warships around Taiwan on a near-daily basis, but those are counted separately.

香港财政司司长在财富管理颁奖典礼上宣布，2025年香港管理资产将达到创纪录的42.2万亿港元，净流入激增近200%。政府计划进行税务改革和家族办公室目标，以维持香港的地位

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 23 日 14:20 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港财经事务及库务局局长表示，香港已成为全球最大的跨境财富管理中心，去年管理的总资产达到创纪录的42.2万亿港元，同比增长20%。该官员援引证监会最新调查显示，资本净流入激增近200%，至2.1万亿港元。

10月23日，司长在香港经济日报财富管理大奖2026颁奖典礼上发表讲话时预计，2025年至2030年，香港管理的跨境财富将以年均9%的速度增长，继续保持全球领先地位。他认为，香港的增长得益于“一国两制”的优势、开放透明的经济政策和稳定的投资环境。
这位官员指出，中央政府“十五五”规划明确支持加强香港作为国际资产和财富管理中心的地位。中环写字楼市场复苏，空置率降至9.9%，反映出业界对该市金融前景的信心。

为了提高竞争力，政府计划加强对基金、单一家族办公室和附带权益的税收优惠。拟议的措施包括扩大免税制度，以涵盖大型单一投资者基金和更多合格投资，例如贷款、私人信贷、数字资产和贵金属。如果立法通过，这些变化可能会从 2025-26 纳税年度开始生效。

在房地产投资信托方面，政府将在今年推出一项法案，以促进REITs私有化或重组，随后在明年上半年推出一项法案，对准备上市的REITs免除非住宅物业转让印花税。官员们还将寻求将房地产投资信托基金纳入与中国大陆资本市场的跨境互联互通计划。
目前，香港有超过 3,380 家单一家族办公室，每年产生约 126 亿港元的运营支出，并雇用了超过 10,000 名全职专业人士。政府制定了2026年至2028年间帮助至少220家家族办公室在该市建立或扩张的目标，比之前的三年目标200家增加了10%。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong's Financial Secretary announced at a wealth management awards ceremony that the city's managed assets reached a record HK$42.2 trillion in 2025, with net inflows surging nearly 200 per cent. The government plans tax reforms and family office targets to maintain Hong Kong's position as the

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 14:20 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury said the city has become the world's largest cross-border wealth management centre, with total assets under management reaching a record HK$42.2 trillion last year, up 20 per cent year on year. Net capital inflows surged nearly 200 per cent to HK$2.1 trillion, according to the latest Securities and Futures Commission survey cited by the official.

Speaking at the Hong Kong Economic Times Wealth Management Awards 2026 on 23 October, the secretary projected that the city's cross-border wealth under management would grow at an average annual rate of 9 per cent between 2025 and 2030, maintaining its global lead. He attributed the growth to Hong Kong's advantages under the 'one country, two systems' principle, its open and transparent economic policies, and stable investment environment.

The official noted that the central government's 15th Five-Year Plan explicitly supports strengthening Hong Kong's role as an international asset and wealth management centre. Office market recovery in Central saw vacancy rates fall to 9.9 per cent, reflecting industry confidence in the city's financial prospects.

To boost competitiveness, the government plans to enhance tax incentives for funds, single-family offices and carried interest. Proposed measures include expanding the tax exemption regime to cover large single-investor funds and more qualifying investments such as loans, private credit, digital assets and precious metals. The changes could take effect from the 2025-26 tax year if legislation passes.

On real estate investment trusts, the government will introduce a bill this year to facilitate REIT privatisation or restructuring, followed by a bill in the first half of next year to waive stamp duty on non-residential property transfers for REITs preparing for listing. Officials will also seek to include REITs in cross-border connectivity schemes with mainland Chinese capital markets.

More than 3,380 single-family offices now operate in Hong Kong, generating an estimated HK$12.6 billion annually in operating expenditure and employing over 10,000 full-time professionals. The government has set a target to help at least 220 more family offices establish or expand in the city between 2026 and 2028, representing a 10 per cent increase from the previous three-year target of 200.

香港
香港机电工程署更新了建筑物能源效益登记计划，并发布了区域供冷和集中式多建筑物供冷系统的新指引，于 2026 年 11 月 1 日生效。此举是继行政长官 2025 年施政报告之后

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 23 日 14:42 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港特别行政区政府机电工程署（机电工程署）于 2026 年 10 月 23 日宣布，发布了香港建筑能源效益注册计划的更新版本，以及区域供冷系统和集中式多建筑物供冷系统的新操作指引。
这些更新是在政府主导的启德区域供冷系统试点取得成功之后进行的，该试点证明了此类技术在香港的可行性。在2025年《行政长官施政报告》中，政府宣布计划推出优化计划，通过技术、税收和建筑面积激励措施，鼓励非政府实体发展较小规模的区域供冷或集中式多建筑物供冷系统。该计划旨在增加这些技术的采用并促进绿色技术的发展，支持减缓气候变化，并加速实现《香港气候行动计划2050》中香港的碳中和目标。

更新后的注册计划扩大了其范围，接受区域供冷和集中式多建筑供冷系统的注册申请，无需额外的绿色认证。根据该计划，合资格节能建筑装置的资本开支可在计算每年利得税时全数扣除。
新的操作指南为行业和用户提供了良好实践、设计参考和创新技术，以提高区域供冷和集中式多建筑供冷系统的可靠性、安全性和能源效率。该指南包括对现有《区域供冷服务冷却条件》、《区域供冷系统连接技术指南》和《区域供冷系统附近开挖指南》三份文件的更新，以及两份新增文件：《区域供冷系统模块化机电设备应用指南》和《区域供冷系统管网设施维护指南》。

更新后的登记方案及全部五项操作指引将于2026年11月1日起生效。优化计划下的进一步措施将逐步推出，预计于2027年第一季度全面实施。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong's Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has updated the Building Energy Efficiency Registration Scheme and issued new guidelines for district cooling and centralised multi-building cooling systems, effective 1 November 2026. The move follows the Chief Executive's 2025 Policy Addres

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 14:42 HKT · 2 min read

The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD) of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government has released an updated version of the Hong Kong Building Energy Efficiency Registration Scheme along with new operational guidelines for district cooling systems and centralised multi-building cooling systems, the government announced on 23 October 2026.

The updates follow the successful government-led Kai Tak district cooling system pilot, which demonstrated the feasibility of such technology in Hong Kong. In the 2025 Chief Executive's Policy Address, the government announced plans to introduce an optimisation programme encouraging non-government entities to develop smaller-scale district cooling or centralised multi-building cooling systems through technical, tax and floor area incentives. The programme aims to increase the adoption of these technologies and promote green technology development, supporting climate change mitigation and accelerating the city's goal of carbon neutrality under the Hong Kong Climate Action Plan 2050.

The updated registration scheme expands its scope to accept registration applications for district cooling and centralised multi-building cooling systems without requiring additional green certification. Under the scheme, capital expenditure on qualifying energy-efficient building installations can be fully deducted when calculating annual profits tax.

The new operational guidelines provide industry and users with good practices, design references and innovative technologies to enhance the reliability, safety and energy efficiency of district cooling and centralised multi-building cooling systems. The guidelines include updates to three existing documents — the District Cooling Service Cooling Conditions, the Technical Guidelines for Connection to District Cooling Systems, and the Guidelines for Excavation near District Cooling Systems — as well as two newly added documents: the Guidelines for Application of Modular Mechanical and Electrical Equipment in District Cooling Systems and the Guidelines for Maintenance of District Cooling System Pipeline Network Facilities.

The updated registration scheme and all five operational guidelines will take effect on 1 November 2026. Further measures under the optimisation programme will be rolled out progressively, with full implementation expected by the first quarter of 2027.

Taipei, Oct. 23 (CNA) The Mainland Affairs Council (MAC), Taiwan's top China policy agency, on Friday expressed condolences to China over a deadly earthquake in Tibet and urged Taiwanese nationals in the area to stay safe.

The magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Nagqu Prefecture at 10:33 p.m. Thursday, at a depth of 10 kilometers, according to the China Earthquake Networks Center.

As of 7 a.m. Friday, the earthquake had killed 16 people and injured 54 others, and 339 households had reported damage to their homes, China's Xinhua News Agency reported.

The MAC said Taiwan's Straits Exchange Foundation was trying to contact Taiwanese nationals in the affected area to check on their safety.

According to the government's registration system for Taiwanese traveling to China, Hong Kong and Macau, 164 people were registered as being in Tibet, the council said. It urged them to stay safe and said the government would closely monitor the situation.

# 西藏发生7级地震16死46伤

中国西藏那曲市巴青县星期四（10月22日）晚间发生7.0级地震，造成16人遇难，46人受伤，隔邻的青海也感受到强烈震动。

综合央视新闻和新华社报道，地震发生在星期四晚上10时33分，震源深度10千米，震中距青海省界约11公里，距青海杂多县城约152公里。地震已导致11人重伤，35人受轻伤，房屋倒塌及受损情况339户，牲畜棚圈受损20座。

报道称，目前救灾物资已陆续抵达灾区，各方救援力量正在全力开展抢险搜救、伤员救治等各项抗震救灾工作。此外，地震发生后，国务院抗震救灾指挥部副总指挥、应急管理部部长张成中立即视频调度当地情况，要求尽快核实灾情，全力做好抢险救援、群众转移安置和震情监测等工作。

国务院抗震救灾指挥部办公室、应急管理部启动国家地震灾害四级应急响应，派出工作组赶赴当地指导处置。

青海省玉树藏族自治州杂多县与巴青县相邻，交界乡镇震感强烈，部分房屋出现裂缝，暂未接到房屋倒塌和人员伤亡报告。

title: Third Hong Kong media outlet receives suspicious letter with unknown powder from UK
zh_title: 香港第三家媒体收到来自英国的含有不明粉末的可疑信件
summary: 第三家香港媒体收到一封从英国寄来的含有不明粉末的可疑信件，这是此类事件连续第二天发生。来自英国的含有不明粉末的威胁信被发送给三家香港媒体。照片：屏幕截图，来自 Orange News。在线媒体Orange News周四在Facebook上发帖称，其办公室收到了这封信，该信据称是“海外读者”的举报，但其中含有可疑粉末。 《橙色新闻》表示，其工作人员向警方报告了这一事件，其编辑团队的工作并没有受到影响。
content:
第三家香港媒体收到一封从英国寄来的含有不明粉末的可疑信件，这是此类事件连续第二天发生。来自英国的含有不明粉末的威胁信被发送给三家香港媒体。照片：屏幕截图，来自 Orange News。在线媒体Orange News周四在Facebook上发帖称，其办公室收到了这封信，该信据称是“海外读者”的举报，但其中含有可疑粉末。 Orange News表示，其工作人员已向警方报告了这一事件，其编辑团队的工作没有受到影响。该新闻媒体上传的一张照片显示，这封信上盖有英国主要邮政服务提供商皇家邮政的邮戳。该媒体表示，“强烈谴责任何通过非正常手段干扰新闻工作的行为”。在此事件发生之前，两家媒体——HK01 和 Dot Dot News——周三收到了来自英国的类似信件。两家媒体都向警方报告了这一事件，并表示他们的运营没有受到影响。 HK01表示“强烈谴责任何通过发送危险材料或威胁信来制造恐慌、恐吓记者或干扰编辑自主权的卑鄙行为”。点点新闻也谴责了这些信件。香港记者。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据新闻媒体报道，警方针对每起事件都派出了拆弹小组。
《橙新闻》由国有的华联出版集团旗下子公司运营，而《点点新闻》隶属于国有的大公文汇报集团。两者都被认为是亲建制媒体。 HK01由亲北京企业家余本海于2016年创立。上个月，当地媒体星岛日报也收到一封恐吓信，其中含有不明白色粉末。警方迅速逮捕了一名24岁的嫌疑人。香港记者协会（HKJA）当时谴责了这一事件，称这威胁了香港的新闻自由。自2020年和2024年国安法实施以来，香港的国际新闻自由指数大幅下降。监管机构称逮捕和监禁记者、突击搜查新闻编辑室以及关闭包括《苹果日报》、《立场新闻》和《公民新闻》在内的约 10 家媒体机构。超过 1,000 名记者失业，许多人移居国外。与此同时，香港政府资助的广播公司香港电台采用了新的编辑指南，清理了档案并砍掉了新闻和讽刺节目。另请参阅：解释者：国家安全法规定的香港新闻自由 2022 年，行政长官李家超表示，新闻自由“在香港人的口袋里”，但“没有人可以凌驾于法律之上”。尽管他告诉媒体要“讲好香港故事”，但政府部门却不愿对故事的说法做出回应。

【原文 English Original】
A third Hong Kong media outlet has received a suspicious letter containing unknown powder sent from the UK, marking the second consecutive day of such incidents. Threatening letters containing unknown powder from the UK were sent to three Hong Kong media outlets. Photo: Screenshot, via Orange News. Online media outlet Orange News said in a Facebook post on Thursday that its office received the letter, which purported to be a tip-off from “overseas readers,” but contained suspicious powder. Orange News said its staff reported the incident to police and that the work of its editorial team was not affected. A photo uploaded by the news outlet showed the letter was stamped with a Royal Mail postmark, the primary postal service provider in the UK. The outlet said it “strongly condemns any behaviour that interferes with journalistic work through abnormal means.” The incident came after two media outlets – HK01 and Dot Dot News – received similar letters from the UK on Wednesday. Both outlets reported the incidents to police and said their operations were not affected. HK01 said it “strongly condemns any despicable act that creates panic, intimidates journalists or interferes with editorial autonomy by sending dangerous materials or threatening letters.” Dot Dot News also condemned the letters. Journalists in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. A police bomb disposal team was dispatched in response to each of the incidents, according to the news outlets. Orange News is operated by a subsidiary of the state-owned Sino United Publishing group, while Dot Dot News falls under the state-affiliated Ta Kung Wen Wei Media Group. Both are considered pro-establishment media. HK01 was founded in 2016 by pro-Beijing entrepreneur Yu Pun-hoi. Last month, local outlet Sing Tao also received a threatening letter containing unidentified white powder. Police swiftly arrested a 24-year-old suspect. The Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) condemned the incident at that time, saying it threatened press freedom in the city. Hong Kong has plummeted in international press freedom indices since the onset of the 2020 and 2024 security laws . Watchdogs cite the arrest and jailing of journalists , raids on newsrooms and the closure of around 10 media outlets including Apple Daily , Stand News and Citizen News . Over 1,000 journalists have lost their jobs, whilst many have emigrated . Meanwhile, the city’s government-funded broadcaster RTHK has adopted new editorial guidelines , purged its archives and axed news and satirical shows. See also:  Explainer: Hong Kong’s press freedom under the national security law In 2022, Chief Executive John Lee said press freedom was “in the pocket” of Hongkongers but “nobody is above the law.” Although he has told the press to “ tell a good Hong Kong story ,” government departments have been reluctant to respond to story pitches .

## 马达加斯加暂停审理多宗腐败案

在印度洋中的非洲大岛马达加斯加，该国司法当局暂停审理三宗涉及前总统安德里·拉乔利纳（l'ancien président malgache Andry Rajoelina）及其部长的重大腐败案件。这是本台法广（RFI）法语通讯员巴黎时间2026年10月22日星期四发自非洲大岛马达加斯加（Madagascar）的最新法文消息之一。这三宗都是针对前政权的大案。

发表时间： 22/10/2026 - 21:05 更改时间： 22/10/2026 - 21:08

12 分钟 浏览时间

 法广(RFI)图片 / 马达加斯加[反贪机构]（PAC - le Pôle Anti-Corruption）是一个负责案件审理的专门法庭。 RFI Image / Madagascar : PAC - Pôle Anti-Corruption est un tribunal spécialiséisé composé de magistrats dédiés. (illustration) © RFI/Sarah Tetaud

[![Image 2: format adapté : 1920 x 1080](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/06db98b2-ce48-11f1-a08c-7967b15eed96/w:1024/2026-10-22-j-FMM-Madagascar-PAC-P%C3%B4le-Anti-Corruption-Sarah-Tetaud-Image-RFI.jpg) 法广(RFI)图片 / 马达加斯加[反贪机构]（PAC - le Pôle Anti-Corruption）是一个负责案件审理的专门法庭。 RFI Image / Madagascar : PAC - Pôle Anti-Corruption est un tribunal spécialiséisé composé de magistrats dédiés. (illustration) © RFI/Sarah Tetaud](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E7%B6%93%E8%B2%BF/20261022-rfi%E6%B3%95%E5%BB%A3-%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-%E5%B0%BC%E5%8F%A4%E6%8B%89-%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2-%E9%A6%AC%E9%81%94%E5%8A%A0%E6%96%AF%E5%8A%A0%E6%9A%AB%E5%81%9C%E5%AF%A9%E7%90%86%E5%A4%9A%E5%AE%97%E8%85%90%E6%95%97%E6%A1%88)
据本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）2026年10月22日星期四刊出的法文报道，马达加斯加（[Madagascar](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/madagascar/)）司法当局现已暂停审理三宗[贪腐](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E8%B4%AA%E8%85%90/#pager)（la [corruption](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/corruption/)）大案。这几宗案件针对前总统安德里·拉乔利纳（[Andry Rajoelina](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/andry-rajoelina/)）、其任内的总理克里斯蒂安·恩蔡（[Christian Ntsay](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/christian-ntsay/)）以及多名前政府部长。负责审理这些案件的反贪机构（Pôle anti-corruption）法庭希望确认其具有审理这些案件的资格。

**⦁-- 马达加斯加反贪腐机构希望确定其管辖权资格 --**

本台法广(RFI)[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)通讯员欧莱莉（[Aurélie K](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261022-madagascar-le-p%C3%B4le-anti-corruption-suspend-ses-poursuites-contre-l-ex-pr%C3%A9sident-andry-rajoelina-et-ses-ministres)）发自安塔那那利佛（Antananarivo）的消息介绍说，这是针对马达加斯加前政权提起的司法诉讼中，最严重的三起。其中之一是该国矿业部一个保险柜内36公斤黄金失踪案；另一宗案涉嫌在学校课桌椅公共采购合同及授予过程中的腐败行为；最后还有一桩案子涉及对马达加斯加主权基金的管理。

[![Image 3: Image d'archive / Madagascar: le Pôle anti-corruption suspend ses poursuites contre l’ex-président Andry Rajoelina et ses ministres. Ici, Panneau contre la corruption à Madagascar. (illustration)](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a325aafc-10b6-11ea-903e-005056bf7c53/w:1024/39086300851_76125aaeaf_z_0.jpg) Image d'archive / Madagascar: le Pôle anti-corruption suspend ses poursuites contre l’ex-président Andry Rajoelina et ses ministres. Ici, Panneau contre la corruption à Madagascar. (illustration) © Rod Waddington/Flickr / archive RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261022-madagascar-le-p%C3%B4le-anti-corruption-suspend-ses-poursuites-contre-l-ex-pr%C3%A9sident-andry-rajoelina-et-ses-ministres)
本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）的法文报道说，负责此类案件的专门法庭——[反贪机构]（PAC - le Pôle Anti-Corruption）已将相关程序全部暂停，并向高等宪法法院(HCC - la Haute Cour Constitutionnelle)询问其是否有权审理前执政当局的首长们。

**⦁-- 马达加斯加反贪腐机构希望确定其管辖权资格 --**

同一法文报道说，马达加斯加宪法为此预留了一个专门的司法管辖机构-[高等司法法院](HCJ-la Haute Cour de Justice)。然而，前任官员若要在此受审，必须首先由国会议员（un député）提起控告。据（马达加斯加）国家反腐败机构， 有15宗此类案件在国民议会被搁置了近五年之久。

尼古拉

本台法广(RFI)[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)通讯员在这篇法文报道的最后一个段落中指出，马达加斯加高等宪法法院(HCC- la Haute Cour Constitutionnelle)于今年三月份开辟了另一条途径。该法院裁定，[贪腐](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E8%B2%AA%E8%85%90/)行为不属于履行公职的范畴。因此，前任部长可以由反腐败部门进行审理。但该法院现在仍需裁定，这一逻辑是否也适用于一名前国家元首。马达加斯加前总统安德里·拉乔利纳（Andry Rajoelina）及其任命的前总理克里斯蒂安·恩蔡（Christian Ntsay）在一年前政权垮台时就已离开了这个国家。

Taiwan's table tennis players Lin Tzu-yu (right) and her partner Su Jin-sian (left). Photo courtesy of the Ministry of Sports

Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) Taiwan's Lin Tzu-yu (林姿妤) and her partner Su Jin-sian (蘇晉賢) won the mixed doubles XD20 table tennis gold at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, Thursday, marking Lin's second title defense of the Games and Taiwan's third gold.

Lin and Su defeated Hong Kong's Lam Yan Yu (林恩羽) and Wong Hon Lam (黃翰林) 11-9, 8-11, 11-5, 11-8 in the best-of-five-game final.

On Tuesday, Lin also defended her Asian Para Games women's singles class 10 table tennis title, defeating compatriot Tian Shiau-wen (田曉雯) in the final.

Lin has now won two of Taiwan's three gold medals at the Games.

Lin had won the mixed doubles event at the 2022 Asian Para Games with then-partner Lin Chun-ting (林駿梃).

(By Chen Jung-chen and James Lo)

title: What’s holding up Washington’s $14 billion arms sale to Taiwan?
zh_title: 是什么阻碍了华盛顿向台湾出售 140 亿美元的武器？
summary: 几个月来，台湾一直在等待美国总统唐纳德·特朗普批准出售价值 140 亿美元的武器和装备，台湾将利用这些武器和装备来抵御中国潜在的攻击。 2025 年 7 月 11 日汉光军演第四天，空军爱国者导弹系统部署在台北一个公园。照片：I-Hwa Cheng/法新社。华盛顿——台北最重要的安全支持者——已向台湾出售了价值数十亿美元的武器，最近一次是在12月，当时它批准了创纪录的111亿美元的一揽子计划。中国反对美国军事支持台湾
content:
几个月来，台湾一直在等待美国总统唐纳德·特朗普批准出售价值 140 亿美元的武器和装备，台湾将利用这些武器和装备来抵御中国潜在的攻击。 2025 年 7 月 11 日汉光军演第四天，空军爱国者导弹系统部署在台北一个公园。照片：I-Hwa Cheng/法新社。华盛顿——台北最重要的安全支持者——已向台湾出售了价值数十亿美元的武器，最近一次是在12月，当时它批准了创纪录的111亿美元的一揽子计划。中国反对美国对台湾的军事支持，北京声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并威胁要用武力夺取台湾。特朗普上个月赞扬了他与中国国家主席习近平的“伟大友谊”，但他顶住了美国的政治压力，包括来自共和党议员的压力，要求为当前的武器计划开绿灯。法新社来看看其中的内容以及为何被搁置：为什么台湾要购买美国武器？台湾正在花费巨资升级其防御能力并扩大其国内武器生产能力，但仍然需要美国武器来威慑中国。台湾海巡署船只停靠在台湾北部的基隆港。资料照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。自1979年华盛顿与台北建立外交关系转而与北京建立外交关系以来，美国一直恪守其在《台湾关系法》中的承诺，向台湾提供武器以供其防御。
但特朗普5月表示，美国对台军售可能成为与中国讨价还价的筹码，这在全世界敲响了警钟。另请参阅：特朗普否认向中国习近平出售武器，但表示“也许这是一个好主意”。台北已提醒特朗普注意美国的承诺，包括国务卿卢比奥在内的美国官员坚称美国对台政策没有改变。赖清德领导的民进党资深议员王定宇表示，此次出售将表明美国对台湾的支持，并向北京发出一个信息，即如果美国发动攻击，美国不会独自面对“台湾”。包裹里有什么？台湾正在开发一种名为“T-Dome”的多层防空系统，希望能够抵御中国大陆的潜在攻击。爱国者导弹、自动指挥和控制系统以及360度防空雷达系统被视为该系统的关键组成部分，并且是140亿美元计划中的项目之一。台北国防安全研究院军事专家苏子云表示：“这些系统结合起来可以增强台湾战略防空的弹性。”另请参阅：台湾领导人表示增加国防开支以“遏制战争” 武器系统的资金预计来自台湾议会经过数月政治争论后于 5 月通过的 250 亿美元国防开支法案。为什么被推迟了？
特朗普和习近平于 5 月在北京会面，这是预计 2026 年四次会晤中的第一次，当时双方领导人都在寻求缓解两国之间的贸易紧张局势。习近平向特朗普发出直言不讳的警告，称在台湾问题上的失误可能会让美国和中国陷入“冲突”。创纪录的 140 亿美元对台军售可能会威胁美中贸易休战。 “我将做出决定。我会看看，”峰会后，特朗普在回答有关他是否会继续向台湾出售武器的问题时表示。中国国家主席习近平（右）​对越南进行国事访问

【原文 English Original】
Taiwan has been waiting months for US President Donald Trump to approve a $14 billion sale of weapons and equipment, which the island democracy would use to fend off a potential Chinese attack. An Air Force Patriot missile system is deployed at a park in Taipei on July 11, 2025 on the fourth day of the Han Kuang military exercise. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng/AFP. Washington — Taipei’s most important security backer — has sold many billions of dollars’ worth of arms to Taiwan, most recently in December when it approved a record $11.1 billion package. China opposes American military support for Taiwan, which Beijing claims is part of its territory and has threatened to seize with force. Trump, who last month hailed his “great friendship” with Chinese President Xi Jinping, has resisted US political pressure, including from Republican lawmakers, to give the green light for the current arms package. AFP takes a look at what’s in it and why it’s being held up: Why is Taiwan buying US arms? Taiwan is spending huge sums upgrading its defence capabilities and expanding its domestic weapons production capacity, but it still needs US arms to deter China. Taiwan Coast Guard Administration vessels dock in the Port of Keelung in northern Taiwan. File photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. Since Washington switched diplomatic recognition from Taipei to Beijing in 1979, the United States has stuck to its commitments under the Taiwan Relations Act to provide weapons to Taiwan for its defence. But Trump said in May that US arms sales to Taiwan could be a bargaining chip with China, setting off alarm bells across the world. See also: Trump denies offering to sell arms to China’s Xi, but says ‘maybe it’s a good idea’ Taipei has reminded Trump of US commitments, and US officials including Secretary of State Marco Rubio have insisted American policy on Taiwan has not changed. The sale would signal US support for Taiwan and send a message to Beijing that if it launched an attack, it would not face “Taiwan alone”, said Wang Ting-yu, a senior lawmaker in President Lai Ching-te’s Democratic Progressive Party. What’s in the package? Taiwan is developing a multi-layered air defence system, known as the T-Dome, that it hopes could counter a potential Chinese attack. Patriot missiles, an automated command and control system and a 360-degree air defence radar system are seen as critical components of this system and are among the items in the $14 billion package. “Together these systems can strengthen the resilience of Taiwan’s strategic air defences,” said Su Tzu-yun, a military expert at the Taipei-based Institute for National Defense and Security Research. See also: Taiwan’s leader says increasing defence spending to ‘deter war’ Money for the weapons system is expected to come from a $25 billion defence spending bill passed by Taiwan’s parliament in May after months of political wrangling. Why has it been delayed? Trump and Xi met in Beijing in May — the first of four expected meetings for 2026 — as the rival leaders sought to ease trade tensions between their countries. Xi issued a blunt warning to Trump that missteps on Taiwan could push the US and China into “conflict”. A record $14 billion arms sale to Taiwan could threaten the US-China trade truce. “I’m going to make a determination. I’m going to see,” Trump said after the summit in response to a question about whether he would go ahead with arms sales to Taiwan. Chinese President Xi Jinping (right) ​paid a state visit ‌to the US between September 23 and 25 at the invitation of President Donald Trump (right). Photo: White House. Rubio said in June that the proposed package was “under review”, while officials said in May they were assessing whether American weapons stockpiles were sufficient for its Iran operations. A US official said recently that the chances of the package being split into smaller chunks “have gone way up”. Some Taiwanese officials have said they do not care if the US bundles the arms into a single package or multiple — they just want the weapons. “Militarily… Taiwan is racing against time,” said the analyst Su. “Acquiring weapons is not like ordering at a drive-through. Production, delivery and training all take time before the systems can enter service and become effective.”

content:
调查去年大埔火灾的独立委员会已向该市领导人提交了最终报告，详细说明了致命火灾的原因，并建议了哪些方面应承担责任。独立委员会成员于2026年10月22日向市领导李家超提交最终报告。图片：香港政府一站通。根据一份政府声明，委员会成员，包括主席法官乐大卫、立法会议员兼行政议员陈健波，以及医院管理局成员欧阳震华，于周四上午向行政长官李家超提交了最终报告。 “我们将认真研究委员会的报告，积极落实其建议，并尽快公布全面改革和追究责任的计划，”政府在声明中表示。政府表示，由于参与调查的几名个人已被指控犯有刑事犯罪，因此在发布该文件之前将咨询法律意见。 HK01 周四援引消息人士的话称，经过编辑的版本最早将于下周向公众发布，该版本隐藏了任何可能损害正在进行的刑事诉讼的信息。去年11月26日，大埔发生大火，吞噬了正在进行大规模翻修工程的政府资助宏福苑屋村的七栋建筑物。大火造成 168 人死亡，4,600 多名居民流离失所。香港民众悼念在大埔宏福苑火灾中丧生的遇难者。
照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。 大火发生后，幸存者呼吁政府官员承担责任，并回顾他们早些时候曾试图对建筑公司和监督翻修项目的咨询公司发出警报。 NowTV 援引消息人士的话报道称，独立委员会的报告没有指出任何具体负责的官员。主承包商 Prestige Construction & Engineering 和咨询公司 Will Power Architects 将承担这场悲剧的责任。在政府责任方面，报告将点名房屋局独立审查组、消防处、屋宇署及劳工处等四个部门失职，其中独立审查组负有最大责任。该委员会将由政府决定追究谁的责任，以及是否启动纪律处分。十月初，《明报》报道了泄密事件，称随着现任政府六个月最后任期即将结束，不会有任何部长因大埔火灾而被解雇。独立审查组 (ICU) 高级维修测量师 Andy Ku（中）于 2026 年 5 月 6 日离开宏福法院独立委员会听证会。照片：James Lee/HKFP。
该报消息人士称，政府将追究有关部门首长和公务员的“行政责任”，同时将重点转向根据委员会建议提出的改革建议。去年12月，大埔火灾发生几天后，行政长官李家超下令成立由法官领导的大埔火灾独立委员会。从今年3月开始，该委员会在四个月内举办了30场听证会，传唤承包商工作人员、居民和各部门公务员作证。代表独立委员会的高级法律顾问维克多·道斯 (Victor Dawes) 表示

【原文 English Original】
An independent committee investigating last year’s Tai Po fire has submitted its final report to the city’s leader, detailing the causes of the deadly blaze and recommending which parties should be held accountable. Members of the independent committee file their final report to city leader John Lee on October 22, 2026. Photo: GovHK. Committee members – including its chair Judge David Lok, lawmaker and Executive Councillor Chan Kin-por, and Hospital Authority member Rex Auyeung – filed the final report to Chief Executive John Lee on Thursday morning, according to a government statement. “We will carefully study the Committee’s report, actively follow up on its recommendations, and shortly announce the plans for the comprehensive reforms and pursuing accountability,” the government said in the statement. The government said it will consult legal opinions before publishing the document, as several individuals involved in the probe have been charged with criminal offences. A redacted version, hiding any information that might prejudice ongoing criminal proceedings, will be released to the public next week at the earliest, HK01 reported on Thursday, citing sources. The Tai Po fire broke out on November 26 last year, engulfing seven buildings in the government-subsidised Wang Fuk Court housing estate during large-scale renovation works. The blaze killed 168 and displaced over 4,600 residents. Hongkongers pay tribute to victims who died in the fatal fire in Tai Po Wang Fuk Court. Photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. Following the inferno, survivors have called for government officials to be held accountable, recalling their earlier attempts to sound the alarm over the construction company and a consultancy overseeing the renovation project. The independent committee’s report does not name any specific officials to be held responsible, NowTV reported , citing sources. Main contractor Prestige Construction & Engineering and consultancy Will Power Architects will instead bear the blame for the tragedy. Regarding government culpability, the report will name four departments, including the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit (ICU), the Fire Services Department, the Buildings Department, and the Labour Department, for their neglect of duties, with the ICU bearing the most responsibility. The committee will leave it to the government to decide who to hold accountable, and whether to initiate disciplinary action. In early October, Ming Pao reported on leaks suggesting that, as the current administration nears the end of its final term in six months, no ministers will be dismissed over the Tai Po fire. Andy Ku (centre), a senior maintenance surveyor at the Independent Checking Unit (ICU), leaves the Wang Fuk Court independent committee hearing on May 6, 2026. Photo: James Lee/HKFP. The newspaper’s sources said that the government will investigate the “administrative responsibility” of the department heads and civil servants concerned, while shifting their main focus to proposed reforms based on the committee’s recommendations. ‘Unshirkable responsibility’ Chief Executive John Lee ordered the formation of the judge-led independent committee for the Tai Po blaze in December last year, a few days after the fire broke out. From March this year, the committee hosted 30 hearings over four months, summoning contractor staff, residents, and civil servants from various departments to testify. Senior Counsel Victor Dawes, representing the independent committee, said in his 627-page closing statement in July that the government had an “ unshirkable responsibility ” for the fire. Wang Fuk Court on fire in late November 2025. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. One day earlier, a lawyer representing the government urged the committee and the public to differentiate between the “direct cause” of the incident and the authorities’ “regulatory responsibilities.” The lawyer said renovation contractors and professionals “deliberately cheated” the government.

content: 刘军宁   X @liujunning · Oct 21, 2026 自由·平等·博爱：这个观念坏在哪里？ “自由平等博爱”的由来 法兰西启蒙与法国大革命降生了一句著名的口号，叫做“自由平等博爱”。从此这个口号及其信条及其价值观声名大响、经久不衰，回荡至今。在每个中国有文化的人心中也非常受欢迎。 “自由平等博爱”已经变成了法兰西共和国的国家格言。首次把这三个词放在一起使用的是著名的政治人物－罗伯斯庇尔，他是法国大革命的最著名的政治领袖－雅各宾派的首领。他在1790年的一次正式的演讲中提出了“自由平等博爱”这个口号。第二次世界大战之后，“自由平等博爱”被写进了1946年的法国宪法和1958年的法国宪法。现在这个口号成了法国的国家格言，法国的三色国旗也是这个口号的象征。 在中国没有几个政治口号像“自由平等博爱”得到了那么广泛的认同，那么政治正确，那么有道德与情操的感染力。在中国的官方教科书中，“自由平等博爱”被认定为是一个进步的口号，离革命的口号只差一步。这个口号在英美一些进步左倾的知识分子中也很有影响力，但却被英美文明与英美保守主义所拒绝。 这次读书会所读的是斯蒂芬先生的《自由·平等·博爱》一书。斯蒂芬从站在维护自古以来的英国自由制度出发，指出“自由平等博爱”是一种非常错误的价值，即便这个口号在一些英国人中也很有感召力。要是没有斯蒂芬的这本书，在中国从保守主义的角度批评“自由平等博爱”将是非常非常困难的。这样的批评肯定会被视为极端的政治不正确，甚至会被认为是反动的，因为这个口号是进步的。所以，在中国的普遍共识中，“自由平等博爱”还是一个政治正确的口号。 对于密尔先生主张的“自由平等博爱”，斯蒂芬先生在书中做了深度的梳理与批判，王建勋老师已经开始辅导大家阅读这本书。为了深化大家对“自由平等博爱”的理解，我今天将结合该书谈谈保守主义对自由的看法，谈谈保守主义与法兰西启蒙各自的自由观。因为自由是一个充满歧义的范畴，自由的字样已经写在一切的相互对立的意识形态的旗帜上，若不对自由的含义做明确的界定，仅仅说说自由的好话是没有多少实质意义的。 自由的源头 我想先从自由的源头说起。人的自由是从哪里来的？保守主义认为答案只有一个，我们的自由来自作为造物主的耶和华，自由是他赠给人类的礼物。个人不能赋予自己以自由，国家不能赋予国民以自由，君主不能赋予臣民以自由，自然也不能赋予人类以自由，科学更不能给人类制造出自由。人的自由权不是统治者所给予的，也不是统治者有权界定的，只有造物主主才有资格、有能力、有善意赋予人类的自由。 美国宪政的基础 我上面这个说法的依据是美国宪法。美国宪法与宪政就是建立在“造物主赋予人类以自由”这个基础之上的。美国的《独立宣言》是这么说的，“我们认为这些真理是不证自明的：每个人都平等受造，造物主赋予他们若干不可剥夺的权利，其中包括生命权、自由权和追求幸福的权利。”这里讲的很清楚，为什么要制定美国宪法？美国为什么要独立？美国人凭什么要自由？因为造物主赋予的他们自由权。我们再看看美国宪法是怎么写的。其序言中写道，“我们合众国人民为建立更完善的联盟，树立正义，保障国内安宁提供共同防护，促进公共福祉，并保障祂（造物主）赐福给我们以及我们后代的自由，特此为美利坚合众国订立本宪法。”换句话说，如果自由不是造物主赋予的，我们的独立就是没有理由的，制定美国宪法是没有必要的。所以，这两个引证讲得很清楚：美国宪法完全是建立在造物主赋予每个人自由这样的一个基础之上的。 我们再看看杰斐逊是怎么说的。他说的甚至更加明确：“赋予我们生命的造物主也把自由赐给了我们。在人们的心田中，自由是来自造物主的礼物。这个信念是国民自由权的唯一坚实的基础。如果我们移去了这个基础，我们还能认为国民们的自由权仍将稳固持久吗？”如果自由不是来自造物主，那么国民的自由权是不会稳固持久的。后来美国的政治实践表明，美国的自由权迄今为止还是稳固持久的，这也恰恰证成了他们当初争取独立和制定宪法时的看法－那就是人的自由权来自造物主。所以，当造物主把选择的自由作为礼物送给亚当夏娃的时候，他们的全部后代都享有这个礼物。正如我们今天所看到的，就像原罪是不可撤回的一样，造物永远也不会撤回祂赋予人类的自由。这是祂赐给人类的礼物。自由是造物主许诺给人的，对自由的追求也被造物主植入到每个人的心中。所以我们今天所看到的，不论是不是认耶和华为主的国家，都能看到每个人对自由的追求。他们也许时而放弃，也许时而妥协，但是，对自由追求是永远存在的。这也就是说，不探讨自由的神圣源头，就不能理解自由的真谛，也不可能真正获得并享有自由。 历史的验证 当一国之民忘掉造物主的时候，暴君就锻造好了奴役民众的锁链。不信看看那些无神论、唯物论国度的自由状况，就知道自由有其神圣源头。在中国的历史上自由定期归零，是因为中国人不认识造物主，不相信耶和华，不相信自由是来自祂的礼物，因而也毫不珍惜，结果是各种自由频频得而复失。 这个论断也同样适用于耶和华的选民以色列。犹太人的命运在历史上跌宕起伏的缘故也在于此。当以色列人信仰耶和华、恪守十诫时，当他们珍惜雅威的礼物时，他们就得到雅威的赐福，享受自由、安宁与繁荣。当以色列人不再信造物主，崇拜他神，悖逆十诫时，他们就失去自由、遭受奴役，甚至遭受耶和华重重的惩罚。可见，对耶和华的态度决定了对耶和华礼物的态度，也就决定了犹太人的命运－幸福、自由，还是奴役、苦难？这两个主题在以色列历史上不断地交替出现。 所以，保守主义所主张的是有序的自由及神定秩序之下的自由。因为造物主按照自己的形象创造了人，并赋予人以自由的厚礼，就是要让人去自由地思想，自由地言说，自由地创造，自由地实现自我。当耶和华授权人类去统领大地以及上面的万物时，其中也包含让人类去享有自由，也包含着人类应该为享有这样的自由而承担责任。所以自由不是放纵。 自由与律法 被人们所忽视的是，终极的自由宪章是耶和华所写的十诫。这个十诫后来成为祂与祂的选民之间的圣约。表面上看，十诫是对个人的要求，其实十诫上也是对国家的要求。当一个国家不盗窃民众的财产、不侵犯民众的自由、不谋杀民众的生命，并制止任何盗窃财产、侵犯自由和谋杀生命的这些行为的时候，个人的生命权、自由权、财产权就得到了充分的保障。所以，我们看到自由是以上帝所制定的律法为前提的，是受到雅威的律法所约束的。所以，柏克才说，自由必须被约束，才能被拥有，否则，自由就是放纵。 所以，自由是有序的，是秩序之下的自由。有序的自由服从于雅威的律法和人的法律，服从于传统与道德。在信仰和道德、法律传统之外谈论自由毫无意义。对人类而言，只有在信仰与道德、法律与传统的体系之内，才有做出自由选择的可能。因此，自由的性质与价值存在于规范自由的限制之中，没有限制，如柏克所言，就没有自由。因而，保守主义只支持合乎道德的传统的法律的自由。 保守主义要保守的是有序的自由，是习俗与传统中的自由。这种自由是在历史与现实中的具体的自由，不是文人脑袋中抽象出来的自由。保守主义主张给每个人以同等的最大限度的自由，即在法律与传统之下的有序的自由。在政治上，在商业上，在个人生活上，放纵的、不受节制的自由，必然要损害到每个人的自由。在许多保守主义者看来，自由的价值不仅仅在于它有种种的效用，以及达到其他目的的价值，自由本身就是终极价值，是人类的天赋本性的必然要求。 自由作为选择 自由在根本上是个选择，是一个在不同的可能性之间的一个抉择。当自由被当作礼物给人类的时候，耶和华冒了很大很大的风险，因为祂知道人一定会滥用自由。但是，祂却依然让人类享有这份礼物。人们在自由选择中学会分辨善恶，并体验到自由选择的不同后果。耶和华也借此考验人类的领悟自由的能力、自由选择的能力，运用自由的能力以及承担后果的能力。所以，自由事关选择。没有选择就没有自由，有选择才有自由。自由是做出选择、承担责任与接受后果的机会，自由与责任是联系在一起的。 法兰西启蒙对自由的理解 上面我们谈的是保守主义对自由的看法，下面我们再谈一谈“自由平等博爱”背后的法兰西启蒙对自由是怎么理解的。法兰西启蒙所主张的自由是无限的自由，摆脱一切约束的自由。法兰西启蒙认为自由不是造物主的礼物，而是人的产物，是人的大脑自身的产物，特别是由一些政治家和思想家思考出来的。他们认为人本身而不是造物主，是自由的源头，如让·雅各·卢梭所言，“人生而自由，却无往不在枷锁中。” 卢梭认为自由是无限的，是从一开始就拥有的，但是，实现自由需要突破枷锁。卢梭所谓的枷锁特别是指教会的权威，也是实现自由所要反抗的对象；其他的枷锁还包括习俗、传统和道德，都被认为是个性解放与个人自由的敌人。这种自由观也被中国的新青年一代以及后来的追随新青年的人－五四运动乃至文革所继承。在这些运动中，我们都看到了打碎一切传统与枷锁的诉求和行动。 法兰西启蒙不是基于雅威的律法与传统来确定自由的范围，而是依据所谓的“伤害原则”。雅各宾党人主导的1789年《人权与公民权宣言》规定，“自由即所有人皆拥有的，做一切不伤害其他人的自主权。除了保障社会上其他人享受同样权利外，此自然权利不应有任何限制。”所谓的“伤害原则”指的是，凡是不伤害他人的行为都应该在自由的范围之内，而不应该受到任何限制。所以，“自由平等博爱”中的自由意味着每个人有权各行其是，只要不给他人造成伤害就行。自由指向的是个性解放，即按照自己意志进行活动的权利。这一点也体现在密尔的观点中。在密尔那里，这个说法叫“自行其乐无妨，伤害他人莫为（Do as you please, but harm none）。这句话在斯蒂芬的《自由·平等·博爱》一书中可以见到。 自由观背后的人性论 关于自由，保守主义和法兰西启蒙的另外一个重大差异是人性论。因为，每一种政治思想主张、每一种对自由的看法，都基于各自对人性的看法。对人性的看法，决定了对自由的看法。保守主义的人性论基于人的原罪，对人性持悲观的看法。所以，一定要给人的自由设定一个框架，以免自由变成放纵，这就是像水需要容器一样。保守主义认为人性是不完善的，所以，一方面要给人自由，另外一方面要把人的自由放到特定的框架之内，而不能没有框架。 法兰西启蒙持乐观主义的人性论。他们认为人性是向善的，是可完善的，甚至能够达到至善的。既然人性本善，就没有必要对人类设防，就不要严格的约束，只要有可能就给人以无限的自由。这种观点在卢梭的《论人类不平等的起源》中，以及中国人所熟悉的诗句－“六亿神州尽舜尧”这样的语言中，让大家都能感受到：通过政治学习与政治教育，人是可以成为舜尧的，是可以变得极其完美的。 所以，小结一下：保守主义主张有序的自由，法兰西启蒙和“自由平等博爱”的价值观，主张无限的不受约束的自由。 自由的条件 人们在讨论自由的时候，常常忽略一个重要的维度，这就是自由的条件。具体的说，是实现自由需要什么样的条件？或者说如何人才配得自由？ 如果想享受自由，这对人的秉性是有要求的。在法国的革命者们捣毁了巴士底监狱之后，1789年英国的保守主义先驱柏克给友人写了一封信。他在信中写道，“这种革命精神根本不值得称道。如果这种革命精神不是一个偶发事件，而是一个品格的话，那么法国人是不配得自由的。”法国革命者用事实证明，他们的确不配得自由。后来发生的事情充分证明了柏克与保守主义对自由的洞见。在法兰西启蒙思想结出的第一个果实，就是腥风血雨的法国大革命，接在断头台下高高的尸堆上雄起了独裁者拿破仑。他的军国主义把整个欧洲都拖入了战争。此后的法国也一直在共和与帝制的漩涡中挣扎，在一系列的大小战争中连尝败绩，两次被德国占领，靠被英美解救才成为战胜国，直到1958年通过第五共和，法兰西才走上相对稳定的正轨。 前面提到罗伯斯庇尔是“自由平等博爱”口号的极力倡导者，但他竖起的却是断头台，留下的是无头尸，也包括他自己。诗人赫尔德林曾经说过，通向地狱的路是鲜花铺就的。如果法国大革命带来的是腥风血雨的恐怖统治（Reign of Terror）的话，那么，“自由平等博爱”就是通向这种恐怖统治之路上的鲜花，而且是非常美丽的鲜花。 如果要想配得自由，那些追求的自由的人们就必须把美德、勇气、正确的判断在审慎和良知结合起来。这样的自由要求每个人对其自由意志，以自由的行动承担后果。所以，有序的自由是反思性的自由，而不是为所欲为的自由。正如柏克所言，“我要自诩我爱的是一种有气概、有道德、有规矩的自由。”只有爱这样自由的人才是配得自由的人。 人类要想真的配得自由，就意味着人类不可以为所欲为，意味着人类的自由是耶和华与其律法之下的自由。耶和华给人类自由，并用十诫来保护这些自由。这是对人的要求，而不是对其他物种的要求。动物不享有自由权，因为他们不需要十诫与律法，没有必要对狮子说不要谋杀，没有必要对老鼠说不要盗窃。是否享有自由这份礼物，是否恪守十诫是人与动物的一个根本区别。对造物主律法的态度，决定了一个国度的人们是否配得自由。中国的历史同样证明了这一点：自由必须争取，但只有配得自由的国度与人民才能得到自由。 自由的实现 当我们讨论完自由的条件之后，再来谈谈如何实现自由，这个是非常关键的一步。自由分成两个不一样的类型，一个是我们通常所说的自由的权利（liberty），一个叫自由的状态（freedom），这两个区分仅仅适用于英语国家。在拉丁语国家，只有前面一个，即自由权利（liberty），这里既包含自由的权利，也包含自由的状态。这个区分是非常非常重要的。理解了这两个区分，更有利于我们去追求自由，也更有利于理解为什么自由首先在英国和美国得以成功实现,并且持久存在。我们可以这么去想,既然造物主给了我们自由（指自由权），为什么不自由的情形却普遍存在？因为造物主给了我们自由权，不等于我们就有了自由，更不等于我们就可以不用努力坐享其成。就像造物主给了每个人财产权一样，不等于我们不用努力就可以家财万贯。不自由与贫困，常常独立于自由权与财产权而独立存在而普遍存在。 我们如何在自由权与自由的状态之间建立关联？既然造物主给了我们自由权的大礼，就意味着我们还必须去争取自由，而且是在雅威的引导下。就像当年《出埃及记》里所展示的，一方面造物主（耶和华）给了他们自由权，同时又一步一步地引导他们去争取进入自由的状态，这样他们才真正地走出埃及，成为配得自由并且享有自由的人。法国大革命也是以追求自由的名义所发动，但是他们不寻求造物主的领导，而是要自行其是。而且他们还以“自由平等博爱”的名义去诉诸暴力，用暴力拆除阻挡他们的一切藩篱，以追求不是比任何约束的自由。 小结一下，“自由平等博爱”对自由的理解在根本上是错误的，是错误的自由观。它对自由的源头、自由的性质、由与人性的关系，自由的条件与自由的实现等一系列问题上的看法都是错误的。“自由平等博爱”对人性评价过高，因而也给了人类其所不能承受的自由，因为这个自由在本质上是是放纵而不是自由。熟悉美国政治人都知道，今天美国的左派被称作自由派。争取自由原本是件好的事情，为什么在美国左派却被称为自由派？因为他们追求造物主没有赋予人类的自由，他们要按照自己的意志，确定其所要追求的自由，他们按照自己的方式实现他们的自由，他们要通过议会道路、街头路线和文化战略来获得造物主没有赋予他们的那些自由。他们所要的是作为放纵的自由，是摆脱一切束缚的自由。这一点从变性运动，从“黑命贵”，从放任非法移民这些事情上，都可以看到自由派所要追求的自由究竟是什么。 如果评选世界上最动听的口号，我肯定会投票给“自由平等博爱”。我也承认这些都是好字眼。但另一方面，“自由平等博爱”不仅是三个口号，而且是一个完整的更大口号，三个1相加大于3。这个口号出自人，却以造物主的姿态取代造物主所给予人类的“自由平等爱”。这个口号成了新的教义，并且试图取而代之。王建勋老师在课中也提出，密尔特别推崇法国人孔德，他是社会主义的先驱。孔德就试图创立新的宗教来取代对雅威的信靠，提倡“自由平等博爱”的人，他们想把这个价值观抬高到与基督教分庭抗礼，甚至取而代之的层面，可见这个口号的背后是一个乌托邦，一旦彻底实践将会产生灾难性的后果。 我们看一看法国的历程，法兰西启蒙拒绝了亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神，他们找到了自己所发明的神，这就是“自由平等博爱”。他们对重塑人类的追求，甚至超过了重塑法国的追求。所以，在法国信仰自由，变成了不信仰雅威的自由。这在其他国家的宪法中也能看到。法国巴黎也随之成了培养世界各国革命家的圣地和摇篮。我不反对分别的自由、平等与博爱，但是反对作为特定价值观的“自由平等博爱”，反对作为乌托邦的“自由平等博爱”。 未来的国度是雅威的国度 斯蒂芬在对该书总结时说到，管理和引导人类的全部生活有赖于对是否存在造物主和未来国度（future state，书中译为“来世”，有误对于未来国度最详细的描述是在《新约·启示录》中）。斯蒂芬认为，有雅威而没有未来的国度，雅威对我们是没有意义的，因为雅威要把我们带到未来的国度，因为未来的国度是雅威的国度。什么叫做未来的国度？那是雅威亲自掌权的国度，是耶稣亲自掌权的国度，那就是雅威的国度。如果我们只承认雅威的存在而不认为是雅威在掌权，那雅威对我们来说毫无意义。如果有未来国度但没有雅威，我们又不知道谁来掌权，所以我们就不可能对这个未来国度是好是坏产生任何合理的推测。所以，如果既没有雅威也没有未来国度，会出现什么情形？就会出现“自由平等博爱”这样一个基于个人好恶的，基于人所制定的功利主义来规制人的行为的一种情形。 （演讲整理稿）

title: Budget agency yet to discuss funding for CPC's Alaska LNG investment - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 预算机构尚未讨论中油阿拉斯加液化天然气投资的资金问题 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月21日电 台湾预算机构负责人周三表示，尚未讨论为国有中油公司提供资金的问题，该机构计划投资阿拉斯加液化天然气(LNG)项目。预算会计统计司司长陈淑姿在立法听证会上告​​诉立法者，由于该项目的谈判正在进行中，因此尚未咨询她的机构。她表示，资金是否来自年度预算或特别预算将取决于中共的财务结构，但她否认拟议的2,338亿新台币
content:
中新社台北10月21日电 台湾预算机构负责人周三表示，尚未讨论为国有中油公司提供资金的问题，该机构计划投资阿拉斯加液化天然气(LNG)项目。

预算会计统计司司长陈淑姿在立法听证会上告​​诉立法者，由于该项目的谈判正在进行中，因此尚未咨询她的机构。

她表示，资金是否来自年度预算或特别预算将取决于中油集团的财务结构，但她否认拟议向该公司注资2,338亿元新台币的目的是为阿拉斯加交易提供资金。

经济部(MOEA)上周宣布，CPC计划在该项目上投资至多44亿美元，投产后每年采购600万吨液化天然气，大约相当于台湾目前年需求的四分之一。

该部表示，如果该项目的开发按计划进行，最早可能于 2032 年开始交付，不过购买和投资细节仍在谈判中。

[● CPC将投资至多44亿美元阿拉斯加液化天然气项目](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610140011)

陈在周三的听证会上表示，拟议对中油集团和国有公用事业台电公司进行注资和补贴的目的是缓解它们在政府稳定价格政策下吸收更高能源成本所造成的财务压力。
自2020年以来，由于2021年COVID-19后需求激增、俄罗斯2022年入侵乌克兰以及2026年2月开始的伊朗战争，CPC已吸收了6740亿元新台币（207.6亿美元）的进口原油和天然气成本增加。

公司数据显示，截至9月底，累计亏损达新台币910亿元。

经济部的数据显示，台电虽然吸收了大致相同的较高成本，但自 2020 年以来累计亏损已达新台币 3,712 亿元。

内阁提出的6076亿元追加预算，包含对两家公司的补贴。立法者指出，如果年底前未获得通过，该提案将失效。

陈警告说，如果不通过，中油公司的损失将达到新台币1,276亿元，占其1,301亿元实收资本的90%以上。

她表示，这可能会阻碍银行融资，并可能影响原油供应，从而增加通胀压力，并敦促立法者支持预算，以帮助稳定生活成本。

自2016年民进党执政以来，在立法院占多数的反对党因反对民进党的能源政策，一直不愿为中国共产党和台电提供额外资金。

该政策强调逐步淘汰核电，同时支持可再生能源发展，同时严重依赖化石燃料，特别是液化天然气。
根据能源管理局的数据，2026 年前 8 个月，化石燃料占台湾发电量的 85% 以上。

经济部上周表示，阿拉斯加伙伴关系将使台湾液化天然气供应多元化并加强能源安全。报告称，跨太平洋直接运输将提供替代供应路线，有助于降低地缘政治风险。

（潘子瑜、赵彦翔）

尾项/ls

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 21 (CNA) Taiwan's budget agency has yet to discuss funding for state-owned CPC Corp., Taiwan's planned investment in an Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) project, its chief said Wednesday.

Chen Shu-tzu (陳淑姿), head of the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, told lawmakers at a legislative hearing that her agency had not yet been consulted because negotiations on the project were ongoing.

Whether funding would come through the annual budget or a special budget would depend on CPC's financial structure, she said, but she denied that a proposed NT$233.8 billion capital injection into the company was aimed at financing the Alaska deal.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) announced last week that CPC planned to invest up to US$4.4 billion in the project and purchase 6 million metric tons of LNG annually, or roughly a quarter of Taiwan's annual needs at present, once production begins.

Deliveries could start as early as 2032 if the project's development proceeds on schedule, though purchase and investment details were still being negotiated, the ministry said.

[● CPC to invest up to US$4.4 billion in Alaska LNG project](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610140011)

At Wednesday's hearing, Chen said the proposed capital injection and subsidies for CPC and state-owned utility Taiwan Power Co. were intended to ease financial pressure caused by their absorption of higher energy costs under the government's price-stabilization policy.

Since 2020, CPC has absorbed NT$674 billion (US$20.76 billion) in increases in the cost of imported crude oil and natural gas due to a post-COVID 19 surge in demand in 2021, Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, and the war in Iran that began in February 2026.

That has led to accumulated losses of NT$91 billion as of the end of September, company data showed.

Taipower has absorbed roughly the same in higher costs, but its accumulated losses since 2020 have totaled NT$371.2 billion, according to the MOEA.

A supplementary budget of NT$607.6 billion proposed by the Cabinet includes subsidies for the two companies. Lawmakers noted that the proposal would lapse if not passed by year-end.

Without passage, CPC's losses would reach NT$127.6 billion, more than 90 percent of its NT$130.1 billion paid-in capital, Chen warned.

That could hamper bank financing and potentially affect crude oil supplies, adding inflationary pressure, she said, urging lawmakers to support the budget to help stabilize living costs.

Opposition parties, which hold a majority in the Legislative Yuan have been reluctant to provide additional funding for CPC and Taipower because of their objections to the Democratic Progressive Party's energy policy since it took power in 2016.

The policy stressed phasing out nuclear power while supporting the development of renewable energy while relying heavily on fossil fuels, especially LNG.

Fossil fuels have accounted for over 85 percent of Taiwan's electricity generation in the first eight months of 2026, according to Energy Administration figures.

The economics ministry said last week that the Alaska partnership would diversify Taiwan's LNG supplies and strengthen energy security. Direct shipments across the Pacific would provide an alternative supply route that could help reduce geopolitical risks, it said.

(By Pan Tzu-yu and Chao Yen-hsiang)

title: APEC财长会议闭幕，财长们就应对外部挑战达成共识，但未提出具体措施
summary: 亚太经合组织(APEC)财长会议10月20日至21日在香港举行。此次会议正值在亚太地区面临地缘政治局势紧张、不断攀升的债务和技术变革等重要问题之际，各成员经济体财长们探讨了如何在公共财政收紧的情况下支持经济增长，并就如何应对外部挑战达成共识。不过，各方并未就具体政策调整作出承诺。 财长们在会后发布的[联合声明](https://www.apec.org/meeting-papers/sectoral-ministerial-meetings/finance/2026-apec
content:
亚太经合组织(APEC)财长会议10月20日至21日在香港举行。此次会议正值在亚太地区面临地缘政治局势紧张、不断攀升的债务和技术变革等重要问题之际，各成员经济体财长们探讨了如何在公共财政收紧的情况下支持经济增长，并就如何应对外部挑战达成共识。不过，各方并未就具体政策调整作出承诺。

财长们在会后发布的[联合声明](https://www.apec.org/meeting-papers/sectoral-ministerial-meetings/finance/2026-apec-finance-ministers'-meeting)表示，各国重申致力于到2040年构建一个开放、充满活力、具有韧性、和平的亚太共同体；财长们讨论的优先事项包括支持家庭的财政政策、数字基础设施融资、全民享有金融服务和机会，以及青年金融人才对话等等。

联合声明指出，虽然全球和区域经济展现出韧性，快速的技术发展和产业转型成为经济增长的重要引擎，但是，“持续的地缘经济紧张局势、供应链脆弱性、大宗商品价格波动、融资环境趋紧、极端天气事件和自然灾害以及政策不确定性等因素，仍然构成下行风险”。

声明重申了致力于“维护具有韧性的供应链的重要性”，并指出各国都认识到保持区域互联互通和贸易通道畅通符合大家的共同利益。

在数字基础设施融资方面，联合声明强调财长们认识到“稳健的数字基础设施是经济韧性和金融稳定的基石”，但是，一些经济体仍存在巨大的融资缺口，且这一问题正在逐步加剧。

对此，财长们鼓励公共部门为数字基础设施发展“营造清晰、透明且可预期的政策与监管框架”，也鼓励私营部门在提供资金和技术专长方面开发和采用创新的融资方式。

**APEC各经济体财长达成的共识**

中国财政部长、APEC财长会议主席蓝佛安星期三(10月21日)在新闻发布会上表示，亚太经合组织各成员经济体的财政部长已达成共识，将加强宏观经济政策的沟通协调，以应对外部风险和挑战；另外，各成员国也将深化区域一体化进程，推动构建亚太共同体。

APEC的官网新闻报道说，国际货币基金组织(IMF)和亚洲开发银行(ADB)分别提交了对全球和区域经济状况的评估报告，为各国部长审视经济增长和金融稳定面临的风险提供了依据。

另外，世界银行(World Bank)在会议上提交的一份报告探讨了财政政策如何增强家庭抵御能力，同时支持长期增长。报告强调了平衡家庭短期需求与人力资本投资和可持续公共财政的重要性。

APEC财长会是下月APEC领导人非正式会议召开前的最后一个部长级会议，

APEC组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议将于11月18日至19日在深圳举行，主题是“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣”。这是继2001年上海和2014年北京之后，中国第三次举办APEC峰会。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)预计将前往深圳出席本次会议。届时他将可能与中国国家主席习近平及俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)举行双边和三边领导人会谈。

# HELP BRING MY SON BACK HOME

My name is Nelson Wells, Sr. and I write to you on behalf of my wife, Cynthia Wells, and our family, asking for your assistance in our fight to bring home our son, Nelson Wells, Jr., who has been unjustly imprisoned in China for more than eight years. We are natives of Louisiana, who have served our country for decades. I served in the United States Army for more than 20 years, and Cynthia, served at the Department of Defense for nearly 28 years. We’ve traveled all over the United States and world and have a host of extended family and friends, who join us in the fight for our son. This includes Nelson’s wife and three children, who are desperate to have him returned to our family unit. Like us, Nelson, Jr. loved to travel, and it was this love of travel that inspired him to live in Japan and visit China. Unfortunately, it was on one of these visits there that Nelson was arrested and later convicted on a drug charge with little evidence of his guilt, opportunity to defend himself, or due process prior to this conviction and incarceration. He was stripped of his freedom without the opportunity to tell his story. Indeed, it took months for us to learn what happened to him. We’ve fought for years to help our son, working behind the scenes with advocates, lawyers and diplomatic officials in the United States and China. We were told that this quiet strategy was the best strategy to keep him safe, but after nearly a decade with little progress, we’ve decided to tell our story, Nelson’s story. It breaks our heart to say it, but Nelson is now sick. The weight of incarceration has taken a toll on his physical and mental health. As you can see from the photos, our child has gone from a healthy man to an emaciated one, who has lost more than 100lbs and is in poor health. He is suffering from life-threatening medical problems in a prison in Chongqing Southwest China far from us, far from his wife and children. Indeed, we have not seen him during these eight long years. We are sustained by periodic calls from him, and for that, we are thankful to God, the United States State Department, and the Chinese government and prison officials. Still, we fear that he will not last much longer. It is time to bring Nelson home, perhaps through medical parole. Whatever the pathway, getting help for him is more urgent now than ever and so we are turning to the public for help with legal fees and welfare support on his behalf. No amount is too small, and we promise that your donations will only be used to directly secure the release and return of our son. We also invite you to leave a comment alongside your donation with a note of inspiration that we can share with Nelson, a personal reflection about Nelson for those who know him, or a testimonial about why you are deciding to join our fight. Thank you for considering this request. Thank you for your thoughts and prayers for Nelson. Thank you, in advance, for your generosity. Even the act of creating this go fund me page and sharing our story publicly has given us – including Nelson – purpose and hope for the future when we can be reunited. Until then we are heartbroken, but we fight on. Mr. Nelson Wells, Sr. and Mrs. Cynthia Wells Louisiana

title: Hong Kong aviation chief joins C929 certification meeting in Shanghai

summary: 根据内地、香港和澳门监管机构 4 月份达成的协议，中国香港民航处处长出席了在上海举行的首次 C929 型号联合认证会议。 C929 是中国第一架国产长途宽体喷气式飞机，设计座位数高达 290 个，[![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), 主编 2026年10月21日 17:05 香港时间 · 更新于 10 月 21 日 17:19 · 阅读时间 1 分钟 图片：[香港特区政府新闻公报](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/ge
content:
中国
根据内地、香港和澳门监管机构四月份达成的协议，香港民航处处长出席了在上海举行的首次 C929 型号联合认证会议。 C929是中国第一架自主研发的远程宽体客机，设计座位数高达290个，

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 17:05 香港时间 · 更新于 10 月 21 日 17:19 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

 图片：[香港特区政府新闻公报](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/21/P2026102100334.htm)

香港政府宣布，香港民航处处长黄家华周三（10 月 21 日）出席在上海举行的首次 C929 型号联合认证会议。

会议落实了中国民航局、香港民航处、澳门民航局4月签署的C929飞机型号合格审定合作安排。

与主要用于短途航线的C909和C919喷气式飞机不同，C929是中国第一架自主研发的双通道远程宽体客机，设计最大载客量为290个，航程12000公里，可实现跨洋和长途洲际飞行。
黄说，自2007年以来，应内地监管机构的邀请，她的部门积极参与C909和C919飞机的适航审定审查。她对再次受邀参加C929型号认证表示荣幸，并补充说香港将借鉴C909和C919的成功经验，运用适航认证方面的专业知识来支持C929计划。

会上香港代表分享了国际飞机认证经验，并确定了后续支持工作组的蓝图和合作安排。

香港民航处表示，支持国家民航业在各个领域的高质量发展，并表示此次合作将显着深化香港航空业与国家航空航天业的融合，让香港抓住国家“十五五”规划的发展机遇。

黄原定于同日返回香港。

Hong Kong's Civil Aviation Department director attended the first joint C929 type certification meeting in Shanghai, following an April agreement among mainland, Hong Kong and Macau regulators. The C929 is China's first domestically developed long-haul wide-body jet, designed for up to 290 seats and

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 17:05 HKT · updated 21 Oct, 17:19 · 1 min read

 Image: [香港特區政府新聞公報](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/21/P2026102100334.htm)

Hong Kong Civil Aviation Department Director Carmen Wong Ka-wah attended the first joint C929 type certification meeting in Shanghai on Wednesday (21 October), the Hong Kong government announced.

The meeting implemented a cooperation arrangement signed in April by the Civil Aviation Administration of China, the Hong Kong Civil Aviation Department and the Macau Civil Aviation Authority concerning type certification of the C929 aircraft.

Unlike the C909 and C919 jets mainly used for short-haul routes, the C929 is China's first domestically developed twin-aisle long-range wide-body passenger aircraft, designed to carry up to 290 seats with a range of 12,000 kilometres, enabling transoceanic and long-distance intercontinental flights.

Wong said her department has actively participated in airworthiness certification reviews for the C909 and C919 aircraft since 2007, at the invitation of the mainland regulator. She expressed honour at being invited again for the C929 type certification, adding that Hong Kong would build on its successful experience with the C909 and C919 and deploy expertise in airworthiness certification to support the C929 programme.

Hong Kong representatives at the meeting shared international aircraft certification experience and finalised a blueprint and cooperation arrangements for subsequent support working groups.

The Hong Kong Civil Aviation Department said it supports high-quality development of the national civil aviation sector in various areas, adding that the cooperation would significantly deepen integration between Hong Kong's aviation industry and the national aerospace sector, allowing the city to seize development opportunities under the country's 15th Five-Year Plan.

Wong was scheduled to return to Hong Kong on the same day.

# Taiwan-donated patrol vessel will not patrol waters near Taiwan: Premier

10/20/2026 07:14 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

The former Coast Guard Administration's 500-tonne-class Kinmen. Photo courtesy of the WPS Foundation's Facebook page.

Taipei, Oct. 20 (CNA) Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) said Tuesday that a patrol vessel donated by Taiwan's Coast Guard Administration (CGA) to the Philippines would not be used in waters near Taiwan or areas where Taiwanese fishing vessels operate.

The vessel, formerly the CGA's 500-tonne-class Kinmen, was commissioned into the Philippine Coast Guard on Oct. 2.

Speaking at the Legislative Yuan, Cho said the Philippines had pledged during the donation process that the vessel would be used only for designated missions and would not operate in waters related to Taiwan. The vessel could even provide assistance to Taiwan if needed, he added.

Responding to questions from opposition Kuomintang lawmaker Su Ching-chuan (蘇清泉) about past conflicts involving Taiwanese fishing vessels and the Philippine authorities, including the 2013 Guang Da Xing No. 28 incident in which a Taiwanese fisherman was killed, Cho said the incident offered important lessons.

He added that stronger and friendlier exchanges between the two sides could help prevent unnecessary conflicts.

Meanwhile, Ocean Affairs Council Minister Kuan Bi-ling (管碧玲) said Taiwan and the Philippines had established mechanisms for law enforcement cooperation and emergency reporting on fisheries, while deepening their partnership in maritime humanitarian assistance.

The Philippines has demonstrated goodwill by establishing systematic communication and rapid coordination mechanisms to protect the safety of fishermen from both sides, Kuan said.

The CGA has also stationed a liaison officer at the Manila Economic and Cultural Office to maintain communication and reduce the risk of conflict during maritime law enforcement operations, she said. The arrangement aims to prevent incidents like the Guang Da Xing case from recurring.

Kuan added this is not the first time Taiwan had transferred decommissioned vessels to another country, noting that such transfers have long served as a means of strengthening diplomatic and humanitarian ties.

(By Tseng Yi-ning and Wu Kuan-hsien)

# 澳洲议员海恩斯于办公室外被撞重伤 43岁男子被捕

Posted about 5h ago about 5 hours ago Tue 20 Oct 2026 at 6:21am

10月19日，联邦独立议员海伦·海恩斯在选区办公室外被汽车撞倒后受重伤。(ABC News: Matt Roberts)

abc.net.au/news/mp-helen-haines-attacked-in-the-street/107286926

Link copied

Share Share article

10月19日（周一）下午3：35左右，在维州旺加拉塔，印地（Indi）选区联邦独立议员海伦·海恩斯（Helen Haines）正站在自己汽车的后备厢旁。

此时，一辆白色丰田越野车猛然撞上65岁的海恩斯，将她挤在两车之间，她的下半身受到重创。

有目击者称，这辆车从海恩斯身旁驶过后掉头折返，将她撞向她的车，随后又倒车撞了第二次。

海恩斯先被救护车送往旺加拉塔医院，随后空运至墨尔本的阿尔弗雷德医院（The Alfred）抢救。 她接受了手术，ABC证实她已失去一条腿，医生正在全力保住另一条腿。她目前仍然情况危急。

涉案男子43岁，被现场民众制服，警方到场后将其逮捕并带回调查。警方说，在其车内发现了一把刀。

ABC获悉，被拘留的男子名叫布伦丹·纽金特（Brendan Nugent），住在旺加拉塔以东约12公里的Tarrawingee。截至目前，警方尚未公布对他的指控。

澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯周一晚在ABC时事节目《7.30》中说：“这不是一起意外事故，这是蓄意而为。” 他同时表示，要知道这起涉嫌袭击的动机还为时过早，联合反恐小组已被启动。

此案由维州警方牵头，联合反恐小组提供支援，成员包括维州警方、联邦警察和澳大利亚安全情报局（ASIO）。ASIO局长伯吉斯（Mike Burgess）说，维州警方正在查明袭击动机，包括是否出于政治动机。联邦警察局长巴雷特（Krissy Barrett）表示，目前将其视为“孤立事件”，没有已知的相关威胁。

案发地点在海伦·海恩斯议员的办公室外。(ABC News: Annie Brown)

纽金特曾是反伐木环保人士，参加过环保组织“拯救我们的斯特拉斯博吉森林（Save our Strathbogie Forest）”。

该组织负责人伯特拉姆·劳勃特（Bertram Lobert）向ABC表示，新冠疫情爆发前约两年，纽金特参加活动很积极，但疫情后就没有他的消息了。

纽金特的一名邻居对ABC说，附近居民此前多次报警，担心他的心理健康。有消息人士向ABC确认，纽金特在羁押期间已接受心理健康评估。

## 海伦·海恩斯是谁？

65岁的海伦·海恩斯热爱跑步等健身运动。(Supplied: Jaime Chubb)

海伦·海恩斯在维州西南部科拉克（Colac）附近的一个奶牛场长大，从政前做了30年的乡村医疗卫生工作，当过护士、助产士和公共健康研究员，拥有瑞典乌普萨拉大学（Uppsala University）的博士学位。

2019年，她通过社区的独立运动“印地之声”（Voices for Indi）成功当选议员，代表维州乡村地区的印地（Indi）选区。

她是澳大利亚联邦议会历史上首位接任另一位独立议员的独立议员，前任是凯西·麦高恩（Cathy McGowan）。

作为社区独立议员，海恩斯的政治立场不依附于任何主要政党。

她在首次国会演讲中就主张设立强有力的联邦廉政机构。她提出的模式草案，被认为是2023年成立的国家反腐败委员会（NACC）的重要基础，她后来出任监督该机构的议会联合委员会副主席。

海伦·海恩斯遇袭后，民众在事发现场摆上鲜花表示慰问和支持。

此外，海恩斯也极力为偏远和乡村地区在医疗资源、养老服务以及基层医护人员方面争取更多投入。

在基础设施与电信方面，她致力于改善乡村地区的移动网络覆盖、交通运输及住房短缺问题，反对偏远地区在国家发展中被边缘化。

在气候变化与清洁能源转型以及民生方面，海恩斯强调在不让偏远地区社区利益受损的情况下推进清洁能源转型，提高各项社会福利救济金的发放标准，让弱势群体能应付生活基本开销。同时，要求禁止任何赌博广告。

在加沙及中东冲突等国际议题上，海恩斯曾公开呼吁立即实行持久停火、向受灾平民提供紧急人道主义援助，同时谴责哈马斯对以色列的袭击，呼吁释放所有人质。

## 各方反应

正在巴布亚新几内亚参加活动的澳大利亚国防部长理查德·马尔斯（Richard Marles）、外交部长黄英贤和太平洋岛国事务部长帕特·康罗伊（Pat Conroy）均对海伦·海恩斯遇袭表示“深感震惊”。

马尔斯称赞海恩斯是“正直得体的典范”，黄英贤则呼吁澳大利亚人坚守自身的价值观。康罗伊则表示，“在很长一段时间里，这件事都将给澳大利亚国会议员的所有工作蒙上一层阴影”。

海恩斯遇袭事件发生后，新西兰总理克里斯托弗·拉克森（Christopher Luxon）也联系阿尔巴尼斯总理表达了“来自新西兰的关怀”

有分析人士担心，澳大利亚的民主正面临[前所未有的考验](https://abc.net.au/news/2026-10-19/helen-haines-attack-threat-to-democracy/107285334)。

民调机构红桥（Redbridge）的董事托尼·巴里（Tony Barry）警告称，当前政治的碎片化正在制造一个“火药桶”。

“不断加深的政治极化、经济上的不安全感，以及由身份认同驱动的部落主义（Party/Tribalism）兴起，创造了一个极易动荡且碎片化的选民群体，”他说。

他表示，澳大利亚人过去在面对分歧时懂得如何更好地处理，但随着部落主义兴起、共识破裂，政治动荡不太可能减少。

澳大利亚联邦警察局（AFP）公布的数据显示，在2025–2026年度，警方收到了1067起针对国会议员、高官以及相关办公室和设施的威胁、骚扰、骚扰性及攻击性行为的举报，较上一年增长了 12%。

title: Hong Kong election committee nominations close; 31 of 36 sectors oversubscribed

content:
香港
香港选举委员会界别分组选举的提名已于10月20日结束，36个当选界别分组中有31个获得超额认购。共收到1,115份候选人提名和40份团体提名。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 20 日 10:51 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

2026 年选举委员会界别分组一般选举提名已于周二（10 月 20 日）截止。根据官方数字，截至最后一个工作日，相关界别分组的选举主任已收到1,115份候选人提名表格和40份指定团体提名表格。

选举委员的36个界别分组中，有31个界别分组获得超额认购，其余5个界别分组的候选人人数与议席完全相同。在第一板块，所有18个分板块均出现超额认购。第二界别分组中，10个界别分组中有8个出现超额认购，其中竞争最激烈的是社会福利界别分组，有25名候选人角逐15个议席，以及医疗卫生界界别分组，有23名候选人角逐15个议席。

在第三部门，渔业和基层组织分部门均超额认购。渔业界别分组有72名候选人，争夺60个议席；基层组织界别分组有75名候选人，争夺60个议席。
第四组别分组中，代表港九区委员会、扑灭罪案委员会及消防安全委员会委员的界别分组有88名候选人，争夺76个议席；新界界别分组则有93名候选人，争夺80个议席。

五个界别分组拥有相同数目的候选人及议席：教育界；体育、表演艺术、文化和出版分部门；同乡会界别分组；劳工分部门；代表国家机构香港成员的界别分组。若所有候选人均获确认符合资格，且无人退出，则该界别分组无需投票，候选人将自动当选。

选举委员会选举定于 11 月 22 日举行，届时将选出一个由 1,500 名成员组成的新选举委员会。五个界别各有300个议席，其中982个界别分组选举议席、156个指定团体提名议席和362个当然议席。

Hong Kong
Nominations for Hong Kong's Election Committee subsector elections ended on 20 October, with 31 of 36 elected subsectors oversubscribed. A total of 1,115 candidate nominations and 40 group nominations were received.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

20 Oct 2026 at 10:51 HKT · 2 min read

Nominations for the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary elections closed on Tuesday (20 October). As of the last working day, returning officers in the relevant subsectors had received 1,115 candidate nomination forms and 40 designated group nomination forms, according to official figures.

Of the 36 subsectors that elect committee members, 31 are oversubscribed, while the remaining five have exactly the same number of candidates as seats. In the first sector, all 18 subsectors are oversubscribed. In the second sector, eight of ten subsectors are oversubscribed, with the most competitive being the social welfare subsector, where 25 candidates are vying for 15 seats, and the medical and health services subsector, where 23 candidates are contesting 15 seats.

In the third sector, both the fisheries and grassroots organisations subsectors are oversubscribed. The fisheries subsector has 72 candidates for 60 seats, while the grassroots organisations subsector has 75 candidates for 60 seats.

In the fourth sector, the subsector representing members of the Hong Kong and Kowloon district committees, fighting crime committees, and fire safety committees has 88 candidates for 76 seats, while the equivalent New Territories subsector has 93 candidates for 80 seats.

Five subsectors have an equal number of candidates and seats: the education subsector; the sports, performing arts, culture and publishing subsector; the fellow townsmen associations subsector; the labour subsector; and the subsector representing Hong Kong members of national bodies. If all candidates are confirmed as qualified and no one withdraws, these subsectors will not require a vote and candidates will be declared elected automatically.

The Election Committee election is scheduled for 22 November, when a new 1,500-member Election Committee will be chosen. Each of the five sectors holds 300 seats, with 982 seats elected by subsectors, 156 seats nominated by designated groups, and 362 ex-officio seats.

# Taiwan, Philippines sign animal husbandry research pact

10/19/2026 07:26 PM

Photo courtesy of Taiwan's Ministry of Agriculture

Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) Taiwan and the Philippines have signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to strengthen cooperation in animal husbandry research, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said in a press statement Monday.

The MOU was signed by Taiwan's representative to the Philippines, Wallace Chow (周民淦), and his Philippine counterpart, Corazon Avecilla-Padiernos, at the end of the 13th meeting of a technical group on agricultural cooperation in Cebu, the Philippines, on Friday, MOFA said.

The annual meeting has been held since the two countries signed an agreement in 2005 to promote agricultural and fisheries cooperation, MOFA said.

In a separate press release, the Ministry of Agriculture (MOA) said Deputy Agriculture Minister Tu Wen-jane (杜文珍) and Livestock Research Institute Director Huang Chen-fang (黃振芳) traveled to Cebu for Friday's meeting.

In addition to signing the MOU, Taiwanese representatives held talks with their Philippine counterparts on the potential export of Taiwan's atemoya and animal products to the Philippines, the MOA said.

(By Joseph Yeh)

We have a state of emergency declared in Virginia!

And right now we’re seeing what looks like a massive police state closing in on the state capitol where there will be a huge rally on Monday.

This is a very divisive issue that’s generating a lot of media spin and disinformation. And chaos could break out in Richmond.

It is crucial that there be independent, on-the-ground reporting in Richmond, especially given what happened in Charlottesville — where many people argue police actually instigated some of the violence and things definitely got out of hand.

In the past, when massive Yellow Vests protests were taking place in Paris, I was there [reporting on the ground](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hTzwJqUPeqk) and risking safety as protesters were losing eyes due to police brutality. I have also been to places like [Somalia,](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UooepLs3Fqs)[Venezuela](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UOQb7Y5QVO8) and[Cheran](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r3qRm3sXVRU), once the most violent, dangerous area in Mexico. And more recently, I reported on the ground amid huge protests in Hong Kong.

Now lots of people are asking me to go to Richmond, so they can get the truth about what’s happening there.

So I’ve decided to go, if we can raise enough funds for it.

A trip to Virginia isn’t as expensive as going to Hong Kong, where I provided you in-depth, on-the-ground reports on one of the world’s most important protest movements.

But it’s not free either. I still need to cover airfare/gas, hotel and equipment expenses. And I’m planning on hiring a cameraman and video editor. I estimate this will cost around $1,500.

If you value reporting on the events in Virginia that is free of spin and manipulation and provides a real, honest look at what is happening, then your support is essential.

Thank you so much for funding independent media and for allowing me to continue doing the job I love!

# Legal Defense for Hong Kong Democracy Activists

The Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice stands with the people of Hong Kong on the front lines of the fight for freedom & democracy.Courageous Hong Kong democracy activists have been protesting for months against a dangerous Chinese extradition bill that would have undermined their independence and freedom. Though the bill has now been formally withdrawn, the fight is not over. Since June, thousands of protesters have been attacked and injured by police and mainland gangs and over 1,100 people have been detained. Those arrested for peacefully protesting have been charged with offenses that could put them in jail for many years.Hong Kong Democracy protesters have won the first huge victory in the court of public opinion, but the next victories will need to be won in the courts of law.Just a few months ago, the Lantos Foundation was proud to give our highest award to the most recognizable leader of the democracy movement – Joshua Wong. While such leadership is important, all of the brave democracy crusaders deserve more than our admiration. We must equip them to defend themselves against the crushing apparatus of the Chinese communist state. This legal defense fund aims to support Joshua and his compatriots as they defend themselves against false accusations that could land them in prison for years to come.Our hope is that we can match their courage and determination in the form of financial support that will ensure they have fair representation. It is critical that the rule of law be upheld at this pivotal moment in Hong Kong's history. The eyes of the world may be on Hong Kong, but the eyes of history will be on those of us enjoying our own freedom and democracy - let us match our words and good wishes with the resources to defend those on the front lines of this fight for freedom.These legal defense funds will be officially disbursed through the Lantos Foundation's Front Line Fund grant program.

# Fund Independent Reporting In HONG KONG

Fund Independent Reporting In HONG KONG You know something big is happening in Hong Kong!! The protests have been massive, and they may be the biggest geopolitical event of the year. Will China get its way and stomp out dissent? Might covert U.S. aid allow the protesters to sustain their momentum? Needless to say, there is a lot at stake and lots of speculation!!And because of that it’s important for there to be independent, on-the-ground reporting about the events in Hong Kong. When massive Yellow Vests protests were taking place in Paris, We Are Change was there reporting on the ground and risking safety as protesters were losing eyes due to police brutality. # BASEBALL/Zeng Sheng-an's three-run homer gives Dragons 2-0 lead in Taiwan Series
