Wei Chuan Dragons outfielder Zeng Sheng-an. CNA photo Oct. 18, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 18 (CNA) Wei Chuan Dragons outfielder Zeng Sheng-an (曾聖安) hit a three-run homer to power his team to a 3-1 win over the CTBC Brothers at Taipei Dome on Sunday, giving the Dragons a 2-0 lead in the Chinese Professional Baseball League's (CPBL) Taiwan Series.

With the Dragons trailing 1-0 in the bottom of the fifth inning, the 20-year-old Zeng, who joined the team last season and was making his Taiwan Series debut, drove a fastball from Brothers starter Félix Peña over the right-field wall.

Zeng became the second-youngest player in CPBL history to hit a home run in the Taiwan Series.

The homer came after he committed a fielding error in the top of the inning that ultimately allowed the Brothers to take a 1-0 lead.

In a post-game interview, Zeng said that after making a mistake in the top of the inning, his coaches and veteran teammates told him to put it behind him and focus on what he could do next to help the team. He was glad he was able to bounce back in his next at-bat, he said.

Dragons player Tseng Sheng-an hits a three-run homer in the bottom of the fifth inning to put his team ahead, sending fans cheering excitedly from the stands. CNA photo Oct. 18,2026

Peña was later pulled from the mound in the same inning after being hit by a batted ball. He gave up four hits and three walks and struck out three batters over 4.2 innings.

Dragons starter Cristopher Mercedes pitched six innings, allowing one run on five hits and a walk, while striking out three.

The Dragons' second straight win puts them in a strong position to claim their sixth CPBL championship.

In the CPBL's 37-year history, teams that have taken a 2-0 lead in a best-of-seven championship series have gone on to win the title 89.5 percent of the time.

After a day off Monday, the teams will meet again at Taipei Dome on Tuesday for Game 3.

Video courtesy of the Chinese Professional Baseball League

(By Joseph Yeh)

# Taichung Arena on track for completion in 2030: City gov't

10/18/2026 09:02 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

Photo courtesy of the Taichung City government

Taichung, Oct. 18 (CNA) The Taichung Arena is nearly 20 percent complete and remains on track to be finished in 2030, the Taichung City government said Sunday.

The project had been scheduled to be 15 percent complete by now. Underground excavation has finished, and construction is entering the main structural phase, the city's Construction Bureau said in a press release.

Located in Taichung's Beitun District, the arena was designed jointly by Japanese and Taiwanese architects. Construction began on June 1, 2024, after years of planning.

Covering about 6.95 hectares, the complex will have four basement levels, a four-story main arena and a three-story secondary arena, the bureau said.

The main arena is designed to seat about 15,500 spectators, and the secondary arena about 3,000, it added.

The main arena will host international sporting events such as basketball, volleyball, badminton, tennis, futsal and martial arts competitions, as well as concerts, exhibitions and other large-scale events. The secondary arena will be used for athletes' warm-ups and training, as well as for smaller performances and exhibitions.

The complex will also incorporate acoustic design, rainwater recycling and an energy-saving design, the bureau said, adding that an elevated open-air walkway linking the two venues will include walking and running paths, and a rooftop garden is also planned.

The city government has said the project is intended to meet central Taiwan's demand for a large indoor sports and entertainment venue, complementing existing facilities in northern and southern Taiwan.

The Taichung Arena is separate from the planned Taiwan Dome (台灣超巨蛋), a much larger indoor baseball stadium for which the city signed a build-operate-transfer agreement on Friday. Initial plans call for the dome to seat at least 45,000 spectators and to include commercial facilities, hotels and space for major events.

(By Chao Li-yen and Lee Hsin-Yin)

**--****坦桑尼亚球队客场大胜****--**

据本台法广体育组（[RFI Sports](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/sports/)）[[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)足球]([Afrique Foot](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique-foot/))的报道，2026年10月17日周六，坦桑尼亚（la Tanzanie）的 [非洲青年队]（Young Africans）在客场以4比0大胜马达加斯加(Madagascar)的CFFA足球队。当天下午晚些时候，在刚果民主共和国的卢本巴希（Lubumbashi），刚果（金）的TP Mazembe足球队主场，被来自突尼斯的[非洲人俱乐部队]（Club Africain）1比1逼平。

Image d'archive / Afrique Foot - Young Africans, Tanzania.](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/72cea600-1607-11ea-a92d-005056a99247/w:1024/Young_Africans_SC_%28logo%29.png)

 存档图片 / 非洲足球：坦桑尼亚（la Tanzanie）的[非洲青年队]（Young Africans） Image d'archive / Afrique Foot - Young Africans, Tanzania. wikipedia.org

10月17日星期六，坦桑尼亚（la Tanzanie）[[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)青年队]（Young Africans）在以4比0战胜CFFA队之后，基本锁定了非洲冠军联赛（la Ligue des champions de la CAF）的参赛资格。在对阵马达加斯加CFFA足球队的比赛中，坦桑尼亚（la Tanzanie）[非洲青年队]（Young Africans）没有遭遇麻烦。这场以4比0结束的胜利几乎确保了晋级。双方的下回合较量将于10月21日下周三在达累斯萨拉姆（Dar es Salaam）进行。

**--****刚果****(****金****)****球队主场踢平****--**

10月17日星期六下午晚些时候， 刚果（金）的TP Mazembe足球队主场在卢本巴希（Lubumbashi）与突尼斯的[非洲人俱乐部]（Club Africain）的对阵中，遭遇对手顽强抵抗，最终被以1比1逼平，后续仍要努力。双方的胜负悬念有待10月25日下周日在突尼斯举行的下一回合的比赛中揭晓。

刚果（金）的TP Mazembe足球队](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/93d2f02a-4ab0-11eb-9d0f-005056a964fe/w:1024/home-1609329533_illustration-logo-tout-puissant-mazembe-8-etoiles_1609329533_1609329533.jpg)

title: Tibet quake kills 16, injures 46, state media says
zh_title: 官方媒体称西藏地震已造成16人死亡、46人受伤
summary: 中国官方媒体援引当地政府的消息称，西藏发生7.0级地震，造成至少16人死亡、46人受伤、300多间房屋倒塌。救援行动正在进行中，部署了数百名人员。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 23 日 12:54 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟 强烈地震官方媒体援引地方当局的消息称，该事件在中国偏远的西藏地区造成至少 16 人死亡、46 人受伤。
content:
中国
据中国官方媒体援引西藏地方当局的消息称，西藏发生7.0级地震，造成至少16人死亡、46人受伤、300多间房屋倒塌。救援行动正在进行中，部署了数百名人员。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 23 日 12:54 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

官方媒体援引地方当局的消息称，中国偏远的西藏地区发生强烈地震，造成至少 16 人死亡、46 人受伤。周四晚上 10:33（格林威治标准时间 1433）发生的 7.0 级地震中，超过 300 栋房屋倒塌。

官方通讯社新华社称，官员们仍在评估损失情况，救灾工作正在进行中。中国中央电视台（CCTV）援引当地官员的话说，受伤人数为 46 人，其中 11 人伤势严重，339 间房屋倒塌或损坏。

美国地质调查局称，震中位于那曲地区东北偏东约190公里、自治区首府拉萨东北390公里的山区。撞击深度约为10公里。震中位于巴庆县马如乡。据新华社报道，镇副镇长拉旺达波表示，镇政府明显有震感，办公室墙壁出现裂缝。
据央视报道，该地区已启动三级地震灾害应急响应。该机构表示，县城的电力和电信服务中断。据新华社报道，已派出300多名警力参与救灾工作，自治区消防救援总队已调集347名人员前往灾区。

中央电视台发布的视频显示，地震发生时，餐厅里的工作人员纷纷逃离，超市货架上的物品纷纷掉落。闭路电视画面显示，救援人员爬过受损的建筑物，其中一些建筑物的屋顶已经倒塌，并载着一名人员。它还显示救援人员用手电筒照射其他受损的建筑物，士兵们排队准备部署。

中国的地震比较常见。 2025年1月，西藏定日县发生地震，造成至少126人死亡。据官方媒体报道，2023 年 12 月，中国西北部偏远的甘肃省发生地震，造成至少 127 人死亡。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
China
A 7.0 magnitude earthquake in Tibet killed at least 16 people and injured 46, with more than 300 houses collapsed, Chinese state media reported, citing local authorities. Rescue operations are underway with hundreds of personnel deployed.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 12:54 HKT · 2 min read

A strong earthquake killed at least 16 people and injured 46 in China's remote Tibet region, state media said, citing local authorities. More than 300 houses collapsed in the 7.0 magnitude quake, which struck on Thursday at 10:33 pm (1433 GMT).

Officials were still evaluating the damage, and disaster relief work was ongoing, state news agency Xinhua said. China Central Television (CCTV) put the number of injured at 46, 11 of them seriously, with 339 houses collapsed or damaged, citing local officials.

The epicentre was located in a mountainous area about 190 kilometres east-northeast of Nagqu, and 390 kilometres northeast of the regional capital Lhasa, the US Geological Survey said. It struck at a shallow depth of around 10 kilometres. The epicentre was in Maru township in Baqen county. Township deputy head Lhawang Dagpo said the quake was clearly felt at the township office, which sustained cracks in the walls, according to Xinhua.

A level-III earthquake disaster emergency response was activated in the area, CCTV reported. Power and telecoms services were disrupted in the county seat, the agency said. More than 300 police officers have been dispatched for relief work while the regional fire and rescue corps has mobilised 347 personnel to the affected areas, Xinhua reported.

Videos posted by CCTV showed workers running out of restaurants and objects falling off shelves at supermarkets when the quake struck. Rescue workers clambered through damaged buildings, some with collapsed roofs, and carrying one person, footage on CCTV showed. It also showed rescue workers shining flashlights on other damaged buildings and soldiers lining up ready to be deployed.

Earthquakes in China are relatively common. In January 2025, at least 126 people were killed in an earthquake in Tibet's rural Tingri county. In December 2023, a quake in remote Gansu province in northwest China killed at least 127 people, according to state media.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

title: China-Linked Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents in ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
zh_title: 与中国有关的黑客在 ConnectWise 供应链攻击中使用 ARTEX AI 代理
summary: [![图片1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSO gmyeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHSG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV 00GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg )](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSOg myeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHSG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV0 0GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg) 显微
content:
[！[图片1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSO gmyeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHSG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV 00GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg )](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSOg myeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHSG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV0 0GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg)

微软周三披露，一个被称为 **Storm-0940** 的中国国家合作者是 ConnectWise 云备份应用程序最近的[供应链泄露](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/connectwise-resets-credentials-as-cloud.html) 的幕后黑手。

事件期间，Storm-0940 使用了 [ARTEX](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/artex-ai-pentesting-tool-used-in-data.html)，这是一个基于 Go 的代理 AI 渗透测试框架，该框架在针对韩国金融机构的网络攻击中被滥用后已成为闭源，以加快对下游受害者的扫描和侦察、密码喷洒和 OAuth 应用程序滥用。
这家科技巨头表示，自 2026 年 9 月以来，威胁行为者以“机器速度”使用人工智能工具，对全球多个领域的数百个组织进行自动攻击。目标包括航空航天和国防、汽车、化学品、能源、金融服务、政府、法律、制造、媒体、军事、半导体、软件、技术、智囊团和非营利组织。

“Storm-0940 使用 ARTEX 加快了受感染应用程序滥用的速度，通过已被授予访问权限的应用程序对目标环境进行身份验证，从而允许威胁行为者无需交互式用户登录即可进行操作，”微软[说](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/10/21/storm-0940-uses-artex-agentic-ai-connectwise-supply-chain-compromise/)。

“人工智能加速的后续活动包括侦察、应用程序凭据更改以及尝试修改可实现扩展或持久访问的权限。”

Storm-0940 [首次由 Microsoft 详细介绍](https://thehackernews.com/2024/11/microsoft-warns-of-chinese-botnet.html) 于 2024 年 11 月，显示威胁行为者一直在利用名为 Quad7（又名 CovertNetwork-1658）的僵尸网络进行高度规避的密码喷射攻击。据评估，该威胁行为者至少自 2021 年起就处于活跃状态。
[！[图片 2：网络安全](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh-69Sxi6ukfnlM_EpqEB_hRVymcXAcWTNAJetA9huKutPZuG0OOBUvByDCtP_HokC-gM-AzjX0ZhgneUFVzjCyIduRINFj6Yf0JX RFE17_z82UioyT9eoxH2-XQDoD_hInCxc8V2bQrmtnMN-GUR63bseKn7pLRISqlvUJlfuJq8pgCL-Fot7sQDas9 D05/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/nudge-3-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/ai-agent-methods-d)

据称，攻击者还利用面向互联网的应用程序来获得初始访问权限，然后使用受感染的帐户在目标环境中移动。人们还观察到，通过向云基础设施中的现有 OAuth 应用程序添加凭据来建立持久性，以确保对 Microsoft 365 资源的访问。

据微软称，这些由 ARTEX 驱动的攻击中有很大一部分已导致对手获得对组织云基础设施的特权访问权限，包括严重的攻击。

【原文 English Original】
[![Image 1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSOgmyeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHsG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV00GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSOgmyeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHsG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV00GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg)

Microsoft on Wednesday disclosed that a China state-aligned actor dubbed **Storm-0940** was behind the recent [supply chain compromise](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/connectwise-resets-credentials-as-cloud.html) of the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application.

During the incident, Storm-0940 used [ARTEX](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/artex-ai-pentesting-tool-used-in-data.html), a Go-based agentic AI penetration testing framework that was made closed-source in the wake of its abuse in cyber attacks targeting South Korean financial institutions, to speed up scanning and reconnaissance, password spraying, and OAuth application abuse at downstream victims.

The tech giant said the threat actor used the AI tool at "machine speed" to automate attacks targeting hundreds of organizations across the world spanning a broad range of sectors since September 2026. Targets include aerospace and defense, automotive, chemicals, energy, financial services, government, legal, manufacturing, media, military, semiconductor, software, technology, and think tanks and non-profits.

"Storm-0940's use of ARTEX accelerated the speed of compromised application abuse to authenticate to target environments through applications that had already been granted access, allowing the threat actor to operate without requiring an interactive user sign-in," Microsoft [said](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/10/21/storm-0940-uses-artex-agentic-ai-connectwise-supply-chain-compromise/).

"AI-accelerated follow-on activity included reconnaissance, application credential changes, and attempts to modify privileges that could enable expanded or persistent access."

Storm-0940 was [first detailed by Microsoft](https://thehackernews.com/2024/11/microsoft-warns-of-chinese-botnet.html) in November 2024, revealing that the threat actor has been leveraging a botnet called Quad7 (aka CovertNetwork-1658) to conduct highly evasive password spray attacks. The threat actor is assessed to be active since at least 2021.

[![Image 2: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh-69Sxi6ukfnlM_EpqEB_hRVymcXAcWTNAJetA9huKutPZuG0OOBUvByDCtP_HokC-gM-AzjX0ZhgneUFVzjCyIduRINFj6Yf0JXRFE17_z82UioyT9eoxH2-XQDoD_hInCxc8V2bQrmtnMN-GUR63bseKn7pLRISqlvUJlfuJq8pgCL-Fot7sQDas9D05/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/nudge-3-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/ai-agent-methods-d)

The adversary is also said to exploit internet-facing applications to gain initial access, followed by using compromised accounts to move through targeted environments. It has also been observed establishing persistence by adding credentials to existing OAuth applications within cloud infrastructures to ensure access to Microsoft 365 resources.

According to Microsoft, a chunk of these ARTEX-driven attacks have resulted in the adversary gaining privileged access to an organization's cloud infrastructure, including several instances where the time frame from initial targeting to privileged access was less than 3 hours.

In the case of the ConnectWise incident, Storm-0940 has been observed using ARTEX to attempt to sign in to more than 2,250 tenants at 2,900 sign-in attempts per minute, a pace the company said gives defenders a short window to detect and respond.

"Between October 10 and 14, 2026, Storm-0940 infrastructure at 144.172.64[.]99 conducted an automated cross-tenant password-spray campaign targeting 327 accounts across eight organizations to gain access to Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online," Microsoft said.

[![Image 3](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh3Xc6KzPMPQKO3RtYF_6JEqjdfIY1bg3X-U2zaKO7_TwQzBDY6fsps3qphDQw-9EzTGDGM3kriLuztm4LxzE60yFDE3NVH3LV9p5VUg-oMLpBoPMrk38Uinn18tou_8tiBS6Gc4xO3W8COBOXGFkbkBgkli7YL8txxGUa6wZGNNVuEuM0fADa0cfkuZm2E/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/ar.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh3Xc6KzPMPQKO3RtYF_6JEqjdfIY1bg3X-U2zaKO7_TwQzBDY6fsps3qphDQw-9EzTGDGM3kriLuztm4LxzE60yFDE3NVH3LV9p5VUg-oMLpBoPMrk38Uinn18tou_8tiBS6Gc4xO3W8COBOXGFkbkBgkli7YL8txxGUa6wZGNNVuEuM0fADa0cfkuZm2E/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/ar.jpg)

During this window, Microsoft said it captured over 151,000 failed logon events. The activity peaked on October 11 at 2,900 failures per minute, resulting in more than 111,000 failures in a single day. Of these, 48 accounts received more than 1,000 failures. No successful authentication, token issuance, Graph call, or directory change was detected, it noted.

That changed on October 15, 2026, when the AI agents gained access to the identities of multiple ConnectWise cloud applications and began to use them to authenticate to customer environments.

"Additionally, after acquiring control of the identities of multiple ConnectWise cloud applications, the AI agents operating on behalf of the threat actor continued to use the same IP range to authenticate to customer environments using the illicit access acquired through these stolen app credentials, effectively taking advantage of the already established trust by these apps within a tenant," the tech giant added.

In some of these cases, the AI agents are assessed to have progressed beyond authentication to Microsoft Graph and directory operations. This included reconnaissance, application credential modifications to establish persistence, and changes involving identities, groups, and privileged roles.

[![Image 4](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEihyvW6Vi5XS9EzEem8mWZ6I1vdQwHj9pQWyIdJMAgk2HxEegqxF3tCKtOw7REdJ_V27mKU6pm6LbGcSKl5zkvy3wdEoNS3hbdGj9LnNXTuuR-g5cWisW5tp7YTHPJTJWEkyl2iDQAF2oAA9IU7tlw7d5n8hNuHwlSq49zCctuAkuI-omxB8NMByUzipUnd/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/zz.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEihyvW6Vi5XS9EzEem8mWZ6I1vdQwHj9pQWyIdJMAgk2HxEegqxF3tCKtOw7REdJ_V27mKU6pm6LbGcSKl5zkvy3wdEoNS3hbdGj9LnNXTuuR-g5cWisW5tp7YTHPJTJWEkyl2iDQAF2oAA9IU7tlw7d5n8hNuHwlSq49zCctuAkuI-omxB8NMByUzipUnd/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/zz.jpg)
The TAG-217 attack chain | Source: Zscaler

"The application credential modification made by Storm-0940’s associated agents in the targeted victims' environments can lead to persistence through other identities, credentials, and cloud services," Microsoft said. "These changes can remain active as a backdoor even after the original compromised application is mediated."

Storm-0940 is far from the only hacking crew to rely on ARTEX. Microsoft said it has observed threat actors across multiple geographic regions weaponizing the framework in their operations.

Recorded Future Insikt Group, which is tracking the threat cluster behind the attacks on South Korean financial institutions under the moniker [TAG-217](https://www.recordedfuture.com/blog/tag-217-artex-south-korean-banks), said it identified activity linked to the hacking group dating back to August 17, 2026, when it "tested infrastructure designed to maintain remote access to computers and conducted internet scanning."

Over the next few weeks, the Chinese-speaking threat actor is said to have put together tools to attack cryptocurrency mining operations using the YiiMP platform, as well as set up a workspace for testing weaknesses in iPhones and modifying Android system software.

Zscaler ThreatLabz has since revealed that the attack's footprint extends beyond South Korea, and that it opportunistically targeted organizations around the globe and across multiple industry sectors. The findings come from a custom ARTEX deployment that included AI assistant configurations, synchronization scripts, network routing tools, and a Claude Code prompt history.

[![Image 5: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVV2rRkX8tRMF6gCzemvQNpwFwGxRWxY1cJEYfoLLSj1EZYJOlj5WTR77t0i6kELXujYcaHTpRDqTjCbVHH5Pnh7wzxUiKP5j4dsDkWIMlp2bmpZsL0jeAsA_19pHH5UPtyBvNkZdyGEULOAsXPcraMP5CYjQRFefhXRSdEjYkrdcpUnc4ILcvcdEfAauE/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/tl-d.jpg)](https://thehackernews.uk/network-defense-d)

"ARTEX was configured to use a DeepSeek model through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, but other configurations also specified DeepSeek, GLM, and Grok," security researcher Seongsu Park [said](https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/inside-global-ai-assisted-hacking-campaign). "Prompts directed AI models to divide investigation tasks and review one another's findings, including instructions for GLM to review work performed by DeepSeek and its subagents."

An analysis of the prompt histories has revealed requests for bulk personal and transaction data, along with questions about selling stolen data, suggesting the attacks were likely financially motivated. Other prompts related to extracting payment gateway API keys, exploiting NFT minting workflows, and gaining unauthorized administrative privileges.

The findings once again highlight how threat actors are increasingly integrating agentic AI tools into their offensive security workflows to quickly carry out attacks at scale.

"Agents are not constrained by factors affecting humans – they can work around the clock, on weekends, and on holidays and attempt multiple breach paths simultaneously, enabling significantly reduced time from selecting a target to achieving objectives, increasing the speed and impact of complex attacks like supply chain compromises," Microsoft said.

In response to the findings, ConnectWise [said](https://www.connectwise.com/company/trust/advisories) the activity "describes a campaign that reaches well beyond any one company," adding "nation-state actors are increasingly targeting the software supply chain, because one trusted connection can open the door to many organizations."

"AI now lets them test those connections at [...] 'machine speed.' MSPs are in the middle of that chain. They are targets in their own right, and they are also a path into every client they serve. Every vendor and every MSP must defend itself with both of those risks in mind."

ConnectWise, which temporarily shut down services following the attacks, has been restoring services in phases, a process that it said will take several days.

title: China's election interference in Taiwan becomes more targeted: NSB - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: NSB：中国对台湾选举的干预变得更有针对性 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月22日电 国家安全局(NSB)高级官员周四表示，中国对台湾的选举干预现在更多地集中在特定群体和受众上。例如，国安局局长蔡明彦表示，北京正在动员航空公司向部分居住在中国的台湾公民提供折扣机票，让他们回国参加 11 月份地方政府选举，为其支持的候选人投票。此外，蔡英文在立法院听证会前对记者表示，据信中国正在向其支持的候选人和政治团体提供非法资金
content:
中新社台北10月22日电 国家安全局(NSB)高级官员周四表示，中国对台湾的选举干预现在更多地集中在特定群体和受众上。

例如，国安局局长蔡明彦表示，北京正在动员航空公司向部分居住在中国的台湾公民提供折扣机票，让他们回国参加 11 月份地方政府选举，为其支持的候选人投票。

此外，蔡英文在立法院外交国防委员会举行听证会之前对记者表示，据信中国正在向其支持的候选人和政治团体提供非法资金，他计划于 2026 年下半年报告国家安全局的情报工作和运作情况。

蔡英文表示，国家安全局和其他情报机构正在积极调查涉嫌干扰案件，并确定了中国使用的几项关键策略，包括涉嫌贿赂台湾选民，为他们提供廉价的中国观光旅游机会。

他说，另一种可疑的策略是传播虚假信息和有争议的内容、经营非法投注池以及黑客攻击特定目标以窃取与选举相关的情报以进行有针对性的干扰。

蔡说，目前，国家安全局正在使用人工智能工具追踪虚假信息和相关内容的来源。
他补充说，国家安全局正在收集涉嫌干扰选举的证据，并希望在11月28日地方政府选举之前将其移交给司法当局进行调查。

蔡英文在周四向立法委员会提交的报告中表示，截至 9 月份，台湾政府服务网络 (GSN) 平均每天处理约 258 万次网络入侵尝试，比 6 月份报告的数字大幅增加。

他表示，国家安全局不排除活动增加与准备干预地方政府选举有关的可能性。

与此同时，当记者问到最近发生的以取笑中国国家主席习近平而闻名的喜剧演员黄逸豪因一场涉嫌编造的交通事故受伤事件时，蔡英文表示，这已经突破了台湾民主法治社会的严重底线。

新北检察官表示，这起事件是中国为了阻止黄的表演而煽动的。周三，几名人员在新北被起诉，其中包括一名据称策划了这起事故的中国公民，身份仅被称为“K”。

蔡英文周四告诉记者，中国的跨国镇压正在加剧，其策略从监视和暴力恐吓转向其他形式的骚扰，旨在逃避台湾的法律，包括涉嫌上演交通事故。
目前，该案的当务之急是加强对受害人的保护，确保责任人受到严惩。

（余明和柯林）

成品/件

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) China's election interference in Taiwan is now focusing more on specific groups and audiences, a senior National Security Bureau (NSB) official said Thursday.

For example, Beijing is mobilizing airlines to offer discounted tickets to select Taiwan citizens living in China to return home to vote in the November local government elections for candidates it backs, NSB Director-General Tsai Ming-yen (蔡明彥) said.

In addition, China is believed to be providing illicit funding to candidates and political groups it supports, Tsai told reporters ahead of a hearing in the Legislature's Foreign Affairs and National Defense Committee, where he was scheduled to report on the NSB's intelligence work and operations in the second half of 2026.

The NSB and other intelligence agencies are actively investigating the suspected interference cases and have identified several key tactics used by China, including suspected bribery of Taiwanese voters by offering them cheap sightseeing visits to China, Tsai said.

Another suspected tactic is spreading disinformation and controversial content, operating illegal betting pools, and hacking specific targets to steal election-related intelligence for targeted interference, he said.

Currently, the NSB is using artificial intelligence tools to trace the sources of disinformation and related content, Tsai said.

The NSB is collecting evidence of suspected election interference and hopes to hand it over to judicial authorities for investigation before the Nov. 28 local government election, he added.

In his report to the legislative committee on Thursday, Tsai said Taiwan's Government Service Network (GSN) was dealing with an average of about 2.58 million cyber intrusion attempts per day as of September, a sharp increase from the figure reported in June.

The NSB does not rule out the possibility that the increased activity was linked to preparations for interference in the local government elections, he said.

Meanwhile, when asked by reporters about a recent incident in which comedian Huang Yi-hao (黃逸豪), who is known for making fun of Chinese President Xi Jinping (習近平), was injured in an allegedly staged traffic accident, Tsai said it had crossed a serious line in Taiwan's democratic and rule-of-law society.

Prosecutors in New Taipei have said that the incident was instigated by China to stop Huang from performing. Several people, including a Chinese national identified only as "K" who allegedly planned the accident, were indicted in New Taipei on Wednesday.

Tsai told reporters Thursday that China's transnational repression was intensifying, with its tactics shifting from surveillance and violent intimidation to other forms of harassment intended to evade Taiwan's laws, including the alleged staging of traffic accidents.

At the moment, the priority in that case is to strengthen protection for the victim and to ensure that those responsible face severe punishment, he said.

(By Matt Yu and Ko Lin)

Enditem/pc

title: Hong Kong Star Ferry fares to rise by up to HK$1.80 from January
zh_title: 香港天星小轮票价一月起上涨至1.80港元
summary: 香港已批准上调票价，从明年 1 月开始，天星小轮乘客每次行程将多付 1.8 港元。 2020 年 8 月，一艘宣传黑白淡奶的天星小轮。照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。根据行政会议上周二批准并于周三公布的建议，平日票价将上涨0.60至1港元，而周末及公众假期的过海行程将上涨1至1.80港元。平日成人票价上限为港币 6 元，周末及公众假期上限为港币 8.30 元。
content:
香港已批准上调票价，从明年 1 月开始，天星小轮乘客每次行程将多付 1.8 港元。 2020 年 8 月，一艘宣传黑白淡奶的天星小轮。照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。根据行政会议上周二批准并于周三公布的建议，平日票价将上涨0.60至1港元，而周末及公众假期的过海行程将上涨1至1.80港元。平日成人票价上限为6港元，周末及公众假期上限为8.30港元，而月票票价则维持190港元不变。票价调整将适用于穿越维多利亚港的中环至尖沙咀及湾仔至尖沙咀航线，并于明年1月25日生效。持续亏损 天星小轮公司上一次提高票价是在 2023 年，该公司于 3 月份申请每趟票价上涨 0.8 港元至 2 港元，平均票价上涨 30%。政府接受了票价调整的请求，但裁定涨幅应适度。香港的天星小轮。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。政府发言人表示，这家拥有138年历史的公司“在2018年至2023年的六年期间累计亏损超过1亿港元，不得不依靠债务融资来运营其专营服务”。
另见：中东燃油压力下，香港巴士营办商寻求票价加价高达17.7% 发言人补充说：“虽然天星小轮在2024年和2025年录得边际利润，但未来几年将继续面临严峻的财务压力，预计从2026年开始将再次录得亏损，原因是客流量增长缓慢、成本压缩空间有限，以及运营成本和债务相关利息支出持续增加。” 政府表示，该标志性渡轮服务的表现一直是“令人满意的”，并鼓励不断努力通过非票价收入来提高其长期财务生存能力。加价后，天星小轮仍是最实惠的过海交通工具，票价较港铁或专营巴士低约30%至50%。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong has approved fare hikes that will see Star Ferry passengers pay as much as HK$1.80 more per trip starting from January next year. A Star Ferry vessel promoting Black & White Evaporated Milk in August 2020. Photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. Under a proposal approved by the Executive Council last Tuesday and announced on Wednesday, weekday fares will rise by between HK$0.60 and HK$1, while cross-harbour trips on weekends and public holidays will increase by between HK$1 and HK$1.80. Adult fares will be capped at HK$6 on weekdays and HK$8.30 on weekends and public holidays, while the cost of monthly passes will remain unchanged at HK$190. The fare adjustments will apply to both the Central-Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai-Tsim Sha Tsui routes across Victoria Harbour, and will come into effect on January 25 next year. Continued losses The Star Ferry Company , which last raised its fares in 2023, applied in March for increases of HK$0.8 to HK$2 per trip – an average fare hike of 30 per cent. The government accepted the case for fare adjustments, but ruled that the rate of increase should be moderated. Hong Kong’s Star Ferry. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The 138-year-old company “recorded heavy accumulated losses of over HK$100 million during the six-year period between 2018 and 2023, and had to rely on debt financing to run its franchised services,” a government spokesperson said. See also: Hong Kong bus operators seek fare hikes of up to 17.7% amid Middle East fuel pressure “While Star Ferry recorded marginal profits in 2024 and 2025, it will continue to face severe financial pressure in the coming years and is expected to record losses again starting from 2026 due to slow patronage growth, limited room for cost-compression, and continuous increases in operating costs and debt-related interest expenses,” the spokesperson added. The government said the iconic ferry service’s performance had been “satisfactory” and encouraged ongoing efforts to improve its long-term financial viability through non-farebox revenue. After the fare increase, Star Ferry will remain the most affordable means of crossing the harbour, with fares about 30 to 50 per cent lower than the MTR or franchised bus fares.

ZUNYI, Oct. 20 (Xinhua) -- Zunyi in southwest China's Guizhou Province has a resonant title: the "city of historic turning point."

In January 1935, an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee was held in Zunyi during the Long March. The Zunyi Meeting is regarded as a crucial turning point of the Long March, leading to the ultimate success of the Chinese revolution. Since then, Zunyi has become a sacred place for generations of CPC members, and the footprints of the Red Army are forever imprinted on the city's culture and spirits.

Rooted in its revolutionary past, the city is now embarking on a new chapter of development while retaining its historical significance.When the Red Army passed through, its population stood at just over 30,000. By 2025, the permanent population of its central urban area exceeded 1.6 million, with an urbanization rate of 61 percent.

Zunyi also calls for developing new quality productive forces in light of local conditions and accelerating the building of a modern industrial system.

The year 2026 marks the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Long March. Take a drone tour above China's "city of historic turning point."

title: Japan Reports Surge in Airspace Violations by Chinese, Russian Aircraft - USNI News
zh_title: 日本报告中国和俄罗斯飞机侵犯领空的事件激增 - USNI News
summary: 2026 年 6 月 27 日，日本军队拍摄的一架中国轰 6 轰炸机。日本联合参谋部照片 日本中国和俄罗斯飞机侵犯领空的事件继 2025 年减少后，在 2026 财年上半年激增。4 月 1 日至 9 月 1 日期间，日本航空自卫队战斗机紧急升空 442 次。根据日本最近发布的扰乱报告，1月30日是日本2026财年上半年的时间。相比之下，日本航空自卫队[在 2025 年同一时间段]进行了 265 次紧急升空(https://news.usni.org/2025/10/15/japan-reports-decrease-in-airspace-violations-f
content:
2026 年 6 月 27 日，日本军队拍摄的一架中国轰 6 轰炸机。日本联合参谋部照片

继 2025 年减少之后，2026 财年上半年中国和俄罗斯飞机侵犯日本领空的事件激增。

4月1日至9月间，日本航空自卫队战斗机紧急升空442次。根据日本最近发布的扰乱报告，1月30日是日本2026财年上半年的时间。相比之下，日本航空自卫队[在 2025 年同一时间段]进行了 265 次紧急升空(https://news.usni.org/2025/10/15/japan-reports-decrease-in-airspace-violations-from-chinese- Russian-aircraft)。总体而言，2025 财年发生了 595 次紧急扰乱。

在 2026 财年的紧急起飞中，65%（即 285 次）是针对中国飞机和无人机的。俄罗斯飞机进行了 152 次紧急起飞，占 34%，其余 1% 包括 5 次被归类为“其他”的紧急起飞。相比之下，2025 财年，中国飞机和无人机进行了 198 次紧急升空，俄罗斯飞机进行了 59 次，其中 8 次属于“其他”。

报告中记录的实例包括俄罗斯IL-20电子情报（ELINT）飞机在日本海和太平洋上空的飞行、中国Y-9电子情报飞机9月份在东海上空五天的飞行以及中国H-6轰炸机和俄罗斯Tu-95轰炸机的远程联合飞行。
红色为中国飞机，黄色为俄罗斯飞机的飞行路线，显示了4月1日至9月的航班。 2026 年 30 日。日本联合参谋部地图

日本航空自卫队战斗机经常对进入日本防空识别区的飞机进行紧急升空。防空识别区并未得到国际认可，因为该区域通常涵盖 12 海里领土界限以外的国际空域。许多国家利用防空识别区来识别、定位和跟踪该地区的飞机。今年没有侵犯日本领空的记录。

日本联合参谋部发布的地图显示，中国的大部分航班都是在日本西南地区附近的东海上空进行的。大多数俄罗斯航班发生在北海道主岛和本州岛北部附近的日本海和太平洋上空。

西南防空司令部的紧急升空次数最多，为 201 次，而 2025 财年为 189 次。由于对日本的监视以及中国无人机经过该地区对台湾进行侦察，日本西南地区通常是中国活动最多的地区。
此外，解放军海军航母定期在东海和菲律宾海之间过境并进行飞行行动，这促使日本航空自卫队紧急紧急起飞。[去年12月](https://news.usni.org/2025/12/08/chinese-fighters-lock-radar-on-japanese-fighters-monitoring-plan-carrier-strike-group-in-philippine-sea)、辽宁号航空母舰（16）上的J-15战斗机用雷达对日本航空自卫队战斗机进行了武器锁定。 2026 财年的前六个月，没有中国海军航母在日本西南部地区运营。

西南地区还出现了俄罗斯和中国飞机的联合轰炸机飞行，最近一次是在 6 月 27 日。俄罗斯和中国表示，联合海空活动是正常合作活动的一部分，但日本认为这些活动令人担忧。

2026年7月21日，一架俄罗斯Tu-95轰炸机和一架Su-35战斗机飞越日本海。日本联合参谋部照片

【原文 English Original】
A Chinese H-6 bomber photographed June 27, 2026, by Japanese forces. Japan Joint Staff Office photo

Japan saw a surge in airspace violations by Chinese and Russian aircraft during the first half of Fiscal Year 2026 following a decrease in 2025.

The Japan Air Self-Defense Force scrambled fighter aircraft 442 times from April 1-Sept. 30, which is the first half of Japan’s FY2026, according to Japan’s recently released scramble report. In comparison, the JASDF conducted 265 scrambles [in the same time period in 2025](https://news.usni.org/2025/10/15/japan-reports-decrease-in-airspace-violations-from-chinese-russian-aircraft). Overall, FY2025 saw 595 scrambles in FY2025.

Of the FY2026 scrambles, 65 percent – or 285 – were in response to Chinese aircraft and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles. Russia aircraft made up 34 percent with 152 scrambles and the remaining 1 percent included five scrambles classed as “Other.” In comparison, in FY2025, Chinese aircraft and UAVs accounted for 198 scrambles, Russian aircraft for 59 and 8 were “Other.”

The documented instances in the report include flights by Russian IL-20 Electronic Intelligence (ELINT) aircraft over the Sea of Japan and the Pacific Ocean, five days of flights by Chinese Y-9 ELINT aircraft over the East China Sea in September and long-range joint flights by Chinese H-6 bombers and Russian Tu-95 bombers.

The flight paths of Chinese aircraft in red and Russian aircraft in yellow, showing flights from April 1-Sept. 30, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office map

JASDF fighters regularly scramble against aircraft entering Japan’s Air Defense Identification Zone. ADIZs are not recognized internationally because the area usually encompasses international airspace beyond the 12 nautical mile territorial limit. A number of countries use ADIZs to identify, locate and track aircraft in the region. No violations of Japan’s airspace have been recorded this year.

The majority of Chinese flights took place over the East China Sea off Japan’s southwest region, according to a map released by Japan’s Joint Staff Office. Most Russian flights occurred over the Sea of Japan and the Pacific Ocean near the main island of Hokkaido and the northern side of Honshu.

The Southwestern Air Defense Command saw the most scrambles – 201 compared to 189 in FY2025. Japan’s southwest region typically sees the most amount of Chinese activity due to surveillance on Japan and from Chinese UAVs passing through the region to conduct reconnaissance of Taiwan.

In addition, People’s Liberation Army Navy aircraft carriers regularly transit between the East China Sea and the Philippine Sea and conduct flight operations, which prompt JASDF scrambles.[In December last year](https://news.usni.org/2025/12/08/chinese-fighters-lock-radar-on-japanese-fighters-monitoring-plan-carrier-strike-group-in-philippine-sea), PLAN J-15 fighter aircraft from aircraft carrier CNS _Liaoning_ (16) carried out weapons lock with their radars on JASDF fighter aircraft. During the first six months of FY2026, no PLAN carriers operated around Japan’s southwest region.

The southwest region also sees joint bomber flights by Russian and Chinese aircraft, with the latest being on June 27. Russia and China have said the joint naval and air activities are part of normal cooperation activities, though Japan sees activities as a concern.

A Russian Tu-95 bomber and a Su-35 fighter flew over the Sea of Japan on July 21, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo

“In the vicinity of Japan, China and Russia conducted joint flights of bombers and joint navigations of vessels. Such repeated joint activities are obviously intended as demonstration activities against Japan and pose a grave concern for Japan’s security,” reads the Japan Ministry of Defense _Defense of Japan 2026_ annual white paper.

The Northern Air Defense Command conducted 112 scrambles in the first half of FY2026, compared with 53 in the same period in FY2025. The command covers Hokkaido and northern Honshu and usually scrambles in response to Russian aircraft. Hokkaido is in close proximity to Russia’s Sakhalin Island. Russia also conducts long-range surveillance and intelligence gathering flights in the command’s area of operations.

The Western Air Defense Command, covering Kyushu, Shikoku and southern Honshu, carried out 102 scrambles in the first half of FY2026, compared to 14 in the same period. Based on the JSO map, the large increase is due to Chinese flight activities in the East China Sea and Russian aircraft flying from the Sea of Japan to the East China Sea to join Chinese aircraft for joint flights.

The Central Air Defense Command saw 27 scrambles in the first six months of FY2026 compared with nine in the same period in FY2025. The command covers the central portion of the main island of Honshu. Scrambles are primarily in response to Russian air activity in the Sea of Japan.

A Chinese Y-9 ELINT aircraft on Aug. 12, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo

The JSO report also included 25 instances of what were categorized as unusual flight activities. The entries covered the flights of Russian IL-20 ELINT aircraft, Chinese Y-9 ELINT aircraft and TB-001 UAVs. Two entries covered bomber flights. Notably, from Sept. 3-7, fighters were scrambled five consecutive days against a single Y-9 ELINT aircraft flight over the East China Sea.

On Jun. 27, two Chinese H-6 bombers and two J-16 fighters flew from the East China Sea to the Sea of Japan where they joined two Russian Tu-95 bombers, two Tu-142 Maritime Patrol Aircraft (MPA) and one Su-35 fighter for a joint flight to the East China Sea.

The two Tu-95 bombers and Tu-142 MPAs then joined with another pair of Chinese H-6 bombers and four J-16 fighters for a flight between Okinawa and Miyako Island where the bombers and MPA entered the Philippine Sea. The bombers and MPA then conducted a joint flight over the Pacific Ocean, south of Shikoku Island, before returning to the East China Sea.

The second bomber event was on July 21 when a Russian Tu-95 and Su-35 flew over the Sea of Japan.

# Expanding the Military Footprint: China’s New Air Base in Laos

Establishment of the Laotian base follows a pattern in China’s growing external military presence and access.

By [Rajeswari Pillai Rajagopalan](https://thediplomat.com/authors/rajeswari-pillai-rajagopalan/)

October 20, 2026

[](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fexpanding-the-military-footprint-chinas-new-air-base-in-laos%2F&title=Expanding+the+Military+Footprint%3A+China%E2%80%99s+New+Air+Base+in+Laos "Share on LinkedIn")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fexpanding-the-military-footprint-chinas-new-air-base-in-laos%2F "Share on Facebook")[](https://bsky.app/intent/compose?text=Expanding+the+Military+Footprint%3A+China%E2%80%99s+New+Air+Base+in+Laos%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fexpanding-the-military-footprint-chinas-new-air-base-in-laos%2F "Share on Bluesky")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Expanding+the+Military+Footprint%3A+China%E2%80%99s+New+Air+Base+in+Laos&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fexpanding-the-military-footprint-chinas-new-air-base-in-laos%2F "Share on X")

Credit: [Depositphotos](https://manage.thediplomat.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/thediplomat_2024-07-19-131528.jpg)

Ad

As China’s power and self-confidence grows, it’s becoming much more active in projecting that power by establishing military bases abroad. The latest is at Ban Keun Airport near Vientiane, where China has established a joint support and training facility with Laos, according to a September [announcement](http://eng.mod.gov.cn/2025xb/D/V/16490652.html) by the Ministry of National Defense in Beijing.

It is the first overseas military facility that China has openly acknowledged, unlike the ones in Djibouti and Cambodia. This has several implications for the region.

But first, the base itself. Satellite imagery procured and analyzed by[CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/2026/10/08/asia/laos-china-airbase-cia-intl-hnk-ml) shows a 2,000-meter-long runway, taxiway, and parking apron for 22 aircraft. CNN also reports rapid construction at the site. Other media[reports](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/attack-aircraft-military-vehicles-visible-new-china-laos-base-satellite-images-2026-10-06/) mention that satellite photos show eight aircraft, likely Chinese-Pakistani Hongdu JL-8 training and light attack jets (also called K-8s), and more than two dozen support vehicles. Laos[is known to own](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/04597222.2025.2445477) this type of aircraft, but fewer than the eight seen at the facility. Laos could have bought more, or the extras may be Chinese.

China has said that the facility is strictly for training Lao air force pilots, “enhancing practical military cooperation,” and “promoting regional peace and stability.” This sounds reasonable enough, but it conflicts with China’s own previous positions on foreign military facilities. It has been a vocal critic of the global U.S. military presence.

Establishment of the Laotian base follows a pattern in China’s growing external military presence and access. China established its first overseas military facility in Djibouti in 2017, maintaining then and now that it is merely a logistical facility. This is still its most distant foreign military base, sitting astride the crucial waters overlooking the Bab al-Mandab strait leading to the Red Sea.

Closer to home, a Washington Post story in 2022 revealed that China was upgrading the Cambodian Ream Naval Base, with the Chinese military being given “[exclusive use](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2022/06/06/cambodia-china-navy-base-ream/)” of parts of it. China and Cambodia initially denied the report, but last year they formally inaugurated the facility. Soon warships from both countries visited it, conducting joint military drills. Though the base is not very far from China’s own territory, it’s on the strategically crucial Gulf of Thailand and thereby strengthens China’s position in the Indo-Pacific and particularly in the South China Sea.

With the Ream Naval Base in Cambodia and Ban Keun Air Facility in Laos, China now has both naval and aviation logistics hubs in the area.

There are at least four implications from the establishment of the base in Laos, both for neighbors such as Vietnam and the whole region.

First, sitting to the west of Vietnam, it gives China one more pressure point on that country. Vietnam already has a complicated relationship with China, with close economic ties but also significant territorial disputes.

Second, it adds an air power dimension to China’s foreign base activity. The two foreign bases that China previously built were both naval ones. The latest base at Ban Keun provides China’s air force with an air power footing in a strategically sensitive region. China can be expected to later extend the runway to support Chinese surveillance aircraft or bombers. Though Laos is land-locked, its long and narrow geography could provide China with an excellent site for monitoring activity across Southeast Asia.

Ad

Third, this represents a new type of military basing activity. For China, what matters is assured access. By packaging access as joint training facilities or disaster relief and humanitarian support hubs, Beijing secures a more lasting presence while avoiding the diplomatic and political cost of building traditional military bases. As far as China is concerned, it has created pretty much the same strategic effect without investing in a dedicated Western-style base of its own. 欧盟 (EU) 将于周二[公布巩固其在[北极](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/arctic/)的压力的计划](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20260914-leaders-urge-eu-to-expand-arctic-presence-amid-Russia-threat)关键战略地区的【俄罗斯】(https://www.france24.com/en/tag/Russia/)和【美国】(https://www.france24.com/en/tag/usa/)。

法新社看到的新“北极战略”草案显示，从关键原材料到破冰船和海底电缆，欧盟希望增强其在地缘政治战场上的影响力。

欧盟国际伙伴关系负责人约瑟夫·西克拉表示：“北极的新现实要求欧洲成为强大而可靠的合作伙伴。这正是我们新战略的目标。”

“它解决了该地区最紧迫的挑战，从加速[气候变化](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/climate-change/)到日益严重的安全和地缘政治紧张局势，并阐述了欧洲应如何应对。”

随着全球变暖导致海冰融化，北极的竞争正在加剧。俄罗斯、中国和美国等国一直在加大活动力度，竞相争夺自然资源和新的海上航线。

阅读更多[领导人敦促欧盟在俄罗斯“威胁”中扩大北极存在](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20260914-leaders-urge-eu-to-expand-arctic-presence-amid-Russia-threat)
领导人敦促欧盟加强北极作用以应对俄罗斯“威胁”

 封面图片：文件：2022 年 3 月 25 日，挪威军队在北极圈内的塞特穆恩参加名为“寒冷反应 2022”的军事演习，演习汇集了来自北约成员国以及芬兰和瑞典的约 30,000 名士兵，以应对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的情况。©Reuters/Yves Herman

01:54

欧盟的 27 个成员国中有三个北极国家——丹麦、芬兰和瑞典——欧盟在这场游戏中利益攸关。

美国总统[唐纳德·特朗普](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/)一再威胁要将[格陵兰](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/greenland/)——一块广阔的丹麦自治领土——置于美国的控制之下，这让欧洲感到不安。

鉴于远北地区发生的事情也会对更远的南方产生影响，该战略将由欧盟主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩(Ursula von der Leyen)(https://www.france24.com/en/tag/ursula-von-der-leyen/)提出，旨在制定欧盟对该地区的共同方针。

法新社看到的草案强调需要与加拿大、英国和挪威等“志同道合”的非欧盟国家合作；并设想定期举行“北方邻里”合作伙伴峰会。
## 美国呢？

直到最近，作为该地区的重要盟友，美国才被列入可以参与的国家之列，但该国因缺席该文件的其余部分而更加引人注目。

 随着全球变暖导致海冰融化，北极地区的竞争日趋激烈 © Mads Claus Rasmussen / Ritzau Scanpix/法新社

尽管特朗普的语气自今年年初以来有所降温——最终导致与格陵兰岛和丹麦签署了安全协议——但欧洲许多人仍然保持警惕。

【原文 English Original】
The European Union (EU) is to [unveil plans to bolster its foothold](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20260914-leaders-urge-eu-to-expand-arctic-presence-amid-russia-threat)in the [Arctic](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/arctic/)onTuesday, as it grapples with pressure from [Russia](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/russia/) and the [United States](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/usa/) in the key strategic region.

From critical raw materials to icebreakers and undersea cables, the bloc wants to up its presence in the geopolitical battleground, according to a draft of its new "strategy for the Arctic" seen by AFP.

"The new reality in the Arctic requires Europe to be a strong and reliable partner. That is precisely what we aim to achieve with our new strategy," said Jozef Sikela, the EU's head of international partnerships.

"It addresses the region's most pressing challenges, from accelerating [climate change](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/climate-change/) to growing security and geopolitical tensions, and sets out how Europe should respond."

Competition is on the rise in the Arctic as global warming causes sea ice to melt. Countries such as Russia, China and the United States have been ramping up activity– racing to claim natural resources and new maritime routes.

Read more[Leaders urge EU to expand Arctic presence amid Russia 'threat'](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20260914-leaders-urge-eu-to-expand-arctic-presence-amid-russia-threat)

Leaders urge EU to boost Arctic role to tackle Russia 'threat'

 Cover image: Archivo: un miembro del ejército noruego participa en un ejercicio militar llamado "Cold Response 2022", que reúne a alrededor de 30.000 tropas de países miembros de la OTAN, así como de Finlandia y Suecia, en medio de la invasión rusa de Ucrania, en Setermoen, en el Círculo Polar Ártico, Noruega, el 25 de marzo de 2022. © Reuters/Yves Herman

01:54

With three Arctic nations among its 27 members – Denmark, Finland and Sweden – the EU has skin in the game.

And US President [Donald Trump](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/)'s repeated threats to bring [Greenland](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/greenland/) – a vast, autonomous Danish territory – under US control have rattled Europe.

Given that what happens in the far north also has repercussions further south, the strategy, which is to be presented by the EU chief [Ursula von der Leyen](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/ursula-von-der-leyen/), aims to set out a common EU approach to the region.

The draft seen by AFP stresses the need for cooperation with "like-minded" non-EU nations, such as Canada, Britain and Norway; and envisages a regular summit of "Northern Neighbourhood" partners.

## What about the US?

Only recently a key ally in the region, the United States is listed among those who could participate, but the country is otherwise more noticeable for its absence from the remainder of the document.

 Competition is on the rise in the Arctic as global warming causes sea ice to melt © Mads Claus Rasmussen / Ritzau Scanpix/AFP

While Trump's tone has cooled since the beginning of the year– eventually leading to the signing of a security deal with Greenland and Denmark– many in Europe remain wary.

The United States is named only a handful of times in the 20-page paper, compared with almost two dozen mentions for Canada.

Some of the initiatives listed in the strategy seemingly aim to cut dependencies on Washington.

Watch more[Trump’s obsession with Greenland: The real reasons behind his threats](https://www.france24.com/en/trump-s-obsession-with-greenland-the-real-reasons-behind-his-threats)

According to the draft, Brussels is planning a "sovereign and secure" submarine cable to connect Greenland with the EU's mainland as part of a broader "Pan-Arctic" cable project – also linking Canada, Japan and South Korea.

The bloc is also working to provide satellite connectivity in the Arctic through satellite constellation project IRIS², which aims to rival [Elon Musk](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/elon-musk/)'s Starlink.

How to counter an aggressive Russia is also top of mind, with the document pointing to hybrid threats such as "drone incursions" and the sabotage of undersea cables.

The strategy envisages better data-sharing to monitor Moscow's so-called "shadow fleet" of sanctions-busting oil tankers.

And it stresses the importance of boosting Europe's icebreaker fleet, saying Brussels will develop options for joint procurement, pooling and sharing of polar vessels with allies.

Investments in renewable energy and critical raw material projects are also foreseen, among a series of other plans.

_(FRANCE 24 with AFP)_

title: 蔡天鳳案｜前司機指蔡常攜大量現金外出　留意蔡疑曾周轉不靈
summary: 名媛蔡天鳳（Abby Choi）涉遭鄺氏三父子謀殺肢解案（HCCC 198/2025），今(20日）在高等法院續審。蔡天鳳的前私人司機作供。 司機錢紀信供稱，他的工作主要負責接載蔡的一對子女上學，亦會接載蔡的前家姑李瑞香一家出入。他指鄺港傑於2022年11月指他們全家會去兩個月旅行，著他停薪留職，錢反提議取半薪打理七人車被拒，他便辭職，他離職時未有被指控偷竊或講粗口。 錢接受辯方盤問時透露，蔡常攜帶大量現金，但這情況至2022年2至6月起變化，他覺蔡有現金周轉問題，有時購物也
content:
名媛蔡天鳳（Abby Choi）涉遭鄺氏三父子謀殺肢解案（HCCC 198/2025），今(20日）在高等法院續審。蔡天鳳的前私人司機作供。

司機錢紀信供稱，他的工作主要負責接載蔡的一對子女上學，亦會接載蔡的前家姑李瑞香一家出入。他指鄺港傑於2022年11月指他們全家會去兩個月旅行，著他停薪留職，錢反提議取半薪打理七人車被拒，他便辭職，他離職時未有被指控偷竊或講粗口。
錢接受辯方盤問時透露，蔡常攜帶大量現金，但這情況至2022年2至6月起變化，他覺蔡有現金周轉問題，有時購物也會叫錢先墊支，之後再還錢給他。

三名被告：前大伯鄺港傑（35歲，司機）、前家翁鄺球（69歲，退休人士）、前夫鄺港智（32歲，無業），三人被控於2023年2月21日，在香港謀殺蔡天鳳，並在同月21至23日阻止合法埋葬蔡天鳳的屍體。法官早前向選出的陪審團透露，三名被告都否認謀殺罪，至於阻止合法埋葬屍體罪，鄺港傑和鄺港智承認控罪，鄺球則否認罪名。

司機錢紀信稱，他正式入職後，才發現蔡天鳳才是真老闆。(網上圖片)

錢紀信稱，他申請司機工作時，是由蔡的前家姑李瑞香(圖)見工的。（廖雁雄攝）

### 李瑞香見工 蔡天鳳才是真老闆

控方今先傳召蔡天鳳的前司機錢紀信作供，指於2021年4月申請任司機。他指，當時由李瑞香見工，並獲李聘用，於同年5月1日開始工作。他指，當時每周工作六天，月薪2萬元。他「做下做下」才知道真正的老闆是蔡天鳳，並解釋：「佢（蔡天鳳）負責畀錢佢哋出糧畀我，以我所知因為佢係話事嗰個。」

### 主要接載蔡一對子女上學或回家

錢續指，當時駕駛一輛白色七人車，接載蔡的一對子女上學或回家。蔡的長子當時於屯門的學校就讀，錢負責接載他上學，長子放學則乘搭校車返家。此外，錢間中亦會接載蔡的女兒到大埔上學，蔡天鳳或李瑞香或會一同接送蔡的女兒。除了接載蔡的子女，錢亦有接載李瑞香和其家人出入，包括「飲茶，買嘢」。

錢紀信指，2022年11月，鄺港傑(圖)指他們全家要去旅行兩個月，叫錢停薪留職。(資料圖片)

錢紀信稱，記得曾載蔡天鳳往又一城見鄺球(圖)。(資料圖片)

### 鄺港傑有行車紀錄儀密碼

錢指，當時有一個WhatsApp訊息群組，負責安排錢的駕駛工作，成員包括蔡、李和鄺港傑。他續指，起初工作時，鄺港傑並不在港，他於2021年7、8月左右返港，並有指揮錢工作。 被問及該白色七人車有否行車紀錄儀，錢確認有，但後期才運作。錢解釋，鄺港傑接駁行車紀錄儀後，它才運作。同時，鄺港傑有行車紀錄儀的密碼。

### 曾載鄺港傑到中環取信封

錢又透露，曾接載鄺港傑到中環IFC拿取信封，之後載鄺港傑回加多利山，鄺港傑把信封帶到單位。翌日，錢接載蔡到加多利山，之後見蔡帶著信封上車，並載蔡到又一城找鄺球。蔡之後再上車，錢再沒見到信封。錢又指，蔡講家鄉話，錢未能聽懂蔡在車上說什麼。錢指這些事發生在蔡天鳳與譚方駿等在澳門回來後。澳門賭錢的事件發生於2022年。

### 否認曾被指控偷竊或講粗口

錢續指，於2022年11月，鄺港傑稱他和家人將會去旅行兩個月，著錢停薪留職，錢反提議在該段時間支半個月的薪金，幫忙打理七人車，鄺港傑不同意，錢便辭職，並工作至該月15日。被問及有否被指控偷竊，或在蔡的子女面前講粗口或被批評其操守，錢否認。主控郭莎樂問錢有否被指控賭錢，影響他任司機的工作，錢說：「呢個係私人問題，我都唔會同佢哋講」。

代表鄺港傑的大律師Trevor Beel盤問時指，錢記錯鄺港傑回港時間，鄺實際是2021年10月返港，因為根據外遊紀錄，鄺港傑由2021年4月至10月都不在港。錢稱他不記得。

### 指蔡曾向鄺港傑借60萬

Beel又問到，在2022年2月，海棠路單位外是否有數名男人在屋外徘徊，當時錢載蔡天鳳回家，蔡見狀在車內躲藏？錢同意，他理解與蔡欠債有關。錢憶述蔡當時致電鄺港傑，向鄺借60萬元。數日後，錢載鄺去IFC，錢聽到鄺與另一人的對話，得知信封內有60萬元。翌日，蔡帶着同一個信封去又一城。

### 指蔡出門會帶大量現金

錢說，蔡出街會攜帶大量現金，但至2022年2月至6月，情況變得不同。錢印象中蔡當時有現金周轉問題，有時購物蔡會叫錢先墊支，之後再還給錢。錢又說，他有時會載蔡天鳳到蔡的雞蛋仔店取店的收入。Beel亦問車cam的電源是否來自七人車電池，錢同意，指即使沒開引擎，車cam也能夠運作。

錢紀信指，第三被告鄺港智(圖)在2022年才加入群組，但他沒有在群組作過聲。(資料圖片)

### 鄺港智在群組沒作過聲

代表鄺球的律師則指，鄺球很少坐蔡的7人車，錢同意。鄺港智的律師則指，錢的口供提到鄺港智每周會隨同錢的車去接小朋友？錢當時的記憶較準確。錢說：「唔係啊。」錢另同意，鄺港智在2022年被加入了蔡家私家車安排的群組，但鄺沒作過聲。

## 譚父證供

title: Great powers squeeze Southeast Asia’s strategic supply chains
summary: There is a tension building in Southeast Asia’s export model. The region’s strategic supply chains — highly integrated production networks producing goods and technologies that will underpin future economic and geopolitical power — are at t
content:
There is a tension building in Southeast Asia’s export model. The region’s strategic supply chains — highly integrated production networks producing goods and technologies that will underpin future economic and geopolitical power — are at the forefront of economic security concerns and great power competition. These pressures are complicating Southeast Asia’s emerging role as a producer in these networks and could ultimately reduce the economic and development benefits available.

Strategic supply chains span clean energy technologies essential to future energy security, drones with both military and commercial applications, robotics that hold potentially transformative economic benefits, and currently irreplaceable inputs like semiconductors and critical minerals. For Southeast Asia, the most important are semiconductors, critical minerals, solar panels, electric vehicles and batteries.

Recent [Lowy Institute](https://www.lowyinstitute.org/publications/between-the-superpowers-southeast-asia-s-strategic-supply-chain-dilemma) research demonstrates the extent to which these strategic supply chains have become substantial segments of Southeast Asia’s economy. They account for almost one quarter of the region’s total exports and over 10 per cent of its GDP, while also drawing over half of greenfield foreign direct investment across the region since 2021.

Southeast Asia has benefited from being a [connector economy](https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/001/2026/118/article-A001-en.xml) between the United States and China, integrating with the technology and industrial ecosystems of both superpower economies. Those linkages have proven invaluable to the region’s economic development. Under the second Trump administration, Southeast Asia’s trade relationship with the United States has only deepened despite US tariffs. In 2025, the region [eclipsed China’s share](https://www.lowyinstitute.org/publications/navigating-storm-southeast-asia-global-trade-shocks) of US imports for the first time this century, solidifying its position as a viable alternative to Chinese production despite claims it is [acting as a transhipment hub](https://www.whitehouse.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/The-Great-Transshipment-Scam.pdf).

US–China decoupling has had an outsized impact on strategic supply chains. Between 2017 and 2022, China’s share of US strategic goods imports fell by about 13.7 percentage points, [more than twice](https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099812010312311610/pdf/IDU0938e50fe0608704ef70b7d005cda58b5af0d.pdf) the decline in China’s overall share of US imports. After the United States imposed tariffs on Chinese semiconductors and solar panels in 2018, Southeast Asia’s semiconductor-related exports to the US market grew substantially faster and the region became the major supplier of solar panels and cells to the United States.

Southeast Asia’s connector role was crucial for maximising those export opportunities, but it is also why headwinds are now building — it exposes the region to rising geoeconomic tensions as US–China competition intensifies.

Economic security concerns that define the US–China relationship are expanding to include third-party countries. US advanced semiconductor export controls are imperfect and Southeast Asia appears to be a primary location [of leakage to China](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysia-says-trade-permit-required-ai-chips-us-origin-2025-07-14/). Washington has signalled dissatisfaction with this status quo and the [agreements on reciprocal trade](https://www.lowyinstitute.org/the-interpreter/asean-s-dealmaking-trump-shows-promise) struck with Southeast Asia demonstrate the United States is attempting to bring the region into its economic security orbit. Those efforts are only likely to intensify as Southeast Asia further replaces China as a source of US imports.

Where the US market remains exposed to Chinese supply chains, even indirectly via Southeast Asia, Washington has acted. Import duties [imposed in 2025](https://www.trade.gov/final-affirmative-determinations-antidumping-and-countervailing-duty-investigations-crystalline) on most of Southeast Asia’s solar production were justified on the grounds that firms establishing operations there were benefiting from [Chinese solar subsidies](https://www.oecd.org/en/data/dashboards/magic-database-industrial-subsidies/Subsidies-by-sector.html?oecdcontrol-chart-control-bar-80cf69747f-var1=SOLA). Duties on Southeast Asia’s solar products consequently enjoyed bipartisan support. The region’s share in global solar panel and cell production is [expected to decline](https://iea.blob.core.windows.net/assets/ac357b64-0020-421c-98d7-f5c468dadb0f/SoutheastAsiaEnergyOutlook2024.pdf).

Southeast Asia’s exposure goes both ways. China’s government has embarked on a decades-long semiconductor industrial policy program, [estimated at US$150 billion](https://www.semiconductors.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/Taking-Stock-of-China%E2%80%99s-Semiconductor-Industry_final.pdf), made urgent by ever-expanding US export controls. That has stimulated the expansion of a domestic industry at the expense of imports as Beijing prioritises indigenous capability. China is Southeast Asia’s largest semiconductor export market, but its imports from the region fell over 20 per cent between 2021 and 2024. While the artificial intelligence boom in Asia may temporarily reverse this trend as China’s [imports rapidly grow](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/chinas-exports-up-25-yy-august-imports-surge-282-2026-09-08/), that is unlikely to last.

ASEAN is serious about [collectively prioritising](https://asean.org/book/asean-geoeconomics-report-2025-this-time-it-is-different-aseans-agency-in-shaping-the-new-global-agenda/) strategic supply chains like semiconductors, critical minerals and electric vehicles. Indonesia has [conducted](https://www.lowyinstitute.org/publications/future-indonesia-s-green-industrial-policy) a decades-long industrial policy program targeting critical minerals, batteries and electric vehicles. Semiconductor strategies have been announced by several national governments and ASEAN launched a [Framework for Integrated Semiconductor Supply Chain](https://www.eria.org/uploads/clean-afiss-22-sept---for-aem-endorsement--final-.pdf/) in 2025 that seeks to deepen regional coordination and integration. Governments are also combining education and infrastructure programs to complement industrial and trade policies targeting these industries — [Thailand](https://www.lowyinstitute.org/the-interpreter/thailand-s-semiconductor-plan-has-a-washington-problem) wants to develop a regional skills pipeline for semiconductor workers.

Southeast Asian governments should create or increase funding for government agencies or units tasked with combating legitimate cases of transhipment, while transnational criminal operations that circumvent technology export controls need to be shut down. These changes would go some way to allaying US concerns. Accelerating decarbonisation efforts would also raise demand for strategic supply chains and the goods the region wants to produce. Coordinating these efforts regionally would only amplify their positive effects.

Southeast Asia will only become more exposed to a fragmenting global economy. It will need creative and ambitious policies to preserve and deepen strategic supply chains in the region.

_Robert Walker is Research Fellow at the Lowy Institute, Australia._

title: Ethiopia: Airbus Projects Sixfold Growth in Ethiopia's Air Passenger Traffic Over Next 20 Years
summary: Addis Ababa — Airbus has forecast a sixfold rise in Ethiopia's air passenger traffic over the next 20 years, saying Ethiopian Airlines is well placed to turn Addis Ababa into one of Africa's leading aviation hubs. It cited Ethiopian Airline
content:
Addis Ababa — Airbus has forecast a sixfold rise in Ethiopia's air passenger traffic over the next 20 years, saying Ethiopian Airlines is well placed to turn Addis Ababa into one of Africa's leading aviation hubs.

It cited Ethiopian Airlines' expanding network, growing demand and planned airport infrastructure as key factors positioning Addis Ababa to become a leading aviation hub in Africa

Airbus Vice President for Market Analysis and Forecast Antonio Da Costa told ENA that Ethiopia has strong growth potential, with Ethiopian Airlines well positioned to capitalize on rising passenger numbers and expanding regional and international connectivity.

"We're obviously extremely proud to be a partner of Ethiopian Airlines," Da Costa said. "Ethiopian Airlines are our first A350 customer in Africa and have been a great customer of the 350 over the last 10 years."

Keep up with the latest headlines on [WhatsApp](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K "https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K") | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/ "https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/")

Da Costa said the airline's established network, fleet capabilities and hub strategy would help it accommodate the projected increase in passenger traffic.

"We obviously see a very good and strong potential of growth in Ethiopia with over six times more passengers coming over the next 20 years," he said. "So we believe that Ethiopian Airlines is well placed to cover and to take advantage of that growth."

Airbus also projects that African air traffic will triple over the same period, creating opportunities for airlines and airports to expand capacity and strengthen connections across the continent and beyond.

Da Costa said Addis Ababa's role in African aviation would become increasingly significant as Ethiopia develops its planned airport infrastructure, including the new airport project in Bishoftu.

Ethiopia has described the Bishoftu airport project as the largest aviation infrastructure undertaking in Africa's history. Upon completion and full operation, the airport is expected to accommodate up to 110 million passengers annually and serve as Ethiopian Airlines' principal operating base.

"We expect that Addis Ababa and with the new airport to become more and more a central hub for the traffic in Africa," Da Costa said. "We expect that growth of trans-African traffic for the Ethiopian coverage will be increasing by about six times over the next 20 years."

Ethiopian Airlines became the first African operator of the Airbus A350 in 2016 and subsequently became the first African customer for the larger A350-1000, strengthening its position in the continent's long-haul aviation market.

Da Costa described Ethiopian Airlines as a historic African carrier and reaffirmed Airbus's commitment to supporting its expansion with modern, fuel-efficient aircraft suited to its growing operational needs.

"As we want to continue to grow with new aircraft, better aircraft, we're always open to hear from Ethiopian Airlines what their needs are," he said. "We will do our utmost to make sure that we can provide the best aircraft to serve the growing needs of the airline."

He noted that connecting passengers account for nearly two-thirds of Ethiopian Airlines' traffic, highlighting Addis Ababa's importance as a transfer point linking destinations across Africa with Europe, Asia, the Americas and other international markets.

"We're delighted that we have aircraft like the A350 that is capable of connecting Addis Ababa to effectively the whole world," Da Costa said. "By doing so, we believe that we're providing Ethiopian Airlines with the right tools to continue this strong growth."

He added that Airbus would continue working with Ethiopian Airlines to provide aircraft, technical support and operational solutions to help the carrier expand efficiently and sustainably as demand for air travel increases.

The projected growth would further strengthen Ethiopia's ambitions to consolidate its position as a major gateway for African aviation, while the planned airport infrastructure is expected to provide additional capacity to support the airline's long-term expansion.

title: Wary of instability, China calls for deeper security cooperation with Tajikistan
summary: BEIJING, Oct 19 (Reuters) - China's Premier Li Qiang called on Monday for deeper security and intelligence cooperation with Tajikistan to fight what Beijing ‌views as extremism and separatism, and said he hoped the country ‌would take "stro
content:
BEIJING, Oct 19 (Reuters) - China's Premier Li Qiang called on Monday for deeper security and intelligence cooperation with Tajikistan to fight what Beijing ‌views as extremism and separatism, and said he hoped the country ‌would take "strong measures" to protect Chinese citizens.

China has long feared violence in Central Asia could spill ​over into its far western region of Xinjiang, home to the mostly Muslim Uyghur people. China says Uyghur militants were behind a string of past attacks in Xinjiang.

Li told Tajik President Emomali Rahmon that the two countries should deepen cooperation on ‌law enforcement and security, and ⁠strengthen intelligence exchanges and sharing, China's official Xinhua news agency said.

China and Tajikistan should jointly fight the "three evil forces" — a ⁠term Beijing uses to describe terrorism, separatism, and extremism — and safeguard regional peace and stability, Li added.

Human rights groups say China has severely repressed the Uyghur people and ​curtailed their ​religious, cultural and linguistic rights. China denies ​any abuses have taken place.

Li ‌is not the only high-profile foreign official visiting resource-rich Central Asia this week, with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio travelling on Sunday to Uzbekistan. Li was in Uzbekistan before going to Tajikistan.

China, which has a remote, mountainous border with Tajikistan, is a major investor in the country.

Late last year, five Chinese nationals ‌were killed in Tajikistan in attacks the ​authorities said were launched from neighbouring Afghanistan.

Tajikistan, a ​former Soviet republic of around 11 ​million people with a secular government, has tense relations with ‌the Taliban authorities in Afghanistan. It ​has previously warned of ​drug smugglers and illicit gold miners working along the frontier.

Tajikistan endured a brutal civil war in the 1990s after the Soviet Union broke apart, ​during which Rahmon initially ‌rose to power. The country is closely aligned with Russia, which ​maintains a military base there.

(Reporting by Liz Lee and Beijing newsroom; ​Editing by Christopher Cushing and Kate Mayberry)

title: Taiwan shares end lower but fall limited as tech stocks rally late - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台湾股市收低，但跌幅有限，因科技股尾盘上涨 - 焦点台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月19日电 分析师表示，台湾股市周一收盘走低，但由于投资者后期买入包括代工芯片制造商台积电(TSMC)在内的主要科技股，跌幅有限。台湾证券交易所基准指数在46,170.00至46,844.64之间波动后，下跌289.18点，至46,822.08点，跌幅为0.61%。营业额总计新台币 8,251 亿元（254.3 亿美元）。受芯片股拖累，指数早盘暴跌逾940点，费城半导体指数跌3.83
content:
中新社台北10月19日电 分析师表示，台湾股市周一收盘走低，但由于投资者后期买入包括代工芯片制造商台积电(TSMC)在内的主要科技股，跌幅有限。

台湾证券交易所基准指数在46,170.00至46,844.64之间波动后，下跌289.18点，至46,822.08点，跌幅为0.61%。营业额总计新台币 8,251 亿元（254.3 亿美元）。

交易商表示，受芯片股拖累，周五费城半导体指数下跌3.83%后，该指数早盘暴跌逾940点。

协和证券分析师 Kerry Huang 表示：“幸运的是，随着台交所逼近 46,089 点的 60 日移动平均线，逢低买盘变得活跃。”

“随着投资者看到首尔市场反弹，存储芯片制造商三星电子公司和 SK 海力士公司从早先的损失中恢复过来，买盘有所回升。”

电子板块收复部分早前跌幅后仅下跌0.41%，占大盘总市值40%以上的台积电收盘持平，报2,420.00新台币。

“从台积电的反弹来看，我怀疑政府支持的资金站在了买方的一边。买入台积电是推高台交所最有效的方式，”黄说。
一些存储芯片制造商也从盘中低点回升，但南亚科技下跌 2.57%，收于新台币 436.00 元；华邦电子下跌 3.72%，收于新台币 155.50 元。

智能手机芯片设计商联发科股价下跌1.06%，收于新台币4,205.00元，而台积电的专用集成电路(ASIC)设计子公司环球芯芯公司(Global Unichip Corp.)则逆势上涨4.68%，收于新台币7,830.00元。

电子行业其他方面，iPhone组装商和人工智能服务器制造商鸿海精密工业股份有限公司(Hon Hai Precision Industry Co.)下跌1.84%，收于新台币239.50元，而电源管理解决方案提供商台达电子股份有限公司(Delta Electronics Inc.)上涨0.31%，收于新台币1,640.00元。

尽管非科技行业基本上仍然低迷，但由于对印刷电路板材料的强劲需求，某些玻璃纤维布制造商吸引了购买兴趣。

富达玻璃纤维公司上涨10%，收于新台币154.00元；而在场外交易市场上市的宝泰工业材料有限公司则上涨4.84%，收于新台币97.50元。

其他方面，台塑跌4.75%，收于新台币78.20元；南亚塑胶跌1.14%，收于新台币303.50元。

金融板块，富邦金控跌1.86%，收于新台币158.50元；国泰金控跌1.29%，收于新台币114.50元。
“Taiex 的表现将取决于美国市场，”黄说。 “值得关注的一件事是美国国债收益率是否稳定，因为它们是人工智能公司融资成本的关键因素。”

据台湾证券交易所称，周一市场上外国机构投资者净卖出新台币 767.4 亿美元的股票。

（弗朗西斯·黄）

尾项/ls

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) Shares in Taiwan closed lower on Monday, but their losses were limited after investors stepped in late to buy major technology stocks, including contract chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), analysts said.

The Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, ended down 289.18 points, or 0.61 percent, at 46,822.08 after moving between 46,170.00 and 46,844.64. Turnover totaled NT$825.10 billion (US$25.43 billion).

The index plunged more than 940 points in early trading, dragged down by chip stocks, after the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 3.83 percent on Friday, dealers said.

"Fortunately, as the Taiex approached its 60-day moving average of 46,089 points, bargain hunters became active," Concord Securities analyst Kerry Huang said.

"Buying picked up as investors here saw the Seoul market rebound, with memory chipmakers Samsung Electronics Co. and SK Hynix Inc. recovering from their earlier losses."

In the electronics sector, which fell just 0.41 percent after recovering some of its earlier losses, TSMC, which accounts for more than 40 percent of the market's total capitalization, ended unchanged at NT$2,420.00.

"Judging from TSMC's rebound, I suspect government-backed funds stood on the buy side. Buying TSMC is the most effective way to push up the Taiex," Huang said.

Some memory chipmakers also recovered from their intraday lows, although Nanya Technology Corp. fell 2.57 percent to close at NT$436.00 and Winbond Electronics Corp. lost 3.72 percent to end at NT$155.50.

Smartphone chip designer MediaTek Inc. shed 1.06 percent to close at NT$4,205.00, while Global Unichip Corp., TSMC's application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) design subsidiary, bucked the broader downturn, rising 4.68 percent to NT$7,830.00.

Elsewhere in the electronics sector, Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., an iPhone assembler and AI server maker, fell 1.84 percent to close at NT$239.50, while power-management solutions provider Delta Electronics Inc. gained 0.31 percent to end at NT$1,640.00.

While non-technology industries largely remained sluggish, selected glass fiber cloth makers attracted buying interest amid strong demand for materials used in printed circuit boards.

Fulltech Fiber Glass Corp. surged 10 percent to close at NT$154.00, while Baotek Industrial Materials Ltd., listed on the over-the-counter market, ended up 4.84 percent at NT$97.50.

Elsewhere, Formosa Plastics Corp. fell 4.75 percent to close at NT$78.20, while Nan Ya Plastics Corp. lost 1.14 percent to end at NT$303.50.

In the financial sector, Fubon Financial Holding Co. dropped 1.86 percent to close at NT$158.50, and Cathay Financial Holding Co. declined 1.29 percent to end at NT$114.50.

"How the Taiex performs will hinge on the U.S. markets," Huang said. "One thing worth watching is whether U.S. Treasury yields stabilize, as they are a critical factor in AI companies' fundraising costs."

According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange, foreign institutional investors were net sellers of NT$76.74 billion in shares on the market Monday.

(By Frances Huang)

content: 来源: 微评社   2026-10-18 不能因为爱国、爱华为、爱新能源汽车，就不能指出他们的一丝丝儿瑕疵。 新能源汽车产业对中国而言，当然重要。这话说多少遍都不为过。它扛着国运，扛着就业，扛着未来，扛着一整条产业链上无数人的饭碗和房贷。谁要是在今天唱衰新能源，简直像在饭桌上说“其实外卖不如自己做饭”一样不合时宜——虽然你可能没说错，但大家会默契地换个话题。 可产业的根基是信任。信任这个东西很怪，建立起来像攒首付，崩塌起来像P2P。而信任的根基，说到底就一个字：安全。 一辆让人不敢踩刹车的车，不管它有多少块屏幕、多少颗激光雷达、多少种智能场景，都不过是一台会移动的棺材。这话不好听，但棺材本来就不是用来好听的。 一、先别聊“第三空间”，先聊聊刹车 小鹏车主何先生在高速上踩刹车，踩下去“非常硬”，猛踩，中间有几秒完全不降速。车上坐着一个孕妇和一个一岁半的孩子。他后来对记者说“当时非常害怕，现在回想起来也是心有余悸”。心有余悸这个词用得很克制。换作任何一个开过车的人，在那一刻脑子里闪过的都不会是“智能座舱体验如何”，而是“我能不能活着把车停下来”。 奔驰CLA新能源的一位车主遭遇更整齐：主动制动辅助系统完全没触发，制动踏板踩下去没有明显阻力，方向盘同时变得异常沉重、完全无法转动。刹车、转向、防撞，三样东西在同一秒集体请假。你很难不佩服这种默契，像三个约好了一起翘课的室友，只是后果由车上两位老人用肋骨来承担。 还有一辆纯电动牵引车，司机正常踩刹车，线控制动信号丢失，车辆失控冲坡，司机死亡，整车报废。交警封存了EDR和监控，证实司机操作无过错。一个操作无过错的司机，死在一辆“信号丢失”的车里。你甚至不知道该怪谁——信号没有家属，信号也不出席追悼会。 刹车的本质是什么？是一个人在最后一刻把命交给一辆车时，那辆车必须无条件接住。这不是OTA能补的，这是物理。 物理不跟你讲版本迭代。 二、门把手玩隐身，逃生玩成密室逃脱 隐藏式门把手刚出来的时候，宣传话术大概是“降低风阻、提升续航、极简美学”。听着都对。问题是，中保研实测过，配电子门把手的车侧面碰撞后车门弹出成功率只有67%，机械门把手是98%。三十一个百分点，放在概率论里是一串数字，放在事故里就是有人在车里出不来。 有车型碰撞起火后，后排乘客没能自行打开车门逃生，因为车上没有常规可见、易操作的机械解锁结构，仅有的应急方式隐蔽且复杂，碰撞断电后按钮直接失效。你把门把手藏起来追求“无断点”的侧面视觉，结果碰撞之后车体真成了“焊死的牢笼”。牢笼这个词是评论者用的，但坐在后排那个没能出来的人，大概不会觉得这是修辞。 一辆车最基础的安全承诺，是出事之后你能出来，别人能进去救你。这个承诺不需要激光雷达，不需要Orin芯片，不需要任何一行代码。它需要一根你能摸到的机械拉杆。就这。 三、电池说“不起火”，火说“我按自己的时间表” 东风奕派eπ007碰撞之后，五十秒，冒烟，起火。那款车搭载的电池此前被宣传为“不起火、不爆炸”，具备极致安全防护能力。宣传和现实之间的距离，有时候就是五十秒。 极氪因为同一家供应商的电池热失控隐患，召回了三万八千多辆001 WE版。小米SU7在营口充电后驶出不远起火，视频里火花爆炸的场面被网友形容为“炸出烟花”。烟花是过年看的，不是开车看的。 这里有一个微妙的行业默契：热失控不叫热失控，叫“热事件”；起火不叫起火，叫“冒烟”；烧了不叫烧了，叫“极端工况下的非预期现象”。 文字被调教得很懂事，但火不认字。 四、屏幕越大，越像给棺材装彩电 屏幕确实越来越大，语音确实越来越灵，智驾确实越来越会“宣传”。L2被包装成“无限接近L3”，续航标注和低温实测之间能差出一半，智驾相关投诉一年涨了300%。 有的车在夜间高速上因为语音识别错误把大灯关了，撞上护栏。有的车企把事故后用来补漏洞的OTA补丁，包装成“快速响应”，仿佛底层安全逻辑的缺失可以被一次远程升级轻轻抹掉。还有一个月超过一万两千件投诉指向OTA“锁电”，同比涨了273%，车主睡一觉醒来，续航少了一截。你的车在你睡觉的时候被远程优化了，优化掉的恰好是你花钱买的那部分。 这不叫智能，这叫注意力转移术。当一家车企把发布会上百分之八十的时间用来讲屏幕、讲语音、讲场景、讲“第三空间”，剩下百分之二十用一句“安全是最大的豪华”带过的时候，你大概可以猜到底盘下面那部分，他们有多不想让你细看。 五、智能可以迭代，物理规律不接受OTA 新华网有一句评论说得很客气，也很准确：“屏幕再大，语音再灵，没有安全都是零。”零这个数字很有意思。它不否定前面那些东西的存在，它只是让它们全部失效。 让人不敢踩刹车的车，无论多少智能场景，都是一台会移动的棺材。这句话不是在骂新能源，恰恰是因为太希望它好，才不愿意看它把顺序搞反。智能是长在安全上面的花，安全是土。土没了，花开得再艳，也是插在花瓶里，摆在展厅里好看，上路就散了。 六、监管开始夯土，花插在花瓶里没有生命力 好消息是，监管开始动手了。电池新国标把热扩散要求从“着火爆炸前五分钟报警”改成了“不起火、不爆炸”，隐藏式门把手被明确禁止，实体操纵件被要求回归。这相当于在说：花活可以继续玩，但先把土夯实。 一辆车最极致的智能，其实是一个朴素到不好意思拿出来开发布会的能力： 你踩下刹车，它停。你松开安全带，门能开。你撞了，它不起火。 做到这三件事，再谈别的。做不到，屏幕再多，也不过是把棺材装修得更智能了一点。

content:
去年10月19日，多名窃贼伪装成工人，以工业用圆盘切割机破坏入侵博物馆，带走8件无价珍宝，估计价值达1亿美元。

失窃品包括拿破仑三世（Napoleon III）的皇后欧珍妮（Eugenie）的一枚胸针与一顶皇冠。法国总统马克宏当时形容这起窃案是对法国历史的攻击。

多名执法人员与民间艺术品失窃追查机构的专家向法新社表示，若窃贼是单独犯案，并将赃物藏在巴黎地区某处，寻回珍宝的机会最大。

民间机构「艺术品追回国际」（Art Recovery International）的马里内洛（Christopher Marinello）告诉法新社：「他们有一小段时间，可能把珠宝藏在墙里或埋了起来。」

4名嫌犯都在案发后10天内落网。

这批闪耀的19世纪珠宝最后一次现身，是在巴黎北部治安不佳的奥贝维利耶（Aubervilliers）郊区一处地下仓库的监视器画面中，所有犯嫌都住在这一带。

由逾百人组成的专案小组已大规模搜索犯嫌及其家人的住所、地窖、车库和阁楼，但一无所获。

荷兰知名民间艺术品侦探布兰德（Arthur Brand）说，如果珠宝被藏匿起来，或交给「销赃者」保管，仍有可能出现转机，也就是某名犯嫌为换取较轻的刑期而认罪。

他告诉法新社：「法国警方非常专业，懂得怎么讯问，也知道如何施压。你只需要有一个人开口，而在许多案件中，确实会有人开口。」

更令人担忧的情况是，这个犯罪团伙是听命于某名主谋或中间人，且对方与组织犯罪有关联，他们在完成这场破坏抢劫后，就把珠宝交给对方。

国际刑警组织（Interpol）失窃艺术品小组负责人卡特西（Corrado Catesi）说：「组织犯罪的威力，不只在于能提供犯案经验，还有人手可以接手赃物并出售。」

在押期间，其中2名犯嫌声称团队中有一名主谋，但一名接近案情的消息人士近日向法新社透露，调查人员对这项说法持怀疑态度。

最糟的情况是，珠宝已被运出法国，或交给当地从事宝石黑市的联络人。

布兰德指出：「这批珠宝以钻石为主，所以必须拆解、重新切磨再出售。如要选一个地方，会是安特卫普。」他所指的是比利时的钻石交易中心。

马里内洛则认为，特拉维夫和印度也可能是赃物的去向。

欧洲最大的线上钻石珠宝商「77 Diamonds」总经理科明德（Tobias Kormind）告诉法新社，钻石「一旦重新切磨，要重回合法供应链，由批发商或零售商购入，相当容易」。

他说：「除非钻石内部有极为独特的内含物，否则即使是美国宝石学院（GIA）这类顶尖钻石实验室，也很难指认一颗刚抛光的钻石是赃物。」

不过，即使珠宝落入组织犯罪集团手中，似乎仍有一线希望。

布兰德提到几起失窃珠宝最终寻回的案例，其中最着名的是2022年荷兰欧洲艺术博览会（TEFAF）遭抢案，以及2019年德国德勒斯登绿穹珍宝馆（Gruenes Gewoelbe）窃案。

他解释：「虽然我们多半认为，遭窃的金、银和钻石大多再也找不回来，但有些案例确实追回了。」

「我们仍有机会再见到罗浮宫的珠宝，也可能在开庭前就有人松口。」

这批珠宝目前仍列在国际刑警组织的失窃艺术品资料库中。

卡特西告诉法新社，分析全球各地的调查案例发现，失窃物品「可能要3个月到40年才能寻回」。

title: 三宗在台跨境鎮壓案均涉港人 前區議員推測具官方背景的「同一個大老闆」出手

content: 追光者報道 冷戰時期，香港曾是國際諜報交鋒的「竹幕」前緣，其後經濟發展轉型為國際金融中心。然而，隨着近年中國擴大全球影響力及《國安法》實施，香港再次成為諜報基地，但角色卻由以往的間諜「輸入地」成為「輸出地」。如今年初的倫敦經貿辦間諜案、最近台北市長參選人沈伯洋被監控案，均見「香港人」身影。有曾做過私家偵探的前區議員指，涉案人士及公司與香港警察關係匪淺，質疑有官方在背後指揮；亦有評論指，中共故意委派港人從事跨境鎮壓，正是打擊港人的國際形象及民間交流。而「受害人」之一「赴湯」亦慨嘆，政權造成的傷害，「快過我哋去修補嘅速度」。 台灣將於下月底進行各地市長、市議員等的「九合一」地方選舉，專長研究中國認知作戰的學者沈伯洋，以民進黨立委身分參選台北市長。台北地檢署於上周三（7日）偵破一宗於2024年針對他的跟蹤監控案件，4名台灣私家偵探社被起訴。但令人震驚是，出錢的主謀卻是兩名在逃的香港人，其中一人鞠覺賢被更揭發是退休警員，是繼倫敦經貿辦案後再有退休警員涉及跨境鎮壓案件，兩人目前亦被台灣當局通緝。連同早前拳館兩遭淋紅油的湯偉雄（赴湯），以及今年7月矢板明夫遇襲案，累計已經是第3宗有港人參與的在台跨境鎮壓案。 李文浩：沈案偵探社老闆「一直都咁藍」  揭2023年起大量退休警周遊列國 前區議員李文浩曾經是私家偵探，他向《追光者》透露，鞠覺賢是本地一間名為「迅捷國際調查」的偵探社老闆，除了他本人是退休警員外，「迅捷」亦標榜自己成員來自保護證人組（G4）、有組織罪案及三合會調查科（O記）等。李文浩分析，鞠覺賢在案中固然是「收錢做嘢」，但更明顯是有任務在身：「佢哋上心到自己飛過嚟台灣去做呢件事（親自指揮），然後畀台灣徵信社（偵探社）嘅款項一嚟就係十萬蚊港幣，你就可以知道佢哋本身收嘅肯定係倍數於呢個價錢，所以我可以肯定到嘅，就係佢哋後面係有一個龐大嘅金主、一個能夠操控到不同板塊嘅金主。」 他推測，赴湯、矢板明夫、沈伯洋案也是「同一個大老闆」出手，目的是打擊在台不同界別的「反共」人士，而「大老闆」選擇動用黑道網絡來威嚇赴湯及矢板。李文浩又指，「大老闆」很大機會是與警方甚至「官方」有關的人物，因此向同樣具有濃厚警察背景的「迅捷」，委託監控台灣立法委員的重任，「佢哋最鍾意益自己人」。 李文浩同時透露，自2023年起就有大批前警員頻繁外遊，而且不約而同地都是前往港人聚居城市。翻查資料，港府於同年撥出第二筆共50億元公帑作國安用途。同時，倫敦經貿辦案的最早作案時間點，亦是2023年12月。李文浩相信，這並非單純「巧合」。 有人認為跨境鎮壓的作案者都是「收錢做嘢」，但李文浩則分析，襲擊矢板的黑幫人士，當然「睇錢份上」；但反觀沈伯洋案，以及經貿辦案中多名前警員，李文浩認為他們在錢以外，本身就有濃厚的親中和親共意識，因此才會甘願冒險親赴他國參與犯案。他又憶述，數年前自己曾與鞠覺賢同場，在互不認識情況下，對方滔滔不絕批評當時香港青年的社會運動參與和主張都是「搞搞震」，如今沈伯洋案發生，更證明對方「一直都咁藍」。 赴湯：接連跨境鎮壓令海外港人處境「難捱」 曾有可疑人士建議合辦爭議活動 赴湯在台拳館去年遭淋紅油恐嚇，是首宗有港人行兇的跨境鎮壓案件，他的拳館在今年2月再被另一批港人被淋紅油，最終遷離該址。然而不足一年，矢板案和沈伯洋案又被揭發有港人涉案，赴湯自言這段時間對在台，或海外港人而言都是「難捱」。他向本台分享，最近看到一個無人機比賽，賽例上竟有一條是明文禁止中港澳人士參與，慨嘆「因為港府的行為而令海外港人受到標籤」。 他在台灣不時發起關注香港或其他受中國壓迫群體的行動，並在活動場合中強調香港人仍然堅持追求民主自由，但亦承認在跨境鎮壓事件頻生下，他們的倡議漸見吃力：「我們就算點做都唔夠佢哋人多勢眾，可能我哋只係做一件好事，人哋已經做咗九件壞事，佢哋（港府）輸出罪犯嘅速度係快過我哋去修補嘅速度。」 赴湯亦指出，中國或香港的跨境鎮壓手段不單是透過派人執行任務外，他過去亦曾遇到有不明來歷的人士主動聯繫，甚至表示願意給予一筆資金，希望他舉辦一些有可能爭議話題的活動，他呼籲在台港人亦應留意相關情況，但無須過分「捉鬼」，但要注意不要向他人透露過多個人私隱。 桑普：港人作案易「斷尾求生」  令各國重新審視香港人身分 台灣香港協會理事長桑普分析，三宗案件均聘港人作案，反映出中共改變了跨境鎮壓方式，不再依靠在地協力者代勞。這種方式的最大優勢，就是他們在犯案後可以迅速離境，「斷尾求生」，令當地政府無法追緝真正的幕後黑手。李文浩亦同意有關判斷，他指香港比中國擁有更多免簽國家，這些帶任務者更容易偽裝一般旅客出入多國，當地政府亦難以分辨堵截。 桑普又認為，中共利用港人參與跨境鎮壓，或會打擊香港的國際形象以及對外民間交流聯繫，令外界感到香港與中國無異。他提到這種手法令到台灣或歐美政界，在修例保障自身國家安全時都會重新審視「香港人」身分，甚至影響在當地居住港人權益。 李文浩直言，中港政府的跨境鎮壓行為是「累街坊，累哂全香港人承受呢個代價」，憂慮相關行動一旦持續，不但強化香港是「跨國鎮壓基地」的形象，更可能對香港護照逐漸產生敵對心態，影響一般市民的出入境自由。 呼籲海外港人融入當地社會 表達守護民主決心  台灣陸委會兩度為受害人發聲 作為夾縫中的香港人，桑普呼籲身在海外的港人除了要繼續為發聲，亦應主動融入當地社會，與當地人共同守護民主自由；他以伊朗為例，儘管國際社會認定伊朗是獨裁國家，但流亡美國的伊朗社群卻十分主動融入當地社會，同時進行倡議，並因而獲得美國社會歡迎。 不過赴湯認為單靠海外社群努力效果有限，民主國家亦應在政策層面主動區分和堵截有可疑人士入境，甚至提高對跨境鎮壓罪行的刑罰。他認為這樣不單是保障本地人，同時亦是讓受打壓的離散社群可以「放心地行使自己嘅權力同倡議」。 陸委會回覆本台指，台灣法例在應對跨境鎮壓方面確有不足之處，現階段已經就「有安全疑慮的港澳人士」，在入境上加強管制；政府亦正計劃修例提高有關跨境鎮壓行動的罰則，期望未來立法工作能夠獲得朝野政黨支持。在沈伯洋案偵破後，陸委會亦即時呼籲社會不能讓受害者孤單，不要以「幻想」來遮掩跨境鎮壓的事實，助長對方氣焰；上周四（8日）更發布一段，主委邱垂正親自拜訪赴湯的影片，呼籲台灣民眾守住得來不易的自由與民主。 本台亦就近期台灣多宗跨境鎮壓案、經貿辦案涉及港人，甚至有公務員、退休警員背景犯案一事致函港府，詢問當局會否應台灣的通緝令移交逃犯。港府今（16日）傍晚回覆時表示，「強烈譴責任何人以毫無事實根據的言論污衊抹黑特區政府」，並強調港府「絕無牽涉提問中的境外治安事故」，並堅決反對所有針對港府的不實言論。
