content:
新的卫星图像显示，四架中国新型 KJ-3000 机载预警与控制 (AEW&C) 飞机停泊在西安飞机公司 (XAC) 位于西安-阎良的工厂，这增加了大型雷达飞机正在走向或已经进入批量生产的可能性。 Vantor 提供的 10 月 5 日拍摄的卫星图像显示，西飞工厂西部的工厂附近有三架 KJ-3000，第四架位于附近的中国飞行试验中心 (CFTE)。米切尔航空航天研究所高级研究员 J. Michael Dahm 评估说，四架飞机的存在表明该型号已进入批量生产。 10 月 5 日，西飞公司 (XAC) 工厂概览。总共可见四架 KJ-3000。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 位于工厂西部的 XAC 工厂内有三架 KJ-3000 和其他 Y-20。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor Andreas Rupprecht 中国军事航空分析师和 TWZ 撰稿人提供了更为谨慎的评估，指出该图像可能表明批量生产或低速初始生产 (LRIP) 已经开始。然而，他还指出，之前确定的所有四个原型可能只是同时出现在该设施中。具体来说，他将机场 CFTE 部分看到的飞机确定为原型机。西飞工厂其中一台 KJ-3000 的近距离观察。
卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 另一架 KJ-3000 与一对 Y-20B 并存。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 无论解释如何，该图像都以全新的视角展示了一项计划，该计划旨在大幅扩展中国本已庞大的空中监视和战斗管理能力。 KJ-3000，也称为KJ-20，是基于四引擎Y-20运输机，特别是由中国制造的发动机提供动力的改进型Y-20B改型。该飞机的后机身上方安装了一个大型圆形天线罩，前机身上还安装了一系列突出的天线。空中加油探头安装在驾驶舱上方，而尾翼底部的显眼进气口可能旨在为其广泛的机载电子设备提供冷却空气。一辆库存 Y-20B 运输机，配备独特的本地生产的 WS-20 涡轮风扇发动机。来自中国互联网的第一批飞机的低质量照片于 2024 年 12 月开始流传。2025 年 5 月出现了更详细的图像，展示了一个未公开的中国机场的例子。这架序列号为 7821 的飞机被评估为第一架飞机，仍然涂有底漆，与现在在西飞工厂看到的飞机形成鲜明对比。这张照片出现于 2025 年 5 月，显示了疑似第一架 KJ-3000 停放在中国一个秘密机场的地面上。该机仍涂有一层底漆，前机身上的序列号7821清晰可见。
通过中国互联网 KJ-3000 预计将解决中国现有大型喷气式预警机队长期存在的局限性。迄今为止，仅完成了四架 KJ-2000 Mainring 飞机。基于俄罗斯制造的伊尔-76MD运输机的KJ-2000计划受到合适机身有限的限制，现在面临着依赖俄罗斯供应链和老化飞机的双重问题。标准 PLAAF KJ-2000 的侧视图，尽管照片中的序列号已被删除。 FYJS/来自中国互联网 A do

【原文 English Original】
New satellite imagery shows four of China’s new KJ-3000 airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) aircraft at the Xi’an Aircraft Company (XAC) facility at Xi’an-Yanliang , raising the possibility that the large radar planes are moving toward or have entered serial production. Satellite imagery captured on October 5 and provided by Vantor shows three KJ-3000s near the XAC factory in the western part of the facility, with a fourth at the nearby China Flight Test Establishment (CFTE). J. Michael Dahm, a senior fellow at the Mitchell Institute for Aerospace Studies, assesses that the presence of four aircraft points to the type having entered serial production. An overview of the Xi’an Aircraft Company (XAC) facility on October 5. A total of four KJ-3000s are visible. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor Three KJ-3000s along with other Y-20s at the XAC factory in the western part of the facility. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor Andreas Rupprecht , an analyst of Chinese military aviation and TWZ contributor, offered a more cautious assessment, noting that the imagery could indicate that series production or low-rate initial production (LRIP) has begun. However, he also pointed out that all four previously identified prototypes could simply have been at the facility at the same time. Specifically, he identified the aircraft seen at the CFTE portion of the airfield as being a prototype. A closer view of one of the KJ-3000s at the XAC factory. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor An additional KJ-3000 seen alongside a pair of Y-20Bs. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor Whatever the explanation, the imagery offers a fresh look at a program set to significantly expand China’s already substantial airborne surveillance and battle-management capabilities. The KJ-3000, also referred to as the KJ-20, is based on the four-engine Y-20 transport aircraft , specifically the improved Y-20B variant powered by Chinese-made engines. The aircraft features a large circular radome mounted above the rear fuselage, along with a prominent series of antennas on the forward fuselage. An aerial refueling probe is mounted above the cockpit, while a conspicuous intake at the base of the tailfin is likely intended to provide cooling air for its extensive onboard electronics. A stock Y-20B transport with its distinctive locally produced WS-20 turbofan engines. via Chinese internet The first low-quality photographs of the aircraft began circulating in December 2024. More detailed imagery emerged in May 2025, showing an example at an undisclosed Chinese airfield. That aircraft, bearing the serial number 7821 and assessed to be the first example, was still wearing primer, in contrast to the examples now seen at the XAC factory. This photo emerged in May 2025 and shows the presumed first KJ-3000 on the ground at an undisclosed airfield in China. The aircraft still wears a coat of primer, and the serial number 7821 is clearly visible on the forward fuselage. via Chinese internet The KJ-3000 is expected to address longstanding limitations in China’s existing large jet-powered AEW&C fleet. To date, only four KJ-2000 Mainring aircraft have been completed. Based on the Russian-built Ilyushin Il-76MD transport, the KJ-2000 program was constrained by the limited availability of suitable airframes, and now faces the twin issues of reliance on Russian supply chains and aging aircraft. A side view of a standard PLAAF KJ-2000, albeit with the serial number censored from the photo. FYJS/via Chinese internet A domestically produced Y-20-based platform provides a more sustainable basis for a much larger AEW&C fleet, with greater scope for upgrades and potentially export opportunities. The larger airframe should also provide advantages over China’s numerous turboprop-powered AEW&C aircraft, including greater speed, range, and endurance. Its higher operating altitude would give its radar a better vantage point for detecting and tracking targets, particularly low-flying aircraft and missiles that may be masked from ground-based sensors by terrain or the radar horizon. The aerial refueling probe could further extend the aircraft’s range and time on station, although the precise operational capabilities of the KJ-3000 remain unclear. The exact configuration of the KJ-3000’s primary radar has yet to be established. China’s existing KJ-2000 and smaller KJ-500 use fixed radomes containing three active electronically scanned array (AESA) antennas to provide 360-degree coverage, rather than the rotating radomes found on aircraft such as the U.S. E-3 Sentry and Russia’s A-50 Mainstay . Whether the new aircraft follows the same approach remains to be seen. A Russian Aerospace Forces A-50U Mainstay. Russian Ministry of Defense Russian Air Force A-50U Mainstay. (Russian MoD) As well as its large AESA radar, the new aircraft is likely to carry additional intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) systems, while its communications equipment could make it an important networking node for Chinese forces operating across the vast distances of the Indo-Pacific. Such capabilities would be particularly valuable for coordinating combat aircraft, including uncrewed ones , sharing targeting information, and extending the reach of China’s integrated air defense and broader military networks. The KJ-3000 is also part of a broader expansion and diversification of China’s AEW&C fleet. Alongside the new jet-powered aircraft, the People’s Liberation Army continues to field and develop smaller platforms based on the four-turboprop Y-9 transport family . These include the KJ-500 , which has been produced and delivered at a rapid pace, as well as the newer KJ-700, believed to combine radar with electro-optical and infrared sensors for a broader range of surveillance missions. The precise capabilities of the KJ-700 remain uncertain, but you can read about the platform in more detail here . A prototype KJ-700. via Chinese internet The smaller turboprop aircraft offer advantages of their own. They are better suited to operating from dispersed and relatively austere airfields, and they regularly appear at Chinese island outposts and in the strategically important Taiwan Strait . Together, the different types give Chinese forces a range of options for surveillance and command and control, from persistent coverage close to home to operations farther afield. The U.S. Department of Defense has repeatedly highlighted the growing importance of China’s AEW&C fleet. In its latest annual report on Chinese military developments, the Pentagon specifically pointed to the KJ-3000: “The PLA conducted an initial flight with the KJ-3000 Airborne Early Warning and Control (AEW&C) aircraft, which will serve as a surveillance aircraft to monitor aircraft, ships, and other vehicles. The KJ-3000 will probably be the world’s first model to use digital radar and will be capable of anti-jamming, passive detection, and target identification.” Airborne radar and command-and-control aircraft are also important force multipliers for increasingly capable Chinese combat jets , including the stealthy J-20 and aircraft armed with long-range air-to-air missiles . Radar planes like these can serve as critical networking nodes for data sharing and, in some cases, allow Chinese fighters to prosecute targets without turning on their own radar. In 2022, then-Pacific Air Forces commander Gen. Kenneth Wilsbach praised the command and control associated with J-20 operations, noting that some of China’s long-range air-to-air missiles benefit from support provided by the KJ-500. A stock photo of a J-20 stealth fighter. PLAAF For China, a larger and more capable AEW&C fleet would support both the defense of its airspace and efforts to project military power across the Indo-Pacific. These aircraft could help coordinate operations around Taiwan and the South China Sea , improve situational awareness over maritime approaches, and support combat operations at greater distances from the mainland. The same Pentagon report from 2025 further noted: “China’s integration of support aircraft, such as the KJ-500 airborne early warning aircraft, provides the PLAAF with improved ISR capability to support PLA operations, as demonstrated during surge operations near Taiwan.” A KJ-500 arrives at the Zhuhai Air Show Center in November 2022 in Zhuhai, Guangdong Province of China. This is specifically the probe-equipped KJ-500A version. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images VCG A domestically developed, jet-powered platform such as the KJ-3000 would be a logical centerpiece of that effort, particularly since it can be produced in substantially greater numbers than the KJ-2000. The prospect of China expanding its fleet of large, jet-powered AEW&C aircraft stands in contrast to the U.S. Air Force’s troubled effort to replace its aging E-3 Sentry . The U.S. E-7 Wedgetail program has encountered major hurdles , raising concerns about a potential gap in airborne battle management as China continues to field new capabilities. The October 5 imagery does not confirm that serial production has begun. Further imagery showing additional airframes, activity around production facilities, or aircraft in new operational markings may provide a clearer indication of the program’s progress. Regardless, the KJ-3000 appears poised to become an important addition to China’s expanding airborne surveillance and command-and-control architecture. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post Four KJ-3000 Radar Jets At Chinese Factory Point To Serial Production appeared first on TWZ .

title: Record 170 Projects Compete in 2026 ‘Maker China’ Hong Kong Finals
zh_title: 创纪录的170个项目角逐2026“创客中国”香港总决赛
summary: 香港 2026年“创客中国”国际中小企业创新创业大赛香港站吸引了创纪录的170个本地项目。数字政策署署长张依依表示，此次活动有利于初创企业和中小企业展示科技成果，拓展内地市场。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 22 日 19:23 HKT · 2 分钟阅读2026“创客中国”国际中小企业创新创业大赛
content:
香港
2026年“创客中国”国际中小企业创新创业大赛香港站吸引了创纪录的170个本地项目。数字政策署署长张依依表示，此次活动有利于初创企业和中小企业展示科技成果，拓展内地市场。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 22 日 19:23 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

2026年“创客中国”国际中小企业创新创业大赛香港站于10月22日圆满落幕，共吸引了创纪录的170个本地创新项目。署理数码政策专员张依依表示，大赛为香港初创企业和中小企业提供一个重要平台，展示其技术成果并拓展中国内地市场。

张表示，近年来，多个入围团队成功与内地企业对接，有的与内地政府签署合作协议，有的吸引了投资资金。他表示，这些成果有助于加快技术转化、提升品牌影响力、开拓内地和海外市场。
今年的比赛共有 170 个本地项目参赛，创该赛事历史之最。经过初赛和半决赛的评审，十个入围项目晋级今天举行的决赛。各团队向来自不同技术领域的评审团进行现场展示，角逐一、二、三等奖。主办方还安排了十支入围团队与粤港澳大湾区的投资者和企业代表进行一对一的会面，探讨潜在的融资和项目合作。

入围团队还将有机会参加初创企业孵化计划和展览，与内地投资者建立联系，并在内地创业园区落户，在专业指导下帮助项目商业化和拓展市场。

“创客中国”香港站已连续举办八届，得到广州市工业和信息化局、广州市人民政府港澳事务办公室、黄埔区工业和信息化局的支持。本届活动由香港特别行政区政府数码政策办公室、工业和信息化部中小企业发展促进中心、中国中小企业国际合作协会联合主办，香港数码港管理有限公司和天使投资基金会协办。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
The 2026 ‘Maker China’ international SME innovation and entrepreneurship competition Hong Kong leg attracted a record 170 local projects. Acting Commissioner for Digital Policy Zhang Yiyi said the event helps startups and SMEs showcase tech achievements and expand into the mainland market.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

22 Oct 2026 at 19:23 HKT · 2 min read

The 2026 ‘Maker China’ International SME Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition Hong Kong leg concluded successfully on 22 October, drawing a record 170 local innovation projects. Acting Commissioner for Digital Policy Zhang Yiyi said the competition provides a vital platform for Hong Kong startups and small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to showcase their technology成果 and expand into the mainland Chinese market.

Zhang noted that in recent years, several finalist teams have successfully connected with mainland enterprises, with some signing cooperation agreements with mainland governments and others attracting investment funds. These outcomes, he said, helped accelerate the commercialisation of technology, enhance brand influence, and open up both mainland and overseas markets.

This year’s competition saw 170 local projects participate, the highest number in the event’s history. After preliminary and semi-final judging, ten finalist projects advanced to the final round held today. Teams pitched live to a panel of judges from various tech fields, competing for first, second and third prizes. The organiser also arranged one-on-one meetings between the ten finalist teams and investors and business representatives from the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area for potential financing and project collaboration.

Finalist teams will also have opportunities to join startup incubation programmes and exhibitions, connect with mainland investors, and set up in mainland business parks, with professional guidance to help commercialise their projects and expand markets.

The Hong Kong leg of ‘Maker China’ has been held for eight consecutive years, supported by the Guangzhou Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology, the Guangzhou Municipal Government’s Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office, and the Huangpu District Bureau of Industry and Information Technology. This year’s event was jointly organised by the Hong Kong SAR Government’s Digital Policy Office, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology’s SME Development Promotion Centre, and the China SME International Cooperation Association, and co-hosted by Hong Kong Cyberport Management Limited and the Angel Investment Foundation.

title: US Army long-range fires make a splash on the frontline with China
zh_title: 美军远程火力在对华前线引起轰动
summary: 从菲律宾南部的巴拉巴克到日本北部的北海道，美国陆军士兵沿着第一岛链加强了新型远程武器的训练，并与盟国合作进行了过去五年规模更大、更复杂的演习。摆脱了冷战时代的限制，美国陆军一直在升级现有的导弹和火箭炮，并开发新的、射程更远的系统。这些投资主要是为了应对中国导弹武库规模不断扩大和复杂程度不断增长的情况，美国军方担心中国的导弹武库可能会阻碍其部队的发展
content:
从菲律宾南部的巴拉巴克到日本北部的北海道，美国陆军士兵沿着第一岛链加强了新型远程武器的训练，并与盟国合作进行了过去五年规模更大、更复杂的演习。摆脱了冷战时代的限制，美国陆军一直在升级现有的导弹和火箭炮，并开发新的、射程更远的系统。这些投资主要是为了应对中国导弹库规模不断扩大和复杂化的情况，美国军方担心中国导弹库可能会导致其部队在冲突期间无法进入西太平洋。与菲律宾和日本加强训练反映了对中国军事能力的共同担忧。对第一岛链远程火力的重视在涉及这些武器，特别是高机动火炮火箭系统的扩展部署和首次演习中可见一斑。 HIMARS可以使用射程为数十英里的制导火箭或射程为数百英里的弹道导弹执行对地攻击和海上打击任务。美国陆军 HIMARS 于 2021 年在北海道举行的一次演习中首次在日本开展行动，并于 2022 年在冲绳东北部一座岛屿举行的演习中首次部署到日本西南部岛屿（该岛将东海与更广阔的太平洋分开）。从那时起，HIMARS就成为了美国的一个共同特征。
与日本的演习中，最近一次是今年的“利剑”演习，陆军 HIMARS 被派往距台湾以东仅 150 英里的日本岛屿。陆军 HIMARS 在菲律宾有着较长的历史，但近年来，美国和菲律宾军队将其用于新的角色，例如反舰打击，并在该国的新地区使用。在 2024 年和 2025 年的演习中，HIMARS 部署到面向南中国海的巴拉望岛和面向台湾的吕宋岛北部海岸。今年的“肩并肩”演习是两国最大规模的年度演习，展示了两国通过陆地、海上和空中在全国各地部署 HIMARS 的能力：4 月，美国士兵和飞行员将一架 HIMARS 运送到菲律宾最北端的伊巴亚特市，距离台湾仅 100 英里，进行干火演习。几周后，一艘陆军船只将 HIMARS 发射器运送到巴拉望岛以南的巴拉巴克岛，首次进行实弹演习，陆军表示，这显示了其“保护进入苏禄海和西里伯斯海的航运”的能力。美国太平洋陆军司令罗纳德·克拉克将军表示，将部队调入和穿越第一岛链的能力体现了联盟的一体化，并向竞争对手发出了信息。 “这确实是一个共同的成功故事，”克拉克本月在华盛顿特区举行的美国陆军协会年度会议上说道。
克拉克指出，最近的一次演习中，士兵们在华盛顿州的一个基地将 HIMARS 发射器装载到飞机上，然后飞往菲律宾，所有这些都是对手可见的。“然后，我们将从朝鲜库存中抽出的弹药加入到菲律宾，我们的对手可以看到它，然后我们在 HIMARS 快速渗透行动的后端进行实弹射击，”克拉克补充道。 “能够做到这一点，首先需要大量的技能。其次，需要与盟友建立大量的伙伴关系来帮助我们。”克拉克表示，在日益复杂的演习中提高能力

【原文 English Original】
From Balabac in the southern Philippines to Hokkaido in northern Japan, U.S. Army soldiers have stepped up their training with new long-range weapons along the first island chain, working with allies in exercises that have grown larger and more complex over the past half-decade. Freed from Cold War-era constraints , the U.S. Army has been upgrading its existing missiles and rocket artillery and developing new, longer-range systems . Those investments are largely in response to the growing size and sophistication of China’s missile arsenal, which the U.S. military worries could deny its forces access to the Western Pacific during a conflict. The intensification of training with the Philippines and Japan reflects a shared concern about China’s military capabilities. The emphasis on long-range fires in the first island chain is visible in the extended deployments and first-of-their-kind drills involving those weapons, especially the High Mobility Artillery Rocket System . HIMARS can conduct land-attack and maritime-strike missions using guided rockets with ranges of a few dozen miles or ballistic missiles with ranges of a few hundred miles. U.S. Army HIMARS operated in Japan for the first time in 2021 during an exercise in Hokkaido and were first deployed to Japan’s Southwest Islands, which separate the East China Sea from the wider Pacific, in 2022 for an exercise on an island northeast of Okinawa. Since then, HIMARS has been a common feature of U.S. exercises with Japan, most recently this year’s Keen Sword, for which Army HIMARS were sent to a Japanese island that is only 150 miles east of Taiwan. The Army’s HIMARS has a longer history in the Philippines, but in recent years, U.S. and Filipino troops have employed it in new roles, such as anti-ship strikes, and in new parts of the country. Exercises in 2024 and 2025 saw HIMARS deployed to Palawan, facing the South China Sea, and to the northern coast of Luzon, facing Taiwan. This year’s edition of Balikatan, the two countries’ largest annual exercise, showed their ability to move HIMARS around the country by land, sea and air: In April, U.S. soldiers and airmen transported a HIMARS to Itbayat, the Philippines’ northernmost municipality and only 100 miles from Taiwan, for a dry-fire exercise. A few weeks later, an Army watercraft transported a HIMARS launcher to Balabac Island, south of Palawan, for the first time for a live-fire exercise, which showed its ability “to protect shipping going into the Sulu and Celebes Sea,” the Army said. The ability to move forces into and across the first island chain demonstrates alliance integration and sends a message to rivals, according to Gen. Ronald Clark, commander of U.S. Army Pacific. “It’s really a joint success story,” Clark said at the Association of the U.S. Army’s annual conference in Washington, D.C. this month. Clark pointed to a recent exercise for which soldiers loaded HIMARS launchers on aircraft at a base in Washington state and flew them to the Philippines, all of which was visible to adversaries. “We then join munitions from Korea that were drawn out of stocks there to the Philippines, where our adversary could see it, and then we conduct a live-fire on the backend of a HIMARS rapid-infiltration operation,” Clark added. “Being able to do that, it, one, takes a lot of skill. Second, it takes a tremendous amount of partnership with, in this case, allies to assist us.” Clark said improving capabilities in increasingly complex exercises affects adversaries’ thinking. “To be able to conduct operational maneuver and have tremendous tactical effects that then have a strategic effect on our adversary is exactly what we were looking to gain, because what that does is it gives them pause.” Over the past two years, the U.S. Army has introduced its Mid-Range Capability, a new ground-based missile system known as Typhon, to its training in the first island chain. Typhon can fire SM-6 missiles at air and maritime targets a few hundred miles away and Tomahawk missiles at land targets up to 1,000 miles away, bringing swathes of China and Russia into range from the Philippines and Japan. Typhon’s first overseas deployment was in 2024 in the Philippines. It has remained there since then, and in May this year, it was test-fired for the first time, striking a target in central Luzon from nearly 400 miles away. The Army sent a Typhon to Japan for the first time in August 2025 for an exercise the following month, but the weapon lingered until November that year. It returned to Japan this summer, deploying to the southernmost of Japan’s main islands for exercises in June and September and moving to a base on Okinawa for storage in October. U.S. officials told Tokyo the deployment isn’t meant to be permanent, but it has no official end date. The Typhon was sent to the Philippines at Manila’s request and “has maintained forward presence for now over 30 consecutive months,” Maj. Gen. Bernard Harrington said in a presentation at the AUSA conference. Harrington commands the recently established 7th Infantry Division/Multi-Domain Command-Pacific, which combines the 7th Infantry Division’s ground-maneuver elements with the long-range fires and non-kinetic effects of the 1st Multi-Domain Task Force. Typhon’s presence in the Philippines has allowed for extended in-theater training, giving soldiers more insight into issues like “How do we sustain in the environment? How do you protect those types of systems in the environment? How do you connect sensor to shooter?” Harrington said in his presentation. “To be able to do that persistently forward and persistently with our ally in the Philippines and our partners is incredibly important for us.” While the presence of HIMARS and Typhon in new places has been widely publicized, those deployments also create opportunities for U.S. troops to do less visible work to improve communications links and enhance their command-and-control networks , ensuring that friendly forces have a common operating picture of the battlefield and can use their weapons effectively in combat. China has watched these developments warily. Beijing regularly criticizes U.S. exercises with Japan and the Philippines as provocative and destabilizing, and it has singled out Typhon deployments for vitriol . But experts cited by Chinese state media also say China has an advantage against weapons like HIMARS when they are deployed on islands near Taiwan because the islands’ small size and terrain will hinder mobility and concealment and their remoteness will make it easier to spot and block resupply efforts. The logistical challenge is real. U.S. war games also emphasize the difficulty of resupplying small islands near Taiwan — but Harrington said it underscores the need for US forces to disperse and adopt lower-cost, lower-signature weapons alongside expensive missiles. “This maximizes options for the Joint Force while also enhancing the protection and survivability of our soldiers,” Harrington told Defense News at AUSA. “For example, the employment of systems such as long-range one-way-attack drones, unmanned surface vessels, and long-range launched effects may enable our division to achieve a desired effect for the Joint Force while also preserving our larger, more exquisite systems until needed for a specific purpose.”

## Details

Join us for **Halloween Hangover Day Trip** in Omaha on Saturday, November 7 hosted by ¡Stephanie N!

We will meet at noon at the cozy Asian fusion restaurant, [Shiki](https://www.shikiomaha.com/), known for outstanding sushi. Then we will rendezvous at the most haunted museum in the world, the [Museum of Shadows](https://www.museumofshadows.com/). Entrance to the museum is $25 at the door. After touring the museum, we will walk to the affectionately known as “Bob” [Bob Kerrey Pedestrian Bridge,](https://ohmyomaha.com/bob-kerrey-pedestrian-bridge/) which connects Nebraska and Iowa _weather permitting_.

Your host will keep everyone updated on arrivals at each location through the event chat. Please note that each participant is responsible for covering their own meals and any personal purchases.

Most attendees will come solo, although you may include up to 5 guests, so **join us at noon in Omaha on Saturday, November 7, and let’s paint the town red!**

Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.

Who We Are & Our Connection

We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.

“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.

A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family

At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.

Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.

He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.

The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.

Our Family’s Connection to This Community

Our connection to this region goes back generations.

Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.

Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.

The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.

Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.

The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.

Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.

What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.

We Are Grieving Many Losses

Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.

His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.

We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.

Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.

How the Funds Will Be Used

We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.

The funds will be used specifically for:

*   Food and daily necessities
*   Shelter, rent, and household expenses
*   Clothing and essential supplies
*   School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
*   Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
*   Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives

100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.

Bringing the Help Directly to Nepal

Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.

We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.

Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.

If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.

Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.

From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.

With gratitude,

Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family

“The basic foundation of humanity is compassion and love.”

— His Holiness the 14th Dalai Lama

summary: 香港 APEC财长会议10月21日在香港胜利闭幕，与会者就区域经济问题达成广泛共识。特区政府强调此次活动展示了香港作为国际金融中心的独特优势及其能力 [![图 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), 主编 21 2026 年 10 月，香港时间 19:10 · 2 分钟阅读亚太经合组织财长会议结论
content:
香港
10月21日，亚太经合组织财长会议在香港胜利闭幕，与会者就区域经济问题达成广泛共识。特区政府强调此次活动展示了香港作为国际金融中心的独特优势和能力

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 19:10 香港时间 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

亚太经合组织财长会议10月21日在香港特别行政区胜利闭幕，特区政府表示，各成员经济体和国际组织代表就区域经济发展重大问题深入交流，形成广泛共识，取得务实成果。

特区政府表示，这次会议充分展示了香港作为背靠祖国、连通世界的国际金融中心的独特优势和举办大型国际会议的能力。香港将继续发挥“超级联系人”和“超级增值者”作用，深化与APEC成员经济体的交流合作，为区域经济金融发展作出贡献。
会议第二天发表了联合声明。财政司司长陈茂波在讨论环节表示，推动普惠金融，关键在于让市民和中小企业安全、便捷地获得负担得起、可靠的金融服务。他分享了香港“商业数据交换”的经验，促进企业与银行之间的数据共享，提高信用评估效率，让中小企业更容易获得融资。陈强调，消费者保护、数据治理和明确的问责机制必须与创新同步推进。

陈肇始表示，香港支持将青年金融人才交流合作延续至明年，培养具备专业知识、判断力、国际视野和跨境协作能力的新一代专业人才。他建议交流重点关注人工智能负责任应用、数字基础设施融资和普惠金融等实际政策议题，并在参与者之间建立持续的网络，以促进学习和长期合作。
中国财政部长李福安在闭幕辞中表示，各方应坚定落实APEC领导人非正式会议共识，维护多边主义，深化金融领域务实合作，为地区经济金融稳定和长期可持续增长作出贡献。李克强在新闻发布会上表示，会议在三个方面深化了亚太各方共识：加强宏观经济政策沟通和协调，共同应对外部风险挑战；推进金融领域务实合作，支持亚太经济长期可持续发展；推动区域经济一体化，构建亚太共同体。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

CLB.org 总编辑

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
The APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting concluded successfully in Hong Kong on 21 October, with participants reaching broad consensus on regional economic issues. The SAR government highlighted the event as demonstrating Hong Kong's unique advantages as an international financial centre and its capacity

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 19:10 HKT · 2 min read

The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Finance Ministers' Meeting concluded successfully in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on 21 October, with the SAR government stating that representatives from member economies and international organisations engaged in in-depth exchanges on major issues of regional economic development, forming broad consensus and achieving practical outcomes.

The meeting fully demonstrated Hong Kong's unique advantages as an international financial centre backed by the motherland and connected to the world, as well as its capacity to host major international conferences, the government said. Hong Kong will continue to play its role as a 'super-connector' and 'super-value-adder', deepening exchanges and cooperation with APEC member economies to contribute to regional economic and financial development.

On the second day of the meeting, a joint statement was issued. Financial Secretary Paul Chan, speaking in a discussion session, said that promoting financial inclusion hinged on enabling citizens and small and medium-sized enterprises to access affordable and reliable financial services safely and conveniently. He shared Hong Kong's experience with the 'Commercial Data Interchange', which facilitates data sharing between businesses and banks to improve credit assessment efficiency and make it easier for SMEs to obtain financing. Chan emphasised that consumer protection, data governance and clear accountability mechanisms must advance in step with innovation.

Chan said Hong Kong supports extending youth financial talent exchange and cooperation into next year, cultivating a new generation of professionals with expertise, sound judgment, international vision and cross-border collaboration skills. He suggested exchanges focus on practical policy topics including responsible application of artificial intelligence, digital infrastructure financing and financial inclusion, and establish ongoing networks among participants to promote learning and long-term cooperation.

Chinese Finance Minister Li Fuan said in his closing remarks that parties should firmly implement the consensus of the APEC Economic Leaders' Informal Meeting, uphold multilateralism and deepen practical cooperation in the financial sector to contribute to regional economic and financial stability and long-term sustainable growth. At a press conference, Li said the meeting deepened consensus among Asia-Pacific parties in three areas: strengthening macroeconomic policy communication and coordination to jointly address external risks and challenges; advancing practical cooperation in the financial sector to support long-term sustainable economic development in the Asia-Pacific; and promoting regional economic integration to build an Asia-Pacific community.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

Editor in Chief

content:
周三，香港发布了一年来最新的酷热天气警告，因为十月异常炎热，香港天气闷热。 2026 年 10 月 21 日星期三下午 1:45 香港各地气温。照片：weatherhongkong.com 来自香港天文台。该警告于早上 6.45 发出，根据高温指数阈值触发，通常是在水银温度达到或超过 33 摄氏度时触发。周三打破了天文台最新发行日期于2024年10月19日创下的纪录。截至周三午餐时间，元朗气​​温已达摄氏36度，天文台尖沙咀总部录得最高温度达摄氏33.8度。另请参阅：避暑安全综合指南 天文台周三表示：“广东沿海风力微弱，同时，受高空固定天气系统影响，广东天气总体晴朗，天气炎热。” “此外，粤北地区气压正在上升，预计今晚东北季候风将吹袭沿海地区。”档案照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港中文大学地球与环境科学系教授戴耀廷周三在电台节目中表示，超级厄尔尼诺现象导致赤道太平洋中部和东部海面温度上升，削弱了东北季风。
戴还指出，位于马尼拉东北部东部的超强台风“占比”导致当地气流减弱。据iCable报道，他补充说，香港人今年应该会经历一个更热的冬天，或者可能是历史上最热的冬天，因为超级厄尔尼诺现象预计将持续到明年春天。天文台预计，到下周三，该市将继续出现30摄氏度以上的高温。气候变化 根据 HKFP 的weatherhongkong.com，周三也是有记录以来最热的 10 月 21 日，打破了 2024 年记录的 31.5 摄氏度。 (function(){function e(){window.addEventListener(`message`,function(e){if(e.data[`datawrapper-height`]!==void 0){var t=document.querySelectorAll(`iframe`);for(var n in e.data[`datawrapper-height`])for(var r=0,i;i=t[r];r++)if(i.contentWindow===e.source){var a=e.data[`datawrapper-height`][n]+`px`;i.style.height=a}}})}e()})(); (function(){function e(){window.addEventListener(`message`,function(e){if(e.data[`datawrapper-height`]!==void 0){var t=document.querySelectorAll(`iframe`);for(var n in e.data[`datawrapper-height`])for(var r=0,i;i=t[r];r++)if(i.contentWindow===e.source){var a=e.data[`datawrapper-height`][n]+`px`;i.style.height=a}}})}e()})();天文台的数据显示，从一年中“炎热夜晚”的数量到夏季最后一个月八月的平均气温，一个又一个的记录正在被打破。

Hong Kong saw the latest issuance of a Very Hot Weather warning in a year on Wednesday, as the city sweltered during an exceptionally hot October. Temperatures across Hong Kong at 1:45pm on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. Photo: weatherhongkong.com via HKO. The warning – which was raised at 6.45am – is triggered based on a heat index threshold and generally when the mercury is set to reach , or exceed, 33 degrees Celsius. Wednesday breaks the previous record of October 19, 2024 for the Observatory’s latest issuance. Temperatures had reached 36 degrees Celsius in Yuen Long by Wednesday lunchtime, with a high of 33.8 degrees Celsius recorded at the Observatory’s Tsim Sha Tsui headquarters. See also: A comprehensive guide to beating the heat and staying safe “Winds are weak over the coast of Guangdong. Meanwhile, under the influence of an settled weather system aloft, the weather is generally fine and very hot over Guangdong,” the Observatory said on Wednesday. “Besides, pressure is rising over northern Guangdong. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coastal areas tonight.” File Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Professor Amos Tai from the Chinese University of Hong Kong’s Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences said on a radio programme on Wednesday that the super El Niño – which sees sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean rise – has weakened the northeast monsoon. Tai also pointed to Super Typhoon Champi, located east-northeast of Manila, as contributing to subsiding air currents locally. According to iCable, he added that Hongkongers should expect a hotter winter this year – or perhaps the hottest in history – as the super El Niño phenomenon is expected to last until next spring. The Observatory predicts that the city will continue to see highs of above 30 degrees Celsius until next Wednesday. Changing climate According to HKFP’s weatherhongkong.com , Wednesday also marked the hottest October 21 on record, beating 31.5 degrees Celsius recorded in 2024. title: Fraudster posing as fire officer targets clinic in wheelchair deposit scam
zh_title: 骗子冒充消防员以诊所为目标进行轮椅押金诈骗
summary: 香港一名自称消防局人员的诈骗犯欺骗香港一家物理治疗诊所预约六次预约，然后索要电动轮椅押金。诊所工作人员起了疑心，上网查询，避免了损失。警方敦促企业核实来电者身份并避免付款 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日04:29 HKT · 2分钟阅读 假订单骗局在香港重新浮现，涉及诈骗
content:
香港
一名自称消防局人员的诈骗犯欺骗一家香港物理治疗诊所预约六次，然后索要电动轮椅押金。诊所工作人员起了疑心，上网查询，避免了损失。警方敦促企业核实来电者身份并避免支付费用

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 21 日 04:29 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港再次出现虚假订单诈骗案，诈骗者冒充消防局官员，针对一家物理治疗诊所实施诈骗。周二，一名诊所工作人员在 Threads 上发帖称，他们接到一名自称“消防局官员”的男子打来的电话，他说几名同事受伤，需要治疗，同时预约了六个预约。

周二第一次预约前，该男子打电话称自己急需20台电动轮椅，并要求诊所代他向指定“医疗公司”缴纳押金。该工作人员起了疑心，上网查了一下，发现该供应商的名字此前曾被用于诈骗。他们拒绝转账，避免了损失。预约的六个人都没有出现。该发帖人批评骗子不仅企图诈骗，还占用真正患者所需的预约名额，呼吁公众保持警惕。
类似的骗局此前也曾发生过。去年1月，骗徒冒充澳门消防局人员致电两家汽车维修店，声称消防局急需更换十多个轮胎，且“原供应商与总监闹翻”，要求店家代为订购，并承诺可以保留差价。商店收到假转账截图后相信了这些截图并将钱转给指定供应商，直到要求购买更多轮胎时才意识到这是一个骗局。两间店铺共损失逾27万港元。

警方反诈骗协调中心呼吁商家不要被大单利润蒙蔽双眼，不要轻易支付押金。他们应该通过在官方网站上搜索该组织的联系电话来验证来电者的身份，检查Scameter网站或应用程序上的可疑信息，如有疑问，请拨打反诈骗热线18222。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
A fraudster claiming to be a Fire Station Officer tricked a Hong Kong physiotherapy clinic into booking six appointments, then demanded a deposit for electric wheelchairs. The clinic staff became suspicious, checked online and avoided loss. Police urge businesses to verify callers and avoid paying d

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 04:29 HKT · 2 min read

A scam involving fake orders has resurfaced in Hong Kong, with a fraudster posing as a Fire Station Officer to target a physiotherapy clinic. A clinic staff member posted on Threads on Tuesday that they had received a call from a man claiming to be a 'Fire Station Officer,' who said several colleagues were injured and needed treatment, booking six appointments at once.

Before the first appointment on Tuesday, the man called to say he urgently needed 20 electric wheelchairs and asked the clinic to pay a deposit on his behalf to a designated 'medical company.' The staff member became suspicious and checked online, discovering the supplier's name had previously been used in scams. They refused to transfer the money and avoided a loss. The six booked appointments all failed to show up. The poster criticised the scammer for not only attempting fraud but also occupying appointment slots needed by genuine patients, urging the public to stay alert.

Similar scams have occurred before. In January last year, fraudsters posing as Macau fire department personnel called two car repair shops, claiming the department urgently needed to replace more than ten tyres and that the 'original supplier had fallen out with the director,' asking the shops to order on their behalf and promising they could keep the difference. The shops received fake transfer screenshots, believed them and transferred money to the designated supplier, only realising it was a scam when asked to buy more tyres. The two shops lost over HK$270,000 in total.

The Police Anti-Deception Coordination Centre has urged businesses not to be blinded by profits from large orders and not to pay deposits easily. They should verify callers' identities by searching for the organisation's contact number on official websites, check suspicious information on the Scameter website or app, and call the Anti-Scam Helpline 18222 if in doubt.

summary: 2023 年 2 月 5 日，美国海军查尔斯顿号航空母舰 (LCS-18) 在南中国海航行。美国海军照片 菲律宾马尼拉 — 据北京称，美国海军查尔斯顿号航空母舰 (LCS-18) 在“非法侵入”南中国海争议海域周边地区后，于周二被中国军队追踪。解放军表示，周二早些时候，中国军队被派往萨比纳浅滩附近监视独立级濒海战斗舰。中国根据其十段线领土主张对该海域拥有主权。 “美方行为侵犯中国主权权益，危害海上安全，
content:
查尔斯顿号航空母舰 (LCS-18) 航行于南海，2023 年 2 月 5 日。美国海军照片

菲律宾马尼拉——据北京称，查尔斯顿号航空母舰(LCS-18)“非法侵入”南海争议海域周边地区后，周二被中国军队追踪。

解放军表示，周二早些时候，中国军队被派往萨比纳浅滩附近监视独立级濒海战斗舰。中国根据其十段线领土主张对该海域拥有主权。

解放军南部战区在一份声明中表示：“美方行为侵犯中方主权权益，危害海上安全，不利于地区和平稳定。美方应立即停止此类活动。海南战区部队始终保持高度戒备，坚决维护国家主权安全，维护地区和平稳定。”

自[2024年与马尼拉对峙](https://news.usni.org/2024/09/14/manila-withdraws-coast-guard-flagship-from-sabina-shoal-ais-shows)以来，中国人民解放军海军、中国海警快艇和中国海上民兵船只一直维持北京在萨比纳浅滩的存在。这些行动是由中国在南沙群岛前沿部署的大型部队来维持的，该群岛拥有多个填海造地的陆地基地，配有机场、港口、传感器以及防空和反舰导弹系统。
美国航行正值中国和菲律宾之间一个月的紧张局势加剧之际。自10月初以来，两国在南海和吕宋海峡至少发生了[8次近距离接触](https://news.usni.org/2026/10/09/philippine-and-chinese-incidents-spike-in-south-china-sea-luzon-strait)。

美国海军军舰和海岸警卫队快艇通常部署到南海进行航行自由行动。去年，一艘中国海军导弹驱逐舰与中国海警巡逻艇严重相撞，导致两名中国水兵丧生，[USS_Higgins_ (DDG-76)]在黄岩岛举行了航行自由行动](https://news.usni.org/2025/08/13/navy-denies-china-chased-off-u-s-warship-from-scarborough-shoal)死了。

美国第七舰队前沿部署的濒海战斗舰定期在南海巡逻并与东南亚国家进行演习。 7月和8月，美国“圣巴巴拉”号航母（LCS-32）连续与菲律宾、日本和澳大利亚军队在整个地区进行海上合作活动。海军 [P-8A 海神](https://news.usni.org/2023/10/06/another-summer-in-the-south-china-sea-a-guided-tour-of-the-worlds-most-contested-waters) 和海军陆战队 [MQ-9A收割者](https://news.usni.org/2024/06/03/u-s-marine-mq-9a-reapers-now-deployed-to-the-philippines)也在这些航行期间提供情报、监视和侦察支持。
[！[图片 2：Aaron-Matthew Lariosa](https://news.usni.org/wp-content/uploads/userphoto/337.jpg)](https://news.usni.org/author/amlariosa)

### [亚伦-马修·拉里奥萨](https://news.usni.org/author/amlariosa)

亚伦-马修·拉里奥萨 (Aaron-Matthew Lariosa) 是一名自由国防记者。他的报道重点是菲律宾国防现代化、南海和美国在第一岛链的努力。
[关注@AaronMatthewI_L](https://twitter.com/@AaronMatthew_L?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

【原文 English Original】
USS Charleston (LCS-18) navigates the South China Sea, Feb. 5, 2023. US Navy photo

MANILA, Philippines — USS _Charleston_ (LCS-18) was tracked by Chinese forces on Tuesday after the ship “illegally intruded” into the area surrounding a contested South China Sea maritime feature, according to Beijing.

Chinese forces were dispatched to monitor the Independence-class LCS near Sabina Shoal early Tuesday, the PLA said. China claims the maritime feature under its 10-Dash Line territorial assertion.

“The U.S. action infringes upon China’s sovereign rights and interests, jeopardizes maritime security, and is detrimental to regional peace and stability. The U.S. side should immediately cease such activities. Forces of the STC remain on high alert at all times to resolutely safeguard national sovereignty and security and uphold regional peace and stability,” the People’s Liberation Army Southern Theater Command said in a statement.

The PLA Navy, China Coast Guard cutters and China Maritime Militia vessels have maintained Beijing’s presence at Sabina Shoal since a [2024 standoff with Manila](https://news.usni.org/2024/09/14/manila-withdraws-coast-guard-flagship-from-sabina-shoal-ais-shows). These operations are sustained by a large forward-deployed Chinese force in the Spratly Islands, which is host to several reclaimed land bases with air fields, ports, sensors and anti-aircraft and anti-ship missile systems.

The U.S. sail comes amid a month of heightened tensions between China and the Philippines. Since the beginning of October, at least [eight close encounters](https://news.usni.org/2026/10/09/philippine-and-chinese-incidents-spike-in-south-china-sea-luzon-strait) have occurred across the South China Sea and Luzon Strait between the two countries.

U.S. Navy warships and Coast Guard cutters usually deploy to the South China Sea for Freedom of Navigation Operations. Last year, [USS _Higgins_ (DDG-76) held a FONOP](https://news.usni.org/2025/08/13/navy-denies-china-chased-off-u-s-warship-from-scarborough-shoal) at Scarborough Shoal in the aftermath of a severe collision between a PLAN guided-missile destroyer and CCG patrol vessel that left two Chinese sailors dead.

Forward-deployed LCSs under U.S. 7th Fleet regularly patrol the South China Sea and drill with Southeast Asian states. In July and August, USS _Santa Barbara_ (LCS-32) held consecutive maritime cooperative activities with Philippine, Japanese and Australian forces throughout the region. Navy [P-8A Poseidon](https://news.usni.org/2023/10/06/another-summer-in-the-south-china-sea-a-guided-tour-of-the-worlds-most-contested-waters) and Marine Corps [MQ-9A Reapers](https://news.usni.org/2024/06/03/u-s-marine-mq-9a-reapers-now-deployed-to-the-philippines) also provide intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance support during these sails.

title: 马建：在麻木与觉醒之间

content: ——序周远志的长篇小说《浑浊的婉儿河》 作者：马建 独立中文笔会 2026-10-21 在中国社会的精神生态更趋物质化、道德腐败、金钱泛滥之际，周远志没有跟随文人堕落一同滑坡。他以独立思考创作了这部长篇小说，为时代留下一部理想社会与失败制度交织的作品。它让我们看到人的内心与社会交织所产生的冲突与矛盾，也因此证实：文学不仅要紧扣时代，也要与作家自己的人生感悟相一致。 确切地说，《浑浊的婉儿河》就是今天中国善恶不分的缩影：人人提心吊胆地过日子，家家彼此防备，构成一种政治恐惧弥漫的社会。这是一部残酷与麻木混合、相互扭曲的长篇小说。作者的创作意图十分明确——国人的善恶与制度密不可分，并描写个体性格生成的前因与后果。书中描写了一位名叫上官婉儿的风尘女子，如何走进“红楼”，又如何走出红尘，最终成为雇凶杀人犯的过程。小说揭露了当代中国社会从基层到高层的腐化与残忍，以及中国人的麻木与冷酷，同时也描写了上官婉儿在痛苦中的觉醒，使这部绝望的长篇小说显露出一线希望。 书中以莫少晟律师在犹豫不决中收取一万元贿赂作为开端，使故事成为善恶势力摇摆的座标。而这个人物恰恰是中国社会的润滑剂，因为善的社会和恶的制度都无法独立存在。因此，正是村干部宁显贵的凶恶逼出了上官婉儿的复仇。 而在政治权力控制之下，个人的觉醒往往也成为一次政治反抗。今天的中国社会，表面看似人人富有：有车有房，甚至有情人；大城市高楼林立，人们只用一台手机就可以搞定生活中吃喝拉撒睡等几乎所有事务。可以说，中国人已经过上了高科技的现代化生活。外国人更是被京剧脸谱、长城、旗袍与女性形象所吸引，把中国理想化为文明的样板。上官婉儿在北京纸醉金迷的生活环境是故事的高潮，在“银河人间”的浮华幻象下，权贵的纸醉金迷彻底撕开了秩序的底裤。那是官商勾结的饕餮盛宴：名酒入喉如水，权力化作筹码，在包间内肆意挥霍。官僚们沉溺于感官的极度膨胀，以金钱豢养青春，将法律与尊严践踏于昂贵的皮鞋之下。这种腐烂不仅是肉体的荒淫，更是手握重权者对民生的集体背弃，在霓虹灯影中，勾勒出一幅极度扭曲、金玉其外而败絮其中的权力终局。 但这本书的真实描写，却如同啄木鸟一般敲开树皮，将虫子啄出，使中国现实呈现出扎心的悲痛感。这绝不是种上几盆花草、建起几栋高楼就能消失无踪的中国农民、农民工的精神困境。我们知道，一个靠暴力建立的政权，必然用恐怖来控制社会。而在这样的社会中生存下来的人们，就不得不具备某种麻木的品格。但随之而来的后果是：残酷的统治得以顺利发展并扎根。在伊斯兰国家，女性往往被包裹在黑色或咖啡色的头巾（赫佳布）中生活，受教育、上街都受到限制。相比较而言，中国女性似乎“自由”一些。但中国每年仍有大量女性被拐卖，“铁链女”并非个案，烈女邓玉娇也不是个案，而是在贫困地区反覆出现的现实。对女性的不尊重，与落后国家的意识并无本质差别，因为许多女性受害者背后，往往都有权力在为罪恶撑腰。 在这本书里，我们真切地感到，权贵势力横行乡里、掠夺财富、强占人妻、环境污染、拐卖儿童与野蛮推行的计划生育政策，使上官婉儿一步步走向逼良为娼的绝路，这是一种来自制度变异的迫害。我们不仅要看到各级党员干部与黑恶势力沆瀣一气所带来的经济巨变现实，也要看到这舞台背后基层民众血泪交织的真实处境。不然，我们就无法看到人心向善的努力。 上官婉儿的命运绝非个案。权势集团为了打压个性独立、思想解放、敢于挑战不公不义社会现实的女性，施展了一切肮脏的政治手段。历史进入到21世纪，各地维权女性风起云涌，各地残酷暴力打压手段层出不穷。于是近年来涌现了震惊中外的江西女孩李宜雪“被精神病事件”，网红县委书记陈行甲当政时期的湖北省巴东县，丈夫和大儿子非正常死亡而维权的向贤玲“被寻衅滋事”的判罪事件；湖北黄石市的女孩刘清香“被精神病”事件、湖北汉川市女子刘风兰“被精神病”事件、湖北恩施女子谭小英“被精神病”事件，等等。这些风靡网路平台的不幸事件数也不清，都是上官婉儿的缩影。政治流氓们为了掩盖其罪恶本质，对待人民用尽了流氓手段。在本书里，以上官婉儿为主的女性们与社会、与制度、与官僚们淋漓尽致地展现了“民不畏死，奈何以死惧之？”的勇气与斗志。 我认为，作者正是借上官婉儿的故事，让我们看到自八十年代以来中国社会阶层重新分化的权力结构。在经济全球化的浪潮之下，中国社会发生了人性极度的扭曲。特别是在政治生态原地踏步的同时，经济却高速发展，整个社会变成了一党专制与资本逻辑混合的“八宝粥”。又经过十几年的发展，一个巨大的“天鹅绒监狱”逐渐封顶。但在这穹顶之下，潜藏着生态破坏、环境污染、贪污腐败肆意横行、情感缺失等一系列社会精神危机。科技与人性、家庭与国家，也在不断地撕裂与重组。 而这部《浑浊的婉儿河》的大部分叙述，是以坐台小姐的日记形式呈现。从文学手法来看，这未必是最理想的结构，但却真实贴近了上官婉儿的情感伤疤，使其一步步演化为复仇的心理过程。周远志生活在当代中国。他所面对的，是在市场经济相对成熟条件下，对穷人与富人共同人性处境的探讨。他在既开放又封闭的社会空间中游刃有余地书写，在压抑与表达之间潇洒地进出，将自身的苦难忠实地表达出来。这种独立的文学意识，使现实与虚构结合在一起，也使上官婉儿这一人物更加生动感人。这也说明，中国当代文学正处在一个复杂阶段：既有粗劣之作，也仍然存在旷世经典的文学。在娱乐小说铺天盖地的小资趣味之中，文学尚未完全失语。 周远志其人，我未曾见过，甚至也不知道这名字的真假。但由于同处独立写作者的文人圈子，我看到他不断进出监狱，也不断以文字冲撞现实，使地下文学与流亡文学得以延续。至于其真名或笔名，在这样的语境中已不重要——正如古代经典作者，也需后人考证其真实身份。文学在过去，被视为道德书写；回归正常审美判断，则应当包含同情、悲悯与真诚。从《金瓶梅》中，我们看到个人与社会的相互腐蚀；从狄更斯的小说中，我们看到工业时代城市与人心的演变。文学既是作家的内心表达，也使读者获得真实感受，从而在文明层面产生共鸣。 从《浑浊的婉儿河》这一标题就可以看出：腐败社会必然有一整套制度在守护，缺一不可。从县委政法委书记到法院院长、检察长、公安局长、司法局长、派出所长，几乎同流合污。同时，作者又试图从法官、检察官与律师之中开辟出一条希望之路，这也构成了小说的核心冲突。 这也是周远志在谎言与暴力统治之下仍然坚持写作的信念。他从莫少晟律师，引出更年轻的助手朱可可与经验老道的姜律师、伍腾飞、茅也思，在更高层的权力结构中呼唤良知，呼唤社会正义与道德的回归。这让我看到周远志与上官婉儿共同的绝望：因为故事的结尾虽然令人松一口气，却依然令人不胜悲哀。因为这个看似富裕的新时代，仍然是一个穷凶极恶的时代。 2026年3月27日

title: Chinese Navy Shadows USS Charleston Near Contested Sabina Shoal - USNI News
zh_title: 中国海军在有争议的萨比纳浅滩附近跟踪查尔斯顿号航空母舰 - 美国海军学院新闻
source: 美国海军学会新闻 USNI（军事/海上）（Google新闻聚合）
summary: 2023 年 2 月 5 日，美国海军查尔斯顿号航空母舰 (LCS-18) 在南中国海航行。美国海军照片 菲律宾马尼拉 — 据北京称，美国海军查尔斯顿号航空母舰 (LCS-18) 在“非法侵入”南中国海争议海域周边地区后，于周二被中国军队追踪。解放军表示，周二早些时候，中国军队被派往萨比纳浅滩附近监视独立级濒海战斗舰。中国根据其十段线领土主张对该海域拥有主权。 “美方行为侵犯中国主权权益，危害海上安全，
content:
查尔斯顿号航空母舰 (LCS-18) 航行于南海，2023 年 2 月 5 日。美国海军照片

菲律宾马尼拉——据北京称，查尔斯顿号航空母舰(LCS-18)“非法侵入”南海争议海域周边地区后，周二被中国军队追踪。

解放军表示，周二早些时候，中国军队被派往萨比纳浅滩附近监视独立级濒海战斗舰。中国根据其十段线领土主张对该海域拥有主权。

解放军南部战区在一份声明中表示：“美方行为侵犯中方主权权益，危害海上安全，不利于地区和平稳定。美方应立即停止此类活动。海南战区部队始终保持高度戒备，坚决维护国家主权安全，维护地区和平稳定。”

自[2024年与马尼拉对峙](https://news.usni.org/2024/09/14/manila-withdraws-coast-guard-flagship-from-sabina-shoal-ais-shows)以来，中国人民解放军海军、中国海警快艇和中国海上民兵船只一直维持北京在萨比纳浅滩的存在。这些行动是由中国在南沙群岛前沿部署的大型部队来维持的，该群岛拥有多个填海造地的陆地基地，配有机场、港口、传感器以及防空和反舰导弹系统。
美国航行正值中国和菲律宾之间一个月的紧张局势加剧之际。自10月初以来，两国在南海和吕宋海峡至少发生了[8次近距离接触](https://news.usni.org/2026/10/09/philippine-and-chinese-incidents-spike-in-south-china-sea-luzon-strait)。

美国海军军舰和海岸警卫队快艇通常部署到南海进行航行自由行动。去年，一艘中国海军导弹驱逐舰与中国海警巡逻艇严重相撞，导致两名中国水兵丧生，[USS_Higgins_ (DDG-76)]在黄岩岛举行了航行自由行动](https://news.usni.org/2025/08/13/navy-denies-china-chased-off-u-s-warship-from-scarborough-shoal)死了。

美国第七舰队前沿部署的濒海战斗舰定期在南海巡逻并与东南亚国家进行演习。 7月和8月，美国“圣巴巴拉”号航母（LCS-32）连续与菲律宾、日本和澳大利亚军队在整个地区进行海上合作活动。海军 [P-8A 海神](https://news.usni.org/2023/10/06/another-summer-in-the-south-china-sea-a-guided-tour-of-the-worlds-most-contested-waters) 和海军陆战队 [MQ-9A收割者](https://news.usni.org/2024/06/03/u-s-marine-mq-9a-reapers-now-deployed-to-the-philippines)也在这些航行期间提供情报、监视和侦察支持。

【原文 English Original】
USS Charleston (LCS-18) navigates the South China Sea, Feb. 5, 2023. US Navy photo

MANILA, Philippines — USS _Charleston_ (LCS-18) was tracked by Chinese forces on Tuesday after the ship “illegally intruded” into the area surrounding a contested South China Sea maritime feature, according to Beijing.

Chinese forces were dispatched to monitor the Independence-class LCS near Sabina Shoal early Tuesday, the PLA said. China claims the maritime feature under its 10-Dash Line territorial assertion.

“The U.S. action infringes upon China’s sovereign rights and interests, jeopardizes maritime security, and is detrimental to regional peace and stability. The U.S. side should immediately cease such activities. Forces of the STC remain on high alert at all times to resolutely safeguard national sovereignty and security and uphold regional peace and stability,” the People’s Liberation Army Southern Theater Command said in a statement.

The PLA Navy, China Coast Guard cutters and China Maritime Militia vessels have maintained Beijing’s presence at Sabina Shoal since a [2024 standoff with Manila](https://news.usni.org/2024/09/14/manila-withdraws-coast-guard-flagship-from-sabina-shoal-ais-shows). These operations are sustained by a large forward-deployed Chinese force in the Spratly Islands, which is host to several reclaimed land bases with air fields, ports, sensors and anti-aircraft and anti-ship missile systems.

The U.S. sail comes amid a month of heightened tensions between China and the Philippines. Since the beginning of October, at least [eight close encounters](https://news.usni.org/2026/10/09/philippine-and-chinese-incidents-spike-in-south-china-sea-luzon-strait) have occurred across the South China Sea and Luzon Strait between the two countries.

U.S. Navy warships and Coast Guard cutters usually deploy to the South China Sea for Freedom of Navigation Operations. Last year, [USS _Higgins_ (DDG-76) held a FONOP](https://news.usni.org/2025/08/13/navy-denies-china-chased-off-u-s-warship-from-scarborough-shoal) at Scarborough Shoal in the aftermath of a severe collision between a PLAN guided-missile destroyer and CCG patrol vessel that left two Chinese sailors dead.

Forward-deployed LCSs under U.S. 7th Fleet regularly patrol the South China Sea and drill with Southeast Asian states. In July and August, USS _Santa Barbara_ (LCS-32) held consecutive maritime cooperative activities with Philippine, Japanese and Australian forces throughout the region. Navy [P-8A Poseidon](https://news.usni.org/2023/10/06/another-summer-in-the-south-china-sea-a-guided-tour-of-the-worlds-most-contested-waters) and Marine Corps [MQ-9A Reapers](https://news.usni.org/2024/06/03/u-s-marine-mq-9a-reapers-now-deployed-to-the-philippines) also provide intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance support during these sails.

 You're either looking at a company to join, or you're trying to understand what your competitors are doing. Either way, you're researching blind—reading scattered reviews, googling company news, checking LinkedIn. It takes forever and you miss things.
 Stop doing this manually.
 In this workshop, you'll customize and deploy a working AI research agent in 3 hours. Fork an existing competitive intelligence agent, wire in your own data sources (RSS feeds, APIs, whatever's available), and run it. Feed it a company or industry keyword. Get back structured intelligence: recent news, hiring patterns, market positioning, gaps, red flags.
**What you'll actually do:**

*   Clone a working competitive intelligence agent from GitHub
*   Add your own custom data sources (RSS feeds, open APIs, etc.)
*   Test it live on a real company or competitor
*   Walk away with a deployed agent you can run 100+ times

**Two use cases, one agent:**

1.   **Job Seeker Mode** — Research a company before you apply, interview, or accept an offer. Understand growth, hiring, leadership, red flags.
2.   **Competitive Mode** — Understand what competitors are doing, market gaps, hiring trends, strategic moves. For employees and side hustlers.

**What you need before the workshop:**

*   10 min of pre-work (optional, but recommended): Clone the GitHub repo, set up your API key, test it runs
*   A laptop with a browser ([Claude.ai](http://claude.ai/))
*   Basic comfort with Claude—you should already be asking it questions and iterating

**After the workshop:**

*   Post-work recap doc: What you built, how to iterate, advanced techniques, troubleshooting
*   Optional upsell: Advanced agent techniques course (separate paid offering)

**This is NOT:**

*   A tutorial on "how to use AI"
*   A guide to corporate strategy
*   A tool for stalking or privacy violations (we cover ethical guardrails)

**Price:** $17–27 (one-time, includes materials + post-work doc)
**Pre-work is optional.** If you complete it, you'll hit the ground running. If you skip it, no problem—we'll set up during the first 20 minutes.

content:
菲尼克斯尾矿公司周二宣布，将在纽约州罗彻斯特建造一座耗资 3.75 亿美元的商业规模稀土加工厂，以应对美国寻求放松中国对矿产的控制。该工厂名为 Freedom Separation，每年将处理超过 18,000 吨开采和回收的稀土原料，满负荷生产每年超过 4,400 吨分离稀土氧化物。产量预计将在 2027 年增加，然后在 2028 年达到满负荷。“技术可以让美国控制其关键供应链，但需要熟练、坚定的人才能将这一承诺转化为生产，”菲尼克斯尾矿公司首席执行官兼联合创始人尼克·迈尔斯在一份声明中表示。 “罗切斯特拥有这样的人才。他们知道如何建设、如何创新以及如何运营世界一流的工业运营。”   Phoenix Tailings 选择罗切斯特市的伊士曼商业园建设占地 500,000 平方英尺的工厂，理由是其现有的工业基础设施以及当地在工程、制造、化学加工和运营方面的专业知识。据路透社报道，纽约州州长 Kathy Hochul 表示，纽约州将为该项目提供 300 万美元的基于绩效的税收抵免。 “我致力于支持准备在纽约投资并带来高薪就业机会的创新项目和公司，”霍赫尔说。
“菲尼克斯尾矿不仅将在伊士曼商业园创造至少 90 个新就业机会，进一步支持我们州的创新经济，而且还将通过在纽约建立稀土元素供应链，在加强我们的国家安全方面发挥关键作用。”  联邦政府的支持 罗彻斯特工厂是 Phoenix Tailings 价值 12 亿美元的 Freedom 项目的一部分，该项目是一个分离和金属化平台，旨在缩小美国中游稀土加工能力的差距。这项更广泛的计划预计将在纽约州、马萨诸塞州和新罕布什尔州创造 500 多个就业岗位。自由项目已从战争部战略资本办公室获得了 5 亿美元的有条件贷款承诺。菲尼克斯的新设施也得到了民主党纽约州州长和美国参议员查克·舒默的支持。稀土精炼商从五角大楼获得 5 亿美元贷款，用于建设“自由设施”“这对于减少我们对外国加工商的依赖并保护我们的国家安全至关重要，”舒默说。 “我长期以来一直支持伊士曼商业园作为制造业中心，很高兴新公司认识到我长期以来所知道的：纽约州北部是新制造业投资的主要目的地。” （来自路透社的文件）

【原文 English Original】
Phoenix Tailings announced Tuesday it will build a $375-million commercial-scale rare earths processing facility in Rochester, New York, as the US looks to loosen China’s grip on minerals. The plant, called Freedom Separation, will process more than 18,000 tons of both mined and recycled rare earth feedstock annually, producing over 4,400 tons per year of separated rare earth oxides at its full capacity. Production is expected to ramp up in 2027 before reaching full capacity in 2028.  “Technology can give America control over its critical supply chains, but it takes skilled, determined people to turn that promise into production,” Phoenix Tailings CEO and co-founder Nick Myers said in a statement . “Rochester has those people. They know how to build, how to innovate, and how to run world-class industrial operations.”   Phoenix Tailings selected Eastman Business Park in the city of Rochester for the 500,000-square-foot facility, citing its existing industrial infrastructure and local expertise in engineering, manufacturing, chemical processing and operations.   New York governor Kathy Hochul said the state will provide $3 million in performance-based tax credits for the project, Reuters reported.   “I am committed to supporting innovative projects and companies that are ready to invest in New York and bring good-paying jobs,” Hochul said. “Phoenix Tailings will not only create at least 90 new jobs at Eastman Business Park, further supporting our state’s innovation economy, but they will also play a critical role in bolstering our national security by building a supply chain for rare earth elements in New York.”  Federal backing    The Rochester facility forms part of Phoenix Tailings’ $1.2 billion Freedom project, a separation and metallization platform designed to close the gap in US midstream rare earth processing capacity.  The broader initiative is slated to generate more than 500 jobs across New York, Massachusetts and New Hampshire.  The Freedom Project has secured a $500-million conditional loan commitment from the Department of War’s Office of Strategic Capital. Phoenix’s new facility is also backed by democratic NY state governor and US Senator Chuck Schumer.  Rare earth refiner gets $500M loan from Pentagon to build ‘Freedom Facility’ “This is critical for reducing our reliance on foreign processors and protecting our national security,” Schumer said. “I’ve long championed Eastman Business Park as a hub for manufacturing and am glad that new companies are recognizing what I have long known: Upstate New York is a prime destination for new manufacturing investments.” (With files from Reuters)

香港
香港国际机场荣获三项最佳机场荣誉，其中包括连续第六年荣获“亚洲领先机场”称号，9月份客运量同比增长10.2%至486万人次。机场管理局报告称，各项交通指标稳步增长，并表示将

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 20 日 21:39 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港国际机场（HKIA）荣获三项最佳机场殊荣，9月份旅客吞吐量同比增长10.2%至486万人次。

其中一项荣誉是，该机场自 2020 年以来连续第六年被世界旅游奖评选为亚洲领先机场。该奖项被认为是行业卓越的全球基准，由世界各地的旅游专业人士和旅行者评选，旨在表彰航空、旅游和酒店业的杰出表现。此外，该机场连续第五年被评为中国领先机场。

该机场还连续 14 次获得 TTG 旅游奖“旅游名人堂 - 最佳机场”称号，这是自 1989 年以来由读者投票决定的年度行业荣誉。
香港机场管理局行政总裁张嘉辉表示，机场持续获得地区同行的认可，令管理局深感荣幸。她表示，这些奖项不仅是对机场多年来持续取得的成就的肯定，也是对全体机场员工的奉献和集体努力的表彰。展望未来，张家口表示，机场管理局将继续与业务伙伴合作，提升旅客体验，巩固机场作为世界级国际航空枢纽的地位。

当局在一份声明中报告称，9 月份所有主要交通指标均稳步扩张。随着客运量增长 10.2%，航班起降量增长 7%，达到 32,175 架次，货运吞吐量增长 6.3%，达到 433,000 公吨。值得注意的是，转机和过境旅客继续推动整体旅客增长，其次是旅客入境人数同比增长 5%。大多数市场均录得增长，其中中国市场领先，中东市场跌势有所缓解。

此外，转运和进口推动货运增长，分别增长 26.9% 和 9.2%。东南亚和中国大陆引领地区货运量，帮助抵消了欧洲航线的下降，当局将其归因于欧盟7月份取消了小额进口关税豁免。
今年前三季度，机场旅客吞吐量4910万人次，飞机起降量302075架次，同比分别增长10.1%和3.9%。同期货运量增长 3.1%，达到 378 万吨。连续 12 个月，旅客吞吐量同比增长 11.5%，达到 6540 万人次；航班起降量增长 4.9%，达到 405,945 架次；货运量增长 3.3%，达到 518 万吨。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong International Airport received three best-airport honours, including Asia's Leading Airport for the sixth straight year, as September passenger traffic rose 10.2 per cent year on year to 4.86 million. The Airport Authority reported steady growth across traffic indicators and said it will k

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

20 Oct 2026 at 21:39 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong International Airport (HKIA) has won three best-airport honours as September passenger traffic recorded a 10.2 per cent year-on-year increase to 4.86 million.

Among the honours, the airport was voted Asia's Leading Airport at the World Travel Awards for the sixth consecutive year since 2020. Considered a global benchmark of industry excellence, the awards are decided by travel professionals and travellers worldwide to recognise outstanding performance across aviation, tourism and hospitality. In addition, the airport was named China's Leading Airport for the fifth consecutive year.

The airport also secured its 14th consecutive "Travel Hall of Fame – Best Airport" title at the TTG Travel Awards, an annual industry distinction determined by reader voting since 1989.

Vivian Cheung Kar-fai, chief executive officer of the Airport Authority Hong Kong, said the authority was honoured by the airport's continued recognition among regional peers. She stated that the awards not only reaffirm the airport's sustained achievements over the years but also honour the dedication and collective efforts of the entire airport workforce. Looking ahead, Cheung noted that the authority will continue collaborating with business partners to elevate the passenger experience and consolidate the airport's standing as a world-class international aviation hub.

In a statement, the authority reported steady expansion across all major traffic indicators in September. Alongside the 10.2 per cent rise in passenger volume, flight movements rose 7 per cent to 32,175, while cargo throughput expanded 6.3 per cent to 433,000 metric tons. Notably, transfer and transit passengers continued to drive overall passenger growth, followed by a 5 per cent year-on-year growth in visitor arrivals. Growth was recorded in most markets, with China leading and the Middle East market's decline easing.

Additionally, cargo growth was driven by transshipment and imports, which rose 26.9 per cent and 9.2 per cent, respectively. Southeast Asia and mainland China led regional cargo traffic, helping offset declines on European routes that the authority attributed to the European Union's elimination of a low-value import customs tax exemption in July.

Across the first three quarters of the year, the airport handled 49.1 million passengers and 302,075 flight movements, representing year-on-year gains of 10.1 per cent and 3.9 per cent, respectively. Cargo volume grew 3.1 per cent over the same period to 3.78 million metric tons. On a rolling 12-month basis, passenger throughput increased 11.5 per cent year on year to 65.4 million, flight movements rose 4.9 per cent to 405,945, and cargo volume climbed 3.3 per cent to 5.18 million metric tons.

title: Hackers Use Autonomous AI Agents to Breach Company Websites, Target Over 1,200 Sites

一名讲中文的犯罪分子将自主人工智能代理指向公司网站，并让他们在几乎没有帮助的情况下闯入，而一名安全研究人员则目睹了这一切的发生，因为操作员在互联网上打开了控制面板。

这些特工尝试了 1,200 多个网站，并访问了属于 100 多家公司的网站，其中包括农业设备制造商 Deere、家电公司 SharkNinja 和发动机制造商 Cummins，[根据路透社](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/how-one-hacker-used-ai-agents-few-thousand-dollars-break-into-scores-sites-2026-10-19/)，它审查了攻击者自己的记录以识别他们。目前尚不清楚有多少数据（如果有）被盗取。
安全公司 **NorForge** 的研究人员 Snorre Fagerland 通过扫描互联网上暴露的 [Cairn](https://norforge.com/blog/inside_cairn) 副本发现了这些操作，Cairn 是一种深受黑客欢迎的开源人工智能工具。

从 10 月 2 日左右开始，他发现大约有两打 Cairn 实例被恶意使用，这让他能够实时读取攻击者的工作。他周一公布了调查结果，路透社在发表之前看到了这份报告，并根据自己对攻击者活动的审查列出了受害者的名字。

Cairn 为人工智能代理提供了一个起点和一个目标，然后让他们一步一步地朝着这个目标努力。特工将他们发现的内容发布到共享板上，操作员可以在此过程中添加提示。它是为[授权渗透测试](https://github.com/oritera/Cairn)而构建的，也可以做其他工作，但在这里它未经许可就指向了网上商店。

Cairn 的作者（发帖名为“le1xia0”）告诉路透社，该工具不是为黑客攻击而设计的，有害使用也不是他们的意图。

### 特工做了什么，谁被击中了[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-use-autonomous-ai-agents-to.html#what-the-agents-did-and-who-was-hit)

NorForge 将暴露的面板分为三组，并判断其中 20 多个可能是恶意的。最繁忙的集群被 NorForge 称为 AIA0001，是中文的，将 14 个面板与 1,100 多个攻击项目连接起来。
NorForge 表示，其目标似乎是持久访问商店和支付系统以供以后使用，目标是美国、日本和澳大利亚。

[！[图片 2：网络安全](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh-69Sxi6ukfnlM_EpqEB_hRVymcXAcWTNAJetA9huKutPZuG0OOBUvByDCtP_HokC-gM-AzjX0ZhgneUFVzjCyIduRINFj6Yf0JX RFE17_z82UioyT9eoxH2-XQDoD_hInCxc8V2bQrmtnMN-GUR63bseKn7pLRISqlvUJlfuJq8pgCL-Fot7sQDas9 D05/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/nudge-3-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/ai-agent-methods-d)

一个典型的任务是要求特工找到一种在商店上运行代码的方法，然后植入一个 Web shell 上传器。这是一种保存上传文件的形式，而不是运行命令的形式，攻击者可以随时将其交换为更糟糕的东西。

NorForge 检查了一项声称的布雷亚

【原文 English Original】
[![Image 1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjYic0qXjDFjrKdw3Ed58Uv28Xt2G7GTuEZhXrAiV07Xnn_I9DPNeQuntZ-TNMi_4i0JdPOyLj4geWCj8K_Zv2OBO4qaujmlDFzBDljcRvvbDx-3r1hSDDaDN-mI3u61F2gJW6zhShFGLZBKrLM0k0Y9yl5-VOVXFHiJaEg3V65-yfT1yXWc5FSfaYLCKg/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/bot-attack.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjYic0qXjDFjrKdw3Ed58Uv28Xt2G7GTuEZhXrAiV07Xnn_I9DPNeQuntZ-TNMi_4i0JdPOyLj4geWCj8K_Zv2OBO4qaujmlDFzBDljcRvvbDx-3r1hSDDaDN-mI3u61F2gJW6zhShFGLZBKrLM0k0Y9yl5-VOVXFHiJaEg3V65-yfT1yXWc5FSfaYLCKg/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/bot-attack.jpg)

A Chinese-speaking criminal pointed autonomous AI agents at company websites and let them break in with almost no help, and a security researcher watched it happen because the operators left their control panels open on the internet.

The agents tried more than 1,200 sites and reached websites belonging to more than 100 companies, including farm-equipment maker Deere, appliance company SharkNinja and engine maker Cummins, [according to Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/how-one-hacker-used-ai-agents-few-thousand-dollars-break-into-scores-sites-2026-10-19/), which reviewed the attacker's own records to identify them. How much data, if any, was taken is not known.

The researcher, Snorre Fagerland of the security firm **NorForge**, found the operations by scanning the internet for exposed copies of [Cairn](https://norforge.com/blog/inside_cairn), an open-source AI tool popular with hackers.

Beginning around October 2, he found about two dozen Cairn instances being used maliciously, which let him read the attackers' work in real time. He set out the findings on Monday, and Reuters, which saw the report before publication, named the victims from its own review of the attacker's activity.

Cairn gives AI agents a starting point and a goal, then lets them work toward it step by step. The agents post what they find to a shared board, and the human operator can add hints along the way. It was built for [authorized penetration testing](https://github.com/oritera/Cairn) and does other jobs too, but here it was pointed at online shops without permission.

Cairn's author, who posts as "le1xia0," told Reuters the tool was not designed for hacking attacks and that harmful use was not their intention.

### What the agents did, and who was hit[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-use-autonomous-ai-agents-to.html#what-the-agents-did-and-who-was-hit)

NorForge grouped the exposed panels into three clusters and judged more than 20 of them likely to be malicious. The busiest cluster, which NorForge calls AIA0001, is Chinese-language and links 14 panels to more than 1,100 attack projects.

Its aim seems to be lasting access to shop and payment systems for later use, NorForge said, with targets in the United States, Japan and Australia.

[![Image 2: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh-69Sxi6ukfnlM_EpqEB_hRVymcXAcWTNAJetA9huKutPZuG0OOBUvByDCtP_HokC-gM-AzjX0ZhgneUFVzjCyIduRINFj6Yf0JXRFE17_z82UioyT9eoxH2-XQDoD_hInCxc8V2bQrmtnMN-GUR63bseKn7pLRISqlvUJlfuJq8pgCL-Fot7sQDas9D05/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/nudge-3-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/ai-agent-methods-d)

A typical task told the agents to find a way to run code on a shop and then plant a web shell uploader. That is a form that saves uploaded files, not one that runs commands, and attackers can swap it for something worse at any time.

NorForge checked one claimed break-in, at a large hardware-parts vendor, and found the web shell live. It independently confirmed the compromise of one very large US retailer, in which the agents found the single cookie setting that selected a vulnerable backend server.

The three named companies told Reuters the damage was limited. Deere said it took steps to fix the problem and had no sign that sensitive information was accessed. SharkNinja said the attack hit a standalone product-support site and that it had contained the threat.

[![Image 3](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiKWlfztW31xCL9GCv_IM02aBNvK7BQxbPL58zp9C877wrDwqkNoO_514rB4CUMNmacDgMLfSrtmfdBLWswGft9X7pu1GiirF1ReeG7HoP0qnm_TY_f_lnBgqA-98P3cGdi9Pf4BPxqe9tMUROq8jQaCgT16EXRlymHikDKllXsiY20p5XzhYKAemU3-G0/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/project1.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiKWlfztW31xCL9GCv_IM02aBNvK7BQxbPL58zp9C877wrDwqkNoO_514rB4CUMNmacDgMLfSrtmfdBLWswGft9X7pu1GiirF1ReeG7HoP0qnm_TY_f_lnBgqA-98P3cGdi9Pf4BPxqe9tMUROq8jQaCgT16EXRlymHikDKllXsiY20p5XzhYKAemU3-G0/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/project1.jpg)

Cummins said it was investigating a report of a possible attack on a website run by one of its vendors. Two smaller businesses also told Reuters they were compromised.

One documented intrusion, by the agent's own account, worked through unauthorized write access to a memcached session store, unsafe handling of saved PHP objects, and a weakness in old Zend Framework code. The paths differ from victim to victim, so this is one chain, not a single method.

### Cheap, fast, and largely unsupervised[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-use-autonomous-ai-agents-to.html#cheap-fast-and-largely-unsupervised)

The instructions were short. The Chinese-speaking operator sketched out preferred tactics in fewer than 100 Chinese characters, Reuters reported, and the agents went from there.

Successful break-ins took a little under 23 hours on average, NorForge found, and the overall success rate across the tools it saw was around 10%, though it cautioned the clusters chase different goals and are not directly comparable.

The cost was low, but the figures are rough. NorForge put the average at about $5 a task, counting attempts that failed or ended early, and said the uncertainty is considerable. Fagerland separately told Reuters the whole campaign had used about $5,000 worth of tokens, or roughly $50 per successful hack.

[![Image 4](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhxCU0m3ePijI63AQtZy448sq_dsak85AbieKiduMI8l4iUOqsCQFFOfbbs-XnZ0sWoB8SbnDDrXGvOZgK6px8elVG91PPCialgheA9QyNhSXA-NRcIIBLYrmM8uI7ZycBAxYNCZ8rxKTrr6lj2nQFQYKtE7SSD1-iEO2gCWwPfQS_Fu0shvN6-aA7DMG4/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/project2.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhxCU0m3ePijI63AQtZy448sq_dsak85AbieKiduMI8l4iUOqsCQFFOfbbs-XnZ0sWoB8SbnDDrXGvOZgK6px8elVG91PPCialgheA9QyNhSXA-NRcIIBLYrmM8uI7ZycBAxYNCZ8rxKTrr6lj2nQFQYKtE7SSD1-iEO2gCWwPfQS_Fu0shvN6-aA7DMG4/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/project2.jpg)

All the AIA0001 tasks ran under a worker named claudecode_deepseek-v4.1-flash, which could point to a [DeepSeek V4.1 Flash](https://openrouter.ai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash) model driven by Anthropic's Claude Code. Neither the researcher nor Reuters confirmed the models, and Reuters said only that the campaign appeared to use DeepSeek and Claude Code.

### The open panels leak the victims' secrets too[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-use-autonomous-ai-agents-to.html#the-open-panels-leak-the-victims-secrets-too)

Leaving a Cairn panel open is a separate problem from the break-ins. The panels show who is being attacked, what weaknesses were found, and which credentials and keys were taken, so having your site tested on an open instance can expose your secrets, whatever the test's outcome.

NorForge ran the secrets scanner Trufflehog over the panel data and found hundreds of secrets, 11% of which it verified as still valid.

The panels also appear to expose the full set of the tool's controls, including the ability to start and stop projects, feed in new data, and point agents to different targets.

NorForge said it did not test whether those controls work without a login. A second, English-language cluster went further and exposed the operators' own SSH logins to their staging servers; NorForge said it did not log in.

[![Image 5: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVV2rRkX8tRMF6gCzemvQNpwFwGxRWxY1cJEYfoLLSj1EZYJOlj5WTR77t0i6kELXujYcaHTpRDqTjCbVHH5Pnh7wzxUiKP5j4dsDkWIMlp2bmpZsL0jeAsA_19pHH5UPtyBvNkZdyGEULOAsXPcraMP5CYjQRFefhXRSdEjYkrdcpUnc4ILcvcdEfAauE/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/tl-d.jpg)](https://thehackernews.uk/network-defense-d)

The exposure is not only a criminal problem. NorForge also found apparently legitimate penetration-testing firms that had left real client tests on unsecured panels, putting their customers' data at the same risk.

### What to check, and where this came from[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-use-autonomous-ai-agents-to.html#what-to-check-and-where-this-came-from)

Defenders can act on a few points:

*   **Exposed panels.** Agent control panels of this kind often answer on port 8000, so an exposed one without a login is worth hunting for.
*   **Stray upload forms.** An unexpected file-upload form sitting in a hidden directory is the foothold these agents aimed for.
*   **Magento patching.** A worker directory NorForge browsed held a proof-of-concept for a critical Magento flaw, [StyleSmuggler](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/adobe-patches-magento-zero-day.html) (CVE-2026-75650), and a test lab for it. There is no evidence it was used in these break-ins, but any shop still on an affected build should apply Adobe's hotfix for it: Adobe Commerce 2.4.4 through 2.4.9, or Magento Open Source 2.4.6 through 2.4.9.

NorForge's search followed a [September report by Gambit Security](https://gambit.security/blog-posts/autonomous-ai-agents-online-retailers-25-a-company), a separate campaign in which a criminal used Cairn alongside two other AI tools to steal credit cards; that report is what first flagged Cairn on an attacker's server. No source links the two operations.

NorForge said it is working with Reuters to warn victims and is asking hosting firms to take the panels down, an effort it said depends on how the hosts respond.

5年過去了，彷彿一切烽煙已經在時間中沈沒，然而有些人仍然選擇不去遺忘。 Five years have passed since Hong Konger's last attempt to maintain their freedom, and it seems that all dust has settled. However, some people still choose not to forget. 經過多方努力，我們在Yermo的自由雕塑公園（Liberty Sculpture Park）建立起了香港地，用藝術去銘記香港人的意志不滅。 After many efforts, we have established Hong Kong Corner in the Liberty Sculpture Park in Yermo, using art to remember the unyielding will of the Hong Kongers. 香港地的維護和創作需要長期的投入，我們亟需你的支持。不論捐款多少，都代表著你對香港所出的一分力。 The maintenance and creation of Yermo's "Hong Kong Corner" requires long-term investment, and we urgently need your support. Any donation, no matter the amount, represents your contribution to the undying spirit of Hong Kongers. 希望有一日我們能在自由的香港相見！ We hope to meet in a free Hong Kong someday. 捐款用途有三 Donation serves 3 main purposes. 1. 現時香港地有四件展品，沙漠氣候極端，冬寒夏焰，烈日風沙，我們要定期維修，提供防曬材料予連儂牆， 令他們可以日久維新。 1. Currently, Hong Kong Corner has four exhibits. We need to perform regular maintenance for some of the art works and provide sun & water protection sealants in the harsh desert weather condition. 2. 香港抗爭者的雕像現時沒有任何解釋。 在我們維修的過程當中，經常見到美國本地人到訪，但他們對於2019抗爭一事並不了清楚。希望可以籌款建立一塊金屬牌匾， 刻上中英文描述，令到到訪者了解究竟發生了什麼事。 2. The statues of Hong Kong Protesters currently have no explanations. During our maintenance work, we often see local Americans visiting, but they are not familiar with the 2019 protests. We hope to raise funds to establish a metal plaque with descriptions in both Chinese and English to help visitors understand what happened. 3. 自由雕塑公園的創辦人陳維明老師亦為香港地建立了新牆，我們希望可以籌款聘請來自香港的專業藝術家，以壁畫描繪出香港的景況。 3. Mr. Chen Wei Ming, the art creator of Liberty Sculpture Park, has also built a new wall for Hong Kong Land. We hope to raise funds to pay for the expenses of hiring a professional artist from Hong Kong to depict the situation in Hong Kong with a mural.

2. The statues of Hong Kong Protesters currently have no explanations. During our maintenance work, we often see local Americans visiting, but they are not familiar with the 2019 protests. We hope to raise funds to establish a metal plaque with descriptions in both Chinese and English to help visitors understand what happened.

3. 自由雕塑公園的創辦人陳維明老師亦為香港地建立了新牆，我們希望可以籌款聘請來自香港的專業藝術家，以壁畫描繪出香港的景況。

3. Mr. Chen Wei Ming, the art creator of Liberty Sculpture Park, has also built a new wall for Hong Kong Land. We hope to raise funds to pay for the expenses of hiring a professional artist from Hong Kong to depict the situation in Hong Kong with a mural.
