zh_title: Hudbay和三菱批准铜世界建设
summary: Hudbay Minerals（多伦多证券交易所、纽约证券交易所代码：HBM）和日本三菱公司已批准在亚利桑那州南部建设耗资 21 亿美元的 Copper World 项目，尽管建设成本飙升了 59%。 Hudbay 周三在一份声明中表示，自 2023 年预可行性研究以来的范围变化导致了 2 亿美元的额外资本成本。 Hudbay 预计将出资约 5 亿美元，不到初始投资的四分之一，第一期付款将推迟到 2028 年。之前在 2023 年的研究中估计资本成本为 13 亿美元。 “铜世界制裁决定是一个立场
content:
Hudbay Minerals（多伦多证券交易所、纽约证券交易所代码：HBM）和日本三菱公司已批准在亚利桑那州南部建设耗资 21 亿美元的 Copper World 项目，尽管建设成本飙升了 59%。 Hudbay 周三在一份声明中表示，自 2023 年预可行性研究以来的范围变化导致了 2 亿美元的额外资本成本。 Hudbay 预计将出资约 5 亿美元，不到初始投资的四分之一，第一期付款将推迟到 2028 年。之前在 2023 年的研究中估计资本成本为 13 亿美元。加拿大皇家银行资本市场 (RBC Capital Markets) 矿业分析师萨姆·克里滕登 (Sam Crittenden) 周三在一份报告中表示，“铜矿世界的制裁决定是 Hudbay 中期增长计划的积极一步，尽管股价反应可能有限，因为该项目的范围和初步资本支出估计基本符合预期。”这一举措是在完成最终可行性研究 (DFS) 后做出的，为美国最大的新铜矿之一在 2029 年下半年开始生产扫清了道路。位于图森东南约 50 公里处的 Copper World 预计将帮助 Hudbay 的综合年铜产量翻一番，达到约 250,000 吨，同时公司现有业务也将采取增长举措。周三上午，Hudbay 股价在多伦多上涨 0.2%，至 33.34 加元，该公司估值约为 148 亿加元（106 亿美元）。去年该股的交易价格在 20.26 加元至 44.48 加元之间。
Hudbay 表示，以每磅 5 美元的长期铜价和 8% 的贴现率计算，Copper World 的税后净现值 (NPV) 为 12 亿美元，内部收益率 (IRR) 为 17%，投资回收期为 5.4 年。如果铜的平均价格为每磅 6 美元，则净现值 (NPV) 升至 23 亿美元，内部收益率 (IRR) 升至 22%。杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 矿业分析师法哈德·塔里克 (Fahad Tariq) 在一份报告中表示：“预计资本支出将会大幅上涨。” “铜世界对铜价的杠杆作用很高。” Copper World 的基本情景设想矿山寿命为 15 年，基于已探明和概算储量 3.9 亿吨铜品位 0.47%。在运营的第一个十年中，年铜产量平均为 102,000 吨，比 2023 年预计的 92,000 吨增加 11%。第一个十年的平均现金成本估计为每磅 1.65 美元。开发计划包括在第四年增加一个坑内破碎和输送系统，并在运营第五年将选矿厂的产量从每天 60,000 吨扩大到 90,000 吨。这将使第六年至第十年的铜年产量提高到约 120,000 吨，比前五年的平均 84,000 吨增加 43%。 Hudbay 表示，Copper World 拥有测得和指示资源量 12 亿吨，铜品位 0.40%，所含金属量 499 万吨。推断资源量估计为 2.75 亿吨，铜品位为 0.3%，含铜量为 927,000 吨。
扩建方案 需要联邦许可的单独扩建方案可以将矿山寿命延长一倍以上，达到 37 年。Hudbay 表示，根据每磅铜价格 5 美元，扩建方案将带来 25 亿美元的 NPV、19% 的 IRR 和 5.4 年的初始投资回收期。国家银行金融矿业分析师唐·德马科周三在一份报告中表示，该项目的资金“预计不会成为问题”。现金来源包括三菱向合资企业初始投入的 6 亿美元、2.3 亿美元

【原文 English Original】
Hudbay Minerals (TSX, NYSE: HBM) and Japan’s Mitsubishi have approved construction of the $2.1-billion Copper World project in southern Arizona despite a 59% surge in construction costs. Scope changes since a 2023 prefeasibility study have resulted in $200 million of additional capital costs, Hudbay said Wednesday in a statement . Hudbay expects to contribute about $500 million, less than one-quarter of the initial investment, with its first installment deferred until 2028. Capital costs were previously estimated at $1.3 billion in the 2023 study. “The Copper World sanction decision is a positive step towards Hudbay’s medium term growth plans, although the share price reaction may be limited as the scope of the project and initial capex estimates are largely as expected,” RBC Capital Markets mining analyst Sam Crittenden said Wednesday in a note. The move, which follows the completion of a definitive feasibility study (DFS), clears the way for one of the largest new copper mines in the United States to start producing in the second half of 2029. Copper World, located about 50 km southeast of Tucson, is expected to help double Hudbay’s consolidated annual copper production to about 250,000 tonnes, alongside growth initiatives at the company’s existing operations. Hudbay shares rose 0.2% to C$33.34 Wednesday morning in Toronto, valuing the company at about C$14.8 billion ($10.6 billion). The stock has traded between C$20.26 and C$44.48 in the past year. Base case Using a long-term copper price of $5 per lb. and an 8% discount rate, Copper World has an after-tax net present value (NPV) of $1.2 billion, an internal rate of return (IRR) of 17% and a payback period of 5.4 years, Hudbay said. If copper averages $6 per lb., the NPV rises to $2.3 billion and the IRR to 22%. “The expectation was that there would be significant capex inflation,” Jefferies mining analyst Fahad Tariq said in a note. “Copper World is highly leveraged to copper prices.” The base case for Copper World contemplates a 15-year mine life based on proven and probable reserves of 390 million tonnes grading 0.47% copper. Annual copper production would average 102,000 tonnes during the first decade of operations, an 11% increase from the 92,000 tonnes projected in 2023. Average cash costs are estimated at $1.65 per lb. during the first decade. The development plan includes adding an in-pit crushing and conveying system in year four and expanding the concentrator to 90,000 tonnes from 60,000 tonnes per day in the fifth year of operations. That would lift annual copper production to about 120,000 tonnes during years six through 10 – a 43% increase from the 84,000-tonne average of the first five years. Copper World holds measured and indicated resources of 1.2 billion tonnes grading 0.40% copper for contained metal of 4.99 million tonnes, Hudbay says. Inferred resources are estimated at 275 million tonnes grading 0.3% copper for 927,000 tonnes of contained copper. Expansion scenario A separate expansion scenario, requiring federal permits, could more than double the mine life to 37 years. Based on a $5 per lb. copper price, the extension would deliver an NPV of $2.5 billion, an IRR of 19% and an initial payback period of 5.4 years, Hudbay says. Funding for the project “is not expected to be an issue,” National Bank Financial mining analyst Don DeMarco said Wednesday in a note. Sources of cash include Mitsubishi’s initial $600 million contribution to the joint venture, $230 million in stream financing from Wheaton Precious Metals (TSX, NYSE, LSE: WPM), an anticipated $650 million project debt facility and subsequent pro-rata equity contributions from both Hudbay and Mitsubishi. Hudbay is well-positioned to fund capital contributions from its existing cash balance of $915 million, its revolving credit facility and projected free cash flow from its other operations during Copper World’s development, DeMarco added. Long history Copper World incorporates the former Rosemont copper deposit, now known as the East deposit, and additional deposits identified through exploration beginning in 2020. Hudbay reconfigured the project after legal and permitting challenges complicated development of Rosemont, shifting its initial mine plan onto private land and patented mining claims to avoid the need for federal permits. A preliminary economic assessment released in 2022 established the phased development strategy, followed by an enhanced prefeasibility study in 2023. Hudbay subsequently secured key Arizona environmental permits, including aquifer protection and air quality approvals. Mitsubishi acquired a 30% stake in the project through a $600-million investment completed in January 2026. That left Hudbay with 70% ownership. Copper World is expected to create more than 1,000 construction jobs and 500 permanent operating positions. Concentrate facility Hudbay is also evaluating a fully permitted concentrate leach facility that could produce copper cathode domestically, reducing reliance on overseas smelting and refining. It has the potential to add about $377 million to Copper World’s after-tax NPV, Hudbay says. The project will strengthen U.S. copper supplies as demand grows from manufacturing, infrastructure, electrification and national security industries, Hudbay says. “Copper World is one of the most attractive copper growth projects in the Americas, offering some of the highest copper grades, lowest cash costs and favourable capital intensity,” Hudbay CEO Peter Kukielski said in the statement. “This project adds more than 100,000 tonnes of annual copper production over the first 10 years, and the DFS demonstrates the full potential of the project in the extension case, delivering higher annual copper production for more than 30 years.”

title: 【动乱】陈光诚、高瑜、蔡霞推荐袁立的三点评论
summary: 蔡霞 X @realcaixia · 4h 很赞同高瑜姐的推文，尤其是最后一段话：遑论中国，在“政治正确”“进步主义”包容鼓励之下的社会大骚乱，正在巴黎、法国和欧洲蔓延，包括美国发生过的“黑命贵”和反对以色列支持巴勒斯坦（哈马斯）运动。 世界各地的社会大动乱都是在相通的意识形态鼓动之下发生的。 我加一句话：据说鼓动这些骚乱的金主现在住在上海。鼓动和参与这些骚乱的背后组织，有打着镰刀斧头旗帜的，有鼓吹共产主义的。 —————————————— 高瑜 @gaoyu200812 ·
content: 蔡霞   X @realcaixia  ·  4h 很赞同高瑜姐的推文，尤其是最后一段话：遑论中国，在“政治正确”“进步主义”包容鼓励之下的社会大骚乱，正在巴黎、法国和欧洲蔓延，包括美国发生过的“黑命贵”和反对以色列支持巴勒斯坦（哈马斯）运动。 世界各地的社会大动乱都是在相通的意识形态鼓动之下发生的。 我加一句话：据说鼓动这些骚乱的金主现在住在上海。鼓动和参与这些骚乱的背后组织，有打着镰刀斧头旗帜的，有鼓吹共产主义的。 —————————————— 高瑜 @gaoyu200812 · Oct 20 為 袁 立 的 三 條評論點贊 。 袁 立 斥責中國“公知”具有紅衛兵意識，一點不為過。 有一商榷：“只不过就是一群识字的红卫兵。” 紅衛兵還是識字的，只不過被毛澤東中斷了學業，當年才疏學淺罷了。1977年恢復高考，紅衛兵中不少人繼續學業，成為為政權服務的“公知”。 何家棟先生有一評論：“ 紅衛兵是識字的義和團，義和團是不識字的紅衛兵 。”批判了中國半個多世紀以來，在盲目的意念和意識形態驅動下發生的兩場反社會的運動。義和團運動有幾十萬人參加，紅衛兵運動規模大得多，達到1300萬人。袁立批判的當今“公知”中存在的紅衛兵意識，追朔上去，有辱斯文,確實可追述到“刀槍不入”，“扶清滅洋”的義和團運動. 遑論中國，在“政治正確""進步主義"包容鼓勵之下的社會大騷亂，正在巴黎、法國和歐洲蔓延，包括美國發生的“黑命貴”和反以色列支持巴勒斯坦運動。 世界各地的社會大動亂都是在相通的意識形態鼓動之下發生的。 陈光诚 Guangcheng Chen  X @iguangcheng · Mar 7, 2025 不怕不識貨就怕貨比貨，顯而易見：袁立的見識非比尋常，那些只會讀死書的書呆子的認知怎能與之相提並論。 以下文字节选自袁立写在川普胜选日的文章。非常值得好好阅读。 “为什么那么多的中国文人，法律人，媒体记者特别讨厌川普，甚至上升为仇恨？并给支持川普的人，贴上标签叫做川粉？ 第一，他们讨厌川普，是因为中国文人骨子里有士大夫情结，他们受儒家文化的影响，把人分成了三六九等。在他们眼里，商人算什么？不入流，如何可以去参政议政？成何体统？从政，只有他们才配。中国文人历来对商人的理解就是：商人重利轻别离。殊不知受海洋文明的影响，真正的商人是：自由至上，契约精神至上，他们以追求独立、自由、价值创造、价值实现，公平交换，守约，效率、创新和公平。如果有一天中国社会真正能做到有契约精神，中国社会就会开始改变。 第二，那么他们为什么又上升为仇恨，甚至给人贴标签呢？是因为受了文革的影响，社会是一个仇恨的伤痕氛围，他们不是给人贴标签，就是别人给他们贴标签，他们曾经是臭老九，现在是公知。所以他们也习惯给别人贴上川粉的标签，以此来羞辱别人。  第三，他们大多没有信仰甚至贬低信仰，对信仰不屑一顾。他们不知道基督信仰，成就了今天的科学，医学，法律，宪政。没有基督教在中国开创的大学，他们连大学都没见过。现在他们跟在西方左派媒体的屁股后面吃屎，因为他们并没有系统的懂得西方的政治、历史，甚至简单的英语，甚至美国为什么变得如此的败坏，他们都不懂其中原因。 他们极其的傲慢又极其的可怜，他们的处境是令人同情的，但这是他们自己选择的。这样的文人水平段位根本没有力量带领中国走出困境，进入应许之地，上帝也不会使用他们。   无论是个人乃至国家都有自己的命运。 圣经说，【人种的是什么，收的就是什么！】 最后我想以一句经文，告诉他们，【神阻挡骄傲的人，赐恩照亮给谦卑的人。】 那些动不动就骂川普和川普支持者的人，只不过就是 一群识字的红卫兵 。

title: 12-year-old girl dies from influenza A complications in Hong Kong
zh_title: 香港12岁女孩死于甲型流感并发症
summary: 香港一名有基础健康问题的12岁女童感染甲型流感后，因感染性休克、弥散性血管内凝血及多器官功能衰竭死亡。卫生防护中心报告本流感季出现25宗严重儿科个案，并呼吁接种疫苗。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日 18:46 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 A患有基础疾病的12岁女孩感染流感后死亡
content:
香港
一名有基础健康问题的12岁女童感染甲型流感后，因感染性休克、弥散性血管内凝血及多器官功能衰竭而死亡。卫生防护中心报告本流感季出现25宗严重儿科个案，呼吁接种疫苗。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 21 日 18:46 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

一名患有基础疾病的 12 岁女孩在感染甲型流感后死亡，流感导致感染性休克、弥散性血管内凝血和多器官衰竭。据卫生防护中心（CHP）称，该患者于 10 月 20 日死亡。

该女孩于10月19日出现发烧、咳嗽和腹泻，随后出现呕吐。 10月20日晚，她的病情恶化，被送往东区医院急症​​室，并出现心脏骤停。她苏醒过来并被送进儿科重症监护室。她的呼吸道样本检测出甲型流感病毒呈阳性。
初步调查显示，该名女童在潜伏期内没有外游，也没有接种2026/27季节性流感疫苗。她的一名家庭接触者最近出现了轻微的上呼吸道症状，但不需要住院治疗。案件将转交死因裁判官调查。

卫生防护中心主任庄淑君医生表示，香港自六月下旬开始进入流感季节，持续近四个月，活动仍维持高水平。本季共录得25例儿童重症流感病例，与上季同期持平。

庄博士呼吁公众不要低估流感，并采取预防措施，包括接种疫苗。对去年数据的分析显示，未接种疫苗的儿童患严重并发症或死于流感的可能性是接种疫苗的儿童的五倍左右。在疗养院65岁或以上的长者中，未接种疫苗的人患严重流感的可能性比接种疫苗的人高出约四倍。
庄博士指出，广泛的社区传播导致感染和重症病例大幅增加。自9月学校重新开放以来，学校已报告近460起流感样疾病疫情，影响约2,800人。预计未来几周流感活动将保持在高水平。学校外展疫苗接种计划通过健康电子记录系统引入了新的电子同意功能，已有约 960 所学校参与。外展预计将于12月中旬完成，比去年提前了大约两周。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
A 12-year-old girl with underlying health conditions died from septic shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation and multiple organ failure after contracting influenza A. The Centre for Health Protection reported 25 severe paediatric cases this flu season and urged vaccination.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 18:46 HKT · 2 min read

A 12-year-old girl with underlying health conditions has died after contracting influenza A, which led to septic shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation and multiple organ failure. The patient died on 20 October, according to the Centre for Health Protection (CHP).

The girl developed fever, cough and diarrhoea on 19 October, followed by vomiting. Her condition deteriorated on the evening of 20 October, and she was taken to the accident and emergency department of Eastern District Hospital, where she experienced cardiac arrest. She was resuscitated and admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit. Her respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A virus.

Preliminary investigations showed the girl had not travelled abroad during the incubation period and had not received the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine. One of her household contacts had recently developed mild upper respiratory symptoms, but did not require hospitalisation. The case will be referred to the Coroner for investigation.

Dr Chuang Shuk-kwan, Director of the CHP, said Hong Kong has been in its influenza season since late June, lasting nearly four months, with activity remaining at a high level. This season has recorded 25 severe cases of influenza among children, the same number as the same period in the previous season.

Dr Chuang urged the public not to underestimate influenza and to take preventive measures, including getting vaccinated. Analysis of last year's data showed that unvaccinated children were about five times more likely to suffer severe complications or die from influenza than vaccinated children. Among elderly residents of care homes aged 65 or above, unvaccinated individuals were about four times more likely to develop severe influenza than those vaccinated.

Dr Chuang noted that widespread community transmission had led to a significant increase in infections and severe cases. Since schools reopened in September, nearly 460 influenza-like illness outbreaks had been reported in schools, affecting about 2,800 people. Influenza activity is expected to remain at high levels in the coming weeks. The school outreach vaccination programme has introduced a new electronic consent function via the Health e-Record System, with about 960 schools already participating. Outreach is expected to be completed by mid-December, about two weeks earlier than last year.

## Details

AI connectivity is the backbone of your governance strategy, but the ecosystem underneath it won't stop moving. New models, new agents, new attack surfaces, every quarter. A governance plan built for today's stack breaks by next quarter's.
 So how do you build one that holds?

Join this live, interactive session and bring your real questions. Submit the governance challenges you're actually facing: budget overruns, policy sprawl, agent access control, compliance across teams, whatever's keeping you up at night. Walk away with a curated roadmap for planning and implementing your AI governance program. Not a generic framework. A plan built around where you are right now and where the market is headed next.

You'll leave with:

*   A framework for governance that adapts as models, agents, and tooling change, instead of one you have to rebuild every quarter
*   Answers to your specific governance questions, submitted live and addressed in the session
*   A curated roadmap for planning and implementing your AI governance program, built around where your organization stands today

## Details

**TICKETS: $10**
_**Must be purchased on [Valorie's Website](https://www.valorielewis.com/events-1/psychic-development-games-10-22-26).**_
_**Meetup event link will redirect you to purchase a ticket on my website.**_

**Psychic Game Night** is a playful, interactive experience where you'll explore different psychic skills through a variety of fun challenges and group activities. One game might have you tuning into hidden objects. Another might invite you to describe unseen images, practice telepathy, work with symbolic impressions, or experiment with classic ESP exercises. Every activity is designed to help you practice your intuition in a relaxed, supportive environment.

There are no grades, no pressure, and no expectation that you'll get everything "right." The goal is to experiment, discover how your intuition works, and enjoy the experience alongside others who are just as curious as you are.

Whether you're brand new to psychic development or you've been exploring your gifts for years, you'll have opportunities to participate at your own comfort level while cheering each other on along the way.

Bring your curiosity, your sense of humor, and an open mind!

## Details

Our fourth Friday drum circle. 7pm at Unity Church. (Remember to come through the back entrance of the church.)

The shaman performs a powerful ceremony, using her Divine drum to guide participants through spiritual journeys while honoring ancestral wisdom traditions.

Throughout history, female shamans have served as spiritual leaders and healers across diverse cultures. These powerful women maintain sacred and Divine connections between human communities and the Spirit world.
 Modern ethnographic studies reveal that female shamanic traditions continue today, with practitioners often distinguished by symbolic items like ceremonial drums—instruments that create rhythmic pathways between realms.
 This contemporary female shamans frequently blends ancestral practices with modern spiritual Supernatural Christ approaches, preserving ancient wisdom while adapting to present-day contexts. Her ceremonies often involve community gatherings where healing energy and spiritual guidance are shared.

Enjoy your time of relaxation, meditation and journey with THE Shaman of Omaha. Your journey will be unique and personal. And POWERFUL. Enjoy this time.
 There are plenty of comfortable chairs but you can also bring yoga mat and a pillow if you would prefer.

Donations are split between church and shaman.

## Details

I have lived in 6 countries, traveled to 45 and all 7 continents, and checked everything off my very extensive travel bucket list by the age of 36.

Ask me anything.

Whether you would like to travel more, are itching to live the digital nomad life, or just want to hear some cool stories from around the globe, join me to chat about life, travel, and the pursuit of happiness.

If you’d like to know more about me and my story in the meantime, check out [https://www.nicoleelysejourneys.com](https://www.nicoleelysejourneys.com/) and my talk on “Why getting robbed at gunpoint in Colombia is the best thing that’s ever happened to me.”

This is not a sales pitch. I do do travel coaching if you want more targeted help getting started, but that’s not what we’re here to talk about. I just like meeting fellow travelers and wannabe travelers.

summary: 香港 香港于10月21日发布酷热天气警告，气温接近33°C。中文大学教授将高温归因于超强台风占比的下沉空气、超强厄尔尼诺现象削弱季风以及全球变暖。该警告可能会打破最新发布的记录。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日 11:30 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港报》天文台于西日早上6时45分发出酷热天气警告

香港
香港于10月21日发布酷热天气警告，气温接近33°C。中文大学教授将高温归因于超强台风占比的下沉空气、超强厄尔尼诺现象削弱季风以及全球变暖。该警告可能会打破最新发布的记录。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 11:30 香港时间 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港天文台周三早上6时45分发出酷热天气警告，十月底市区气温飙升至摄氏33度左右，新界部分地区的气温甚至更高。

预计气温将打破此前于2024年10月19日发布的一年中最新高温天气纪录。如果本周五（10月23日）气温达到33摄氏度或以上，也将成为有记录以来最热的霜降节气，超过2006年创下的31摄氏度的纪录。

香港中文大学地球与环境科学系教授兼副系主任戴佩权周三上午在电台节目中解释说，这次不合季节的热浪是由三大因素综合作用造成的。
首先，截至今天早上8点，位于马尼拉东北偏东约1,040公里处的超强台风“占比”产生的外层下沉气流，加上香港上空的反气旋，导致空气下沉，风力减弱。这减少了云量和降雨量，让强烈的阳光直接给城市供暖。

其次，超级厄尔尼诺现象改变了热带环流模式，在南海和菲律宾造成了异常的反气旋环流。这抑制了对流活动，并显着削弱了通常在秋季使该地区降温的东北季风。由于季风的降温作用大幅减弱，热量容易在局部积聚。此外，厄尔尼诺现象往往会将台风路径推向更北的地方，远离香港；然而，由于海面温度极高，任何接近的台风都会蒸发更多的水分和热量，从而加剧风暴的强度。

第三，全球变暖导致总体基准温度升高。当短期天气异常和气候现象叠加在已经因全球变暖而扭曲的基线上时，气温将明显高于历史平均水平。

戴补充说，超厄尔尼诺现象的影响预计将持续到明年春天，这意味着香港可能会经历反常的暖冬。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong issued a Very Hot Weather Warning on 21 October as temperatures neared 33°C. A professor from Chinese University attributed the heat to Super Typhoon Champi’s subsiding air, a Super El Niño weakening the monsoon, and global warming. The warning may break the record for latest issuance.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 11:30 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Very Hot Weather Warning at 6.45am on Wednesday as late-October temperatures soared to around 33 degrees Celsius in urban areas, with parts of the New Territories recording even higher figures.

The temperature is expected to break the record for the latest issuance of a Very Hot Weather Warning in a year, previously set on 19 October 2024. If temperatures reach 33 degrees Celsius or above this Friday (23 October), it will also mark the hottest Frost's Descent solar term on record, surpassing the previous record of 31 degrees Celsius set in 2006.

Amos Tai Pui-kuen, professor and deputy chair of the Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, explained on a radio programme on Wednesday morning that this unseasonable heat wave is caused by the compounding effects of three major factors.

First, the outer subsiding air currents from Super Typhoon Champi, located about 1,040 kilometres east-northeast of Manila as of 8am this morning, coupled with an anticyclonic aloft over Hong Kong, led to sinking air and weakened winds. This reduced cloud cover and rainfall, allowing intense sunlight to directly heat the city.

Second, a Super El Niño altered tropical circulation patterns, creating an anomalous anticyclonic circulation over the South China Sea and the Philippines. This suppressed convective activity and significantly weakened the northeast monsoon that typically cools the region in autumn. With the monsoon's cooling effect drastically reduced, heat easily accumulated locally. Additionally, El Niño tends to push typhoon paths further north, away from Hong Kong; however, due to extremely high sea surface temperatures, any approaching typhoon will evaporate more moisture and heat, fueling the storm's intensity.

Third, global warming has raised the overall baseline temperature. When short-term weather anomalies and climate phenomena are superimposed on a baseline that is already warped by global warming, temperatures rise significantly above historical averages.

Tai added that the impact of the Super El Niño is expected to persist through next spring, meaning Hong Kong is likely to experience an unseasonably warm winter.

content:
香港国际机场 (HKIA) 表示，由于过境旅客和来自中国大陆的游客大幅增加，9 月份旅客吞吐量为 486 万人次，比去年同期增长 10.2%。香港国际机场。资料图片：香港政府一站通。机场管理局周二表示，上个月“所有主要交通区域均实现稳定增长”，航班数量增长 7%，达到 32,000 架次，货运量增长 6.3%，达到 433,000 吨。当局表示，两位数的旅客增长主要是由过境旅客推动的，而游客人数也同比增长了 5%。该公司在一份声明中表示：“从地区来看，大多数市场均录得增长，其中中国大陆的贡献最为强劲，而中东地区的下滑继续放缓。”自二月份美国和以色列对伊朗发动军事打击以来，香港和中东之间的航班受到干扰，引发了海湾地区更广泛的地区冲突。香港国际机场离境大堂。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这些数字表明香港国际机场今年迄今表现强劲，在 2026 年前三个季度接待了 4,910 万名旅客和超过 30 万个航班。去年同期，机场接待了 4,470 万名旅客和超过 29 万个航班。
与此同时，根据机场管理局的数据，9月份转运和进口的货运量也有所增长，分别增长了26.9%和9.2%。“东南亚和中国大陆是[货运]的主要增长动力，抵消了7月份[欧盟]取消最低免税额后欧洲货运量的下降，”管理局表示。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong International Airport (HKIA) has said it handled 4.86 million passengers in September – up 10.2 per cent from the same period last year – thanks to strong upticks in transit passengers and visitors from mainland China. Hong Kong International Airport. File photo: GovHK. The Airport Authority said on Tuesday that there was “steady growth across all key traffic areas” last month, with flights growing seven per cent to over 32,000 and cargo volume increasing 6.3 per cent to 433,000 tonnes. The double-digit passenger growth was driven primarily by transit passengers, while visitor arrivals also increased five per cent year on year, the authority said. “Regionally, most markets recorded growth, with the strongest contribution from the Chinese Mainland, while decline in the Middle East continued to ease,” it said in a statement. Flights between Hong Kong and the Middle East have been disrupted since the US and Israel launched military strikes on Iran in February, triggering wider regional conflicts across the Gulf. The Departure Hall at Hong Kong International Airport. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The figures signify a strong performance from HKIA so far this year, as it handled 49.1 million passengers and more than 300,000 flights over the first three quarters of 2026. The airport processed 44.7 million passengers and just over 290,000 flights in the same period last year. Meanwhile, cargo volume also grew in September on transshipments and imports, which increased 26.9 per cent and 9.2 per cent respectively, according to the Airport Authority. “Southeast Asia and the Chinese Mainland were the main growth drivers [for cargo], offsetting the decline in volume in Europe following the removal of the [European Union’s] duty-free de minimis exemption in July,” the authority said.

## Details

**[Wake Up Together](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)**[](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)is an online meditation community that was established in 2020 by Trina Truong and partners. Our mission is to help support individuals in maintaining a solid meditation practice through practicing in an accessible and open-minded community. We meet every day, virtually. While we are rooted in the Vipassana-Insight tradition, our approach is also inclusive to all Buddhist meditation practices such as anapanasati (mindfulness of the breath), Metta (loving-kindness), body scans, Zen, ton glen, and others.

The space that our meditators come to know is one that expresses itself as welcoming and embodying all views and interpretations of spirituality.

We hold the commitment to remain humble and vulnerable in our role as the door openers to the individual's inner journey. We aspire to shape the experience for participants to experience serenity, clear-seeing and profound understanding of the mind, and the [no] self through the practices, the guidance, the teachings, and the reflections offered in group sharing.

To solidify this spiritual aspiration is to make a commitment to sit in community with a predetermined frequency or as often as you can.
 We welcome you to join our beloved community!
**[Register to Join](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdJF26i6aTbMKLzw53MiwlehbsGaJG5qmVBPQEWwQ6WCOirKg/viewform)**

These guided meditations are offered daily and given freely. There
 are no up-front fees. Wake Up Together is 100% donation based,
 relying on your support and generosity.

Momo Crawlers, we’re asking for your help.

The disaster at the Nepal-Tibet border has left thousands displaced from their homes, and the full scope of the crisis is still being realized. Many Momo Crawl vendors and volunteers remain concerned for loved ones who are still missing.

Through friends and family, we’ve established contact with mutual aid networks on the ground in Nepal. They are also providing us with live updates on the aid groups they’re seeing, what those groups are accomplishing, and where additional support is most needed.

Our plan is to allocate funds according to the feedback we receive from our contacts in Nepal. In addition to mutual aid groups and NGOs, we anticipate directing a significant portion of proceeds to the Nepali government’s [Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/). This fund accepts digital payments, and we encourage you to donate directly if you prefer: [](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/)[https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/)

We established this GoFundMe primarily for ease of use and to help us track the impact of the Momo Crawl community. We expect to keep the drive active until Momo Crawl on September 13th, 2026, but donations received now will be allocated to relief efforts on a rolling basis. We will share updates about the use of funds as information becomes available.

With love and gratitude,

The Momo Crawl team

**Alan Wan**

Donation protected

Dear Friends,

My name is Alan, and I am writing this with a sincere and humble heart.

I am a Chinese political dissident living in Houston, Texas. Because of my beliefs and my willingness to speak openly about freedom, human rights, and justice, I have faced serious threats and intimidation from the Chinese government. These pressures have made it impossible for me to safely return to China, where my family still lives. Every day, I carry the pain of being separated from my loved ones, uncertain when—or if—I will ever be able to reunite with them again.

Beyond the emotional suffering, I am now facing severe financial hardship. Due to restrictions and complications surrounding the transfer of my personal funds from abroad, I have been unable to access resources that I once depended on for survival. My savings are rapidly disappearing, and I am now struggling simply to cover basic daily necessities such as food, housing, transportation, and medical care.

This situation has left me feeling isolated and vulnerable. I never imagined that standing by my principles would lead to such profound personal sacrifice, but I continue to hold onto hope.

Today, I am reaching out with deep humility to ask for your support. Any assistance—whether financial help, practical resources, or connections to organizations that aid individuals in political exile—would mean more than words can express. Your kindness could help me maintain stability during this incredibly difficult chapter of my life and allow me to continue moving forward with dignity.

I am not asking for luxury, only for the chance to live safely and meet my most basic needs while I navigate these extraordinary challenges.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Your compassion, understanding, and support would be a lifeline during one of the hardest periods of my life.

With deepest gratitude,

Alan

title: Hang Seng slides 319 points on tech losses and UK bank tax plan
zh_title: 恒生指数因科技亏损和英国银行税收计划下跌 319 点
summary: 受科技权重股和英国银行税务担忧拖累，香港股市周二下跌 1.32%，恒生指数收报 23,867 点。在有报道称英国计划征税后，联想股价暴跌近 10%，汇丰银行和渣打银行股价也下跌。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 20 日 16:42 HKT · 2 分钟阅读港股受科技和金融热潮拖累，周二收盘跌幅扩大
content:
商务
受科技权重股和英国银行税务担忧拖累，港股周二下跌 1.32%，恒生指数收报 23,867 点。在有报道称英国计划征税后，联想股价暴跌近 10%，汇丰银行和渣打银行股价也下跌。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 20 日 16:42 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

受科技及金融权重拖累，港股周二收盘延续跌势，联想(0992)跌近10%，且有报道称英国计划向银行征税。

恒生指数跌 319 点，跌幅 1.32%，报 23,867 点，全日成交额 1,900 亿港元。科技股指数下跌 1.52%，至 4,045 点。

据外媒报道，英国财政大臣约翰·希利计划在其第一份预算中对银行征税，该预算将于10月28日公布。所得款项将为特定群体的临时生活费用支持计划提供资金。受此消息影响，总部位于英国的银行汇丰银行(0005)和渣打银行(2888)的股价分别下跌3.34%和4.29%。

汇丰银行将于下周二召开董事会委员会会议，审议2026年第三季度盈利公告以及是否派发2026年第三次普通股中期股息。
在近期全球科技股普遍遭遇抛售的情况下，科技巨头继续下跌，联想暴跌 9.98%，成为表现最差的蓝筹股。宁德时代（3750）周二晚些时候将公布第三季度财报，股价下跌 6.58%，泡泡玛特（9992）下跌 4%。其他主要科技公司，包括阿里巴巴(9988)和腾讯(0700)，分别下跌3.58%和1.77%。

与此同时，生物制药股豪森药业(3692)上涨8.32%，成为表现最佳蓝筹股。药明生物（2269）和京东健康（6618）也分别上涨3.84%和3.22%。

内地方面，上证综合指数上涨4.45点，或0.12%，至3,735点；深证综合指数下跌0.14%，至11,801点。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Business
Hong Kong stocks fell 1.32 per cent on Tuesday, with the Hang Seng Index closing at 23,867 points, dragged by tech heavyweights and UK bank tax fears. Lenovo plunged nearly 10 per cent, while HSBC and Standard Chartered dropped after reports of a planned UK levy.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

20 Oct 2026 at 16:42 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong shares extended their losses at the close on Tuesday, dragged down by technology and financial heavyweights, with Lenovo (0992) falling nearly 10 per cent and reports that the UK plans to levy a tax on banks.

The benchmark Hang Seng Index shed 319 points, or 1.32 per cent, to 23,867 points, with full-day turnover at HK$190 billion. The tech gauge dipped 1.52 per cent to 4,045 points.

UK Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey plans to impose a tax on banks in his first budget, to be announced on October 28, according to foreign media reports. The proceeds would fund a temporary cost-of-living support programme for specific groups. Shares of UK-headquartered banks HSBC (0005) and Standard Chartered (2888) fell 3.34 per cent and 4.29 per cent, respectively, on the news.

HSBC will hold a board committee meeting next Tuesday to review the announcement of its third-quarter 2026 earnings and whether to pay a third interim dividend on its ordinary shares for 2026.

Amid recent broader global tech sell-offs, technology heavyweights continued their losses, with Lenovo plunging 9.98 per cent as the worst-performing blue chip. CATL (3750) sank 6.58 per cent ahead of its third-quarter earnings report due later on Tuesday, and Pop Mart (9992) declined 4 per cent. Other major tech firms, including Alibaba (9988) and Tencent (0700), fell 3.58 per cent and 1.77 per cent, respectively.

Meanwhile, biopharma stock Hansoh Pharmaceutical (3692) advanced 8.32 per cent, closing as the best-performing blue chip. WuXi Biologics (2269) and JD Health (6618) also rose 3.84 per cent and 3.22 per cent, respectively.

On the mainland, the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index rose 4.45 points, or 0.12 per cent, to 3,735 points, while the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Composite Index slipped 0.14 per cent to 11,801 points.

## Details

**[Wake Up Together](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)**[](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)is an online meditation community that was established in 2020 by Trina Truong and partners. Our mission is to help support individuals in maintaining a solid meditation practice through practicing in an accessible and open-minded community. We meet every day, virtually. While we are rooted in the Vipassana-Insight tradition, our approach is also inclusive to all Buddhist meditation practices such as anapanasati (mindfulness of the breath), Metta (loving-kindness), body scans, Zen, ton glen, and others.

The space that our meditators come to know is one that expresses itself as welcoming and embodying all views and interpretations of spirituality.

We hold the commitment to remain humble and vulnerable in our role as the door openers to the individual's inner journey. We aspire to shape the experience for participants to experience serenity, clear-seeing and profound understanding of the mind, and the [no] self through the practices, the guidance, the teachings, and the reflections offered in group sharing.

To solidify this spiritual aspiration is to make a commitment to sit in community with a predetermined frequency or as often as you can.
 We welcome you to join our beloved community!
**[Register to Join](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdJF26i6aTbMKLzw53MiwlehbsGaJG5qmVBPQEWwQ6WCOirKg/viewform)**

These guided meditations are offered daily and given freely. There
 are no up-front fees. Wake Up Together is 100% donation based,
 relying on your support and generosity.

title: SDIS: Do We Really Need Political Parties?, Sat, Oct 24, 2026, 1:30 PM   | Meetup
summary: Our speaker, Christopher Baylor, PhD, previews his talk: “Democrats and Republicans disagree about a great deal, but they tend to agree on one thing: The other party is a major part of what is wrong with American politics. What if the probl
content:
Our speaker, Christopher Baylor, PhD, previews his talk: “Democrats and Republicans disagree about a great deal, but they tend to agree on one thing: The other party is a major part of what is wrong with American politics. What if the problem goes deeper than either party?

“I ask whether political parties are really as necessary to democracy as other political scientists say. Political parties provide informational shortcuts for voters and mobilize turnout, but doing so at the cost of undermining political checks and balances as well as encouraging a form of motivated reasoning toward the in-group and against the out-group. What would we gain, and what might we lose, if parties as such played a much smaller role in American political life?”

This lecture is sponsored by the [San Diego Independent Scholars](https://sdscholars.org/). The location is at the North University Community Library, 8820 Judicial Drive, San Diego, CA 92122. Attendance is free to the public. The lecture will be Zoomcast.

Speaker's Bio: Christopher Baylor is a political scientist and author of _[The Case Against Political Parties](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-032-10891-3)_ (2026, Palgrave Macmillan) and _[First to the Party: The Group Origins of Political Trans­form­ation](https://www.pennpress.org/9780812249637/first-to-the-party/)_ (2018, Univ. of Pennsylvania Press). His research focuses on American political parties, interest groups, and political reform. His writings have been published by _Studies in American Political Development_, _Political Science Quarterly_, the _Washington Post_, and _Fortune_. He received his doctorate from the University of California, Los Angeles and received his master’s degree from Brown University. He was also a Congressional Fellow in Washington, D.C., where he worked in the U.S. House of Representatives. He has taught at Wellesley College, the College of the Holy Cross, and currently as a lecturer at UCLA.

All are welcome to be a part of our evening service. Experience not necessary. Those of any faith or lack thereof are welcome. All that is required is an open mind to learn how to promote wellness, happiness, love, and peace to oneself and all sentient beings. Typically a service will include the following:

*   Check in. (How you’re doing.)
*   Silent meditation, seated on cushion, chair, or one of the pews.

*   Sutra recitation and discussion. (Sutras are the written Dharma teachings.)
*   Much love and laughter.

content:
USNI 新闻图 这些是根据海军和公开数据，截至 2026 年 10 月 19 日，美国海军在世界各地部署的航母打击群和两栖战备群的大致位置。如果 CSG 或 ARG 正在进行分类操作，图表会反映主力舰的位置。在日本，2026 年 10 月 2 日，美国海军陆战队与布拉沃连、第 31 海军陆战队远征部队第 1 海军陆战团第 1 营登陆队在日本冲绳白滩海军设施进行小型船只技能训练。美国海军陆战队照片 USS Tripoli (LHA-7) 正在日本佐世保港口。据船舶观察员称，西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰 (CVN-71) 于周五抵达，周一从日本横须贺出发。第 9 航母战斗群由西奥多·罗斯福号、第 11 舰载航空联队 (CVW)、第 23 驱逐舰中队、第 9 信息战中队和提康德罗加级导弹巡洋舰长津号 (CG-65) 组成。 2026 年 10 月 13 日，隶属于尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 的第 9 航母战斗群水手长副官何塞·勒布朗在扇尾处瞭望。美国海军照片 航母西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71)，母港为加利福尼亚州北岛海军航空站。第 11 号航空母舰西奥多号航空联队罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日驶入日本横须贺舰队活动司令部。
美国海军照片 攻击战斗机中队 (VFA) 154 的“黑骑士” – F/A-18F – 来自加利福尼亚州勒莫尔海军航空站。攻击战斗机中队 (VFA) 211 的“将死者” – F/A-18E – 来自弗吉尼亚州奥希纳海军航空站。攻击战斗机中队 (VFA) 25 的“舰队之拳” – F/A-18E – 来自勒莫尔海军航空站。攻击战斗机中队 (VFA) 86 的“响尾蛇”——F-35C——来自勒莫尔海军航空站。电子攻击中队 (VAQ) 137 的“白鸦” – EA-18G – 来自华盛顿州惠德比岛海军航空站。机载指挥与控制中队 (VAW) 115 – E-2D 的“自由钟” – 来自加利福尼亚州穆古角海军航空站。舰队后勤多任务中队 30 (VRM-30) Det 的“泰坦” _ – CMV-22B – 来自加利福尼亚州北岛海军航空站。直升机海上打击中队 (HSM) 75 的“狼群” – MH-60R – 来自北岛海军航空站。直升机海上作战中队 (HSC) 8 的“八人”——MH-60S——来自北岛海军航空站。防空指挥官长津号航空母舰 (CG-65)，母港位于加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥海军基地。 第 23 号驱逐舰中队 23 号驱逐舰中队驻扎在加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥海军基地，登上了西奥多·罗斯福号。保罗·汉密尔顿号航空母舰 (DDG-60)，母港为圣地亚哥海军基地。迪凯特号航空母舰 (DDG-73)，母港为夏威夷珍珠港海军基地。
2026 年 9 月 11 日，阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰查菲号 (DDG-90) 上的水手在与无人水面舰艇 (USV) 海鹰进行加油演进期间执行管线操作。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福 CSG 还部署了中型无人水面舰艇 (MUSV) 海鹰。在太平洋海军陆战队中士。 10 月 17 日，第 13 海军陆战队远征队第 2/4 营登陆队的安东尼·肯普夫 (Anthony Kempf) 在圣安东尼奥级两栖船坞运输船 USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) 的机库湾中清理隶属于海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364（加强型）的 CH-53 Stallion 的对抗系统。 2026 年，美国海军照片两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 正在太平洋沿岸航行

summary: **6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING ro
content:
**6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING room at bliss available M-SU 8AM-8PM. We have implemented an in-house scheduling calendar that Practitioners may reference to determine an available mutually beneficial time if the recommended time below is not convenient for you.**

**This is a private 1-hour session. Please RSVP directly to the Practitioner to book the session time and then go to [givetobliss.com](http://givetobliss.com/) to make a $33 donation via VENMO (no fees), PayPal or credit card. Thank you!**

**Reiki** is a Japanese energy healing technique developed in the early 1900’s by Mikao Usui to stimulate health and vitality through channeling life force energy. While promoting a deep state of relaxation, Reiki therapy may reduce stress, anxiety, and pain through gentle touch and transferring of energy. The practitioner delivers this energy through their hands to assist in improving the recipients biofield flow and balance on the physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual levels. By having a tranquil effect on the mind and body, Reiki promotes healing and restoration while having a favorable influence on the parasympathetic and autonomic nervous systems.

**Access Bars** was developed by Gary Douglas as a set of tools and processes applied to facilitate more consciousness. As a restorative modality, Access Bars involves the practitioner connecting with 32 points on participants head through gentle touch. This contact facilitates the release of negative energetic thought forms, ideas, beliefs, emotions, and considerations that create barriers. As energetic blockages are discharged, a rebalancing occurs making room for improved thought patterns. Results may include a more peaceful mind, relaxed body, improved outlook, stress relief, more energy, and feeling replenished. Measurements of electrical activity of the brain conducted after an Access Bars treatment were shown to have literally calmed brain activity down.

**Facilitator: Lisa Ann Helmly,MS,RDN,LDN, [lisa@lisahelmly.com**](http://lisa@lisahelmly.com**/)

*   Holy Fire III/Karuna Reiki Master
*   Certified Kundalini Reiki Practitioner
*   Certified Access Bars Practitioner
*   Passionate about inspiring people to optimize their health and wellbeing.
*   Small changes yield big results.

As a Low Country Native, Lisa is enthused to share complimentary integrated healing and restorative modalities to promote optimal health and well-being. Holding a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration equipped Lisa to gain experience in the corporate environment, flip residential housing properties, and continue managing her rental property business. Completing a Master of Science in Nutrition as a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist prepared Lisa for working in the medical sector assisting patients with a variety of illnesses, disease states, and conditions. During this time to the present, Lisa pursued further studies in alternative and integrative health practices attaining multiple credentials. While working in these areas, Lisa continued serving in her roles as a mother, daughter, sister, and friend.

**Sounds Productive Right? Does Being More Productive Support Health and Well-Being?**

“Getting busier does not necessarily make you better…affectively managing your stress does!”

You really didn’t think all of that activity was done perfectly with complete ease and grace, did you? Of course not. As Lisa was stressed out creating elevated levels of cortisol and adrenaline, this lack of balance was in opposition to a positive state of health and well-being. How ironic is that behavior? Lisa more fully understands how stress and being out of balance can have a negative impact on the mind and body. Sometimes the vehicle that drives a person to do, may eventually run them over. Hypothetically speaking, imagine being in a hit and run accident driven by yourself in your very own car. Can you relate now? The coping mechanism of burning the candle at both ends is comfortable because it is familiar. However, the candle may eventually burn out.
 If there is one commonality that we all have in this human experience, it’s managing our own life stressors. Add a dose or two of trauma along the way and what do you get…**Amplified Stress with Triggers.** The well-being sessions are offered here for interested participants to explore complementary and integrative approaches on processing and managing stress to ultimately feel and function better. You are invited to take this peaceful exploration on optimizing your own health and happiness.

# Stop Canceling Plans — Why Hiding at Home Is Ruining Your Vibe

[![Image 7: Photo of the user Feel The Vibe ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/3/a/e/4/thumb_325395076.jpeg?w=96) ![Image 8: Badge for Feel The Vibe ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/next/images/avatar/super-organizer.webp?w=48) Hosted by Feel The Vibe . and jadahearl Feel The Vibe . is a Super Organizer](https://www.meetup.com/feel-the-vibe-meetup/events/317046502/attendees/)

[![Image 9: Photo of Feel The Vibe group](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/c/e/1/2/event_529732754.jpeg?w=3840) ### Feel The Vibe](https://www.meetup.com/feel-the-vibe-meetup/)

## Details

You know the feeling. Thirty minutes before you’re supposed to leave, you type out “so sorry, something came up” and hit send. And for a second, it’s incredible. The couch gets softer. Your shoulders drop. You did it. You’re safe.

That relief doesn’t last long. By tomorrow it’s quietly turned into something else. A slightly smaller world. One more Saturday spent exactly where you started. A calendar that’s getting emptier every time you choose the couch over the door.

Here’s the part nobody tells you: that relief isn’t proof you made the right call. It’s just your brain rewarding you for dodging something uncomfortable, with zero regard for how the isolation compounds later.

You don’t need to fix this by forcing yourself through every single plan from now on. You just need one rule that makes showing up feel possible again. Something like, go for twenty minutes, and if it’s still too much, you’re allowed to leave. Most of the time, the dread fades faster than expected, and the twenty minutes turns into the whole night without you even noticing.

This Online Meetup is for anyone who’s been canceling more than showing up lately. We’re talking about the relief trap, why the version of tonight in your head is almost always worse than the real thing, and how to rebuild a little trust with yourself, one small, low stakes plan at a time.

Come for twenty minutes. See what happens.

title: Taiwan Coast Guard to Acquire MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USVs
zh_title: 台湾海岸警卫队将采购 MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USV
summary: 台湾海岸警卫队与 MARTAC 签署协议，根据美台合作生产防务协议购买 Devil Ray T24 自主水面舰艇。 MARTAC 新闻稿 美国领先的全自动无人水面舰艇 (USV) 供应商海事战术系统公司 (MARTAC) 今天宣布，台湾海岸警卫队管理局 (CGA) 正在采购数量不详的 Devil Ray T24 自主水面舰艇。此次销售是迄今为止美国制造的无人水面航行器最重要的国际采购之一，突显了全球对先进无人管理器的需求不断增长
content:
台湾海岸警卫队与 MARTAC 签署协议，根据美台合作生产防务协议购买 Devil Ray T24 自主水面舰艇。 MARTAC 新闻稿 美国领先的全自动无人水面舰艇 (USV) 供应商海事战术系统公司 (MARTAC) 今天宣布，台湾海岸警卫队管理局 (CGA) 正在采购数量不详的 Devil Ray T24 自主水面舰艇。此次销售是迄今为止美国制造的无人水面航行器最重要的国际采购之一，突显了全球对先进无人海上能力不断增长的需求。这一机会是通过 MARTAC、国立中山科学技术研究院 (NCSIST) 和儒学股份有限公司在 2025 年台北航空航天与国防技术展览会 (TADTE) 期间签署的三方谅解备忘录 (MOU) 实现的。 MARTAC 在台湾的当地合作伙伴孔儒和台湾国有国防研究与发展机构 NCSIST 是推动这一计划从框架协议到采购的关键合作伙伴。该交易条款涉及联合生产模式，其中多艘无人水面航行器将在 MARTAC 战略合作伙伴之一位于佛罗里达州埃奇沃特的工厂生产，其余部分则由台湾儒学制造。
这一合作生产安排反映了双方致力于加强台湾国内工业基础，同时利用 MARTAC 成熟的设计和制造专业知识的承诺。MARTAC 首席增长官 Seamus Flatley 表示：“台湾海岸警卫队的这一追求对于 MARTAC 以及印度-太平洋地区采用无人水面舰艇来说是一个里程碑式的时刻。” “此次多船收购的规模验证了我们系统的运营能力和可靠性，并展示了我们与 NCSIS 和 Confucian 建立的合作伙伴关系的战略价值。” MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USV 采用 Mantas T12 作为有效载荷。玛塔克图片。 “除了MARTAC领先的技术之外，台湾政府选择MARTAC的最重要原因之一是该公司从一开始就愿意在台湾建立联合制作，”孔儒首席执行官李詹姆斯说。 “这是台湾海岸警卫队的第一个无人水面舰艇（USV）计划，使其成为具有重大国家意义的项目，并引起了政府高层领导的密切关注。” Devil Ray T24 是一艘长 27.5 英尺（8.4 m）的高性能自主水面舰艇，突发速度超过 50 节。 T24 旨在支持海岸警卫队和军事组织在复杂的海洋环境中执行各种任务。
该交易的联合生产部分预计将为美国和台湾创造劳动力发展机会，促进供​​应链整合并促进符合原始谅解备忘录条款的技术共享计划。此次出售进一步巩固了MARTAC作为盟国USV解决方案领先供应商的地位，并强化了美国制造的自主海事平台在支持印太地区合作伙伴的安全和海域意识需求方面的重要性。 – 完 – 台湾海岸警卫队将采购 MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USV 的消息首先出现在《海军新闻》上。

Taiwan’s Coast Guard signs an agreement with MARTAC to acquire Devil Ray T24 autonomous surface vessels under a U.S.-Taiwan co-production defense deal. MARTAC press release Maritime Tactical Systems, Inc. (MARTAC), a leading U.S. provider of fully autonomous unmanned surface vessels (USVs), today announced that the Taiwan Coast Guard Administration (CGA) is acquiring an undisclosed number of Devil Ray T24 autonomous surface vessels . The sale represents one of the most significant international purchases of U.S.-manufactured USVs to date, underscoring the growing global demand for advanced unmanned maritime capabilities. The opportunity was made possible through the tripartite Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signed by MARTAC, the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology (NCSIST), and Confucian Co., Ltd. during the 2025 Taipei Aerospace & Defense Technology Exhibition (TADTE). Confucian, MARTAC’s local partner in Taiwan, and NCSIST, Taiwan’s state-owned defense research and development institution, have served as key partners in advancing this initiative from a framework agreement to procurement. The terms of the deal involve a co-production model, with a number of USVs to be manufactured at one of MARTAC’s strategic partner’s facility in Edgewater, Florida, with the remainder built by Confucian in Taiwan. This co-production arrangement reflects the partnership’s commitment to strengthening Taiwan’s domestic industrial base while leveraging MARTAC’s proven design and manufacturing expertise. “This pursuit by the Taiwan Coast Guard represents a landmark moment for MARTAC and for the adoption of unmanned surface vessels in the Indo-Pacific region,” said Seamus Flatley, Chief Growth Officer, MARTAC. “The scale of this multi-vessel acquisition validates the operational capability and reliability of our systems and demonstrates the strategic value of the partnership we established with NCSIST and Confucian.” MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USV featuring a Mantas T12 as a payload. MARTAC picture. “In addition to MARTAC’s leading technology, one of the most important reasons the Taiwan government selected MARTAC was the company’s willingness, from the very beginning, to establish co-production in Taiwan,” said Confucian’s Chief Executive Officer James Lee. “This is the Taiwan Coast Guard’s first Unmanned Surface Vessel (USV) program, making it a project of significant national importance that has attracted close attention from senior government leadership.” The Devil Ray T24 is a 27.5 foot (8.4 m) high-performance autonomous surface vessel capable of burst speeds exceeding 50 knots.  The T24 is designed to support a  wide range of missions  for coast guard and military organizations operating in complex maritime environments. The co-production element of the deal is projected to create workforce development opportunities in both the United States and Taiwan, foster supply chain integration and facilitate technology-sharing initiatives consistent with the terms of the original MOU. The sale further solidifies MARTAC’s position as a leading provider of USV solutions to allied nations and reinforces the importance of U.S.-manufactured autonomous maritime platforms in supporting the security and maritime domain awareness needs of partners across the Indo-Pacific. – End – The post Taiwan Coast Guard to Acquire MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USVs appeared first on Naval News .

summary: 香港一名九岁男孩因侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病入院一天后死亡。香港大学儿科医生表示，自2024年8月开始使用的15价疫苗可以更好地控制血清型3，并建议有需要的儿童补充剂量。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 19 日香港时间 10:35 · 1 分钟阅读 A 以前健康九岁男孩入院一天后死于侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病
content:
香港
一名九岁男孩因侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病入院一天后死亡。香港大学儿科医生表示，自2024年8月开始使用的15价疫苗可以更好地控制血清型3，并建议有需要的儿童补充剂量。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 19 日，香港时间 10:35 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

一名原本健康的九岁男孩因并发症入院一天后死于侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病。据香港电台报道，该男童在潜伏期内没有出国旅行。

香港大学儿科及青少年医学名誉临床副教授关日华医生在香港电台千禧年节目中表示，侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病是一种严重的细菌感染，尤其影响儿童和长者。并发症可能包括脑膜炎，可能导致死亡或永久性残疾；细菌进入血液可导致多器官衰竭；溶血性尿毒症综合征（红细胞自发分解）可导致急性肾衰竭。
关医生指出，侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病的病例相对较少，因为自2009年以来，政府已为在香港出生的婴儿接种疫苗，并敦促65岁及以上的人士接种疫苗。当病例零星发生时，需要进行调查以确定原因，包括患者是否接种过疫苗以及免疫系统是否存在问题。

关医生表示，侵袭性肺炎球菌有超过90种血清型，其中以3型血清型最为可怕，因为它很容易导致病情突然恶化和并发症。他表示，之前的13价疫苗未能很好地控制血清型3，而自2024年8月起，香港已改用15价疫苗，预计将有助于控制疾病。他补充说，有需要的个别儿童可以接种补充剂量的 15 价疫苗。

关博士还表示，侵袭性肺炎球菌是通过飞沫传播的，并敦促公众勤洗手并戴口罩作为预防措施。

Hong Kong
A nine-year-old boy died a day after hospital admission from invasive pneumococcal disease. A Hong Kong University paediatrician said the 15-valent vaccine, in use since August 2024, better controls serotype 3 and advised children in need to get top-up doses.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

19 Oct 2026 at 10:35 HKT · 1 min read

A previously healthy nine-year-old boy has died from invasive pneumococcal disease, a day after being admitted to hospital with complications. The boy had not travelled abroad during the incubation period, according to RTHK.

Dr Kwan Yat-wah, honorary clinical associate professor of paediatrics and adolescent medicine at the University of Hong Kong, said on the RTHK programme _Millennium_ that invasive pneumococcal disease is a serious bacterial infection that particularly affects children and the elderly. Complications can include meningitis, which can cause death or permanent disability; bacteria entering the blood can lead to multiple organ failure; and haemolytic uraemic syndrome, in which red blood cells break down spontaneously, can cause acute kidney failure.

Dr Kwan noted that cases of invasive pneumococcal disease are relatively rare because since 2009 the government has vaccinated infants born in Hong Kong and has urged people aged 65 and above to get vaccinated. When cases occur sporadically, investigations are needed to determine the cause, including whether the patient had been vaccinated and whether their immune system had problems.

There are more than 90 serotypes of invasive pneumococcus, Dr Kwan said, with serotype 3 the most frightening because it can very easily cause a sudden deterioration and complications. He said the previous 13-valent vaccine did not control serotype 3 well, and since August 2024 Hong Kong has switched to the 15-valent vaccine, which is expected to help control the disease. Individual children who need it can receive a top-up dose of the 15-valent vaccine, he added.

Dr Kwan also said invasive pneumococcus is transmitted through droplets, and urged the public to wash hands frequently and wear masks as preventive measures.

Published: 9:30am, 25 Sep 2026

Hong Kong’s first five-year plan marks an unprecedented milestone not only for its economic and social development, but also for how it governs itself. The plan, which drew on 16,000 public submissions – roughly 80 per cent from ordinary citizens – is a testament to the government’s commitment to long-term development, which shows an unusual convergence of public consensus and political will.

For a city long accustomed to letting the market hold the reins, crafting a [road map](https://www.scmp.com/topics/hong-kongs-first-5-year-plan?module=inline&pgtype=article) clear in aims, precise in methods and univocal in stance – and placing itself as the primary agent responsible for its execution – is an act of political self-reinvention. It betokens a willingness to embrace the role of direction setter and reform executor, to be held accountable for outcomes five years down the road rather than merely navigate short-term challenges at hand.

Hong Kong’s reorientation away from a market-led approach indicates not only an upgrade of policy tools, but also a recalibration of governance philosophy.

## Details

[Blood on the Clocktower (BotC)](https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/240980/blood-on-the-clocktower)is currently the #1 rated party game on [Boardgamegeek.com!](http://boardgamegeek.com!/) We are so pleased that the local community playing BotC at Spielbound has grown such that multiple simultaneous games are being run at each of our BotC meet ups!

In November, the BotC meetup is scheduled for Monday, November 2 from 5:30 - 10:30 PM ... and Spielbound is reserving the *entire* Annex (up to 50 attendees~) for this event! Halloween weekend just passed; you are welcome to attend in costume! Dress up as your favorite BotC character!!!!

* A day pass is required to join this special event ($6 per person on Mondays or current Spielbound member); please check in with the front cafe staff when you arrive.
 * Those who have never played 'Blood on the Clocktower' at Spielbound are welcome to attend this event for free to try it out!
 * Storytellers will be on hand to explain the game rules to novice players, starting at 5:30 PM~

_More on the game:_
 Blood on the Clocktower is a game of murder and mystery, lies and logic, deduction and deception for five-to-twenty courageous players and one devious storyteller.

A social game played in person, seated in a circle, each player receives either a ‘good’ or ‘evil’ token with their unique character on it. Good players share information to solve the mystery whilst evil players lie about who they are and what they know. The good team wins if they can piece together their knowledge, trust each other, and execute the demon. The evil team wins if the demon can sow distrust, evade detection, and wipe out the village.

## Details

**[Wake Up Together](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)**[](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)is an online meditation community that was established in 2020 by Trina Truong and partners. Our mission is to help support individuals in maintaining a solid meditation practice through practicing in an accessible and open-minded community. We meet every day, virtually. While we are rooted in the Vipassana-Insight tradition, our approach is also inclusive to all Buddhist meditation practices such as anapanasati (mindfulness of the breath), Metta (loving-kindness), body scans, Zen, ton glen, and others.

The space that our meditators come to know is one that expresses itself as welcoming and embodying all views and interpretations of spirituality.

We hold the commitment to remain humble and vulnerable in our role as the door openers to the individual's inner journey. We aspire to shape the experience for participants to experience serenity, clear-seeing and profound understanding of the mind, and the [no] self through the practices, the guidance, the teachings, and the reflections offered in group sharing.

To solidify this spiritual aspiration is to make a commitment to sit in community with a predetermined frequency or as often as you can.
 We welcome you to join our beloved community!
**[Register to Join](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdJF26i6aTbMKLzw53MiwlehbsGaJG5qmVBPQEWwQ6WCOirKg/viewform)**

These guided meditations are offered daily and given freely. There
 are no up-front fees. Wake Up Together is 100% donation based,
 relying on your support and generosity.

title: 澳警方突击检查华人区，捣毁两家非法赌场，多名华人被拘
summary: 维州警方调查墨尔本北区及东区涉嫌制造毒品的案件，至今已拘捕29人。 调查中还发现了两家分别设于Carnegie和华人区Box Hill的物业内的非法赌场。与此同时，警方在附近多个地点搜出毒品、武器、非法烟草及大笔现金。 目前被拘留的外国籍人士中，包括3名中国籍人士和2名马来西亚籍人士。警方预计会以毒品相关罪名，通过传票起诉其他涉案人员。 报道称，警方在墨尔本东区发现了这两家非法赌场，并拘捕了29人；这起行动是范围更广的涉嫌毒品制造调查的一部分。 警探在Carnegie、Box
content: 维州警方调查墨尔本北区及东区涉嫌制造毒品的案件，至今已拘捕29人。 调查中还发现了两家分别设于Carnegie和华人区Box Hill的物业内的非法赌场。与此同时，警方在附近多个地点搜出毒品、武器、非法烟草及大笔现金。 目前被拘留的外国籍人士中，包括3名中国籍人士和2名马来西亚籍人士。警方预计会以毒品相关罪名，通过传票起诉其他涉案人员。 报道称，警方在墨尔本东区发现了这两家非法赌场，并拘捕了29人；这起行动是范围更广的涉嫌毒品制造调查的一部分。 警探在Carnegie、Box Hill、Balwyn North及South Melbourne执行搜查令时，发现枪支、砍刀、剑和匕首等武器，另外查获了60万澳元现金、非法烟草和电子烟、7公斤冰毒及5公斤氯胺酮。 在7月的调查初期阶段，警方先是在墨尔本北区Bundoora一处物业内拘捕了9人。这些人涉嫌与一个犯罪集团有关。 其中包括两名马来西亚籍人士、一名中国籍人士，以及一名来自泰国的女子。 一名38岁的马来西亚籍人士被控持有用于贩运的物质、设备或材料，并处理赃物。 另一名29岁的马来西亚籍人士则被控贩运冰毒、持有仿制枪支、疏忽处理犯罪所得，以及使用虚假文件。 一名27岁的中国籍男子被控持有冰毒和违禁武器，并贩运烟草及电子烟。 一名25岁的泰国女子被控持有冰毒，以及持有一套被盗的警察制服。 上述4人仍被拘留。至于在该物业被捕的另外5人，警方预计会通过传票，以多项毒品罪名起诉他们。 到了8月，警方调查组的探员在Carnegie发现一处疑似正在运作的非法赌场。 警方指称，赌场内设置了多个赌博房间；当时共有15人参与非法赌场，其中两人为赌场工作人员。 警方逐一问话后释放这15人，并预计会通过传票，以明知是犯罪所得仍进行处理，以及身处提供未经授权赌博活动的场所等罪名起诉他们。 10月15日，警方在相关调查行动中，又对位于South Melbourne的一处物业执行了搜查令。 一名40岁的South Melbourne女子被捕，并被控多项罪名，包括贩运大量、达到商业规模的冰毒、持有可卡因及持有违禁武器。 再发现一家非法赌场，一名中国籍人士被捕 5天后，警方搜查Box Hill一处物业时，发现第二家非法赌场。 现场拘捕了两名涉嫌经营赌场的人。 一名43岁的中国籍人士被控处理疑似犯罪所得的财产，以及身处提供未经授权赌博活动的场所。 警方表示，该名男子仍被拘留。 另一名49岁、来自Balwyn North的男子也预计会因类似罪名被传票起诉。 同一天，侦探还搜查了Box Hill的Whitehorse Road上一处地址。警方据称在现场发现现金及手写账本，显示该场所曾进行大规模赌博活动。 警方在该处拘捕一名59岁的Box Hill女子，她据称是赌场工作人员。 警员搜查Balwyn North一处物业时，发现更多现金和赌场筹码，以及4支枪支、其他武器、大量烟草和毒品制造设备。 一名45岁的Balwyn North女子被捕。警方预计会通过传票，以处理据信属于犯罪所得的财产及枪械相关罪行起诉她。 维州警方调查组侦缉督察Carlie Kohler在声明中表示，这些拘捕行动有助于瓦解在社区运作的毒品集团。 她说：“揭发这些赌场并终止场内的非法活动，有助于把毒品和武器清出街头。这些拘捕行动是我们致力于从各个层面瓦解有组织犯罪的重要一环。我们需要任何掌握非法毒品进口、制造或贩运信息的人挺身而出提供线索。”

title: Society for Hong Kong Studies to disband after 9 years citing lack of funding

summary: 香港研究学会（SHKS）是一个为香港研究提供全球平台的本地学术团体，宣布将在九年后解散。香港大学香港研究会主办的讲座。图片：香港研究学会。 SHKS 在周三发给会员的一封电子邮件中表示，将于 10 月 31 日停止运作。该组织由 21 个国家的 250 名学者创立，并表示关闭的原因是“缺乏资金”。作为亚洲研究协会的官方附属机构，SHKS 自 2017 年起主办了年度会议
content:
香港研究学会（SHKS）是一个为香港研究提供全球平台的本地学术团体，宣布将在九年后解散。香港大学香港研究会主办的讲座。图片：香港研究学会。 SHKS 在周三发给会员的一封电子邮件中表示，将于 10 月 31 日停止运作。该组织由 21 个国家的 250 名学者创立，并表示关闭的原因是“缺乏资金”。作为亚洲研究协会的官方附属机构，SHKS 自 2017 年以来一直举办年度会议、学术研讨会和研讨会，以及有关香港历史、文学、电影、媒体、流行文化和政治的公开讲座。该非营利组织还发表研究成果，并与世界各地的其他香港研究项目合作。该协会表示，它对“过去十年在香港研究方面取得的进步表示感谢”。新会执行委员会成员包括香港大学著名香港历史学者约翰·卡罗尔主席和香港中文大学（中大）新闻与传播学院前院长李伯贤教授。 “纯粹是由于资助”历史学家约翰·卡罗尔。照片：香港大学研究博客。
当地报纸《明报》周四在其定期政治专栏中表示，近年来，当地大学在举办活动时尤其是那些涉及校外参与者的谨慎态度，给新会带来了不利影响。《明报》专栏写道：“这使得租用场地变得越来越困难，为本来应该在公民社会中占据一席之地的社团和非政府组织留下了更少的生存空间。”香港大学的约翰·卡罗尔在回应《明报》时表示，关闭“纯粹是因为资金原因”。卡罗尔补充说，SHKS没有得到大学的任何财政支持，也缺乏继续自行运营的筹款能力。截至今年2月，自2020年北京实施国家安全法以来，香港已有60多个组织——包括工会、教会、媒体团体和政党——解散。这一趋势在2021年下半年加速，香港民主运动的许多历史堡垒在几个月内崩溃。

【原文 English Original】
The Society for Hong Kong Studies (SHKS), a locally based academic community providing a global platform for the study of Hong Kong, has announced it will dissolve after nine years. A talk hosted by the Society for Hong Kong Studies at the University of Hong Kong. Photo: Society for Hong Kong Studies. In an email sent to members on Wednesday, the SHKS said it will cease operations on October 31. The group, founded by 250 scholars in 21 countries, cited a “lack of funding” for the closure. An official affiliate of the Association for Asian Studies, the SHKS has since 2017 hosted an annual conference, workshops and seminars for academics, and public lectures on the city’s history, literature, films, media, pop culture, and politics. The non-profit also published research and collaborated with other Hong Kong studies initiatives around the world. The Society said it was grateful to “have advanced Hong Kong studies for the past decade.” SHKS executive board members include chair John Carroll, a renowned scholar of Hong Kong history at the University of Hong Kong (HKU), and Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) professor Francis Lee, former director of CUHK’s School of Journalism and Communication. ‘Purely due to funding’ Historian John Carroll. Photo: HKU Research Blog. Local newspaper Ming Pao said in its regular political column on Thursday that the SHKS was adversely affected by local universities’ caution around hosting events in recent years – particularly those involving participants from outside their campuses. “This has made renting venues increasingly difficult,” the Ming Pao column read, “leaving less space for the survival of societies and NGOs that should otherwise hold a place in civil society.” In response to Ming Pao, HKU’s John Carroll said the closure is “purely due to funding.” Carroll added that the SHKS does not receive any financial support from universities, and it lacks the fundraising capacity to continue operating on its own. As of February this year, over 60 organisations – including unions, churches, media groups, and political parties – have disbanded in Hong Kong following the imposition of Beijing’s national security law in 2020. The trend accelerated in the second half of 2021, with many historic bastions of Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement crumbling within months.

title: 警方突袭 Box Hill 地下赌场，多名涉案华人落网
summary: 澳洲广播公司 10 月 23 日报道，维州警方在调查墨尔本北区、东区涉毒案件期间，一举捣毁两处地下赌场，多名中国籍嫌疑人落网。 警方查明，两处地下赌场分别设在 Carnegie 以及华人聚居区 Box Hill 的物业内。行动中，探员还在周边多个地点查获毒品、武器、非法烟草以及大额现金。 本次行动被拘留的外籍人员包含 3 名中国籍、2 名马来西亚籍人士。警方后续还计划传唤其他涉案人员，追究毒品相关罪责。 本周早些时候，警方就在 Box Hill 一处非法赌场抓获一名男子 探员
content: 澳洲广播公司 10 月 23 日报道，维州警方在调查墨尔本北区、东区涉毒案件期间，一举捣毁两处地下赌场，多名中国籍嫌疑人落网。 警方查明，两处地下赌场分别设在 Carnegie 以及华人聚居区 Box Hill 的物业内。行动中，探员还在周边多个地点查获毒品、武器、非法烟草以及大额现金。 本次行动被拘留的外籍人员包含 3 名中国籍、2 名马来西亚籍人士。警方后续还计划传唤其他涉案人员，追究毒品相关罪责。 本周早些时候，警方就在 Box Hill 一处非法赌场抓获一名男子 探员持搜查令，对 Carnegie、Box Hill、Balwyn North 以及 South Melbourne 多处地点展开搜查，起获枪支、砍刀、长剑、匕首等各类武器，同时查获 60 万澳元现金、非法烟草与电子烟、7 公斤冰毒以及 5 公斤氯胺酮。 这项调查最早始于 7 月，警方当时在墨尔本北区 Bundoora 的一处物业拘捕 9 名涉嫌关联某犯罪集团的人员。 被捕人员当中有两名马来西亚籍男子、一名中国籍男子以及一名泰国女子。 一名 38 岁马来西亚籍男子被控持有用于毒品贩运的物质、设备或材料，以及处理赃物；另一名 29 岁马来西亚籍男子被控贩运冰毒、持有仿制枪支、疏于处置犯罪所得、使用虚假文件。 一名 27 岁中国籍男子被控持有冰毒、违禁武器，以及非法贩运烟草和电子烟；一名 25 岁泰国女子被控持有冰毒，并且持有一套被盗警用制服。 上述四人目前仍处于羁押状态，同址被捕的另外五人，警方拟通过传票形式，以多项毒品罪名对其提起诉讼。 进入 8 月，调查人员在 Carnegie 排查时，发现一处正在运营的非法赌场。 警方称该场所内设多个赌间，事发时有 15 人在场参与赌博，其中两人为赌场工作人员。警方现场问询后释放这 15 人，后续计划发传票，以处置犯罪所得、在未经许可的赌博场所逗留等罪名起诉他们。 10 月 15 日，专案组继续开展联动搜查，对 South Melbourne 一处物业执行搜查令。一名 40 岁的 South Melbourne 女子被捕，面临多项指控，包括商业规模大宗冰毒贩运、持有可卡因以及持有违禁武器。 时隔五天，警方搜查 Box Hill 另一处物业，查获第二家地下赌场，当场抓获两名涉嫌经营赌场的人员。 一名 43 岁中国籍男子被控处置疑似犯罪所得财产、在未经许可的赌博场所逗留，该男子现已被拘留。 警方在墨尔本东区 Box Hill 非法赌场内查封赌桌 另一名 49 岁、居住在 Balwyn North 的男子，警方将以同类罪名传票起诉。 同日，探员还搜查了 Box Hill Whitehorse Road 的一处地址，现场搜出现金与手写账本，证据显示这里曾开展大规模赌博活动。警方拘捕一名 59 岁 Box Hill 女子，其被指为赌场工作人员。 在 Balwyn North 一处住宅的搜查中，警员找到更多现金、赌场筹码，还起获 4 支枪支、其余武器、大批烟草以及制毒设备，并抓获一名 45 岁 Balwyn North 女子。警方拟通过传票，以处置疑似犯罪所得财产、涉枪相关罪名对其追责。 维州警方调查组侦缉督察 Carlie Kohler 在通报中表示，系列抓捕行动将有力打击扎根本地的贩毒集团。 她称：“查处这些赌场、取缔场内非法活动，能够减少流入街头的毒品与武器。本次一系列拘捕，是我们多层次打击有组织犯罪的关键举措。我们呼吁掌握毒品进口、生产或贩运线索的民众主动向警方举报。”

title: Typhoon Champi prompts school, office closures in most of Taiwan - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台风“占比”导致台湾大部分地区学校和办公室关闭 - 焦点台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月22日电 地方政府周四表示，受台风“占比”影响，除台东县以及离岛澎湖、马祖外，台湾本岛各地的学校和办公室将于周五停课。截至晚上 8 点周四，基隆、台北、新北、桃园、新竹市县、苗栗、台中、彰化、南投、云林、嘉义市县、台南、高雄、宜兰、花莲、屏东、连江等地方政府宣布周五停课。台东县政府宣布兰屿及绿地学校及办公室停课
content:
中新社台北10月22日电 地方政府周四表示，受台风“占比”影响，除台东县以及离岛澎湖、马祖外，台湾本岛各地的学校和办公室将于周五停课。

截至晚上 8 点周四，基隆、台北、新北、桃园、新竹市县、苗栗、台中、彰化、南投、云林、嘉义市县、台南、高雄、宜兰、花莲、屏东、连江等地方政府宣布周五停课。

台东县政府宣布兰屿、绿岛学校及办公室停课，金门县照常办公。

截至下午 5 点CWA数据显示，周四，“占比”以台湾最南端鹅銮鼻以东约450公里为中心，以每小时18公里的速度向西北移动，预计将转向西北偏北。

据CWA称，台风中心附近的最大持续风速为每秒48米，波弗特级7级或以上的风速半径为320公里，10级或以上的风速为160公里。

周四早些时候，CWA 发布了覆盖台湾主岛的陆地警告，并表示当天晚些时候可能将警告范围扩大到澎湖和马祖。

中国气象局天气预报中心副主任伍婉华周四晚表示，预计台风周五和周六移动缓慢，接近台湾时可能会出现不稳定移动。
吴说，预计从周五深夜到周六清晨，风暴中心将在距离台湾最近的地点80公里以内，但仍有可能登陆。

她说，从周四晚上开始，降雨量将会增加，预计周五到周六早上降雨量最大。

周五，台湾北部和东北部将出现大范围阵雨，局部地区有大雨和暴雨，特别是山区。

其他地区，台湾中部和东部地区将有零星阵雨，南部和东南部地区预计有零星阵雨。 CWA表示，台中和花莲山区也可能出现大雨。

据CWA报道，周六台湾北部地区将继续出现大范围阵雨，局地可能有大雨和暴雨。台湾东部及中部山区有零星阵雨。

CWA 表示，预计风暴圈将于周六晚上离开台湾本土。

（余晓涵、石秀全撰）

结局/AW

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) Schools and offices across Taiwan's main island, except in Taitung County, as well as in the outlying islands of Penghu and Matsu, will close Friday due to Typhoon Champi, local governments said Thursday.

As of 8 p.m. Thursday, local governments in Keelung, Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu City and County, Miaoli, Taichung, Changhua, Nantou, Yunlin, Chiayi City and County, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Yilan, Hualien, Pingtung and Lienchiang had announced school and office closures for Friday.

The Taitung County government announced school and office closures in Lanyu and Green Island, while Kinmen County will operate as usual.

As of 5 p.m. Thursday, Champi was centered about 450 kilometers east of Eluanbi, Taiwan's southernmost point, moving northwest at 18 kilometers per hour and expected to turn north-northwest, CWA data showed.

The typhoon had maximum sustained winds of 48 meters per second near its center, with a radius of 320 kilometers for winds of 7 or higher on the Beaufort scale and 160 kilometers for winds of 10 or higher, according to CWA.

CWA issued a land warning covering Taiwan's main island earlier Thursday and said it could be extended to Penghu and Matsu later in the day.

Wu Wan-hua (伍婉華), deputy director of CWA's Weather Forecast Center, said Thursday evening that the typhoon is expected to move slowly on Friday and Saturday and could move erratically as it approaches Taiwan.

The storm's center is forecast to come within 80 kilometers of Taiwan at its closest point from late Friday night to early Saturday morning, with landfall still possible, Wu said.

She said rainfall would increase from Thursday evening, with the heaviest rain expected from Friday through Saturday morning.

On Friday, northern and northeastern Taiwan will see widespread showers, with locally heavy rain and torrential rain possible, especially in mountainous areas.

Elsewhere, central and eastern Taiwan will see scattered showers, while isolated showers are expected in southern and southeastern areas. Heavy rain is also possible in the mountains of Taichung and Hualien, CWA said.

According to CWA, northern Taiwan will continue to see widespread showers on Saturday, with local heavy rain and torrential rain possible. Eastern and mountainous areas of central Taiwan will see scattered showers.

The storm circle is expected to move away from Taiwan proper by Saturday evening, CWA said.

(By Yu Hsiao-han and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

Enditem/AW

title: Taiwan charges five over plot to run over comedian who joked about Xi Jinping
zh_title: 台湾指控五人密谋碾压拿习近平开玩笑的喜剧演员
summary: 检察官称，周三，台湾有五人因涉嫌攻击一名批评中国共产党的台湾单口喜剧演员而被指控。黄一豪.照片：黄一豪，来自 Instagram。台湾指责中国针对台湾的批评者加大跨国镇压力度，北京声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并威胁要使用武力将台湾置于其控制之下。据《新北职业报》报道，台湾被告据称受一名中国人雇佣，监视和殴打黄一豪，以阻止他在9月20日的一场演出中表演。
content:
检察官称，周三，台湾有五人因涉嫌攻击一名批评中国共产党的台湾单口喜剧演员而被指控。黄一豪.照片：黄一豪，来自 Instagram。台湾指责中国针对台湾的批评者加大跨国镇压力度，北京声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并威胁要使用武力将台湾置于其控制之下。新北地检署在一份声明中称，这些台湾被告据称受一名中国人雇佣，监视和殴打黄逸豪，以阻止他在 9 月 20 日的一场演出中表演。检察官称，这五人从七月开始追踪黄，并计划制造一场车祸，意图折断他的胳膊和腿，这样他就可以住院，无法上台。据称，9 月 11 日，两名被告在黄骑回家时将一辆汽车撞向他的摩托车，导致他骨盆瘀伤。检方表示，“此案涉及中共涉嫌跨境打压，指挥我国不法分子通过极端暴力镇压不同政治声音的严重事件。” 2025 年 10 月 30 日，中国国家主席习近平在韩国釜山金海国际机场航站楼出席中美双边会议。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。
他们说，其中两名被告已承认参与了伤害黄的计划。检察官表示，这五名被告“自愿为外国敌对势力服务，意图在台湾社会制造寒蝉效应”，并补充说，这次袭击表现出“极端恶意”和“对人命的漠视”。另请参阅：台湾称中国在地方选举前进行网络攻击和虚假信息事件发生后，被告获取了黄的医疗记录，以要求该中国公民支付最后一笔 450,000 新台币（13,900 美元）的款项。黄感谢调查人员，并警告说，如果中国统治台湾，言论自由将面临风险。黄在脸书上的一份声明中说：“我所做的只是在台湾的一个舞台上花了两分半钟批评（中国国家主席）习近平，但随后我遭到了扔粪便袭击和蓄意车辆袭击的攻击。” “如果人们仅仅因为批评中国共产党而遭受这种待遇，而中国共产党甚至没有统治台湾，那么如果中国共产党统治台湾，我们怎么能指望保留目前的言论自由呢？”

【原文 English Original】
Five people in Taiwan were charged on Wednesday for allegedly attacking a Taiwanese stand-up comedian after he criticised the Chinese Communist Party, prosecutors said. Huang Yi-hao. Photo: Huang Yi-hao, via Instagram. Taiwan has accused China of growing transnational repression targeting critics on the island, which Beijing claims is part of its territory and has threatened to use force to bring it under its control. The Taiwanese defendants were allegedly hired by a Chinese person to surveil and assault Huang Yi-hao to prevent him from performing at a show on September 20, the New Taipei Prosecutors Office said in a statement. The five began tracking Huang in July and planned to stage a car accident with the intention of breaking his arms and legs so he would be hospitalised and unable to go on stage, the prosecutors said. Two of the defendants allegedly rammed a car into Huang’s scooter as he rode home on September 11, leaving him with a bruised pelvis. ‘Chilling effect’ “This case involves a serious incident in which the Chinese Communist Party is suspected of using cross-border suppression tactics to direct lawless elements in our country to suppress dissenting political voices through extreme violence,” the prosectors said. Chinese President Xi Jinping attends a China-US bilateral meeting at the Gimhae International Airport terminal, in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Two of the defendants have admitted their involvement in the plan to injure Huang, they said. The five “willingly served foreign hostile forces with the intent to create a chilling effect” in Taiwanese society, prosecutors said, adding that the attack showed “extreme malice” and “disregard for human life”. See also: Taiwan says China cyberattacks, disinformation up ahead of local elections After the incident, the defendants obtained Huang’s medical records in order to request the final instalment of the NT$450,000 (US$13,900) payment from the Chinese national. Huang thanked investigators and warned that freedom of speech would be at risk if China ever ruled Taiwan. “All I did was spend two and a half minutes criticising (Chinese President) Xi Jinping on a stage in Taiwan, yet I was subsequently targeted with both a faeces-throwing attack and a deliberate vehicular assault,” Huang said in a statement on Facebook. “If people can already be subjected to this kind of treatment simply for criticising the Chinese Communist Party when it does not even govern Taiwan, how can we expect to retain our current freedom of speech if the CCP were ever to rule Taiwan?”

title: Chery open to US partnerships as China car exporter eyes North America
zh_title: 中国汽车出口商瞄准北美，奇瑞向美国开放合作伙伴关系
summary: 一位高管表示，中国最大的汽车出口商奇瑞愿意与美国汽车制造商建立合作伙伴关系，并准备在 2026 年初推出加拿大品牌。该公司面临超过 100% 的美国关税和数据安全障碍，但正在探索包括“不含中国”车辆在内的选择。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日 17:04 HKT · 1 分钟阅读奇瑞，中国最大的汽车出口商对与美国汽车制造商建立合作伙伴关系持开放态度
content:
商务
一位高管表示，中国最大的汽车出口商奇瑞愿意与美国汽车制造商建立合作伙伴关系，并准备在 2026 年初推出加拿大品牌。该公司面临超过 100% 的美国关税和数据安全障碍，但正在探索包括“不含中国”车辆在内的选择。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 17:04 香港时间 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

中国最大的汽车出口商奇瑞公司一位高管周三对路透表示，该公司对与美国汽车制造商建立合作伙伴关系持开放态度，该公司在欧洲和其他地区快速增长后，希望在北美扩张。

副总裁张查理在东部城市芜湖的奇瑞总部接受采访时表示，该公司正在为明年初在加拿大推出品牌做准备。奇瑞出售 Omoda 和 Jaecoo 品牌，是几家以传统汽车公司难以匹敌的先进技术和价格扰乱全球汽车行业的中国汽车制造商之一。
中国汽车公司实际上仍被排除在全球第二大汽车市场美国之外，它们在美国面临超过 100% 的关税和数据安全法规。张强调了奇瑞的灵活性，他说：“显然，我们正在美国寻找不同的选择。我们对不同的选择持非常开放的态度，甚至是与美国汽车制造商建立潜在的合作伙伴关系。”

张的评论是迄今为止关于奇瑞在美国的野心的最清晰的评论，尽管他没有详细说明他所设想的合作伙伴关系类型。他表示，他相信奇瑞能够找到一种瞄准美国市场的方法，并且有可能制造出一款不依赖中国硬件或软件的汽车。他说，从技术角度来看，我们肯定能够在硬件和软件方面找到不受中国影响的解决方案。

奇瑞诞生于长江之滨，其第一款汽车于1999年下线。它最初被称为Cheery，自称是一个欢快的、低成本的品牌。现在，它把自己视为质量代名词的丰田和以创新闻名的特斯拉。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Business
Chery, China's top car exporter, is open to partnerships with US automakers as it prepares for a Canadian brand launch in early 2026, a senior executive said. The company faces over 100 per cent US tariffs and data security hurdles but is exploring options including 'China-free' vehicles.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 17:04 HKT · 1 min read

Chery, China's largest car exporter, is open to partnerships with US automakers, a senior executive told Reuters on Wednesday, as the company looks to expand in North America following rapid growth in Europe and elsewhere.

Vice President Charlie Zhang said in an interview at Chery's headquarters in the eastern city of Wuhu that the company is making preparations for a brand launch in Canada early next year. Chery sells the Omoda and Jaecoo brands and is one of several Chinese automakers disrupting the global industry with advanced technology and prices that legacy car companies have struggled to match.

Chinese car companies remain effectively locked out of the United States, the world's second-largest auto market, where they face tariffs of more than 100 per cent and data security regulations. Zhang emphasised Chery's flexibility, saying: 'The US, obviously, we are trying to look for different options there. We're very open to different options, even a potential partnership with American automakers.'

Zhang's comments are some of the clearest yet about Chery's American ambitions, although he did not go into specifics about the kind of partnerships he envisions. He said he was confident that Chery would find a way to target the US, and that it would be possible to build a car that was not reliant on Chinese hardware or software. 'Definitely from a technical point of view, we will be able to find a China-free solution in terms of hardware and software,' he said.

Established on the banks of the Yangtze River, Chery's first car rolled off the assembly line in 1999. It was originally known as Cheery and billed itself as a cheerful, low-cost brand. Now it sees itself in the mould of Toyota, synonymous with quality, and Tesla, which is known for its innovation.

title: Taiwan says China cyberattacks, disinformation up ahead of local elections
zh_title: 台湾称地方选举前夕中国网络攻击和虚假信息
summary: 台湾情报机构表示，在下个月的地方选举之前，中国加大了网络攻击力度，并散布针对台湾民主的误导性信息。台湾台北，2024 年 1 月 12 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。中国声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并长期以来威胁要使用武力将其置于其控制之下。台北否认这一说法，指责中国利用网络攻击、虚假信息和间谍活动来削弱人们对台湾政府的信心。前9个月台湾平均每天遭受260万次网络攻击
content:
台湾情报机构表示，在下个月的地方选举之前，中国加大了网络攻击力度，并散布针对台湾民主的误导性信息。台湾台北，2024 年 1 月 12 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。中国声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并长期以来威胁要使用武力将其置于其控制之下。台北否认这一说法，指责中国利用网络攻击、虚假信息和间谍活动来削弱人们对台湾政府的信心。国家安全局在周二提交给国会的一份报告中表示，2026 年前 9 个月，台湾平均每天遭受 260 万次网络攻击，而且自 6 月以来这种情况有所加剧。报告称，中国的“网络军队”袭击了台湾的学术和研究部门、电信和国防供应链，以干扰“台湾政府的国防行动、破坏国际合作并窃取敏感技术”。报告称，中国网络攻击者正在利用人工智能，包括“人工智能代理来扫描我们政府网站上的漏洞”。台湾国旗。档案照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。情报官员在过去 9 个月内收集了超过 250 万条由中国执政的共产党传播的虚假信息，而去年同期则为 170 万条左右，主要是在 Facebook 和 Threads 上。
报告称，分析表明，该党“利用技术和人力等多种渠道”“影响选民的支持偏好和选举结果”。 台湾选民于11月28日前往投票站选举市县政府官员。

【原文 English Original】
Taiwan’s intelligence agency said China has cranked up cyberattacks and the distribution of misleading information against the island democracy ahead of local elections next month. Taipei, Taiwan, on January 12, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. China claims Taiwan is part of its territory and has long threatened to use force to bring it under its control. Taipei, which rejects that claim, accuses China of using cyberattacks, disinformation and espionage to erode people’s confidence in the Taiwanese government. Taiwan was hit with an average of 2.6 million cyberattacks a day in the first nine months of 2026, and that has intensified since June, the National Security Bureau said in a report submitted to parliament on Tuesday. China’s “cyber army” hit Taiwan’s academic and research sectors, telecommunications, and defence supply chains to interfere “with the Taiwanese government’s defence operations, undermine international cooperation, and steal sensitive technologies”, the report said. Chinese cyberattackers are making use of artificial intelligence, including “AI agents to scan for vulnerabilities on our government websites”, it said. The Taiwan flag. File Photo: Walid Berrazeg/HKFP. Intelligence officials collected more than 2.5 million pieces of disinformation disseminated by China’s ruling Communist Party over the nine months, compared with around 1.7 million in the same period last year, mainly on Facebook and Threads. Analysis indicates that the party has “utilised diverse channels”, including technological and human, “to influence the support preferences of our voters and the election results”, the report said. Taiwanese voters go to the polls on November 28 to elect city and county government officials.
