content: 声援李青 李青，前脚被华盛顿法官裁决释放，后脚到纽约移民局报道被ICE抓捕（10月13日）。 李青早年是一名普通访民，后逐步成长为积极的维权公民。她因在雅马哈（Yamaha）工厂一线从事琴弦生产，身体受到含辐射材料的严重伤害，被迫走上上访之路。她的丈夫随后也加入维权，她为此多次遭到当局抓捕。 后来，她的丈夫遭遇不明原因离奇身亡，尸体呈七窍流血状。当局进行了尸体解剖，却拒绝向李青及其亲属提供尸检报告。在李青多次索要报告无果、坚决拒绝火化的情况下，当局竟指使村干部冒充亲属签署火化同意书，将遗体秘密火化。为此，李青又进行了长达数年的持续上访与起诉，坚决要求公开尸检报告并追责相关违法人员，但其合法权益始终未能得到伸张。 几年前，她历经千辛万苦（据闻包括游泳渡河）逃亡来到美国。 9月中旬，她在前往中国驻美大使馆继续抗议的途中，被华盛顿DC地方警察抓捕，法官裁决释放。未曾想到她依照通知前往纽约移民局报到竟然遭到美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）抓捕。真是“麻绳专挑细处断，厄运专找苦难人。” 据朋友说因为核材料中毒，她至今每天浑身无力、全身疼痛，骨骼空洞化，皮肤组织病变等问题。其身体状况不适合被关押。因此，恳请各界朋友紧急关注这位饱经苦难和风霜的女士，并尽可能为她提供法律援助与经济支持！努力避免她被遣返回国，如果她被强制遣返，以她在中国驻美国大使馆及大使家门前抗议、上访的经历，必遭中共当局报复。 救人一命胜造七级浮屠！请美国ICE立即释放李青，还她自由！寻求民主、自由、人权、法治的人不应当在美国失去自由。 李青事件紧急关注组 2026.10.13 联署签名： 1、李双德 2、王永红 3、蔡彬 4、王军涛 5、陈立群 6、倪金芳 7、岳金福 8、龙跃 9、周君红 10、李英之 11、傅希秋 12、王安娜 13、陈紫娟 14、李昌霖 15、贾会刚 16、各旭彬 17、刘因全 18、刘海伦 19、武南希 20、刘大卫 21、刘亚伦 22、杨佳 23、王尚武 24、郝芳芳 25、界立建 26、陈劲松 27、袁哲 28、金月花 28、宫凯 29、萧云阳 30、杜海荣 31、叶荣 32、罗建社 33、蔡家炜 34、陈翔威 35、陈树广 36、贾俊伟 37、金秀红 38、王家伟 39、李尊轶 40、张杰 41、xiling zhao 42、任伟 43、康余 44、崔永 45、冯平 46、徐雪峰 47、吴平奇 48、任欢欢 49、周梅 50、彭晨宇 51、史亚怀 52、辛林 53、刘沙沙 54、宁先华 55、孙志刚 56、李荣林 57、吴士妫 58、曹丽强 59、王源浩 60、周清明 61、丁艳霞 62、姜金木 63、林胜全 64、刘瑶 65、房燕勇 66、顾远 67、刘同鹏 68、程小刚 69、李文良 79、赵启 80、魏娜 81、史庆梅 82、何兴强 83、陳維明 84、李青（洛杉矶） 85、杨长兵 86、倪世成 87、 马传兵 88、国盼 89、郑洲 90、方鹊 91、王明义 92、张勇

title: China to restrict exports of mine-building tunnel machines - The Oregon Group
summary: ## Critical Minerals and Energy Intelligence [News](https://theoregongroup.com/)>[Latest News](https://theoregongroup.com/latest-news/)>China to restrict exports of mine-building tunnel machines * China will require licences for exports of
content:
## Critical Minerals and Energy Intelligence

[News](https://theoregongroup.com/)>[Latest News](https://theoregongroup.com/latest-news/)>China to restrict exports of mine-building tunnel machines

*   China will require licences for exports of tunnel boring machines (TBMs) and their key parts to “sensitive” countries from November 18, under [an October 19 Commerce Ministry and customs announcement](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/zwgk/zcfb/art/2026/art_9ce34ccfa6c040d7a4f7622f89133be5.html)
*   Chinese manufacturers account for [nearly 70% of the global TBM market](https://en.people.cn/n3/2025/0605/c90000-20323751.html), and market leader China Railway Hi-tech claims [85% of China’s TBM market at non-coal mines](https://payneinstitute.mines.edu/china-dominates-the-market-for-machines-that-open-mines/)
*   the rules also cover cutterheads, main drives, remanufacturing technology and [wet-shotcrete machines built for work above 3,000 metres](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202610/19/WS6ad6327be4b06d4aa05639f8.html)

China has added tunnel boring machines to its dual-use export control list, extending the licensing approach it has used on [rare-earth magnets](https://theoregongroup.com/commodities/rare-earths/chinas-rare-earth-magnet-exports-to-us-fall-21-before-trump-xi-summit/) to the heavy equipment that builds underground mines.

The rules take effect on November 18. They cover shield and hard-rock TBMs, plus cutterheads, screw conveyors, segment erectors, main drive systems and the technology used to remanufacture them.

Exports to “sensitive countries and regions” in disputes with China will need a licence. Shipments elsewhere will go through a registration system, but exporters and end users must promise not to pass Chinese-made machines on to those destinations. Beijing has not said which countries count as sensitive.

That leaves a lot of buyers exposed as Chinese manufacturers account for [nearly 70% of the global TBM market](https://en.people.cn/n3/2025/0605/c90000-20323751.html), exporting about [US$793 million of rock cutters and tunnelling machinery in 2025](https://mining.com.au/china-commerce-ministry-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines/).

China’s exports of US$793 million worth of HS 843031 tunnelling machinery in 2025 is about seven times what the US exported last year, at roughly [US$109 million](https://comtradeapi.un.org/public/v1/preview/C/A/HS?reporterCode=842&period=2025&cmdCode=843031&flowCode=X&partnerCode=0); although note, the code also includes coal and rock cutters.

### The mining angle

Much of the early coverage has focused on [India’s metro, rail and border tunnels](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/china-imposes-export-controls-on-tunnel-boring-machines-sought-by-india-citing-national-security/article71602536.ece). But TBMs are increasingly used to cut declines and [access tunnels at mines](https://payneinstitute.mines.edu/china-dominates-the-market-for-machines-that-open-mines/). For example:

*   Chinese manufacturer CRCHI shipped a [5.63-metre mining TBM to Zambia’s Chambishi copper mine](https://www.tunnelsandtunnelling.com/news/crchi-exports-mining-tunnel-boring-machine-tbm-to-africa/) to bore a 9.7-km tunnel for a US$830 million project
*   Anglo American drove an [exploration tunnel of about 8.1 km](https://payneinstitute.mines.edu/china-dominates-the-market-for-machines-that-open-mines/) towards its Los Sulfatos copper prospect in Chile, finishing in 2011, and Codelco agreed in 2022 to trial a mining TBM with Komatsu
*   Ivanhoe Electric plans to start boring a [4-km decline at its Santa Cruz copper project](https://www.ivanhoeelectric.com/news/ivanhoe-electric-to-acquire-robbins-tunnel-boring-machine-and-material-handling-system-for-mine-access-development-at-the-santa/) in Arizona in the third quarter of 2027

Ivanhoe Electric’s executive chairman, Robert Friedland, has already said the controls won’t hold up Santa Cruz as its machine comes from Ohio-based Robbins, in a [package costing about US$64.7 million](https://www.ivanhoeelectric.com/news/ivanhoe-electric-to-acquire-robbins-tunnel-boring-machine-and-material-handling-system-for-mine-access-development-at-the-santa/) that includes refurbishment and a material-handling system.

“Over the past 20 years, Chinese-produced TBMs have grown from ZERO to 60-70% of the global market share,” Robert Friedland [wrote on X](https://x.com/robert_ivanhoe/status/2112126428653203466). “So, we suspect that this news will cause a PANIC in the global TBM market.”

Notably, the rules reach beyond new machines: rebuilt TBMs are common in mining outside China, and controls on cutterheads, main drives and remanufacturing technology give Beijing [a say over the rebuild cycle as well as new sales](https://payneinstitute.mines.edu/china-dominates-the-market-for-machines-that-open-mines/).

Chinese groups have also [bought up Western TBM technology](https://payneinstitute.mines.edu/china-dominates-the-market-for-machines-that-open-mines/), including France’s NFM, Aker Wirth’s TBM intellectual property and Caterpillar’s former Lovat business in Canada. Even Robbins was [61% owned by China’s NHI from 2016](https://www.worldconstructionnetwork.com/analysis/robbins-reborn-8694522/) until industry veteran Lok Home [bought back substantially all its assets](https://www.robbinstbm.com/announcement/), in a deal announced in February 2021.

### Why the impact may be limited

This is a licensing regime, however, not an embargo, with China’s Commerce Ministry [saying it will approve applications that meet the rules](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/xwfb/xwfyrth/art/2026/art_1e581b3d58ff46dabe8c44abab408d6c.html) — and Chinese makers need foreign orders.

For example, CRCHI’s overseas revenue rose to [a record 32.4% of its main-business revenue in the first half of 2025](https://payneinstitute.mines.edu/china-dominates-the-market-for-machines-that-open-mines/).

TBMs also remain a niche tool in mining. For example, at Montana’s Stillwater platinum and palladium mine, TBMs have historically cost [about a third as much to run as a conventional mining fleet](https://www.worldconstructionnetwork.com/analysis/tbms-advance-on-mines/), but needed about 1.5 times the capital.

The more likely result, [as the Payne Institute argues](https://payneinstitute.mines.edu/china-dominates-the-market-for-machines-that-open-mines/), is longer lead times and a standing option for Beijing to slow deliveries to particular countries.

But, the timing still matters. Copper miners are already struggling to add supply, as we explained in our earlier article [Refined copper surplus forecast, but copper mines struggle to keep up](https://theoregongroup.com/latest-news/coppers-104000-tonne-surplus-masks-continued-mine-supply-constraint/):

> “The forecast therefore relies on project execution, but the ICSG has already cut 2026 mine growth twice, from the 2.3% it expected in October 2025 to 1.6% in April and 1.3% now.”

Any further disruption, however marginal, threatens to tighten long-term supply further.

The controls don’t stop any mine from being built, but they give Beijing influence over how fast some of the West’s new underground copper supply gets dug.

title: Lift contractor Taizoom failed to install fire-resistant door frames in 338 buildings, gov’t probe finds
zh_title: 政府调查发现，电梯承包商 Taizoom 未能在 338 栋建筑物中安装防火门框
summary: 政府调查发现，香港电梯承包商 Taizoom Elevator 未能在全市 300 多座建筑中正确安装门框组件，继上周两个公共住宅区也发现类似缺陷。机电工程署总部位于九龙湾。照片：香港政府一站通。机电工程署（EMSD）周一表示，已检查了 383 座装有 Taizoom 安装的电梯的建筑物，发现其中 338 座缺少防烟密封组件，该组件旨在防止火灾和烟雾进入电梯井。全部 3 个
content:
政府调查发现，香港电梯承包商 Taizoom Elevator 未能在全市 300 多座建筑中正确安装门框组件，继上周两个公共住宅区也发现类似缺陷。机电工程署总部位于九龙湾。照片：香港政府一站通。机电工程署（EMSD）周一表示，已检查了 383 座装有 Taizoom 安装的电梯的建筑物，发现其中 338 座缺少防烟密封组件，该组件旨在防止火灾和烟雾进入电梯井。机电工程署在专门披露巡查进度的网页上表示，所有338处受影响的物业均为私人楼宇，其管理公司或业主立案法团已或将接获有关缺陷的通知。该署补充说：“截至目前的检查显示，所有升降机门框组件缺失的个案均与Taizoom有关，机电工程署现阶段将集中资源尽快为这些大厦安装升降机门框。”机电工程署上周透露，观塘翠屏（北）村及沙田博康村的升降机（均由Taizoom安装）门框零件缺失，构成违规。该部门表示，缺失的部件不会影响电梯的安全运行，但已指示Taizoom自费修复缺陷。翠屏(北)村。照片：维基共享资源。
该署还要求全市其他升降机承办商检查其自有的升降机并提交报告，并补充机电工程署将于11月中前在全市进行抽样检查。截至周一，机电工程署已巡查38座由其他注册升降机承办商安装的升降机的大厦，没有发现门框组件缺失的情况。机电署上周还表示，Taizoom 已向部门声称，尽管门框组件缺失，但其升降机工程已完成。 Taizoom涉嫌严重疏忽或触犯《升降机及自动梯条例》，警方正调查该承建商是否有欺诈及提供虚假陈述。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong lift contractor Taizoom Elevator failed to properly install door frame components across more than 300 buildings across the city, a government probe has found, following similar defects revealed at two public housing estates last week. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department headquarters in Kowloon Bay. Photo: GovHK. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD) said on Monday that it had inspected 383 buildings with lifts installed by Taizoom and found 338 of them were missing smoke-seal components designed to keep fire and smoke from entering lift shafts. All 338 affected properties are private buildings, and their management companies or owners’ corporations have been or will be notified of the defects, the EMSD said on a webpage dedicated to disclosing the progress of its inspections. “As inspections to date show that all cases of missing lift door frame components are related to Taizoom, the EMSD will at this stage focus its resources on installing lift door frames for these buildings as soon as possible,” the department added. The EMSD revealed last week that lifts in Kwun Tong’s Tsui Ping (North) Estate and Sha Tin’s Pok Hong Estate – both installed by Taizoom – had missing door frame parts that amounted to non-compliance. The department said the missing parts do not affect the safe operation of the lifts, but it has instructed Taizoom to repair the defects at its own expense. Tsui Ping (North) Estate. Photo: Wikicommons. It also asked other lift contractors in the city to inspect their own elevators and submit reports, and added that the EMSD will conduct sample checks across the city by mid-November. As of Monday, the EMSD had inspected 38 buildings with lifts installed by other registered lift contractors and found none with missing door frame components. The EMSD also said last week that Taizoom had claimed to the department that its lift works were completed despite the missing door frame components. Taizoom is suspected of serious negligence or misconduct under the Lifts and Escalators Ordinance, while the police are investigating whether the contractor had engaged in fraud and the provision of false statements.

title: Taiwan manufacturers' business sentiment hits 54-month high - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台湾制造商景气创54个月新高 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月23日电 台湾经济研究院([TIER](https://www.tier.org.tw/))周五表示，受全球人工智能(AI)热潮的提振，台湾出口导向型制造业9月份的商业信心升至约54个月来的最高水平，同时警告未来潜在风险。台湾领先的经济智库之一TIER编制的数据显示，衡量本地制造商商业信心的制造业综合指数较8月上涨0.50点至101.39，为2022年2月以来的最高水平。时间
content:
中新社台北10月23日电 台湾经济研究院([TIER](https://www.tier.org.tw/))周五表示，受全球人工智能(AI)热潮的提振，台湾出口导向型制造业9月份的商业信心升至约54个月来的最高水平，同时警告未来潜在风险。

台湾领先的经济智库之一TIER编制的数据显示，衡量本地制造商商业信心的制造业综合指数较8月上涨0.50点至101.39，为2022年2月以来的最高水平。

数据显示，服务业综合指数环比下跌3.15点至92.65，建筑业综合指数则止跌回升，较8月上涨2.81点至110.42。

TIER 表示，制造商继续受益于国际品牌在新产品发布（包括 iPhone 18 系列和 iPhone Duo）之前对人工智能基础设施的大规模全球投资和库存积累。

该研究所表示，国际原油价格飙升也推高了石化产品价格，而一些非科技行业完成年度检修有助于提振生产。
在 TIER 9 月份的调查中，26.8% 的制造业受访者表示当月商业状况有所改善，高于 8 月份的 19.5%，而 20.3% 的受访者表示状况恶化，低于一个月前的 25.6%。

然而，对未来六个月的预期减弱。在同一调查中，24.0%的受访者预计经营状况将改善，较8月份下降3.1个百分点；19.8%的受访者预计经营状况会恶化，较8月份上升1.8个百分点。

TIER经济预测中心主任孙明德表示，尽管有AI热潮和消费电子旺季的支撑，台湾经济仍面临风险，包括美联储可能采取更强硬的立场来抑制通胀。

孙说，美联储加息可能会导致美元兑新台币走强，从而可能促使外国机构投资者将资金撤出台湾，并导致当地金融市场波动。

孙说，中东的军事冲突可能会推高原油价格，并促使上游石化供应商提高价格，但这种提价可能会削弱下游买家的需求。

孙还指出了对人工智能发展可能放缓的担忧，这最近给全球股市带来了压力。
TIER 表示，在服务业，近期金融市场的波动使企业更加谨慎，但食品和饮料行业继续受益于需求增长。

该智库表示，在建筑方面，央行在9月中旬放松了选择性信贷控制，支撑了房地产市场，但该行业仍面临大量未售出房屋库存。

（潘子瑜、黄芳芳摄）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 23 (CNA) Business sentiment in Taiwan's export-oriented manufacturing sector rose to its highest level in about 54 months in September, buoyed by the global artificial intelligence (AI) boom, the Taiwan Institute of Economic Research ([TIER](https://www.tier.org.tw/)) said Friday, while warning of potential risks ahead.

The manufacturing sector's composite index, which gauges business sentiment among local manufacturers, rose 0.50 points from August to 101.39, its highest level since February 2022, according to data compiled by TIER, one of Taiwan's leading economic think tanks.

The composite index for the service sector fell 3.15 points month-on-month to 92.65, while the index for the construction industry rebounded from a previous decline, rising 2.81 points from August to 110.42, the data showed.

TIER said manufacturers continued to benefit from massive global investments in AI infrastructure and inventory buildup by international brands ahead of new product launches, including the iPhone 18 series and iPhone Duo.

A surge in international crude oil prices also pushed up the prices of petrochemical products, while the completion of annual maintenance by some non-tech industries helped boost production, the institute said.

In TIER's September survey, 26.8 percent of manufacturing respondents said business conditions had improved that month, up from 19.5 percent in August, while 20.3 percent said conditions had worsened, down from 25.6 percent a month earlier.

Expectations for the next six months weakened, however. In the same survey, 24.0 percent of respondents expected business conditions to improve, down 3.1 percentage points from August, while 19.8 percent expected them to deteriorate, up 1.8 percentage points.

Gordon Sun (孫明德), director of TIER's Economic Forecasting Center, said that despite support from the AI boom and the peak season for consumer electronics, Taiwan's economy still faced risks, including the possibility of the U.S. Federal Reserve taking a more hawkish stance to curb inflation.

A Fed rate hike would likely strengthen the U.S. dollar against the Taiwan dollar, potentially prompting foreign institutional investors to pull funds out of Taiwan and causing volatility in local financial markets, Sun said.

Military conflicts in the Middle East could push crude oil prices higher and prompt upstream petrochemical suppliers to raise prices, though such increases could weaken demand from downstream buyers, Sun said.

Sun also noted concerns about a possible slowdown in AI development, which have recently weighed on global stock markets.

In the service sector, recent financial market volatility has made businesses more cautious, though the food and beverage industry continued to benefit from rising demand, TIER said.

In construction, the central bank's easing of selective credit controls in mid-September supported the property market, but the industry still face a large inventory of unsold homes, the think tank said.

(By Pan Tzu-yu and Frances Huang)

title: THE BODY REMEMBERS:  Releasing Trauma Through Energy Healing with Susan Rogert, Mon, Nov 2, 2026, 7:00 PM   | Meetup
summary: Presented by Susan Rogert, Reiki Master, Teacher & Certified Medical Reiki Practitioner What if your body has been holding on to something your heart is ready to release? Some experiences leave more than memories. They leave echoes — old wo
content:
Presented by Susan Rogert, Reiki Master, Teacher & Certified Medical Reiki Practitioner

What if your body has been holding on to something your heart is ready to release?

Some experiences leave more than memories. They leave echoes — old wounds, unspoken emotions, and invisible burdens we may not even realize we're carrying.

Even when our minds have moved on, our bodies may still remember. But what if there's a gentler way to release what we've been holding and open the door to healing?

Join us for a fascinating exploration with Susan Rogert, as she takes us beyond the physical and into the unseen world of energy, where she believes the imprints of trauma can linger — and where new possibilities for healing may begin.

Drawing on nine years of working with first responders and military personnel, Susan will share what she has witnessed through her Reiki practice, how trauma may influence our energetic well-being, and how gentle energy work can offer a path toward greater peace, balance, and release.

Meet Susan Rogert
 Susan is a Reiki Master, teacher, certified Medical Reiki practitioner, and founder of Healing Home Omaha, a program devoted to offering natural energy healing practices to first responders and military personnel.

For nine years, she has dedicated herself to helping those who have carried extraordinary burdens, discovering along the way the profound connection she sees between the body's energy, our experiences, and our capacity for healing.

Susan brings something beautiful to her work: a gentle presence, a compassionate heart, and a deep respect for the healing journey of every person she encounters.

Perhaps the most extraordinary part of healing isn't what we discover we've been carrying — but what becomes possible when we finally begin to let it go.

If time permits, the talk will end with a meditation.

summary: 香港证券及期货事务监察委员会已对美味集团的三名高级管理人员和五名联系人提起诉讼，指控他们操纵股价以满足从创业板转主板的上市要求。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 22 日 16:59 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 Hong香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（证监会）再次向市场失当行为审裁处提起诉讼
content:
商务
香港证券及期货事务监察委员会已对美味集团的三名高级管理人员和五名联系人提起诉讼，指控他们操纵股价以满足从创业板转主板的上市要求。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 22 日 16:59 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（证监会）已向市场失当行为审裁处对Tasty集团的三名高级管理人员及其五名亲属、雇员和密切联系人提起诉讼，指控其计划操纵该公司股价，以便利其从香港联交所创业板转往主板的计划。

证监会指称，于2020年6月1日至9月18日期间，美味集团主席兼联合创始人黄宜山、行政总裁兼联合创始人陈伟珍以及前首席财务官余孟泰指示或协调另外五名人士——陈雪怡、黄一鸣、黄日进、黄家英和陈文——进行交易。五人被指直接或通过他人买卖Tasty Group股份，人为推高并维持股价于1.32港元左右，以满足主板转板的最低市值5亿港元的要求。
期内，公司股价由0.73港元飙升至1.36港元，涨幅达86%。证监会表示，这些交易表现出价格操纵的特征，包括在接近收市时提出激进的出价以及可能设定或影响收盘价的订单。六个交易日中，成交量占该日公司股票全部成交量。

证监会表示，个人之间的沟通包括讨论目标价格以及何时以及如何下订单。涉嫌的计划还涉及大量资金转移，资金在用于购买 Tasty Group 股票之前不久就被转移。股价于2020年7月27日首次收于1.32港元上方，公司于2020年8月5日宣布正式申请转主板，但最终没有进行计划的转板。

仲裁庭将确定是否发生任何市场不当行为，并查明参与涉嫌不当行为的任何个人。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Business
Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission has launched proceedings against three senior executives of Tasty Group and five associates, alleging they manipulated the share price to meet listing requirements for a transfer from GEM to the Main Board.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

22 Oct 2026 at 16:59 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has initiated proceedings before the Market Misconduct Tribunal against three senior executives of Tasty Group and five of their relatives, employees and close associates, alleging a scheme to manipulate the company's share price to facilitate its planned transfer from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's GEM board to the Main Board.

The SFC alleged that between 1 June and 18 September 2020, Tasty Group Chairman and co-founder Wong Yee Shan, Chief Executive Officer and co-founder Chen Wai Zhen, and former Chief Financial Officer Yu Mang Tai instructed or coordinated five other individuals — Chan Suet Yi, Wong Yat Ming, Wong Yat Chun, Wong Ka Ying and Chan Man — to conduct transactions. The five are alleged to have bought and sold Tasty Group shares, either directly or through others, artificially pushing up and maintaining the share price at about HK$1.32 to meet the minimum market capitalisation requirement of HK$500 million for a Main Board transfer.

During the period, the company's share price surged 86 per cent from HK$0.73 to HK$1.36. The SFC said the transactions exhibited characteristics of price manipulation, including aggressive bids placed near market close and orders that could set or influence closing prices. On six trading days, the transactions accounted for all trading in the company's shares for that day.

The SFC said communications among the individuals included discussions about target prices and when and how to place orders. The alleged scheme also involved large fund transfers, with money moved shortly before being used to purchase Tasty Group shares. The share price first closed above HK$1.32 on 27 July 2020, and the company announced its formal application to transfer to the Main Board on 5 August 2020, though it ultimately did not proceed with the planned transfer.

The tribunal will determine whether any market misconduct occurred and identify any individuals who engaged in the alleged misconduct.

title: Sovereign wealth inflows to China and Hong Kong surge 190pc in first nine months
zh_title: 前9个月流入中国大陆和香港的主权财富激增190%
summary: 据 CNBC 报道，2026 年前 9 个月，中国大陆和香港的商业主权财富基金投资额达到 142 亿美元，较 2025 年全年总额增长 190%，这主要是由中东基金推动的。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 22 日香港时间 17:47 · 阅读 2 分钟2026 年前 9 个月，主权财富基金在中国大陆和香港投资了 142 亿美元（1,107.6 亿港元），相当于 190%
content:
商务
据 CNBC 报道，2026 年前 9 个月，中国大陆和香港的主权财富基金投资额达到 142 亿美元，较 2025 年全年总额激增 190%，这主要是由中东基金推动的。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 22 日 17:47 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

据 CNBC 周四报道，2026 年前 9 个月，主权财富基金在中国大陆和香港的投资额为 142 亿美元（1107.6 亿港元），较 2025 年全年投资额增长 190%，主要由中东投资者推动。

报告称，这是因为主权投资者对中国技术、生物技术、消费业务和先进制造业的兴趣日益浓厚，旨在抓住中国竞争性行业的机遇。

报告援引新加坡咨询公司 Global SWF 的数据称，今年前 9 个月主权投资的强劲表现与 2025 年同比下降 54% 形成鲜明对比，当时地缘政治紧张局势和对中国经济前景的担忧抑制了投资者情绪。
在中国内地和香港的投资中，沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金出资60亿美元，阿布扎比投资局出资25亿美元。再加上阿布扎比穆巴达拉和卡塔尔投资局的8亿美元和6亿美元投资，这四个海湾财富基金占同期流入中国和香港的主权资金流入的近70%。

新加坡淡马锡首席投资官罗希特·西帕希马拉尼 (Rohit Sipahimalani) 在最近举行的米尔肯峰会上表示，生物科技是该基金在中国投资的一个特别令人兴奋的领域，本土消费品牌也拥有强大的潜力。他进一步指出，中国在人工智能硬件供应链上的竞争力不断增强，可能会让中国制造商越来越多地挑战全球参与者。

淡马锡是中国光学元件制造商中际旭创7月份在香港首次公开募股的基石投资者之一，该发行规模为534.1亿港元，这是今年亚洲第二大股票发行。 8月，卡塔尔投资局和挪威主权财富基金也加入了阿里巴巴102亿美元的股票发行。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Business
Sovereign wealth fund investments in mainland China and Hong Kong reached US$14.2 billion in the first nine months of 2026, a 190 per cent surge over 2025's full-year total, driven largely by Middle Eastern funds, CNBC reported.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

22 Oct 2026 at 17:47 HKT · 2 min read

Sovereign wealth funds invested US$14.2 billion (HK$110.76 billion) in mainland China and Hong Kong in the first nine months of 2026, a 190 per cent surge over the funds' full-year investments in 2025, driven mainly by Middle Eastern investors, CNBC reported on Thursday.

This came as interest grew among sovereign investors in Chinese technology, biotechnology, consumer businesses and advanced manufacturing, aiming to seize opportunities in Chinese competitive sectors, the report said.

The robust performance of sovereign investment during the nine months this year contrasts with the 54 per cent year-on-year decline recorded in 2025, when geopolitical tensions and concerns over China's economic outlook dampened investor sentiment, according to the report, citing data from Singapore-based consultancy Global SWF.

Among the investments in mainland China and Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund contributed US$6 billion, while Abu Dhabi Investment Authority invested US$2.5 billion. Coupled with US$800 million and US$600 million investment from Abu Dhabi's Mubadala and Qatar Investment Authority, the four Gulf wealth funds accounted for nearly 70 per cent of sovereign inflow into China and Hong Kong during the period.

Singapore's Temasek chief investment officer Rohit Sipahimalani said at the recent Milken Summit that biotechnology stands out as a particularly exciting sector for the fund to invest in China, with local consumer brands also holding strong potential. He further noted that China's rising competitiveness across the AI hardware supply chain could see Chinese manufacturers increasingly challenge global players.

Temasek was among the cornerstone investors in Chinese optical-components manufacturer Zhongji Innolight's HK$53.41 billion Hong Kong initial public offering in July - Asia's second-largest share sale this year. In August, Qatar Investment Authority and Norway's sovereign wealth fund also joined Alibaba's US$10.2 billion share offering.

title: Five-star Jansen puts Proteas in firm control
summary: For a second consecutive day, the spoils belonged to the Proteas in this pulsating Test match, with Marco Jansen emerging as the hero. The lanky left-arm seamer bagged five for 33 in 11 overs as Australia crumbled to 99 all out in their fir
content:
For a second consecutive day, the spoils belonged to the Proteas in this pulsating Test match, with Marco Jansen emerging as the hero.

The lanky left-arm seamer bagged five for 33 in 11 overs as Australia crumbled to 99 all out in their first innings in reply to South Africa’s 425 for nine declared.

By the close of play, Australia were 156 for four in their second innings after being asked to follow on for only the fourth time in their history against South Africa.

They need 170 runs to make South Africa bat again, while the Proteas need six wickets with a ball that is 54 overs old.

Marco Jansen (centre) and South Africa teammates celebrate the dismissal of Australia’s Beau Webster at St George’s Park on 21 October. (Photo: Richard Huggard / Gallo Images)

With Australia facing a first-innings deficit of 326 runs, Proteas skipper Temba Bavuma opted to enforce the follow-on despite being a bowler short, after Anrich Nortje pulled up with a groin injury midway through his third over of the day, barely an hour into play.

That was a big blow for the South African pace attack, especially coming an over after Nortje had removed the stubborn Marnus Labuschagne (14), brilliantly caught by a diving Simon Harmer in the slips.

Having come into the series after more than three years out of Test cricket due to a string of injuries, it was another miserable setback for Nortje.

### Jansen’s masterclass

Jansen took up the cudgels and produced a masterclass in aggressive but controlled left-arm seam bowling that resulted in his third five-fer in Test cricket to set up a likely Proteas victory.

The Aussies will resume on day five with the nuggety Travis Head on 87 and nightwatchman Scott Boland on two.

It was the second time in the same day Boland found himself at the crease – an unusual scenario for a regular No 10 batter – having started the day’s play after coming in as first-innings nightwatchman on day three.

Spinner Simon Harmer celebrates the dismissal of Beau Webster during Australia’s second innings on day four at St George’s Park. (Photo: Richard Huggard / Gallo Images)

If there was any doubt about whether asking Australia to follow on was the right call, you only had to see the Proteas’ premier fast bowler Kagiso Rabada’s body language to understand that his team were up to the task.

As all the players left the field at the end of Australia’s first innings, the visiting dressing room was trying to ascertain if they were being asked to bat again.

Rabada looked right at the Aussies and gave them a batting motion. When a great fast bowler is frothing to get at you again, you know you’re in for a long afternoon.

Rabada clocked one ball at 154.5km/h in the first innings with the wind at his back. That must get into any batter’s head.

### Wickets tumble

With 1½ days lost to rain, Australia resumed their first innings on the fourth morning at three for one with hopes of at least securing a draw from the match.

Things started well enough with eight runs via two fours by Head from Rabada’s opening over on a sunny fourth morning as he aligned his radar.

But with the first ball of the next over, bowled by Jansen, the first of 13 wickets on the day fell.

Fast bowler Kagiso Rabada clocked a delivery at 154.5km/h on day four of the second Test at St George’s Park. (Photo: Richard Huggard / Gallo Images)

Boland edged a rising delivery to wicketkeeper Ryan Rickelton and the Proteas were on their way. Little did he know he’d be back out there some seven hours later to reprise the role.

With Boland gone, Jansen removed Head with a beauty that moved off the seam and struck the left-hander on the pad. Although the Proteas’ appeal was subdued, and the umpire said not out, Bavuma asked for a review. It was plum. The skipper’s fine Test continued.

Labuschagne fell to Nortje soon after, leaving the great Steve Smith and first-Test hero Matt Renshaw to try to blunt the Proteas attack.

For more than an hour they managed without much fuss.

But Jansen turned the match on its head in the 30th over when he had Renshaw caught by Harmer at slip from a nasty rising delivery with his fourth ball of the over. It was a sensational catch, with Harmer flinging himself low and to his left.

Two balls later Alex Carey nicked off without scoring, and Australia were in trouble at 65/6, with only Smith from the top order remaining.

All-rounder Beau Webster (13) managed to stick around for 36 minutes but eventually was undone by another Jansen peach and a sharp catch by Aiden Markram in the slips.

Smith, meanwhile, was struggling with a neck injury, which curbed his movement. It resulted in his already awkward batting style becoming even more bizarre, as he played from an almost chest-on position due to the discomfort in his neck.

It couldn’t last, and a clearly distracted Smith was clean bowled by Wiaan Mulder for 28, the high score of the innings. But in the process, Smith went past 11,000 Test runs, to become only the third Aussie after Allan Border and Ricky Ponting to reach the milestone.

Rabada and Mulder mopped up the tail, removing Mitchell Starc (1) and Pat Cummins (7) to end the innings.

### The follow-on

Of the previous 30 times Australia have been asked to follow on in Test cricket, they have never won. They have salvaged 11 draws, though.

Another draw looks unlikely even though Head is still at the crease and Smith might be in better shape to bat on day five if needed.

Australia batter Travis Head sweeps. Head was unbeaten on 87 in Australia’s second innings and will resume his innings on day five. (Photo: Richard Huggard / Gallo Images)

Harmer was the main problem for the Aussies in their second innings, removing Labuschagne for 39, thanks to a rash attempt by the batter to hit the ball out of the park. He skied it to deep long-on, where Jansen took a good running catch over his shoulder.

Considering the strong wind that blew for much of the day, it was a trickier catch than it looked.

It was a strange shot choice by Labuschagne soon after he had successfully reviewed after being given out leg before. Instead of capitalising on his good fortune, he threw it away.

Harmer then removed Webster for eight after Rabada had earlier taken the wicket of opener Nic Maddinson (8) in the third over.

The Proteas, needing six wickets, still have a lot of work to do. But they are in the driving seat to level the series. **DM**

**Gulnisa Nazarova**

My name is Gulnisa Nazarova, and I have been an Uyghur language instructor for over 20 years. This year, as I turn 60, instead of gifts I am asking for something much closer to my heart.

My dear mother taught me how to cook. Through her hands, I learned patience, generosity, and how food carries memory. Many of the dishes she passed on come from the Uyghur tradition, a cuisine rich in history, flavor, and storytelling, yet still too little known and increasingly at risk of being forgotten.

This fundraiser supports a lifelong dream of mine: creating a cookbook dedicated to Uyghur cuisine and cultural heritage.

My connection to Uyghur culture begins with my family and upbringing. My parents and ancestors came from the Uyghur Autonomous Region, known as Eastern Turkistan to Soviet Central Asia in the mid-20th century, carrying with them their traditions, food, language, history, and stories. I grew up learning not only recipes, but also their deeper meaning — meals that bring families together, celebrations filled with memory, and dishes that carry history from one generation to the next.

Over the years, I have worked professionally to support Uyghur language and culture through teaching, writing, and sharing my knowledge with others around the world. This cookbook, however, is different. It comes directly from the heart — from meals shared with my family and from a deep desire to preserve the taste of home for future generations.

This is a personal initiative, and the funds raised will help cover:

*   Research and documentation of recipes and food stories
*   Photography and image use for the book
*   Writing and editing
*   Professional design
*   Initial publication costs

Whether you give a little or a lot, you are helping keep a culinary heritage alive.

Thank you for celebrating my 60th birthday by honoring my mother’s legacy with me.

title: Kazakhstan wealth fund raises 3b yuan with dim sum bond in Hong Kong
zh_title: 哈萨克斯坦财富基金在香港发行点心债券筹集30亿元人民币
summary: 哈萨克斯坦主权财富基金 Samruk-Kazyna JSC 通过在香港首次发行离岸点心债券筹集了 30 亿元人民币（35.3 亿港元）。这只在香港和阿斯塔纳交易所上市的两期债券获得了三倍多的超额认购，凸显了强大的投资者 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日 20:13 HKT · 2 分钟阅读哈萨克斯坦主权财富基金 Samruk-Kazyna JSC 已完成书籍
content:
商务
哈萨克斯坦主权财富基金Samruk-Kazyna JSC通过在香港首次发行离岸点心债券筹集了30亿元人民币（35.3亿港元）。该两期债券在香港和阿斯塔纳交易所上市，获得超额认购三倍以上，凸显了投资者的强烈需求。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 20:13 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

哈萨克斯坦主权财富基金 Samruk-Kazyna JSC 表示，该基金已完成簿记建档工作，并为其在香港首次发行离岸点心债券定价，筹集资金总额为 30 亿元人民币（35.3 亿港元）。

此次发行包括两期，期限分别为三年和五年，已获准在香港联合交易所（HKEX）和阿斯塔纳国际交易所（AIX）交易。其中，三年期债券规模为20亿元，年票面利率为2.15%；五年期债券规模为10亿元，年票面利率为2.3%。

该基金表示，需求超额认购三倍多，突显国际投资者对该基金的信用状况以及哈萨克斯坦发行人对离岸人民币市场的浓厚兴趣。

此次交易涉及花旗、国泰君安国际、渣打银行、中国银行、中信银行国际及工银亚洲。
据称，所得款项将用于资助 Samruk-Kazyna JSC 开展的投资项目。其补充称，发行以离岸人民币为主的债券标志着该基金多元化其融资来源和扩大国际投资者基础的战略又迈出了一步，包括通过获得离岸人民币市场的流动性，离岸人民币市场是国际债务市场增长最快的领域之一。

香港特区政府一带一路办公室发言人在社交媒体上表示，这笔交易有力地证明了香港作为“一带一路”倡议的“超级增值者”和人民币国际化的全球枢纽。它还代表了“中心对中心”合作的成果。加上哈萨克斯坦开发银行和哈萨克斯坦天然气公司在第十一届“一带一路”高峰论坛期间发行的点心债，自今年早些时候行政长官访问中亚以来，哈萨克斯坦机构已通过点心债筹集了超过100亿元人民币，标志着新的历史里程碑。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Business
Kazakhstan's sovereign wealth fund Samruk-Kazyna JSC has raised 3 billion yuan (HK$3.53 billion) through its debut offshore dim sum bond issuance in Hong Kong. The two-tranche bond, listed on the Hong Kong and Astana exchanges, was more than three times oversubscribed, highlighting strong investor d

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 20:13 HKT · 2 min read

Kazakhstan's sovereign wealth fund Samruk-Kazyna JSC has completed bookbuilding and priced its debut offshore dim sum bond issuance in Hong Kong, raising a total of 3 billion yuan (HK$3.53 billion), the fund said.

The issuance comprises two tranches with tenors of three and five years which have been admitted for trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX) and Astana International Exchange (AIX). The three-year bonds, amounting to 2 billion yuan, have an annual coupon of 2.15 per cent, while the five-year bonds, amounting to 1 billion yuan, carry a 2.3 per cent annual coupon.

Demand was more than three times oversubscribed, underscoring strong interest from international investors in the fund's credit profile and Kazakhstani issuers in the offshore yuan market, the fund said.

The transaction involved Citi, Guotai Junan International, Standard Chartered Bank, Bank of China, China CITIC Bank International and ICBC (Asia).

The proceeds will be used to finance investment projects undertaken by Samruk-Kazyna JSC, it said. The offshore yuan-dominated bond issuance marks another step in the fund's strategy to diversify its funding sources and broaden its international investor base, including by accessing liquidity in the offshore yuan market, one of the fastest-growing segments of the international debt market, it added.

A spokesperson of Hong Kong's Belt and Road Office said on social media that the deal is a solid testimony to Hong Kong as the Belt and Road Initiative's 'super value‑adder' and a global hub for yuan internationalization. It also represents the outcomes of the 'hub‑to‑hub' cooperation. Together with issuances by the Development Bank of Kazakhstan and KazMunayGas during the 11th Belt and Road Forum, Kazakh institutions have raised more than 10 billion yuan via dim sum bonds since the Chief Executive's visit to Central Asia earlier this year, marking a new historic milestone.

title: 获刑6年6个月的香港47人案之郑达鸿狱中度过其38岁生日
summary: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 10 月 20 日，本网获悉：今天，获刑 6 年 6 个月的香港 47 人案之郑达鸿狱中度过其 38 岁生日。郑达鸿因参与 2020 年民主派初选，于 2021 年被捕， 2024 年 11 月被以 “ 串谋颠覆国家政权罪 ” 判刑 6 年 6 个月。他是申请终极上诉许可的 11 名被告之一。香港终审法院已排期 2026 年 12 月 10 日举行许可聆讯。 郑达鸿 ： 1988 年 10 月 20 日出生，英文名 Tat Cheng T
content: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 10 月 20 日，本网获悉：今天，获刑 6 年 6 个月的香港 47 人案之郑达鸿狱中度过其 38 岁生日。郑达鸿因参与 2020 年民主派初选，于 2021 年被捕， 2024 年 11 月被以 “ 串谋颠覆国家政权罪 ” 判刑 6 年 6 个月。他是申请终极上诉许可的 11 名被告之一。香港终审法院已排期 2026 年 12 月 10 日举行许可聆讯。 郑达鸿 ： 1988 年 10 月 20 日出生，英文名 Tat Cheng Tat-hung ，原英属香港籍、现中华人民共和国（香港）籍人，香港岛炮台山居住公民，前北炮同盟（已解散）成员，公民党青年公民前主席、公民党副秘书长及执行委员会成员，原香港东区丹拿选区议员，中共眼里的「反中乱港分子」，泛民主派人士，中国在押政治犯。 自 12 岁起在香港岛东区北角长大，曾先后就读于张祝珊英文中学、圣士提反书院及香港理工大学，并取得社会政策及行政（荣誉）学士；大学时期，因其热衷社会事务而于 2011 年成为公民党九龙西支部实习生；来年毕业后，其正式加入公民党，并于北角开拓地区服务； 2013 年初，其到香港北角丹拿地区工作，一直跟进北角海滨规划、抗衡地产霸权、官商勾结，关注棕地发展、倡议丁屋截龙等土地政策、监察皇都戏院保育工程，并曾多次出席城市论坛作公众教育及演说等活动； 2014 年 10 月 31 日— 2016 年 10 月 7 日，曾担任公民党青年公民前主席，并在此期间还曾担任过港岛支部副主席； 2015 年，其在区议会选举中以多数票选为香港东区北角丹拿选区议员，成为首个民主派区议员； 2016 年— 2018 年，曾又获选担任公民党副秘书长，并考获香港城市大学法律博士； 2019 年，其再次参选区议会，联同党友李予信及数名素人（即无从政经验但跻身于政坛的人）组成“北炮同盟”，出选北角炮台山七区； 2020 年立法会换届选举，由于时任议员陈淑庄因占中案被判入狱而无法寻求连任，故其代表公民党接替陈淑庄出战港岛区，同年 7 月 22 日，其以港岛区第四位的得票，最终胜出泛民阵营举办的初选，但仅过 8 天，其又因多项议题的政治立场与态度被询问，包括涉及其曾签署反对港区国安法的声明、争取外国制裁、否决财政预算案等范畴，遂其竟被选举主任裁定为提名无效；同年 12 月 15 日，其在社交网站上宣布退出公民党； 2021 年 1 月 6 日，其在香港民主派初选大搜捕中遭香港警务处国家安全处拘捕，后其虽于同年 3 月 13 日取保获释，但同年 5 月 21 日，其等 12 名各区民主派议员被曝请辞，之后其又被收押候审； 2024 年 5 月 30 日，香港高等法院 3 名国安法指定法官裁定其等 47 案被告「串谋颠覆国家政权」罪成； 2024 年 11 月 19 日，其等「 47 人初选颠覆罪」案被告在西九龙裁判法院统一宣判，其因「反中乱港分子」和「不认罪」而被判囚 6 年 6 个月（ 78 个月），刑期预至 2030 年； 2024 年 12 月 13 日获悉，其因不服判决，已提起上诉。

title: Endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty offers non-surgical obesity treatment in Hong Kong
zh_title: 内窥镜袖状胃成形术在香港提供非手术肥胖治疗
summary: 香港 Dennis Lam 医生将内窥镜袖状胃成形术 (ESG) 描述为一种无疤痕手术，可将胃容量减少 70%，帮助代谢综合征患者在 12 至 24 个月内实现 15% 至 20% 的总体体重减轻，且无需腹部切口。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日 05:22 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港患者》据报道，患有严重肥胖症的香港人常常很难找到正确的治疗方法
content:
香港
Dennis Lam 博士将内窥镜袖状胃成形术 (ESG) 描述为一种无疤痕手术，可将胃容量减少 70%，帮助代谢综合征患者在 12 至 24 个月内实现 15% 至 20% 的总体体重减轻，且无需腹部切口。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 21 日 05:22 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

普通外科专家林展头医生表示，香港患有严重肥胖症的患者往往很难找到合适的治疗方法。他说，虽然腹腔镜减肥手术仍然是一种高效的金标准干预措施，但并不是每个候选人都适合或能适应大手术。

在临床实践中，患者经常表示感到陷入困境：传统的生活方式措施可能产生有限的长期效果，而外科手术感觉像是一个比他们准备采取的更大的飞跃。林博士在《标准》中写道，肥胖是一种复杂的代谢状况，而不是意志力的失败。
对于那些寻求安全替代方案的人来说，内窥镜袖状胃成形术 (ESG) 提供了宝贵的非手术中间立场。与传统手术不同，ESG 是在全身麻醉下完全通过口腔进行，无需任何腹部切口。医生使用配备专门缝合装置的柔性内窥镜，放置全层连续缝线，将胃壁向内折叠和收紧，将胃壁的容量减少大约 70%，形成一根窄管。

由于没有切除或永久切除胃组织，患者可以从最小的术后疼痛和顺利恢复中受益，通常需要住院几天进行密切监测和初步饮食适应。

除了显着减轻体重之外，ESG 还可作为对抗代谢综合征的有力干预措施，代谢综合征是包括高血压、高血糖、内脏脂肪和异常胆固醇水平在内的一系列疾病。通过物理限制胃容量并减慢胃排空，该手术可以帮助患者实现早期饱腹感，同时有利地重置关键的胃肠激素信号。
临床研究表明，患者在 12 至 24 个月内总体体重平均减轻 15% 至 20%，同时健康状况也得到显着改善。这些包括增强胰岛素敏感性和改善 2 型糖尿病的糖化血红蛋白控制，有利于心血管健康的血压和血脂下降，以及非酒精性脂肪肝参数的降低。

林博士总结说，减肥管理并不是一刀切的。通过将无切口、器官保留技术与经过验证的代谢益处相结合，ESG 扩展了现代医疗护理的范围，使患者能够安全地重新掌控自己的健康。

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Dr Dennis Lam describes endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty (ESG) as a scarless procedure that reduces stomach capacity by 70 per cent, helping patients with metabolic syndrome achieve 15 to 20 per cent total body weight loss over 12 to 24 months without abdominal incisions.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 05:22 HKT · 2 min read

Patients in Hong Kong living with severe obesity often struggle to find the right treatment, according to Dr Dennis Lam Chin-tou, a specialist in general surgery. While laparoscopic bariatric surgery remains a highly effective gold-standard intervention, not every candidate is suited for or comfortable with a major operation, he said.

In clinical practice, patients frequently express feeling stuck in a gap: traditional lifestyle measures may yield limited long-term results, while surgical operations feel like a larger leap than they are ready to take. Obesity is a complex metabolic condition, not a failure of willpower, Dr Lam wrote in The Standard.

For those seeking a safe alternative, endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty (ESG) offers a valuable non-surgical middle ground. Unlike traditional surgery, ESG is performed entirely through the mouth under general anaesthesia without any abdominal cuts. Using a flexible endoscope equipped with a specialised suturing device, the physician places full-thickness running stitches to fold and cinch the stomach walls inward, reducing its capacity by roughly 70 per cent into a narrow tube.

Because no gastric tissue is cut or permanently removed, patients benefit from minimal post-procedure pain and a smooth recovery, typically staying in hospital for a few days for close monitoring and initial dietary adaptation.

Beyond significant weight reduction, ESG serves as a powerful intervention against metabolic syndrome, a cluster of conditions including hypertension, high blood sugar, visceral fat and abnormal cholesterol levels. By physically restricting stomach capacity and slowing gastric emptying, the procedure helps patients achieve early satiety while favourably resetting key gastrointestinal hormone signals.

Clinical studies demonstrate that patients achieve an average total body weight loss of 15 to 20 per cent over 12 to 24 months, alongside meaningful health improvements. These include enhanced insulin sensitivity and improved glycated haemoglobin control in type 2 diabetes, favourable drops in blood pressure and lipid profiles for cardiovascular health, and reductions in non-alcoholic fatty liver parameters.

Bariatric management is not one-size-fits-all, Dr Lam concluded. By pairing an incisionless, organ-sparing technique with proven metabolic benefits, ESG expands the spectrum of modern medical care, empowering patients to safely regain control of their health.

title: 49ers hold off furious Commanders' second-half rally to go 6-0
summary: SANTA CLARA, Calif. -- For about 30 minutes Monday night, the [San Francisco 49ers](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/sf/san-francisco-49ers) looked poised to roll to their sixth consecutive victory against the [Washington Commanders](ht
content:
SANTA CLARA, Calif. -- For about 30 minutes Monday night, the [San Francisco 49ers](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/sf/san-francisco-49ers) looked poised to roll to their sixth consecutive victory against the [Washington Commanders](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/wsh/washington-commanders).

Then, wide receiver [Mike Evans](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/16737/mike-evans), attempting to play through a sore right Achilles, went down after a 16-yard catch. When he finally got back up moments later, he hobbled to the locker room and did not return.

Upon his departure, he took San Francisco's momentum with him. That left the Niners doing something they haven't had to do much of this season: scrambling to pull out a late victory.

Washington battled back from a 20-point deficit in a second half that almost flipped the script. Costly 49ers penalties paired with Commanders quarterback[Jayden Daniels](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4426348/jayden-daniels)' second-half rhythm, allowed Washington to come to within inches of taking a late lead and the upset.

Instead, safety[Malik Mustapha](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4696211/malik-mustapha)'s fourth-down pass breakup at the goal line paired with a clinching sack by[Romello Height](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4432244/romello-height) and [Keion White](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4243493/keion-white) spurred the Niners to a [23-17](https://www.espn.com/nfl/game/_/gameId/401873008/commanders-49ers) win.

Though the Niners escaped with a win, the question now centers on Evans' health. San Francisco coach Kyle Shanahan said after the game that Evans' Achilles injury is the same thing (soreness) he dealt with all week. Shanahan said he didn't think Evans would need further testing or imaging.

The 49ers are already without wideouts [Ricky Pearsall](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4428209/ricky-pearsall) (knee),[De'Zhaun Stribling](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4710714/dezhaun-stribling)(ankle), [Demarcus Robinson](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3043116/demarcus-robinson) (ankle),[Deebo Samuel Sr](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3126486/deebo-samuel-sr). (hamstring) and [Christian Kirk](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3895856/christian-kirk) (calf), leaving quarterback [Brock Purdy](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4361741/brock-purdy) to throw to a patchwork group of receivers that includes [Brandin Cooks](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/16731/brandin-cooks), [Jordan Watkins](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4431466/jordan-watkins) and [Jacob Cowing](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4575665/jacob-cowing).49ers WRs not named Evans had two catches for 35 yards.

Although Kirk and Robinson are close to returning, the Niners might need to consider a trade to get some help.

Here are the most important things to know for both teams:

## [San Francisco 49ers](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/sf/san-francisco-49ers) (6-0)

**What to make of Brock Purdy's performance**: After five pass attempts on the game's opening drive, Purdy reached 1,500 career passes, which made him the highest-rated passer among qualified quarterbacks in league history. Purdy and the offense came out throwing and were on track for one of his biggest statistical performances of the season before a big lead and the injury to Evans left the Niners looking to run the ball and the clock to put away the game. Still, Purdy did more than his share in leading San Francisco to the win, finishing 21-of-29 for 264 yards and one touchdown. He didn't throw an interception and gained 28 yards on five carries.

**Stat to know:** Through the first five weeks, running back[Christian McCaffrey](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3117251/christian-mccaffrey)was averaging his lowest number of touches (16) and scrimmage yards per game (84.6) since his rookie season in 2017. That has partially been by design to help McCaffrey stay fresh, but with Evans out, the Niners needed him Monday night. McCaffrey had his most active night of the season, finishing with 25 touches for 117 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns. He also lost a fumble as San Francisco was driving deep in Washington territory.

## Top Stories

**Trend to watch:**With the exception of punter[Corliss Waitman](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3125280/corliss-waitman)'s continued excellence, the Niners special teams remained an adventure. For the second week in a row, returner [Jacob Cowing](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4575665/jacob-cowing) muffed a punt, this time inside San Francisco's 5. He recovered it, but the Niners had to begin their least effective drive of the first half from the 4. What's more, kicker [Eddy Pineiro](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4034949/eddy-pineiro) missed his third extra point attempt of the season. That goes with his three missed field goal attempts to bring his total missed kicks for the season to six. That's the most in the NFL and more than he had all of last season. The Niners also were called for fair-catch interference on a punt that set up the Commanders at their 46 with 52 seconds left. For a team that has been so good on offense and defense, special teams are again emerging as a concerning question. --_Nick Wagoner_

**Next game:**at[Atlanta Falcons](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/atl/atlanta-falcons)(Sunday, 1 p.m. ET)

## [Washington Commanders](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/wsh/washington-commanders)(1-4-1)

The Commanders were headed to an embarrassing defeat with a first half that did nothing to quell speculation on coach Dan Quinn's future -- especially after their overtime gaffe the previous week in a tie against the[New York Giants](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/nyg/new-york-giants). Washington needs to be beyond moral victories in Quinn's third season, but by rallying with a chance to win the game, the Commanders at least showed they could and would compete.

Even though multiple ownership sources said Quinn's job was safe, the rally certainly helped quiet that noise. If the Commanders play in the NFC East the way they did in the second half -- especially with how quarterback [Jayden Daniels](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4426348/jayden-daniels) has played the past two weeks -- they can have a chance. Multiple team officials pointed out before the game that, regardless of Monday's outcome, they knew the season was far from over because of the NFC East's lackluster play. First up after the bye: a home game vs. the[Philadelphia Eagles](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/phi/philadelphia-eagles). The NFC East became the first division in NFL history to go winless in consecutive weeks in which all teams in the division played a game.

**What to make of Jayden Daniels' performance**: Daniels had one bad play in the first half when, on a fourth down, he threw the ball away. Quinn said he knew it was fourth down. He said someone asked him on the headset about the illegal shift on the play. Quinn told them they couldn't now kick a field goal. But other than that, Daniels played another solid game in rallying the Commanders from a 20-3 halftime deficit. Washington lacked a running game so the burden was on Daniels to produce. He threw two touchdown passes in the second half. Perhaps his best throw came on a third-and-8 with pressure in his face as he had to throw early to receiver[Antonio Williams](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4040629/antonio-williams). The 23-yard completion and roughing penalty set up his second touchdown pass. Daniels completed 29 of 40 attempts for 300 yards.

**Trend to watch:**Red zone defense. It has been terrible for Washington as it given up 12 touchdowns in a row on red zone trips. It had given up nine straight entering the game and the 49ers scored a touchdown on their first three trips. The Commanders finally broke the streak by forcing a field goal late in the first half. They have struggled to defend tight ends in this area and, predictably,[George Kittle](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3040151/george-kittle)caught the first touchdown pass of the game against zone coverage.

**Most surprising performance:**The Commanders' second-half defense. They had given up a combined 85 points in the past four second halves. They appeared to save their worst half for the first two quarters Monday by giving up 303 yards and 20 points. But in the second half, they gave up only 64 yards and three points, putting the offense in position to rally. Washington gave up 7.4 yards per play in the first half and 3.79 in the second half.--_John Keim_

**Next game:**vs.[Philadelphia Eagles](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/phi/philadelphia-eagles)(Nov. 1, 8:20 p.m. ET)

**Help for Bhujung Tamang**

Dominic and Kayla are raising funds for Bhujung Tamang, a friend they met while traveling in Nepal before/after the Langtang trek. During that trip, Dominic and Kayla stayed with Bhujung for a few days in his village of Syabru Besi. Bhujung welcomed them with kindness and gave them a truly special local experience they have never forgotten. Now, after a devastating flood destroyed Syabru Besi, Bhujung is facing an unimaginable loss. His home and hotel were destroyed, many of his friends were killed or are missing, and he lost all of his possessions in the disaster. It is estimated that Syabru Besi still has 1300 people missing.

Dominic and Kayla met Bhujung by chance while starting their 7 day hike up the Langtang Valley, one of Nepal's premier hiking destinations. They were looking for a place to stay and found the only hotel in the Old Village of Syabru Besi. Upon getting to know Bhujung, Dominic and Kayla discovered that they were the first guests Bhujung had had in almost 3 years because he was taking care of his late mother's declining health. As a token of gratitude and friendship, Bhujung gifted Dominic and Kayla a hand stitched bag his mother made pictured above.

This fundraiser is meant to provide direct relief to Bhujung as he begins the long process of recovering and rebuilding after this tragedy. The money raised will go directly to him to help support his immediate needs (food, housing, etc.) and give him a foundation to move forward after losing so much. Dominic and Kayla are asking for donations of any amount to help Bhujung through this heartbreaking time. If you are able to give, thank you for showing compassion and support to someone who once showed such generosity to travelers far from home. Please consider donating and sharing this fundraiser to help Bhujung rebuild his life.

**Tarra Subhar Massallo**

Donation protected

After fleeing from the Chinese annexation of Tibet, many Kyirong Tibetan families crossed into Nepal believing their exile would be temporary. It was not. Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley had become their home instead- a place where hundreds of families had to rebuild from nothing, including my grandparents. Like many Tibetan refugees, they eventually moved on to build new lives in India. However, not everyone left. Some of their family stayed behind in Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley, carrying on the roots left behind by previous generations.

On August 26, 2026, a glacier collapse high in the Langtang Himal sent a wall of water and debris surging down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli Bazaar: the towns where that branch of our family stayed and built their lives after losing everything once before. **Four households in our family were directly affected:**

*   **Our cousin Dawa Dakpa (confirmed deceased) leaves behind a wife and two young children.**
*   **Aku Jangchup, his wife, and child (confirmed deceased)**
*   **Nama Nangsa Ghongma's family and relatives (missing)**
*   **Nama Karmo Subhar's family and relatives (missing)**

Now, our families face rebuilding once again, with roads and homes submerged in mud. **100% of every contribution will go directly to these impacted families and the wider flood-affected communities**as they recover together. The funds will be spent on various essentials based on each family's needs (including, but not limited to: temporary shelter, food, emergency medical care, and transportation costs). We invite you to help write the next chapter of this story. Please help support this fundraiser in any way that you can.

**Who I am:**

My name is Tarra Subhar Massallo. I am the granddaughter of Tibetan refugees who fled from Kyirong during the 1959 Chinese annexation of Tibet, and the daughter of a Tibetan immigrant mother who moved from India to the United States with her family in search of a better life. Growing up in a mixed household, I am surrounded by the importance of my many cultures and giving back to my respective communities.

The Indian Association of Sacramento (IAS) based in Sacramento , California, USA has a long-standing commitment to helping families in need. We have supported more than 40 charitable causes and raised over $250,000 for those facing hardship. We have also responded to natural disasters, including supporting victims of the 2025 Nepal earthquake.

content: 巴黎的示威活动在过去一个月中升级。 (路透社：Abdul Saboor) 抗议活动席卷欧洲，数十万人在欧洲大陆的数十个城市走上街头。 最初的示威活动始于上个月在法国，此后，骚乱已蔓延至六个国家。 虽然存在一些共同的抱怨（特别是生活成本），但问题也会因地点不同而有显著差异。 巴黎和里尔部分地区已宣布宵禁，因为一些集会演变为暴力，导致数百人被捕，并造成商店和公共建筑的广泛破坏。 现在，分析师警告称，不满情绪可能在接下来的几周内在更多国家蔓延。 以下是您需要了解的内容。 人们为何抗议？ 示威活动可以追溯到 9 月 17 日，当时巴黎东南部一所高中的教师因人员短缺问题而抗议。 随后学生也加入进来，骚乱并未花多长时间就蔓延到全国其他学校。 最初关于教育的问题已经扩大，涵盖了普遍的生活成本问题和公共部门的削减。 法国的集会变得越来越暴力，周末数万人走上街头，遍布全国。 在某些地区，商店被洗劫，历史建筑被破坏甚至纵火。 抗议者在法国各地的城市与防暴警察发生冲突，并袭击政府大楼。 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在周日晚上的电视讲话中谴责了“无节制的暴力”，并将责任归咎于激进左翼破坏者，他们劫持了一场拥有合理担忧的运动。 在法国抗议活动开始的同时，马德里的人们也开始示威，因为一家投资公司强行将一位居住了 70 年的老人的租金提高了 230%，并将其赶出了家。 马里卡门·阿巴斯卡尔，87 岁，在被强制从公寓中移走后两周死于医院。 骚乱已经蔓延，现在多个国家的集会正在进行。以下是首次示威活动发生的时间和地点： 这张地图显示了抗议活动规模最大的地区。 我们是如何走到这一步的？ 法国拥有欧元区第二大经济体。但政府正面临高债务、巨额预算赤字和不断上升的借贷成本。 今年，它将花费比国防或教育更多的钱来偿还债务。 虽然学校和教学资源的状态在法国一直是焦点（特别是点燃了最初的集会），但大陆各地吸引人们走上街头的问题不止一个。 大多数问题都与生活成本上升有关。以下是概述： 示威活动的影响实际上取决于您身在何处。 在法国，巴黎的官员周一鼓励其地区 counterparts 实施宵禁。与此同时，西班牙正面临 11 月 29 日的突然选举，这是首相佩德罗·桑切斯在住房改革（旨在遏制公众抗议）被立法者拒绝后不久宣布的。 阿尔巴尼亚的问题与西欧略有不同。政府腐败是吸引人们要求改变首都地拉那局势的主要原因之一，那里有政客被指控使用狡猾的手段批准与特朗普家族相关的豪华沿海开发项目。 马德里抗议者在本月初发出他们的声音。 (路透社：Violeta Santos Moura) 接下来可能发生什么？ 在法国，政府已举行危机会议，巴黎和里尔部分地区宣布宵禁。这是在抗议者承诺在未来几天升级行动之后。 该国距离总统选举不到六个月，各政党互相指责煽动暴力。 例如，极右翼政治领袖玛丽娜·勒庞将责任完全归咎于政府，称法国处于“暴力与无助之间，甚至被挟持”。 事实上，欧洲正面临一些专家所称的“超级选举周期”，这可能加剧紧张局势，因为多个国家将在未来 12 个月内进行选举。 与此同时，阿尔巴尼亚总理埃迪·拉马承诺留任，尽管面临辞职呼吁，因此那些已经使警察陷入困境的抗议活动可能会再次爆发。 意大利、葡萄牙和比利时的政府都谴责了日益增长的暴力行为，并未提供任何让步。 过去几周，希腊、奥地利、爱尔兰和德国也记录了较小的示威活动。

title: Hong Kong hairy crab shops struggle as more shoppers head north
zh_title: 随着越来越多的购物者北上，香港大闸蟹店陷入困境
summary: 香港 由于跨境购物和网上竞争，香港传统大闸蟹店的生意面临 10% 至 20% 的下降，铜锣湾一家零售商报告订单下降和游客减少。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 19 日 18:16 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 Hong香港历史悠久的大闸蟹店正面临跨境采购和网上购物日益激烈的竞争，铜锣湾零售商之一
content:
香港
由于跨境购物和网上竞争，香港传统大闸蟹店的生意面临 10% 至 20% 的下降，铜锣湾一家零售商报告订单下降和游客减少。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 19 日 18:16 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港历史悠久的大闸蟹店正面临来自跨境购买和网上购物的日益激烈的竞争，铜锣湾的一家零售商报告今年的业务下降了 10% 至 20%。

《英文虎报》的姊妹刊物《星岛头条》走访了两家传统大闸蟹店，发现随着时令美食重返市场，销量参差不齐。一家店的老板表示，今年新顾客很少，主要靠老顾客，生意比去年同期下降了10%至20%。

她表示，体型较小、价格更实惠的螃蟹销量下降了 20% 至 30%，部分原因是经济压力、网上购物以及大陆购买大闸蟹的趋势日益增长。往年旺季，有顾客订购了1000多只螃蟹作为礼物。但她表示，今年的订单数量和规模均有所下降。
她还指出，过去在离开香港之前购买螃蟹的酒店客人和游客已基本消失。十一月通常是生意最繁忙的月份，她说她有些担心销售情况。

然而，对五至六两或以上的中型螃蟹的需求保持稳定，而对较大螃蟹的订单则略有增加。重阳节前夕，该店增加了9至10两螃蟹的订单，以满足顾客寻求更丰盛的时令大餐的需求。

与此同时，另一家已经经营了50至60年的商店的老板表示，货源充足，价格与往年相似，而且质量也有所提高。他表示，该店的业务基本保持稳定，部分原因是在线销售约占其收入的 30% 至 40%。他说，虽然团体聚会的大订单已不再常见，但购买螃蟹在家吃的顾客的小订单却有所增加。

尽管越来越多的香港人前往内地购买大闸蟹，但他警告说，质量并不总是有保证。他说，香港出售的大闸蟹质量普遍较好。他补充说，大多数顾客更喜欢在购买前亲自检查螃蟹，只有在对零售商产生信心后才转向网上购买。

Hong Kong
Traditional hairy crab shops in Hong Kong face a 10 to 20 per cent drop in business due to cross-border shopping and online competition, with one Causeway Bay retailer reporting declining orders and fewer tourists.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

19 Oct 2026 at 18:16 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's long-established hairy crab shops are facing growing competition from cross-border purchases and online shopping, with one Causeway Bay retailer reporting a 10 to 20 per cent drop in business this year.

A visit by Sing Tao Headline, a sister publication of The Standard, to two traditional hairy crab shops found mixed sales as the seasonal delicacy returned to the market. The owner of one shop said it had attracted few new customers this year and was relying mainly on regulars, with business down 10 to 20 per cent from the same period last year.

She said sales of smaller, more affordable crabs had fallen by 20 to 30 per cent, partly due to economic pressures, online shopping and the growing trend of buying hairy crabs on the mainland. In previous peak seasons, some customers had ordered more than 1,000 crabs as gifts. But both the quantity and size of orders had declined this year, she said.

She also noted that hotel guests and tourists who used to buy crabs before leaving Hong Kong had largely disappeared. November is usually the busiest month for the business, and she said she was somewhat concerned about sales.

However, demand for medium-sized crabs weighing five to six taels or more remained stable, while orders for larger crabs had edged up. Ahead of the Chung Yeung Festival, the shop increased orders for crabs weighing nine to 10 taels to meet demand from customers seeking a more substantial seasonal feast.

Meanwhile, the owner of another shop, which has been operating for 50 to 60 years, said supplies were plentiful and prices were similar to previous years, while quality had also improved. He said the shop's business had remained broadly stable, partly because online sales accounted for around 30 to 40 per cent of its revenue. While large orders for group gatherings had become less common, smaller orders from customers buying crabs to eat at home had increased, he said.

Although more Hongkongers were heading to the mainland to buy hairy crabs, he cautioned that quality was not always guaranteed. He said hairy crabs sold in Hong Kong were generally of better quality. He added that most customers preferred to inspect crabs in person before buying, switching to online purchases only after they had developed confidence in a retailer.

香港浸会大学于 10 月 16 日至 18 日举行首届 AI-TEM 2026 会议，聚集了 200 多名国际学者，讨论人工智能的伦理挑战。该活动与波士顿大学、高丽大学和维也纳大学合作，重点关注扩大响应

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 19 日 22:12 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港浸会大学（HKBU）于10月16日至18日主办首届AI-TEM 2026：人工智能、科技与新兴媒体国际会议，云集了200多名国际学者、教师和研究生。该活动由波士顿大学、高丽大学和维也纳大学合作举办，主题是“扩展负责任的人工智能通信”。

演讲者和与会者讨论了人工智能带来的伦理挑战，包括隐藏的不平等、不平衡的采用和新形式的排斥。演讲和辩论的重点是传播研究如何帮助建立一个更具包容性和对社会有益的未来。香港浸会大学传理学院院长钟布在会议开幕式上表示：“人工智能的未来不仅仅是技术的问题，更是人类的问题。工程师可以告诉我们算法有多高效，但只有传播学者才能解释社会为何存在。
波士顿大学的 James E. Katz 强调了国际合作的重要性，并指出四所大学的目标是在快速变化的人工智能和媒体领域促进探究自由和独立思想。此次活动邀请了香港大学的 Michael Chau Chiu-lung、波士顿大学的 Yang Sung-Un、维也纳大学的 Jörg Matthes、智利天主教大学的 Ingrid Bachmann 和高丽大学的 Jennifer Ihm 等顶尖学者发表主题演讲，提供有关人工智能、传播和新兴媒体的全球视角。

一个亮点是互动会议，将来自当地几所中学的学生与国际学者联系起来。学生们就人工智能的伦理影响、其在日常生活中的作用以及对就业市场的未来影响进行了讨论，将年轻人的声音带入有关负责任人工智能的全球辩论中。会议还包括研究论文展示和三场专门小组会议。

会议结束时，香港浸会大学、波士顿大学、高丽大学和维也纳大学承诺继续合作并倡导以人为本、对社会负责的人工智能通信研究。

Hong Kong Baptist University held the inaugural AI-TEM 2026 conference from October 16 to 18, gathering over 200 international scholars to discuss ethical challenges of AI. The event, in partnership with Boston University, Korea University, and the University of Vienna, focused on extending responsi

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

19 Oct 2026 at 22:12 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) hosted the first AI-TEM 2026: AI, Technology & Emerging Media international conference from October 16 to 18, gathering more than 200 international scholars, faculty, and graduate students. The event, organized in partnership with Boston University, Korea University, and the University of Vienna, focused on the theme of 'Extending Responsible AI Communication'.

Speakers and participants discussed ethical challenges posed by AI, including hidden inequalities, uneven adoption, and new forms of exclusion. Presentations and debates centered on how communication research can help build a more inclusive and socially beneficial future. Zhong Bu, Dean of HKBU's School of Communication, opened the conference by stating: 'The future of AI isn't just about technology, it is a human question. Engineers can tell us how efficient an algorithm can be, but only communication scholars can explain why society exists as it does.'

James E. Katz of Boston University highlighted the importance of international collaboration, noting that the four universities aim to promote freedom of inquiry and independent thought in the rapidly changing field of AI and media. The event featured keynote presentations from leading academics including Michael Chau Chiu-lung from the University of Hong Kong, Yang Sung-Un from Boston University, Jörg Matthes from the University of Vienna, Ingrid Bachmann from the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile, and Jennifer Ihm from Korea University, offering global perspectives on AI, communication, and emerging media.

A highlight was an interactive session connecting students from several local secondary schools with international scholars. Students engaged in discussions on AI's ethical implications, its role in daily life, and future implications for the job market, bringing youth voices into the global debate on responsible AI. The conference also included research paper presentations and three specialized panel sessions.

The conference concluded with HKBU, Boston University, Korea University and the University of Vienna pledging to continue their collaboration and champion research into human-centered, socially responsible AI communication.

# Sean dineen's mission to get my dissertation published

Support My Mission to Empower the Exceptionality Community As a person with cerebral palsy and many years advocating for people with exceptionalities, I’ve seen firsthand how society often dismisses their potential. Many are denied opportunities and classified in ways that stifle their growth, creating dependency instead of independence. This is not just morally unacceptable—it holds society back from innovation and progress. When my wheelchair got mislaid, I crawled through the streets. My research challenges these norms. By exploring how nondemocratic societies like Taiwan and apartheid South Africa engaged with the exceptionality community, I’ve uncovered surprising insights. These nations, despite their flaws, prioritized accessibility and genuine inclusion, consulting directly with the communities they aimed to serve. My work highlights how these approaches can inform global policies to create more inclusive and thriving societies. Now, I need your help to complete this vital research. I’ve traveled extensively, gathering data from South Africa, Australia, and the U.S. But key documents are located in one South African city, while interviews with 13 political leaders are required in another. As someone with cerebral palsy, I also need two assistants to make my travel and research possible. I’ve raised $1,500 toward my $10,000 goal, but I still need $8,500 to finish. Completing this dissertation is not just a personal milestone—it’s a step toward improving opportunities for the exceptionality community worldwide. Your support, no matter the amount, will make a difference. Together, we can replace outdated perceptions with true inclusion, unlocking the potential of millions. Thank you for joining me in this mission.

**Help Me Study Abroad in Taiwan – A Journey of Language, Culture & Growth**

Hi everyone,

I’m excited to share that I’ve been given an incredible opportunity to study abroad in Taiwan (June 3 - July 1)! This program will allow me to fully immerse myself in a new culture while studying Mandarin Chinese and engaging in meaningful cross-cultural experiences.

Studying abroad in Taiwan is more than just travel for me — it’s a chance to grow academically, professionally, and personally.

Why Taiwan?

Taiwan is known for its rich history and welcoming communities. By living and studying there, I will:

Strengthen my Mandarin Chinese language skills

Build cross-cultural communication skills

Study alongside local and international students

Experience Taiwanese traditions, festivals, and daily life firsthand

Develop independence, adaptability, and global awareness

**Why I’m Fundraising**

While I’ve worked hard to prepare for this opportunity, studying abroad comes with significant expenses, including:

Program tuition and fees

Housing

Flights

Cultural excursions and educational activities

Any contribution — big or small — will help make this life-changing experience possible.

**Your support is not just helping me travel — you are investing in my education, personal growth, and future.** I’m so grateful for any encouragement, donations, or shares. I can’t wait to share updates, photos, and stories from Taiwan along the way! Thank you for being part of this journey with me!

title: Volta doubles Springer rare earths, eyes 2027 study
zh_title: Volta 将 Springer 稀土产量翻倍，着眼 2027 年研究
summary: Volta Metals (CSE: VLTA) 已将其位于安大略省的 Springer 矿床的指示稀土资源量增加了一倍多，随着 2027 年经济评估的进展，该项目按测量和指示资源吨位跻身北美五个最大的项目之列。更新后的矿产资源估算将指示资源量增加了 116%，达到 1.224 亿吨，总稀土氧化物 (TREO) 品位为 0.59%。另外 1.975 亿吨品位 0.53% TREO 被归类为推断。独立准备的估算还包括该项目的第一次镓资源评估。 “我们相信
content:
Volta Metals (CSE: VLTA) 已将其位于安大略省的 Springer 矿床的指示稀土资源量增加了一倍多，随着 2027 年经济评估的进展，该项目按测量和指示资源吨位跻身北美五个最大的项目之列。更新后的矿产资源估算将指示资源量增加了 116%，达到 1.224 亿吨，总稀土氧化物 (TREO) 品位为 0.59%。另外 1.975 亿吨品位 0.53% TREO 被归类为推断。独立准备的估算还包括该项目的第一次镓资源评估。 Volta 总裁兼首席执行官凯雷姆·乌斯梅兹 (Kerem Usenmez) 在一份声明中表示：“我们相信，在市场为中国以外的供应支付溢价之际，斯普林格正在成为北美少数几个大型、可通过公路获取的磁铁稀土和潜在镓来源之一。”萨德伯里首席执行官表示，萨德伯里在“披萨外卖区”举办了大型稀土项目，此次扩张正值西方政府寻求减少对中国的依赖，中国在全球稀土加工和镓生产中占据主导地位。这两种商品都具有重要的战略意义，稀土用于电动汽车和风力涡轮机的永磁体，而镓对于某些半导体技术至关重要。
高品位扩张 Springer 表示，高品位核心产量增长了 140%，达到 2,760 万吨，TREO 品位为 1%，预计金属净收入为每吨 384 加元（272 美元），相当于原地金属总价值 106 亿加元（75 亿美元）。推断的高品位核心产量增加了九倍，达到 2,670 万吨，TREO 品位为 0.94%，估计金属净收入为每吨 333 加元（236 美元），或原地总价值 89 亿加元（63 亿美元）。该区域仍然开放以进行扩张。该矿床在其指示资源范围内还含有估计 4,427 吨原位镓，其中包括 1,480 万吨的高品位区域，平均每吨 56 克。镓可以提供额外的收入来源，尽管 Volta 尚未确定这种金属是否可以经济地回收。该公司正在进行冶金研究，以评估回收方法和潜在的商业可行性。磁铁稀土（钕、镨、镝和铽）约占指定资源稀土氧化物总含量的 22.4%，Volta 表示这一比例是北美最高的之一。北美稀土项目按测量和指示吨位排名，包括报告的储量。推断吨位单独显示以供上下文参考，不用于排名。 （标普全球市场情报数据库，2025 年 5 月；施普林格于 2026 年 9 月 30 日 MRE。
根据该公司引用的标准普尔全球市场情报数据，按实测和指示资源吨位计算，施普林格在北美稀土项目中排名第五。不过，该排名衡量的是资源规模而不是经济潜力，也没有考虑品位、冶金、开发成本或项目成熟度的差异。发展前景 Springer 位于萨德伯里以东约 70 公里处，受益于直接的高速公路、现场电力以及附近的天然气和铁路基础设施。该矿床的低剥采率也可以支持未来的矿山开发，尽管该项目的经济性尚未经过测试。 Volta 计划进行额外钻探以扩大和提炼资源，同时推进稀土冶金工作

【原文 English Original】
Volta Metals (CSE: VLTA) has more than doubled the indicated rare earth resource at its Springer deposit in Ontario, placing the project among North America’s five largest by measured and indicated resource tonnage as it advances toward an economic assessment in 2027. The updated mineral resource estimate increased indicated resources by 116% to 122.4 million tonnes grading 0.59% total rare earth oxides (TREO). A further 197.5 million tonnes grading 0.53% TREO are classified as inferred. The independently prepared estimate also includes the project’s first gallium resource assessment. “We believe Springer is shaping up as one of the few large, road-accessible sources of magnet rare earths, and potentially gallium, in North America, at a time when the market is paying a premium for supply from outside China,” Volta president and CEO Kerem Usenmez said in a statement. Sudbury hosts major rare earth project ‘in a pizza delivery zone,’ CEO says The expansion comes as Western governments seek to reduce their dependence on China, which dominates global rare earth processing and gallium production. Both commodities are strategically important, with rare earths used in permanent magnets for electric vehicles and wind turbines, while gallium is essential to certain semiconductor technologies. High-grade expansion Springer’s indicated high-grade core grew 140% to 27.6 million tonnes grading 1% TREO, with an estimated net metal revenue of C$384 ($272) per tonne, equivalent to C$10.6 billion ($7.5 billion) in gross in-situ metal value. The inferred high-grade core increased ninefold to 26.7 million tonnes grading 0.94% TREO, with an estimated net metal revenue of C$333 per tonne ($236), or C$8.9 billion ($6.3 billion) in gross in-situ value. The zone remains open for expansion. The deposit also contains an estimated 4,427 tonnes of in-situ gallium within its indicated resource, including a higher-grade zone of 14.8 million tonnes averaging 56 grams per tonne. Gallium could provide an additional revenue stream, although Volta has yet to establish whether the metal can be economically recovered. The company is conducting metallurgical studies to assess recovery methods and potential commercial viability. Magnet rare earths — neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium and terbium — account for about 22.4% of the indicated resource’s total rare earth oxide content, a proportion Volta says is among the highest in North America. North American rare earth projects ranked by Measured and Indicated tonnage, including Reserves where reported. Inferred tonnage is shown separately for context and is not used in the ranking. ( S&P Global Market Intelligence database, May 2025; Springer at the September 30, 2026 MRE. ) Springer ranks fifth among North American rare earth projects by combined measured and indicated resource tonnage, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence data cited by the company. However, the ranking measures resource size rather than economic potential and does not account for differences in grade, metallurgy, development costs or project maturity. Development outlook Located about 70 km east of Sudbury, Springer benefits from direct highway access, on-site power and nearby natural gas and rail infrastructure. The deposit’s low strip ratio could also support future mine development, although the project’s economics remain untested. Volta plans additional drilling to expand and refine the resource while advancing metallurgical work on rare earth and gallium recovery. The company is targeting a preliminary economic assessment (PEA) in the first half of 2027, which would provide an initial evaluation of potential mining costs, processing requirements and project economics.
